File: app/Console/Commands/ImportSdm.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Services\Import\EmployeeImporter;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ImportSdm extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'sdm:import
        {employees : path CSV Data Employee (delimiter ;)}
        {training : path CSV Training Record (delimiter ;)}
        {--fresh : kosongkan tabel employees dan training_records dulu}';

    protected $description = 'Import dan bersihkan data employee serta training record';

    public function handle(EmployeeImporter $empImporter, TrainingImporter $trainImporter): int
    {
        if ($this->option('fresh')) {
            DB::table('training_records')->delete();
            DB::table('employees')->delete();
        }

        $this->info('Import employees...');
        $empBatch = $empImporter->import($this->argument('employees'));
        $this->info("Employee import completed: {$empBatch->rows_imported} imported, {$empBatch->rows_skipped} skipped out of {$empBatch->rows_total} rows.");
        if ($empBatch->warnings) {
            $this->warn('Warnings:');
            foreach ($empBatch->warnings as $k => $w) {
                $this->line("- {$w['message']}: {$w['count']} times");
            }
        }

        $this->info('Import training records...');
        $trainBatch = $trainImporter->import($this->argument('training'));
        $this->info("Training import completed: {$trainBatch->rows_imported} imported, {$trainBatch->rows_skipped} skipped out of {$trainBatch->rows_total} rows.");
        if ($trainBatch->warnings) {
            $this->warn('Warnings:');
            foreach ($trainBatch->warnings as $k => $w) {
                $this->line("- {$w['message']}: {$w['count']} times");
            }
        }

        $this->report();

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function report(): void
    {
        $unmapped = DB::table('company_aliases')->whereNull('company_id')->count();
        $total = DB::table('company_aliases')->count();

        $this->newLine();
        $this->warn("Alias Nama PT belum terpetakan: $unmapped dari $total.");
        $this->line('Lihat: SELECT alias FROM company_aliases WHERE company_id IS NULL;');
    }
}

File: app/Console/Commands/SyncPortalCommand.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Throwable;

class SyncPortalCommand extends Command
{
    /**
     * The name and signature of the console command.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $signature = 'sdm:sync-portal {--dry-run : Simulasi penarikan data portal tanpa mengubah database} {--scheduled : Penjalanan otomatis dari scheduler}';

    /**
     * The console command description.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $description = 'Tarik data training dari Portal FR Academy';

    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     */
    public function handle(TrainingImporter $importer): int
    {
        $dryRun = (bool) $this->option('dry-run');
        $scheduled = (bool) $this->option('scheduled');

        $modeText = $scheduled ? ' (terjadwal)' : ($dryRun ? ' (dry-run)' : '');
        $this->info("Menjalankan sync portal{$modeText}...");

        try {
            $batch = $importer->importFromPortal(null, $dryRun, $scheduled);

            if ($batch->status === 'failed') {
                $err = is_array($batch->warnings) ? ($batch->warnings['error'] ?? 'Gagal') : 'Gagal';
                $this->error("Gagal! {$err}");

                return Command::FAILURE;
            }

            $this->info("Berhasil! Total: {$batch->rows_total}, Diimpor: {$batch->rows_imported}, Dilewati: {$batch->rows_skipped}");

            return Command::SUCCESS;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->error('Gagal: '.$e->getMessage());

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }
    }
}

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DefaultValueBinder;

class EmployeesExport extends DefaultValueBinder implements FromQuery, WithCustomValueBinder, WithHeadings, WithMapping
{
    use Exportable;

    protected $query;

    public function __construct($query)
    {
        $this->query = $query;
    }

    public function query(): Builder|\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|Relation
    {
        return $this->query;
    }

    public function headings(): array
    {
        return [
            'ID Database',
            'Employee ID / NIK',
            'Nama',
            'Tanggal Lahir',
            'Tempat Lahir',
            'Tanggal Bergabung',
            'Tipe Pekerjaan',
            'Kode Level Jabatan',
            'Kode Jabatan',
            'Nama Jabatan',
            'Kode Organisasi',
            'Nama Organisasi',
            'Perusahaan',
            'Lokasi',
            'Gender',
            'Status Pernikahan',
            'Agama',
            'Kode PTKP',
            'Nama PTKP',
            'Group',
            'Region',
        ];
    }

    public function map($employee): array
    {
        return [
            $employee->id,
            $employee->employee_id,
            $employee->name,
            $employee->birth_date,
            $employee->birth_place,
            $employee->join_date,
            $employee->employment_type,
            $employee->job_level_code,
            $employee->job_title_code,
            $employee->job_title_name,
            $employee->organization_code,
            $employee->organization_name,
            $employee->company ? $employee->company->name : null,
            $employee->location ? $employee->location->name : null,
            $employee->gender,
            $employee->marital_status,
            $employee->religion,
            $employee->ptkp_code,
            $employee->ptkp_name,
            $employee->group,
            $employee->region,
        ];
    }

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        $column = $cell->getColumn();
        // Force these code columns to be explicit strings to prevent scientific notation
        if (in_array($column, ['B', 'H', 'I', 'K', 'R'])) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);

            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }
}

            $record->year,
            $record->days,
            $record->hours,
            $record->training_name,
            $record->instructor,
            $record->venue,
            $record->regularity,
            $record->source_type,
            $record->level,
        ];

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        $column = $cell->getColumn();

        if (in_array($column, ['B', 'C'])) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);

            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

class UserController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Tampilkan daftar akun pengguna dengan filter dan statistik.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $query = User::query()
            ->with(['employee:employee_id,name,job_title_name,organization_name,region'])
            ->when($request->filled('search'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $term = trim((string) $request->input('search'));
                $q->where(function ($sub) use ($term) {
                    $sub->where('name', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                        ->orWhere('nik', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                        ->orWhere('job_title', 'like', "%{$term}%");
                });
            })
            ->when($request->filled('role'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $q->where('role', $request->input('role'));
            })
            ->when($request->filled('status'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $status = $request->input('status');
                if ($status === 'active') {
                    $q->where('is_active', true);
                } elseif ($status === 'inactive') {
                    $q->where('is_active', false);
                }
            })
            ->orderByRaw("CASE WHEN role = 'superadmin' THEN 1 WHEN role = 'manajemen' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END")
            ->orderBy('name');

        return Inertia::render('Admin/Users', [
            'users' => $query->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'filters' => [
                'search' => (string) $request->input('search', ''),
                'role' => (string) $request->input('role', ''),
                'status' => (string) $request->input('status', ''),
            ],
            'stats' => [
                'total' => User::count(),
                'superadmin' => User::where('role', 'superadmin')->count(),
                'manajemen' => User::where('role', 'manajemen')->count(),
                'viewer' => User::where('role', 'viewer')->count(),
                'active' => User::where('is_active', true)->count(),
                'inactive' => User::where('is_active', false)->count(),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint live autocomplete pencarian karyawan berdasarkan NIK atau Nama.
     */
    public function searchEmployee(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $term = trim((string) $request->input('q', ''));

        if (strlen($term) < 1) {
            return response()->json([]);
        }

        $existingNiks = User::whereNotNull('nik')->pluck('nik')->flip()->toArray();

        $employees = Employee::query()
            ->where(function ($sub) use ($term) {
                $sub->where('employee_id', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                    ->orWhere('name', 'like', "%{$term}%");
            })
            ->limit(10)
            ->get(['employee_id', 'name', 'job_title_name', 'organization_name', 'region'])
            ->map(function (Employee $emp) use ($existingNiks) {
                return [
                    'employee_id' => $emp->employee_id,
                    'name' => $emp->name,
                    'job_title_name' => $emp->job_title_name,
                    'organization_name' => $emp->organization_name,
                    'region' => $emp->region,
                    'already_registered' => isset($existingNiks[$emp->employee_id]),
                ];
            });

        return response()->json($employees);
    }

    /**
     * Daftarkan akun baru (dari data karyawan atau input manual akun Direksi).
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $isManual = $request->boolean('is_manual');

        if ($isManual) {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'nik' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50', 'unique:users,nik'],
                'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'job_title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'role' => ['required', 'string', Rule::in(['superadmin', 'manajemen', 'viewer'])],
                'password' => ['required', 'string', 'min:6'],
                'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            ], [
                'nik.required' => 'NIK atau ID Akun wajib diisi.',
                'nik.unique' => 'NIK / ID ini sudah terdaftar sebagai pengguna sistem.',
                'name.required' => 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi.',
                'job_title.required' => 'Jabatan wajib diisi.',
                'role.required' => 'Pilih role hak akses pengguna.',
                'role.in' => 'Role yang dipilih tidak valid.',
                'password.required' => 'Kata sandi wajib diisi.',
                'password.min' => 'Kata sandi minimal terdiri dari 6 karakter.',
            ]);

            User::create([
                'nik' => $validated['nik'],
                'name' => $validated['name'],
                'job_title' => $validated['job_title'],
                'role' => $validated['role'],
                'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
                'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
            ]);

            return back()->with('success', "Akun Direksi / Khusus untuk {$validated['name']} ({$validated['nik']}) berhasil dibuat dengan jabatan {$validated['job_title']}.");
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nik' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50', 'unique:users,nik', 'exists:employees,employee_id'],
            'role' => ['required', 'string', Rule::in(['superadmin', 'manajemen', 'viewer'])],
            'password' => ['required', 'string', 'min:6'],
            'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ], [
            'nik.required' => 'NIK wajib diisi.',
            'nik.unique' => 'NIK ini sudah terdaftar sebagai pengguna sistem.',
            'nik.exists' => 'NIK tidak ditemukan pada master data karyawan.',
            'role.required' => 'Pilih role hak akses pengguna.',
            'role.in' => 'Role yang dipilih tidak valid.',
            'password.required' => 'Kata sandi wajib diisi.',
            'password.min' => 'Kata sandi minimal terdiri dari 6 karakter.',
        ]);

        $employee = Employee::where('employee_id', $validated['nik'])->first();
        $name = $employee ? $employee->name : $validated['nik'];
        $jobTitle = $employee ? $employee->job_title_name : null;

        User::create([
            'nik' => $validated['nik'],
            'name' => $name,
            'job_title' => $jobTitle,
            'role' => $validated['role'],
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
            'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', "Akun untuk {$name} ({$validated['nik']}) berhasil dibuat dengan role ".ucfirst($validated['role']).'.');
    }

    /**
     * Perbarui role hak akses akun pengguna.
     */
    public function updateRole(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'role' => ['required', 'string', Rule::in(['superadmin', 'manajemen', 'viewer'])],
        ], [
            'role.required' => 'Role wajib dipilih.',
            'role.in' => 'Pilihan role tidak valid.',
        ]);

        $currentUser = $request->user();

        if ($user->id === $currentUser->id && $validated['role'] !== 'superadmin') {
            return back()->with('error', 'Anda tidak dapat menurunkan role akun Anda sendiri.');
        }

        if ($user->isSuperAdmin() && $validated['role'] !== 'superadmin' && User::where('role', 'superadmin')->count() <= 1) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Tidak dapat mengubah role superadmin terakhir dalam sistem.');
        }

        $user->update(['role' => $validated['role']]);

        return back()->with('success', "Role akun {$user->name} berhasil diubah menjadi ".ucfirst($validated['role']).'.');
    }

    /**
     * Reset kata sandi pengguna.
     */
    public function resetPassword(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'password' => ['required', 'string', 'min:6'],
        ], [
            'password.required' => 'Kata sandi baru wajib diisi.',
            'password.min' => 'Kata sandi minimal 6 karakter.',
        ]);

        $user->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', "Kata sandi untuk akun {$user->name} ({$user->nik}) berhasil direset.");
    }

    /**
     * Aktifkan atau nonaktifkan akun pengguna.
     */
    public function toggleStatus(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $currentUser = $request->user();

        if ($user->id === $currentUser->id) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Anda tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun Anda sendiri.');
        }

        if ($user->isSuperAdmin() && $user->is_active && User::where('role', 'superadmin')->where('is_active', true)->count() <= 1) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Tidak dapat menonaktifkan satu-satunya akun Superadmin yang aktif.');
        }

        $newStatus = ! $user->is_active;
        $user->update(['is_active' => $newStatus]);

        $statusText = $newStatus ? 'diaktifkan' : 'dinonaktifkan';

        return back()->with('success', "Akun {$user->name} ({$user->nik}) berhasil {$statusText}.");
    }

    /**
     * Hapus akun pengguna dari sistem.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $currentUser = $request->user();

        if ($user->id === $currentUser->id) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Anda tidak dapat menghapus akun Anda sendiri.');
        }

        if ($user->isSuperAdmin() && User::where('role', 'superadmin')->count() <= 1) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Tidak dapat menghapus superadmin terakhir dalam sistem.');
        }

        $userName = $user->name;
        $userNik = $user->nik;
        $user->delete();

        return back()->with('success', "Akun {$userName} ({$userNik}) berhasil dihapus dari sistem.");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Clean;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use App\Support\TrainingFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DataController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Endpoint /data/map/locations sudah dihapus bersama peta.
     * Method ini ditinggalkan agar tidak 404, redirected ke companies.
     *
     * @deprecated
     */
    public function locations(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        return response()->json([]);
    }

    public function companies(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get(['company_id', 'location_id', 'region', 'birth_date']);
        $companyIds = $employees->pluck('company_id')->unique()->filter();

        // Ambil semua lokasi terkait secara bulk
        $locationIds = $employees->pluck('location_id')->unique()->filter();
        $locations = Location::whereIn('id', $locationIds)->get(['id', 'code', 'name'])->keyBy('id');

        $companies = Company::whereIn('id', $companyIds)->get()->map(function ($c) use ($employees, $locations) {
            $emps = $employees->where('company_id', $c->id);

            // Lokasi unit untuk perusahaan ini
            $companyLocIds = $emps->pluck('location_id')->unique()->filter();
            $companyLocations = $companyLocIds->map(fn ($id) => $locations->get($id))->filter();
            $locNames = $companyLocations->pluck('name')->filter()->values()->all();
            $locCodes = $companyLocations->pluck('code')->filter()->values()->all();

            // Hitung generasi mini untuk generation bar di galeri
            $generations = [];
            foreach ($emps as $e) {
                if ($e->birth_date) {
                    $g = Demographics::generation(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)->year);
                    if ($g) {
                        $generations[$g] = ($generations[$g] ?? 0) + 1;
                    }
                }
            }

            $meta = Clean::companyMeta($c->name, $locNames);

            return [
                'id' => $c->id,
                'code' => $c->code,
                'name' => $c->name,
                'group' => $c->group,
                'employee_count' => $emps->count(),
                'location_count' => $companyLocIds->count(),
                'region' => Clean::region($emps->first()->region ?? $c->region) ?? 'Unknown',
                'generations' => $generations,
                'initials' => $meta['initials'],
                'aliases' => $meta['aliases'],
                'facilities' => Clean::facilities($locNames),
                'location_names' => $locNames,
                'location_codes' => $locCodes,
            ];
        })->sortByDesc('employee_count')->values();

        return response()->json([
            'data' => $companies,
            'total_locations' => $employees->pluck('location_id')->unique()->filter()->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function companyProfile(Request $request, Company $company, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        // Daftar lengkap seluruh unit operasional perusahaan (tetap utuh meskipun sedang difilter lokasi)
        $allCompanyEmployees = Employee::query()->where('company_id', $company->id)->get(['id', 'location_id']);
        $totalCompanyHc = $allCompanyEmployees->count();

        $allLocIds = $allCompanyEmployees->pluck('location_id')->filter()->unique();
        $locNames = Location::whereIn('id', $allLocIds)->pluck('name', 'id');
        $locCounts = $allCompanyEmployees->groupBy('location_id')->map(fn ($g) => $g->count());

        $locDetails = [];
        foreach ($allLocIds as $locId) {
            $locDetails[] = [
                'id' => $locId,
                'name' => $locNames[$locId] ?? 'Unknown',
                'count' => $locCounts[$locId] ?? 0,
            ];
        }
        usort($locDetails, fn ($a, $b) => $b['count'] <=> $a['count']);

        // Filter diterapkan untuk menghitung analitik spesifik (misal per kebun/pabrik/unit)
        $query = Employee::query()->where('company_id', $company->id);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        $employees = $query->get();

        $totalHc = $employees->count();
        if ($totalHc === 0 && ! $request->filled('location_id')) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'No data'], 404);
        }

        $females = $employees->where('gender', 'Female')->count();
        $perm = $employees->filter(fn ($e) => in_array($e->employment_type, ['PERM', 'PERMANENT'], true))->count();

        // Untuk umur dan masa kerja, ambil yg valid saja
        $ages = $employees->map(fn ($e) => Demographics::age(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)))->filter();
        $loses = $employees->map(fn ($e) => Demographics::los(Carbon::parse($e->join_date)))->filter();

        $avgAge = $ages->count() > 0 ? $ages->average() : 0;
        $avgLos = $loses->count() > 0 ? $loses->average() : 0;

        // Demografi: Generasi
        $generations = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $g = Demographics::generation(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)->year);
            if ($g) {
                $generations[$g] = ($generations[$g] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        // Job Level
        $levels = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if ($e->job_level_code) {
                $levels[$e->job_level_code] = ($levels[$e->job_level_code] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        // Department
        $depts = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if ($e->organization_name) {
                $depts[$e->organization_name] = ($depts[$e->organization_name] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }
        arsort($depts);
        $depts = array_slice($depts, 0, 8);

        // Ringkasan pelatihan perusahaan (dari baris terhubung saja)
        $empIds = $employees->pluck('id')->all();
        $trainings = DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereIn('employee_id', $empIds)
            ->get(['employee_id', 'training_name', 'hours', 'regularity', 'source_type']);

        $totalTrainingHours = round((float) $trainings->sum('hours'), 1);
        $trainedHc = $trainings->pluck('employee_id')->unique()->count();
        $trainingCoverage = $totalHc > 0 ? round(($trainedHc / $totalHc) * 100, 1) : 0;
        $avgHoursPerTrainee = $trainedHc > 0 ? round($totalTrainingHours / $trainedHc, 1) : 0;

        // Analisis Demografi Mendalam: Usia Bins & Gender
        $ageBins = [
            '<25' => ['name' => '<25', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '25-29' => ['name' => '25-29', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '30-34' => ['name' => '30-34', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '35-39' => ['name' => '35-39', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '40-44' => ['name' => '40-44', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '45-49' => ['name' => '45-49', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '50-54' => ['name' => '50-54', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
            '55+' => ['name' => '55+', 'Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0, 'total' => 0],
        ];

        // Analisis Masa Kerja (Tenure) Bins
        $tenureBins = [
            ['name' => '<1 Thn', 'value' => 0],
            ['name' => '1-3 Thn', 'value' => 0],
            ['name' => '3-5 Thn', 'value' => 0],
            ['name' => '5-10 Thn', 'value' => 0],
            ['name' => '10-15 Thn', 'value' => 0],
            ['name' => '15+ Thn', 'value' => 0],
        ];
        $tenureMap = ['<1 Thn' => 0, '1-3 Thn' => 1, '3-5 Thn' => 2, '5-10 Thn' => 3, '10-15 Thn' => 4, '15+ Thn' => 5];

        $asOf = now();
        $cohortYears = [];
        $newHireIds = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $gender = $e->gender === 'Female' ? 'Female' : 'Male';

            // Usia
            if ($e->birth_date) {
                $birth = Carbon::parse($e->birth_date);
                $ageFull = Demographics::ageFullYears($birth, $asOf);

                // Age bin
                $bin = '<25';
                if ($ageFull >= 55) {
                    $bin = '55+';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 50) {
                    $bin = '50-54';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 45) {
                    $bin = '45-49';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 40) {
                    $bin = '40-44';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 35) {
                    $bin = '35-39';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 30) {
                    $bin = '30-34';
                } elseif ($ageFull >= 25) {
                    $bin = '25-29';
                }

                $ageBins[$bin][$gender]++;
                $ageBins[$bin]['total']++;
            }

            // Masa Kerja
            if ($e->join_date) {
                $join = Carbon::parse($e->join_date);
                $losFull = Demographics::losFullYears($join, $asOf);

                if ($losFull < 1) {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['<1 Thn']]['value']++;
                    $newHireIds[] = $e->id;
                } elseif ($losFull < 3) {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['1-3 Thn']]['value']++;
                } elseif ($losFull < 5) {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['3-5 Thn']]['value']++;
                } elseif ($losFull < 10) {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['5-10 Thn']]['value']++;
                } elseif ($losFull < 15) {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['10-15 Thn']]['value']++;
                } else {
                    $tenureBins[$tenureMap['15+ Thn']]['value']++;
                }

                $cohortYear = $join->year;
                $cohortYears[$cohortYear] = ($cohortYears[$cohortYear] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        // Sort cohort
        ksort($cohortYears);
        $cohortData = [];
        foreach ($cohortYears as $yr => $cnt) {
            $cohortData[] = ['year' => (string) $yr, 'count' => $cnt];
        }

        // Untrained new hires
        $trainedEmpIds = $trainings->pluck('employee_id')->unique()->all();
        $untrainedNewHires = count(array_diff($newHireIds, $trainedEmpIds));

        // Top trainings
        $topTrainings = $trainings->groupBy('training_name')
            ->map(fn ($grp, $tName) => [
                'name' => $tName,
                'participants' => $grp->pluck('employee_id')->unique()->count(),
                'hours' => round((float) $grp->sum('hours'), 1),
            ])
            ->sortByDesc('participants')
            ->values()
            ->slice(0, 6)
            ->all();

        // Demografi tambahan: status pernikahan & tipe kepegawaian
        $maritalCounts = [];
        $employmentTypeCounts = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $m = $e->marital_status ?: 'Lainnya';
            $maritalCounts[$m] = ($maritalCounts[$m] ?? 0) + 1;

            $et = $e->employment_type ?: 'Lainnya';
            $employmentTypeCounts[$et] = ($employmentTypeCounts[$et] ?? 0) + 1;
        }

        // Pelatihan breakdown (regularity & source_type)
        $trainRegularity = [];
        $trainSourceType = [];
        foreach ($trainings as $tr) {
            $r = $tr->regularity ?: 'Non Regular';
            $trainRegularity[$r] = ($trainRegularity[$r] ?? 0) + 1;

            $s = $tr->source_type ?: 'Internal';
            $trainSourceType[$s] = ($trainSourceType[$s] ?? 0) + 1;
        }

        // Opsi filter untuk tab staf
        $allDepts = $employees->pluck('organization_name')->filter()->unique()->sort()->values()->all();
        $availableLevels = array_values(array_filter(array_keys($levels)));
        $availableEmploymentTypes = $employees->pluck('employment_type')->filter()->unique()->sort()->values()->all();

        return response()->json([
            'total_company_hc' => $totalCompanyHc,
            'active_location_id' => $request->filled('location_id') ? (int) $request->input('location_id') : null,
            'facilities' => Clean::facilities($locNames->values()->all()),
            'kpi' => [
                'hc' => $totalHc,
                'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
                'avg_los' => round($avgLos, 1),
                'female_pct' => round(($females / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
                'perm_pct' => round(($perm / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
                'new_hires' => count($newHireIds),
                'untrained_new_hires' => $untrainedNewHires,
            ],
            'generations' => $generations,
            'levels' => $levels,
            'departments' => $depts,
            'locations' => $locDetails,
            'demografi' => [
                'age_bins' => array_values($ageBins),
                'male_count' => $totalHc - $females,
                'female_count' => $females,
                'marital_status' => $maritalCounts,
                'employment_types' => $employmentTypeCounts,
            ],
            'masa_kerja' => [
                'tenure_bins' => $tenureBins,
                'cohort_years' => $cohortData,
                'avg_los' => round($avgLos, 1),
                'new_hires_count' => count($newHireIds),
            ],
            'training' => [
                'total_hours' => $totalTrainingHours,
                'trained_hc' => $trainedHc,
                'coverage_pct' => $trainingCoverage,
                'avg_hours_per_trainee' => $avgHoursPerTrainee,
                'untrained_new_hires' => $untrainedNewHires,
                'top_trainings' => $topTrainings,
                'regularity' => $trainRegularity,
                'source_type' => $trainSourceType,
            ],
            'filter_options' => [
                'levels' => $availableLevels,
                'departments' => $allDepts,
                'employment_types' => $availableEmploymentTypes,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function companyEmployees(Request $request, Company $company, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $query = Employee::query()->where('company_id', $company->id);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($request->search) {
            $s = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($s) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%$s%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%$s%")
                    ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%$s%");
            });
        }
        if ($request->location_id) {
            $query->where('location_id', $request->location_id);
        }
        if ($request->level) {
            $query->where('job_level_code', $request->level);
        }
        if ($request->department) {
            $query->where('organization_name', $request->department);
        }
        if ($request->employment_type) {
            $query->where('employment_type', $request->employment_type);
        }

        $employees = $query->paginate(20);

        // Map data yg akan direturn
        $employees->getCollection()->transform(function ($e) {
            return [
                'employee_id' => $e->employee_id,
                'name' => $e->name,
                'job_title_name' => $e->job_title_name,
                'job_level_code' => $e->job_level_code,
                'department' => $e->organization_name,
                'employment_type' => $e->employment_type,
                'age' => Demographics::ageFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)),
                'los' => Demographics::losFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->join_date)),
                'photo_url' => $e->photo_url,
            ];
        });

        return response()->json($employees);
    }

    public function cohortEmployees(Request $request, int $year, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query()->whereYear('join_date', $year);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $s = $request->input('search');
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($s) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$s}%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$s}%")
                    ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%{$s}%");
            });
        }

        if ($request->filled('level')) {
            $query->where('job_level_code', $request->input('level'));
        }

        if ($request->filled('employment_type')) {
            $query->where('employment_type', $request->input('employment_type'));
        }

        if ($request->filled('region')) {
            $query->where('region', $request->input('region'));
        }

        $employees = $query->with('company:id,code,name')->orderBy('name')->paginate(15);

        $employees->getCollection()->transform(function ($e) {
            return [
                'id' => $e->id,
                'employee_id' => $e->employee_id,
                'name' => $e->name,
                'job_title_name' => $e->job_title_name,
                'job_level_code' => $e->job_level_code,
                'department' => $e->organization_name,
                'company_code' => $e->company?->code ?? '-',
                'company_name' => $e->company?->name ?? '-',
                'region' => $e->region,
                'gender' => $e->gender,
                'employment_type' => $e->employment_type,
                'join_date' => $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date)->translatedFormat('d M Y') : '-',
                'age' => Demographics::ageFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)),
                'los' => Demographics::losFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->join_date)),
                'photo_url' => $e->photo_url,
            ];
        });

        return response()->json($employees);
    }

    public function employeeDetail(Request $request, string $employee_id, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $employee = Employee::where('employee_id', $employee_id)->firstOrFail();

        // Catat audit log
        AuditLogger::log(
            $user->id,
            'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL',
            Employee::class,
            $employee->id,
            ['description' => "Viewed detail of employee: {$employee->employee_id}"]
        );

        $company = Company::find($employee->company_id);
        $location = Location::find($employee->location_id);

        $birthDate = Carbon::parse($employee->birth_date);
        $age = Demographics::ageFullYears($birthDate);
        $retireYear = $birthDate->copy()->addYears(55)->format('d M Y');
        $isRetireRisk = $age >= 55;

        // Trainings
        $trainings = DB::table('training_records')->where('nik', $employee->employee_id)->get();

        return response()->json([
            'identitas' => [
                'name' => $employee->name,
                'employee_id' => $employee->employee_id,
                'job' => $employee->job_title_code.' - '.$employee->job_title_name,
                'level' => $employee->job_level_code,
                'dept' => $employee->organization_code.' - '.$employee->organization_name,
                'company' => $company->name ?? '-',
                'location' => $location->name ?? '-',
                'group' => $employee->group,
                'region' => $employee->region,
                'photo_url' => $employee->photo_url,
            ],

            'pribadi' => [
                'gender' => $employee->gender,
                'birth_place' => $employee->birth_place,
                'birth_date' => $birthDate->format('d M Y'),
                'age' => $age,
                'religion' => $employee->religion,
                'marital_status' => $employee->marital_status,
                'ptkp' => $employee->ptkp_code.' ('.$employee->ptkp_name.')',
            ],
            'kepegawaian' => [
                'join_date' => Carbon::parse($employee->join_date)->format('d M Y'),
                'los' => Demographics::losFullYears(Carbon::parse($employee->join_date)),
                'employment_type' => $employee->employment_type,
                'generation' => Demographics::generation($birthDate->year),
                'retire_risk' => $isRetireRisk,
                'retire_date' => $retireYear,
            ],
            'pelatihan' => $trainings->map(function ($t) {
                return [
                    'name' => $t->training_name,
                    'month_year' => $t->month.'/'.$t->year,
                    'hours' => $t->hours,
                    'provider' => $t->instructor,
                    'regularity' => $t->regularity,
                ];
            }),
            'pelatihan_total_jam' => $trainings->sum('hours'),
        ]);
    }

    public function trainings(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = DB::table('training_records');
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $s = $request->input('search');
            $query->where('training_name', 'like', "%{$s}%");
        }

        $events = $query->select(
            'training_name',
            'month',
            'year',
            'source_type',
            DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(nik, ""), participant_name)) as participants'),
            DB::raw('SUM(hours) as total_hours')
        )
            ->groupBy('training_name', 'month', 'year', 'source_type');

        $sortField = $request->input('sort', 'year');
        $sortDir = strtolower($request->input('direction', $request->input('order', 'desc'))) === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';

        $validSorts = ['training_name', 'month', 'year', 'participants', 'total_hours', 'source_type'];
        if (in_array($sortField, $validSorts)) {
            if ($sortField === 'year' || $sortField === 'month') {
                $events->orderBy('year', $sortDir)->orderBy('month', $sortDir);
            } else {
                $events->orderBy($sortField, $sortDir);
            }
        } else {
            $events->orderBy('year', 'desc')->orderBy('month', 'desc');
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 10);
        if (! in_array($perPage, [5, 10, 25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 10;
        }

        $paginated = $events->paginate($perPage);

        return response()->json($paginated);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exports\EmployeesExport;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;

class EmployeeDirectoryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::with(['company', 'location']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Search
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Sorting
        $sortKey = $request->input('sort', 'name');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('order', 'asc');

        $allowedSorts = [
            'employee_id', 'name', 'company_name', 'organization_name',
            'job_title_name', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type',
        ];

        if ($sortKey === 'umur' || $sortKey === 'generasi') {
            $query->orderBy('birth_date', $sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } elseif ($sortKey === 'masa_kerja') {
            $query->orderBy('join_date', $sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } elseif ($sortKey === 'company_name') {
            $query->join('companies', 'employees.company_id', '=', 'companies.id')
                ->orderBy('companies.name', $sortOrder)
                ->select('employees.*');
        } elseif (in_array($sortKey, $allowedSorts)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortKey, $sortOrder);
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        if (! in_array($perPage, [10, 15, 25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 25;
        }

        $employees = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Transform for display
        $employees->getCollection()->transform(function ($e) {
            return [
                'id' => $e->id,
                'employee_id' => $e->employee_id,
                'name' => $e->name,
                'company_name' => $e->company->name ?? '-',
                'location_name' => $e->location->name ?? '-',
                'department' => $e->organization_name ?? '-',
                'job_title' => $e->job_title_name ?? '-',
                'level' => $e->job_level_code ?? '-',
                'employment_type' => $e->employment_type ?? '-',
                'generasi' => Demographics::generation($e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)->year : null),
                'umur' => Demographics::age($e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null),
                'masa_kerja' => Demographics::los($e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null),

                // Add fields required by StaffDetailModal if needed
                'company_id' => $e->company_id,
                'region' => $e->region,
                'join_date' => $e->join_date,
                'birth_date' => $e->birth_date,
                'gender' => $e->gender,
                'marital_status' => $e->marital_status,
                'religion' => $e->religion,
                'ptkp_code' => $e->ptkp_code,
                'photo_url' => $e->photo_url,
            ];
        });

        return Inertia::render('Employees/Index', [
            'employees' => $employees,
            'filters' => $request->all(),
        ]);
    }

    public function export(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        // 5.000 max rows
        $query = Employee::with(['company', 'location']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $count = $query->count();
        if ($count > 5000) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Export gagal: Maksimal 5.000 baris per ekspor. Silakan persempit filter.');
        }

        // Log to AuditLogger
        AuditLogger::log(auth()->id() ?? 1, 'EXPORT_EMPLOYEES', null, null, ['count' => $count]);

        return Excel::download(new EmployeesExport($query), 'direktori_karyawan_'.now()->format('Ymd_His').'.xlsx');
    }

    public function uploadPhoto(Request $request, string $employee_id)
    {
        $employee = Employee::where('employee_id', $employee_id)->firstOrFail();

        $request->validate([
            'photo' => 'required|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:3072',
        ]);

        if ($employee->photo_path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($employee->photo_path)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($employee->photo_path);
        }

        $path = $request->file('photo')->store('employees/photos', 'public');
        $employee->update(['photo_path' => $path]);

        AuditLogger::log(
            $request->user()?->id ?? 1,
            'UPDATE_EMPLOYEE_PHOTO',
            Employee::class,
            $employee->id,
            ['employee_id' => $employee->employee_id]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Foto profil berhasil diperbarui.',
            'photo_url' => $employee->photo_url,
        ]);
    }

    public function deletePhoto(Request $request, string $employee_id)
    {
        $employee = Employee::where('employee_id', $employee_id)->firstOrFail();

        if ($employee->photo_path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($employee->photo_path)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($employee->photo_path);
        }

        $employee->update(['photo_path' => null]);

        AuditLogger::log(
            $request->user()?->id ?? 1,
            'DELETE_EMPLOYEE_PHOTO',
            Employee::class,
            $employee->id,
            ['employee_id' => $employee->employee_id]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Foto profil berhasil dihapus.',
            'photo_url' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Support\Clean;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class FilterOptionsController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        // For distinct options, we can query Employee, Company, Location
        // Since dataset is small, doing distinct queries is fine

        $companies = Company::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'code', 'name'])->map(function ($c) {
            $meta = Clean::companyMeta($c->name);

            return [
                'id' => $c->id,
                'code' => $c->code,
                'name' => $c->name,
                'initials' => $meta['initials'],
                'aliases' => $meta['aliases'],
            ];
        });

        $employeeOptions = Employee::query()->get([
            'region', 'group', 'organization_name', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type', 'gender', 'location_id', 'company_id',
        ]);

        $regions = $employeeOptions->pluck('region')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $groups = $employeeOptions->pluck('group')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $departments = $employeeOptions->pluck('organization_name')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $jobLevels = $employeeOptions->pluck('job_level_code')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $employmentTypes = $employeeOptions->pluck('employment_type')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $genders = $employeeOptions->pluck('gender')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();

        $locationsMap = [];
        foreach ($employeeOptions as $emp) {
            if ($emp->location_id) {
                if (! isset($locationsMap[$emp->location_id])) {
                    $locationsMap[$emp->location_id] = [];
                }
                $locationsMap[$emp->location_id][] = $emp->company_id;
            }
        }

        $activeLocationIds = array_keys($locationsMap);
        $locations = Location::whereIn('id', $activeLocationIds)->orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name'])->map(function ($loc) use ($locationsMap) {
            return [
                'id' => $loc->id,
                'name' => $loc->name,
                'companies' => array_values(array_unique($locationsMap[$loc->id] ?? [])),
            ];
        });

        // Generations are static
        $generations = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];

        $trainingRegions = DB::table('training_records')
            ->select('region')
            ->distinct()
            ->whereNotNull('region')
            ->pluck('region')
            ->sort()
            ->values();

        return response()->json([
            'regions' => $regions,
            'trainingRegions' => $trainingRegions,
            'groups' => $groups,
            'companies' => $companies,
            'locations' => $locations,
            'departments' => $departments,
            'jobLevels' => $jobLevels,
            'employmentTypes' => $employmentTypes,
            'genders' => $genders,
            'generations' => $generations,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exports\EmployeeTemplateExport;
use App\Exports\TrainingTemplateExport;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Import\EmployeeImporter;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;

class ImportController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $batches = ImportBatch::latest()->take(50)->get();

        return Inertia::render('Admin/Import', [
            'batches' => $batches,
            'portalSyncConfig' => [
                'enabled' => (bool) config('services.portal.sync_enabled'),
                'time' => config('services.portal.sync_time', '02:00'),
            ],
            'counts' => [
                'employee' => DB::table('employees')->count(),
                'training' => DB::table('training_records')->count(),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, EmployeeImporter $empImporter, TrainingImporter $trainImporter)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'type' => 'required|in:employee,training',
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx,xls',
            'replace_all' => 'nullable|boolean',
        ], [
            'type.required' => 'Kategori data harus dipilih.',
            'type.in' => 'Kategori data tidak valid.',
            'file.required' => 'Berkas harus dipilih.',
            'file.file' => 'Berkas tidak valid.',
            'file.mimes' => 'Format berkas harus .xlsx, .xls, atau .csv.',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $type = $request->input('type');
        $replaceAll = $request->boolean('replace_all', false);

        try {
            if ($type === 'employee') {
                $empImporter->import($file, $request->user()->id, $replaceAll);
            } else {
                $trainImporter->import($file, $request->user()->id);
            }
            Cache::flush();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Import gagal: '.$e->getMessage()]);
        }

        $msg = ($type === 'employee' && $replaceAll)
            ? 'Import data karyawan berhasil (data lama telah dibersihkan).'
            : 'Import berhasil dijalankan.';

        return back()->with('success', $msg);
    }

    public function syncPortal(Request $request, TrainingImporter $importer)
    {
        $dryRun = $request->boolean('dry_run', false);

        try {
            $batch = $importer->importFromPortal($request->user()?->id, $dryRun);
            AuditLogger::log(
                $request->user()->id,
                'import.portal_sync',
                null,
                null,
                [
                    'dry_run' => $dryRun,
                    'rows_total' => $batch->rows_total,
                    'rows_imported' => $batch->rows_imported,
                ]
            );
            Cache::flush();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return back()->withErrors(['portal' => 'Sync Portal gagal: '.$e->getMessage()]);
        }

        $msg = $dryRun ? 'Dry-run sync portal berhasil.' : 'Sinkronisasi data training dari portal berhasil.';

        return back()->with('success', $msg);
    }

    public function reset(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'target' => 'required|in:employee,training,all',
            'confirmation' => 'required|string',
        ], [
            'target.required' => 'Target data harus dipilih.',
            'target.in' => 'Target data tidak valid.',
            'confirmation.required' => 'Ketik kata "HAPUS" untuk mengonfirmasi penghapusan data.',
        ]);

        if (strtoupper(trim($request->input('confirmation'))) !== 'HAPUS') {
            return back()->withErrors(['confirmation' => 'Ketik "HAPUS" untuk mengonfirmasi penghapusan data.']);
        }

        $target = $request->input('target');
        $deletedCount = 0;

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($target, $request, &$deletedCount) {
                $empCount = DB::table('employees')->count();
                $trainCount = DB::table('training_records')->count();

                if ($target === 'employee' || $target === 'all') {
                    DB::table('training_records')->whereNotNull('employee_id')->update(['employee_id' => null]);
                    Storage::disk('public')->deleteDirectory('employees/photos');
                    DB::table('employees')->delete();
                    $deletedCount += $empCount;
                }

                if ($target === 'training' || $target === 'all') {
                    DB::table('training_records')->delete();
                    $deletedCount += $trainCount;
                }

                $label = match ($target) {
                    'employee' => 'Reset / Pembersihan Data Karyawan',
                    'training' => 'Reset / Pembersihan Data Pelatihan',
                    'all' => 'Reset / Pembersihan Seluruh Data Master',
                };

                ImportBatch::create([
                    'user_id' => $request->user()->id,
                    'type' => $target === 'all' ? 'employee' : $target,
                    'filename' => $label,
                    'rows_total' => $deletedCount,
                    'rows_imported' => 0,
                    'rows_skipped' => $deletedCount,
                    'status' => 'completed',
                    'started_at' => now(),
                    'finished_at' => now(),
                ]);

                AuditLogger::log(
                    $request->user()->id,
                    'data.reset',
                    null,
                    null,
                    [
                        'target' => $target,
                        'deleted_employees' => ($target === 'employee' || $target === 'all') ? $empCount : 0,
                        'deleted_trainings' => ($target === 'training' || $target === 'all') ? $trainCount : 0,
                    ]
                );
            });

            Cache::flush();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return back()->withErrors(['reset' => 'Gagal menghapus data: '.$e->getMessage()]);
        }

        $messages = [
            'employee' => 'Seluruh data karyawan berhasil dihapus bersih ('.number_format($deletedCount, 0, ',', '.').' data dibersihkan). Database siap untuk diimpor ulang.',
            'training' => 'Seluruh data rekam pelatihan berhasil dikosongkan ('.number_format($deletedCount, 0, ',', '.').' data dibersihkan).',
            'all' => 'Seluruh data karyawan dan rekaman pelatihan berhasil dikosongkan ('.number_format($deletedCount, 0, ',', '.').' data dibersihkan).',
        ];

        return back()->with('success', $messages[$target] ?? 'Data berhasil direset.');
    }

    public function downloadTemplate(string $type)
    {
        if ($type === 'employee') {
            return Excel::download(new EmployeeTemplateExport, 'Template_Import_Karyawan.xlsx');
        }

        if ($type === 'training') {
            return Excel::download(new TrainingTemplateExport, 'Template_Import_Pelatihan.xlsx');
        }

        abort(404, 'Template tidak ditemukan.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\UpdatePasswordRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProfileRequest;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    public function edit(Request $request)
    {
        return Inertia::render('Profile/Edit', [
            'mustVerifyEmail' => false,
            'status' => session('status'),
        ]);
    }

    public function updateProfile(UpdateProfileRequest $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $user->fill($request->validated());

        if ($user->isDirty('email')) {
            $user->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $user->save();

        AuditLogger::log($user->id, 'account.updated', get_class($user), $user->id);

        return back()->with('status', 'profile-updated');
    }

    public function updatePassword(UpdatePasswordRequest $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $validated = $request->validated();

        $user->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
        ]);

        AuditLogger::log($user->id, 'account.password_changed', get_class($user), $user->id);

        return back()->with('status', 'password-updated');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exports\StaffResignTemplateExport;
use App\Models\StaffResign;
use App\Services\Import\StaffResignImporter;
use App\Services\ResignationMetrics;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class ResignationController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request, ResignationMetrics $metricsService)
    {
        $metrics = $metricsService->getMetrics($request);

        // Build Query for Employee Resignation Directory (Tab 2)
        $query = StaffResign::query();

        // Filter Year
        if ($year = $request->input('year')) {
            if ($year !== 'all') {
                $query->whereYear('resign_date', (int) $year);
            }
        }

        // Filter Region
        if ($rawRegion = $request->input('region')) {
            $regions = collect(Arr::flatten((array) $rawRegion))
                ->filter(fn ($r) => ! empty($r) && $r !== 'all')
                ->values()
                ->all();

            if (! empty($regions)) {
                $query->whereIn('region', $regions);
            }
        }

        // Filter Jenis Resign
        if ($jenis = $request->input('jenis_resign')) {
            if ($jenis !== 'all') {
                $query->where('jenis_resign', $jenis);
            }
        }

        // Filter Cluster Resign
        if ($cluster = $request->input('cluster_resign')) {
            if ($cluster !== 'all') {
                $query->where('cluster_resign', $cluster);
            }
        }

        // Filter Alumni
        if ($alumni = $request->input('alumni')) {
            if ($alumni !== 'all') {
                $query->where('alumni', $alumni);
            }
        }

        // Search
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('jabatan', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('kebun', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('deskripsi_resign', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Sorting
        $sortKey = $request->input('sort', 'resign_date');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('order', 'desc');
        $allowedSorts = ['resign_date', 'join_date', 'nama', 'employee_id', 'jabatan', 'kebun', 'region', 'jenis_resign', 'cluster_resign'];

        if (in_array($sortKey, $allowedSorts)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortKey, $sortOrder);
        } else {
            $query->orderBy('resign_date', 'desc');
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 15);
        if (! in_array($perPage, [10, 15, 25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 15;
        }

        $paginated = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Transform collection to include formatted dates & tenure
        $paginated->getCollection()->transform(function ($item) {
            $join = $item->join_date ? Carbon::parse($item->join_date) : null;
            $resign = $item->resign_date ? Carbon::parse($item->resign_date) : null;

            $tenure = '-';
            if ($join && $resign) {
                $diff = $join->diff($resign);
                $parts = [];
                if ($diff->y > 0) {
                    $parts[] = "{$diff->y} thn";
                }
                if ($diff->m > 0 || empty($parts)) {
                    $parts[] = "{$diff->m} bln";
                }
                $tenure = implode(' ', $parts);
            }

            return [
                'id' => $item->id,
                'employee_id' => $item->employee_id ?: '-',
                'nama' => $item->nama,
                'join_date' => $item->join_date ? $item->join_date->format('d M Y') : '-',
                'resign_date' => $item->resign_date ? $item->resign_date->format('d M Y') : '-',
                'join_date_raw' => $item->join_date ? $item->join_date->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                'resign_date_raw' => $item->resign_date ? $item->resign_date->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                'tenure' => $tenure,
                'jabatan' => $item->jabatan,
                'kebun' => $item->kebun,
                'deskripsi_resign' => $item->deskripsi_resign ?: '-',
                'jenis_resign' => $item->jenis_resign,
                'cluster_resign' => $item->cluster_resign,
                'alumni' => $item->alumni,
                'keterangan' => $item->keterangan ?: '-',
                'region' => $item->region,
            ];
        });

        // Unique filter options (dynamically fetched from DB)
        $years = StaffResign::query()
            ->whereNotNull('resign_date')
            ->selectRaw('DISTINCT YEAR(resign_date) as yr')
            ->orderByDesc('yr')
            ->pluck('yr')
            ->map(fn ($y) => (int) $y)
            ->values()
            ->toArray();

        if (empty($years)) {
            $years = [(int) date('Y'), (int) date('Y') - 1];
        }

        $filterOptions = [
            'clusters' => StaffResign::query()->select('cluster_resign')->distinct()->pluck('cluster_resign')->filter()->values(),
            'jabatans' => StaffResign::query()->select('jabatan')->distinct()->pluck('jabatan')->filter()->values(),
            'regions' => ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim'],
            'years' => $years,
        ];

        return Inertia::render('Resignation/Index', [
            'metrics' => $metrics,
            'records' => $paginated,
            'filters' => $request->only(['year', 'region', 'jenis_resign', 'cluster_resign', 'alumni', 'search', 'sort', 'order', 'tab', 'per_page']),
            'filterOptions' => $filterOptions,
            'flash' => [
                'success' => $request->session()->get('success'),
                'error' => $request->session()->get('error'),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'nama' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'join_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'resign_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'jabatan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'kebun' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'deskripsi_resign' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'jenis_resign' => ['required', 'string', 'in:VOLUNTARY,INVOLUNTARY'],
            'cluster_resign' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'alumni' => ['required', 'string', 'in:Alumni,Non Alumni'],
            'keterangan' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'region' => ['required', 'string', 'in:Riau,Kalbar,Kaltim'],
        ]);

        StaffResign::create($validated);

        return back()->with('success', 'Data karyawan resign berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function template(Request $request)
    {
        $format = strtolower($request->input('format', 'xlsx'));
        $filename = 'template_data_staff_resign_'.now()->format('Ymd');

        if ($format === 'csv') {
            return Excel::download(new StaffResignTemplateExport, "{$filename}.csv", \Maatwebsite\Excel\Excel::CSV, [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
            ]);
        }

        return Excel::download(new StaffResignTemplateExport, "{$filename}.xlsx");
    }

    public function import(Request $request, StaffResignImporter $importer)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:xlsx,xls,csv,txt', 'max:10240'],
            'mode' => ['nullable', 'string', 'in:append,replace'],
        ], [
            'file.required' => 'Silakan pilih file Excel atau CSV yang akan diunggah.',
            'file.mimes' => 'Format file harus berupa Excel (.xlsx, .xls) atau CSV (.csv).',
            'file.max' => 'Ukuran file tidak boleh melebihi 10MB.',
        ]);

        try {
            $mode = $request->input('mode', 'append');
            $result = $importer->import($request->file('file'), $mode);

            $msg = "Import berhasil: {$result['imported']} data baru ditambahkan";
            if ($result['updated'] > 0) {
                $msg .= ", {$result['updated']} data diperbarui";
            }
            if ($result['skipped'] > 0) {
                $msg .= ", {$result['skipped']} baris dilewati";
            }
            $msg .= '.';

            return back()->with('success', $msg);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal memproses file import: '.$e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function export(Request $request): StreamedResponse
    {
        $query = StaffResign::query();

        if ($year = $request->input('year')) {
            if ($year !== 'all') {
                $query->whereYear('resign_date', (int) $year);
            }
        }
        if ($region = $request->input('region')) {
            if ($region !== 'all') {
                $query->where('region', $region);
            }
        }
        if ($jenis = $request->input('jenis_resign')) {
            if ($jenis !== 'all') {
                $query->where('jenis_resign', $jenis);
            }
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('resign_date', 'desc')->get();

        $headers = [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="data_staff_resign_'.now()->format('Ymd_His').'.csv"',
        ];

        return response()->stream(function () use ($records) {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            // Add UTF-8 BOM
            fprintf($handle, chr(0xEF).chr(0xBB).chr(0xBF));

            fputcsv($handle, [
                'NIK', 'Nama Karyawan', 'Tgl Join', 'Tgl Resign', 'Jabatan',
                'Kebun', 'Region', 'Jenis Resign', 'Cluster Resign', 'Alumni', 'Keterangan', 'Alasan Resign',
            ], ';');

            foreach ($records as $r) {
                fputcsv($handle, [
                    $r->employee_id,
                    $r->nama,
                    $r->join_date ? $r->join_date->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                    $r->resign_date ? $r->resign_date->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                    $r->jabatan,
                    $r->kebun,
                    $r->region,
                    $r->jenis_resign,
                    $r->cluster_resign,
                    $r->alumni,
                    $r->keterangan,
                    $r->deskripsi_resign,
                ], ';');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, 200, $headers);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    public function index(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = TrainingRecord::with(['employee', 'company']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Filter NIK Status
        if ($nikStatus = $request->input('nik_status')) {
            if ($nikStatus === 'terhubung') {
                $query->whereNotNull('employee_id');
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_terhubung') {
                $query->whereNull('employee_id');
            } elseif (in_array($nikStatus, ['kosong', 'rusak', 'tidak_valid'])) {
                if ($nikStatus === 'kosong') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'empty');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'rusak') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'corrupt');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_valid') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'not_found');
                }
            }
        }

        // Search
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('participant_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nik', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nik_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('training_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('company_name_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Sorting
        $sortKey = $request->input('sort', 'participant_name');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('order', 'asc');

        $allowedSorts = [
            'nik', 'participant_name', 'company_name_raw', 'department',
            'work_location', 'group', 'region', 'grade', 'position',
            'month', 'year', 'days', 'hours', 'training_name',
            'instructor', 'venue', 'regularity', 'source_type', 'level',
        ];

        if (in_array($sortKey, $allowedSorts)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortKey, $sortOrder);
        } else {
            $query->orderBy('id', 'desc');
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        if (! in_array($perPage, [25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 25;
        }

        $records = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Transform for display
        $records->getCollection()->transform(function ($t) {
            return [
                'id' => $t->id,
                'employee_id' => $t->employee_id,
                'nik' => $t->nik_status === 'ok' ? $t->nik : $t->nik_raw,
                'nik_status' => $t->nik_status,
                'participant_name' => $t->participant_name,
                'pt_name' => $t->company_name_raw,
                'company_alias' => $t->company->name ?? '-',
                'department' => $t->department,
                'work_location' => $t->work_location,
                'group' => $t->group,
                'region' => $t->region,
                'job_category' => $t->grade,
                'job_position' => $t->position,
                'period_month' => $t->month,
                'period_year' => $t->year,
                'days' => $t->days,
                'hours' => $t->hours,
                'training_name' => $t->training_name,
                'instructor' => $t->instructor,
                'place' => $t->venue,
                'is_regular' => $t->regularity === 'Reguler' || $t->regularity == 1,
                'is_internal' => $t->source_type === 'Internal' || $t->source_type == 1,
                'level' => $t->level,

                // Fields for employee modal if linked
                'employee' => $t->employee_id ? [
                    'id' => $t->employee->id ?? null,
                    'employee_id' => $t->employee->employee_id ?? null,
                    'name' => $t->employee->name ?? null,
                    'company_name' => $t->employee->company->name ?? null,
                    'location_name' => $t->employee->location->name ?? null,
                    'department' => $t->employee->organization_name ?? null,
                    'job_title' => $t->employee->job_title_name ?? null,
                    'level' => $t->employee->job_level_code ?? null,
                    'employment_type' => $t->employee->employment_type ?? null,
                    'company_id' => $t->employee->company_id ?? null,
                    'region' => $t->employee->region ?? null,
                    'join_date' => $t->employee->join_date ?? null,
                    'birth_date' => $t->employee->birth_date ?? null,
                    'gender' => $t->employee->gender ?? null,
                    'marital_status' => $t->employee->marital_status ?? null,
                    'religion' => $t->employee->religion ?? null,
                    'ptkp_code' => $t->employee->ptkp_code ?? null,
                ] : null,
            ];
        });

        return Inertia::render('Training/Data', [
            'records' => $records,
            'filters' => $request->all(),
        ]);
    }

    public function export(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        // 5.000 max rows
        $query = TrainingRecord::with(['company']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Filter NIK Status
        if ($nikStatus = $request->input('nik_status')) {
            if ($nikStatus === 'terhubung') {
                $query->whereNotNull('employee_id');
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_terhubung') {
                $query->whereNull('employee_id');
            } elseif (in_array($nikStatus, ['kosong', 'rusak', 'tidak_valid'])) {
                if ($nikStatus === 'kosong') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'empty');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'rusak') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'corrupt');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_valid') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'not_found');
                }
            }
        }

        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('participant_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nik', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nik_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('training_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('pt_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");

        AuditLogger::log(auth()->id() ?? 1, 'EXPORT_TRAINING_RECORDS', null, null, ['count' => $count]);

        return Excel::download(new TrainingRecordsExport($query), 'data_training_'.date('Ymd_His').'.xlsx');
    }

File: app/Http/Middleware/EnsureRole.php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureRole
{
    /**
     * Handle an incoming request.
     *
     * @param  Closure(Request): (Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, string ...$roles): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user) {
            return redirect()->route('login');
        }

        if (! $user->is_active) {
            auth()->logout();
            $request->session()->invalidate();
            $request->session()->regenerateToken();

            return redirect()->route('login')->withErrors(['nik' => 'Akun Anda telah dinonaktifkan. Hubungi Administrator.']);
        }

        if (! empty($roles) && ! in_array($user->role, $roles, true)) {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk halaman ini.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Middleware;

class HandleInertiaRequests extends Middleware
{
    /**
     * The root template that's loaded on the first page visit.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/server-side-setup#root-template
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $rootView = 'app';

    /**
     * Determines the current asset version.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/asset-versioning
     */
    public function version(Request $request): ?string
    {
        return parent::version($request);
    }

    /**
     * Define the props that are shared by default.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/shared-data
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function share(Request $request): array
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        if ($user && ! $user->relationLoaded('employee')) {
            $user->load('employee:employee_id,job_title_name,organization_name,region');
        }

        return [
            ...parent::share($request),
            'auth' => [
                'user' => $user ? [
                    'id' => $user->id,
                    'name' => $user->name,
                    'nik' => $user->nik,
                    'email' => $user->email,
                    'role' => $user->role,
                    'is_active' => (bool) $user->is_active,
                    'is_superadmin' => $user->isSuperAdmin(),
                    'is_manajemen' => $user->isManajemen(),
                    'is_viewer' => $user->isViewer(),
                    'can_import' => $user->canImport(),
                    'can_manage_users' => $user->canManageUsers(),
                    'job_title' => $user->job_title ?: $user->employee?->job_title_name,
                    'employee' => $user->employee ? [
                        'job_title_name' => $user->employee->job_title_name,
                        'organization_name' => $user->employee->organization_name,
                        'region' => $user->employee->region,
                    ] : null,
                ] : null,
            ],
            'flash' => [
                'success' => $request->session()->get('success'),
                'warning' => $request->session()->get('warning'),
                'error' => $request->session()->get('error'),
            ],
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Http/Middleware/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.php
