<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class SecurityHeadersMiddleware
{
    /**
     * Handle an incoming request and attach essential security headers.
     *
     * @param  Closure(Request): (Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        // 1. Remove PHP version disclosure from header
        if (function_exists('header_remove')) {
            header_remove('X-Powered-By');
        }

        $response = $next($request);

        // Remove from response object headers if set by framework / web server
        $response->headers->remove('X-Powered-By');

        // 2. Content Security Policy (CSP)
        // Accommodates Vite assets, Inertia.js, React, Tailwind, and Cloudflare Turnstile
        $cspDirectives = [
            "default-src 'self'",
            "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://challenges.cloudflare.com",
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com",
            "font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com",
            "img-src 'self' data: blob: https:",
            "connect-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com",
            "frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com",
            "object-src 'none'",
            "base-uri 'self'",
            "form-action 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com",
        ];

        $response->headers->set('Content-Security-Policy', implode('; ', $cspDirectives));

        // 3. Essential Security Headers (HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy)
        $response->headers->set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        $response->headers->set('X-Frame-Options', 'SAMEORIGIN');
        $response->headers->set('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
        $response->headers->set('Permissions-Policy', 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()');

        // HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
        $response->headers->set('Strict-Transport-Security', 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains');

        return $response;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Imports;

use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ToArray;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCalculatedFormulas;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCustomValueBinder;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Cell;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DefaultValueBinder;

class GenericImport extends DefaultValueBinder implements ToArray, WithCalculatedFormulas, WithCustomValueBinder
{
    public function array(array $array): void
    {
        // Handled by Excel::toArray() return value.
    }

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        // Jika nilai aslinya string numerik panjang, paksa sebagai string agar tidak jadi float/notasi ilmiah
        if (is_string($value) && is_numeric($value) && strlen($value) >= 10 && ! str_contains($value, '.')) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);

            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

// use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\MustVerifyEmail;
use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;

#[Fillable(['name', 'nik', 'email', 'password', 'role', 'job_title', 'is_active', 'last_login_at'])]
#[Hidden(['password', 'remember_token'])]
class User extends Authenticatable
{
    /** @use HasFactory<UserFactory> */
    use HasFactory, Notifiable;

    /**
     * Get the attributes that should be cast.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'last_login_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Relasi ke data master karyawan berdasarkan NIK.
     */
    public function employee(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Employee::class, 'nik', 'employee_id');
    }

    /**
     * Ambil nama jabatan pengguna (dari kolom job_title atau relasi employee).
     */
    public function getDisplayJobTitleAttribute(): ?string
    {
        return $this->job_title ?: $this->employee?->job_title_name;
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah user adalah Superadmin.
     */
    public function isSuperAdmin(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'superadmin';
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah user adalah Manajemen.
     */
    public function isManajemen(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'manajemen';
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah user adalah Viewer biasa.
     */
    public function isViewer(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'viewer';
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah user berhak melakukan import data (Superadmin atau Manajemen).
     */
    public function canImport(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->role, ['superadmin', 'manajemen'], true);
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah user berhak mengelola akun pengguna (Superadmin).
     */
    public function canManageUsers(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'superadmin';
    }
}

File: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        if (
            str_starts_with((string) config('app.url'), 'https://')
            || app()->isProduction()
            || request()->isSecure()
            || request()->header('x-forwarded-proto') === 'https'
            || request()->server('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO') === 'https'
            || (isset($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] === 'on')
        ) {
            URL::forceScheme('https');
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class AuditLogger
{
    /**
     * Catat aksi ke audit logs.
     *
     * @param  int  $userId  ID pengguna yang melakukan aksi
     * @param  string  $action  Nama aksi, contoh: 'IMPORT_LOCATIONS', 'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL'
     * @param  string|null  $subjectType  Model class, contoh: Location::class
     * @param  int|null  $subjectId  ID dari model
     * @param  array  $meta  Data tambahan dalam bentuk array
     * @return void
     */
    public static function log(?int $userId = null, string $action = '', ?string $subjectType = null, ?int $subjectId = null, array $meta = [])
    {
        DB::table('audit_logs')->insert([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'action' => $action,
            'subject_type' => $subjectType,
            'subject_id' => $subjectId,
            'meta' => json_encode($meta),
            'created_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }
}

================
File: app/Services/CombinedMetrics.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use App\Support\MetricsHelper;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CombinedMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::now();

        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get([
            'id', 'employee_id', 'region', 'company_id', 'organization_name', 'job_level_code',
            'job_title_name', 'birth_date', 'join_date', 'gender',
        ]);

        $totalEmployees = $employees->count();
        if ($totalEmployees === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $empIds = $employees->pluck('id')->toArray();

        $trainings = DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereNotNull('employee_id')
            ->whereIn('employee_id', $empIds)
            ->get(['employee_id', 'hours']);

        $totalTrainingsAll = DB::table('training_records')->count();
        $unlinkedTrainingsAll = DB::table('training_records')->whereNull('employee_id')->count();
        $unlinkedPct = $totalTrainingsAll > 0 ? round(($unlinkedTrainingsAll / $totalTrainingsAll) * 100, 1) : 0;

        $banner = [
            'unlinked_count' => $unlinkedTrainingsAll,
            'total_count' => $totalTrainingsAll,
            'unlinked_pct' => $unlinkedPct,
        ];

        $empHours = [];
        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            if (! isset($empHours[$t->employee_id])) {
                $empHours[$t->employee_id] = 0;
            }
            $empHours[$t->employee_id] += $t->hours;
        }

        $covRegion = [];
        $covCompany = [];
        $covDept = [];
        $covLevel = [];
        $titlesByLevel = [];
        $jobTitlesTable = [];

        $hrsGen = [];
        $hrsLevel = [];
        $hrsGender = [];

        $retirementTraining = [
            '0_jam' => 0,
            '1_15_jam' => 0,
            '16_plus_jam' => 0,
        ];

        $newHireNoTrainingCount = MetricsHelper::countNewHireNoTraining($employees, $asOf, $empHours);
        $scatter = [];
        $companyRanking = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $hasTraining = isset($empHours[$e->id]);
            $hours = $hasTraining ? $empHours[$e->id] : 0;

            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $cid = $e->company_id ?? 0;
            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $gender = $e->gender ?? 'Unknown';
            $jt = $e->job_title_name ? trim($e->job_title_name) : 'Tidak Diketahui';

            if ($lvl && $e->job_title_name) {
                $titlesByLevel[$lvl][$e->job_title_name] = ($titlesByLevel[$lvl][$e->job_title_name] ?? 0) + 1;
            }

            $lvlStr = ($lvl !== null && $lvl !== '' && $lvl !== 'Unknown') ? (string) $lvl : '-';
            $jtKey = $jt.'||'.$lvlStr;

            if (! isset($jobTitlesTable[$jtKey])) {
                $jobTitlesTable[$jtKey] = [
                    'title' => $jt,
                    'level' => $lvlStr,
                    'hc' => 0,
                    'trained_hc' => 0,
                    'hours_sum' => 0,
                ];
            }
            $jobTitlesTable[$jtKey]['hc']++;
            if ($hasTraining) {
                $jobTitlesTable[$jtKey]['trained_hc']++;
                $jobTitlesTable[$jtKey]['hours_sum'] += $hours;
            }

            if (! isset($covRegion[$reg])) {
                $covRegion[$reg] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($covCompany[$cid])) {
                $covCompany[$cid] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($covDept[$dept])) {
                $covDept[$dept] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($covLevel[$lvl])) {
                $covLevel[$lvl] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            }

            $covRegion[$reg]['total']++;
            $covCompany[$cid]['total']++;
            $covDept[$dept]['total']++;
            $covLevel[$lvl]['total']++;

            if ($hasTraining) {
                $covRegion[$reg]['trained']++;
                $covCompany[$cid]['trained']++;
                $covDept[$dept]['trained']++;
                $covLevel[$lvl]['trained']++;
            }

            $birth = $e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null;
            $ageFloat = Demographics::age($birth, $asOf);
            $gen = Demographics::generation($birth ? $birth->year : null);

            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            $tenureFloat = Demographics::los($join, $asOf);

            if ($hasTraining) {
                if (! isset($hrsGen[$gen])) {
                    $hrsGen[$gen] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                }
                if (! isset($hrsLevel[$lvl])) {
                    $hrsLevel[$lvl] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                }
                if (! isset($hrsGender[$gender])) {
                    $hrsGender[$gender] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                }

                $hrsGen[$gen]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsGen[$gen]['linked_hc']++;

                $hrsLevel[$lvl]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsLevel[$lvl]['linked_hc']++;

                $hrsGender[$gender]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsGender[$gender]['linked_hc']++;
            }

            $isRisk = Demographics::isRetirementRisk($birth, $asOf);
            if ($isRisk) {
                if ($hours == 0) {
                    $retirementTraining['0_jam']++;
                } elseif ($hours <= 15) {
                    $retirementTraining['1_15_jam']++;
                } else {
                    $retirementTraining['16_plus_jam']++;
                }
            }

            // Removed new hire no training inline calculation

            if ($tenureFloat !== null && $hasTraining) {
                $scatter[] = [
                    'masa_kerja' => round($tenureFloat, 2),
                    'jam_pelatihan' => round($hours, 1),
                ];
            }

            if (! isset($companyRanking[$cid])) {
                $companyRanking[$cid] = [
                    'hc' => 0, 'age_sum' => 0, 'age_count' => 0,
                    'linked_hc' => 0, 'hours_sum' => 0, 'risk_count' => 0,
                ];
            }
            $companyRanking[$cid]['hc']++;
            if ($ageFloat !== null) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['age_sum'] += $ageFloat;
                $companyRanking[$cid]['age_count']++;
            }
            if ($hasTraining) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['linked_hc']++;
                $companyRanking[$cid]['hours_sum'] += $hours;
            }
            if ($isRisk) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['risk_count']++;
            }
        }

        $formatCoverage = function ($map, $attachTitles = false) use (&$titlesByLevel) {
            $res = [];
            foreach ($map as $name => $data) {
                $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['trained'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
                $row = ['name' => $name, 'trained' => $data['trained'], 'total' => $data['total'], 'pct' => round($pct, 1)];
                if ($attachTitles && isset($titlesByLevel[$name])) {
                    $top = $titlesByLevel[$name];
                    arsort($top);
                    $row['top_titles'] = $top;
                }
                $res[] = $row;
            }
            usort($res, fn ($a, $b) => $b['pct'] <=> $a['pct']);

            return $res;
        };

        $formatAvg = function ($map, $attachTitles = false) use (&$titlesByLevel) {
            $res = [];
            foreach ($map as $name => $data) {
                $avg = $data['linked_hc'] > 0 ? $data['hours'] / $data['linked_hc'] : 0;
                $row = ['name' => $name, 'avg_hours' => round($avg, 1), 'total_hours' => $data['hours'], 'linked_hc' => $data['linked_hc']];
                if ($attachTitles && isset($titlesByLevel[$name])) {
                    $top = $titlesByLevel[$name];
                    arsort($top);
                    $row['top_titles'] = $top;
                }
                $res[] = $row;
            }
            usort($res, fn ($a, $b) => $b['avg_hours'] <=> $a['avg_hours']);

            return $res;
        };

        $companyIds = array_keys($companyRanking);
        $companyNames = DB::table('companies')->whereIn('id', $companyIds)->pluck('name', 'id');

        $companyRankTable = [];
        foreach ($companyRanking as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $avgAge = $data['age_count'] > 0 ? $data['age_sum'] / $data['age_count'] : 0;
            $cov = $data['hc'] > 0 ? ($data['linked_hc'] / $data['hc']) * 100 : 0;
            $avgHours = $data['linked_hc'] > 0 ? $data['hours_sum'] / $data['linked_hc'] : 0;
            $riskPct = $data['hc'] > 0 ? ($data['risk_count'] / $data['hc']) * 100 : 0;

            $companyRankTable[] = [
                'id' => $cid,
                'name' => $name,
                'hc' => $data['hc'],
                'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
                'trained_hc' => $data['linked_hc'],
                'coverage' => round($cov, 1),
                'total_hours' => round($data['hours_sum'], 1),
                'avg_hours' => round($avgHours, 1),
                'risk_pct' => round($riskPct, 1),
            ];
        }
        usort($companyRankTable, fn ($a, $b) => $b['coverage'] <=> $a['coverage']);

        $covCompanyNamed = [];
        foreach ($covCompany as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $covCompanyNamed[$name] = $data;
        }

        $jobTitlesRanking = [];
        foreach ($jobTitlesTable as $data) {
            $covPct = $data['hc'] > 0 ? ($data['trained_hc'] / $data['hc']) * 100 : 0;
            $avgHours = $data['trained_hc'] > 0 ? ($data['hours_sum'] / $data['trained_hc']) : 0;
            $pctOfTotal = $totalEmployees > 0 ? ($data['hc'] / $totalEmployees) * 100 : 0;

            $jobTitlesRanking[] = [
                'title' => $data['title'],
                'level' => $data['level'],
                'hc' => $data['hc'],
                'pct_of_total' => round($pctOfTotal, 2),
                'trained_hc' => $data['trained_hc'],
                'coverage' => round($covPct, 1),
                'total_hours' => round($data['hours_sum'], 1),
                'avg_hours' => round($avgHours, 1),
            ];
        }
        usort($jobTitlesRanking, fn ($a, $b) => $b['hc'] <=> $a['hc']);

        return [
            'banner' => $banner,
            'coverage' => [
                'region' => $formatCoverage($covRegion),
                'company' => $formatCoverage($covCompanyNamed),
                'dept' => $formatCoverage($covDept),
                'level' => $formatCoverage($covLevel, true),
            ],
            'hours' => [
                'generation' => $formatAvg($hrsGen),
                'level' => $formatAvg($hrsLevel, true),
                'gender' => $formatAvg($hrsGender),
            ],
            'retirement_training' => $retirementTraining,
            'new_hire_no_training' => $newHireNoTrainingCount,
            'scatter' => $scatter,
            'company_ranking' => $companyRankTable,
            'job_titles_ranking' => $jobTitlesRanking,
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'banner' => null,
            'coverage' => ['region' => [], 'company' => [], 'dept' => [], 'level' => []],
            'hours' => ['generation' => [], 'level' => [], 'gender' => []],
            'retirement_training' => ['0_jam' => 0, '1_15_jam' => 0, '16_plus_jam' => 0],
            'new_hire_no_training' => 0,
            'scatter' => [],
            'company_ranking' => [],
            'job_titles_ranking' => [],
        ];
    }
}

        'J05' => ['group' => 'NON GROUP', 'region' => 'Non'],
    ];

    private array $companiesCache = [];

    private array $locationsCache = [];

    public function import(UploadedFile $file, ?int $userId = null, bool $replaceAll = false): ImportBatch
    {
        $batch = ImportBatch::create([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'type' => 'employee',
            'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName().($replaceAll ? ' (Ganti Total)' : ''),
            'status' => 'running',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $report = new ImportReport;

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($file, $report, $replaceAll) {
                if ($replaceAll) {
                    DB::table('training_records')->whereNotNull('employee_id')->update(['employee_id' => null]);
                    Storage::disk('public')->deleteDirectory('employees/photos');
                    DB::table('employees')->delete();
                }

                $this->companiesCache = DB::table('companies')->pluck('id', 'code')->all();
                $this->locationsCache = DB::table('locations')->pluck('id', 'code')->all();
                $this->processFile($file, $report);

                // Auto-relink training records to newly imported employees based on NIK
                $driver = DB::getDriverName();
                if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                    DB::statement("
                        UPDATE training_records tr
                        JOIN employees e ON tr.nik = e.employee_id
                        SET tr.employee_id = e.id
                        WHERE tr.employee_id IS NULL AND tr.nik IS NOT NULL AND tr.nik != ''
                    ");
                } else {
                    DB::statement("
                        UPDATE training_records
                        SET employee_id = (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE employees.employee_id = training_records.nik)
                        WHERE employee_id IS NULL AND nik IS NOT NULL AND nik != ''
                    ");
                }
            });

            Cache::flush();

            try {
                $batch->update([
                    'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                    'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                    'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                    'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                    'finished_at' => now(),
                    'status' => 'completed',
                ]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                file_put_contents('warnings_dump.json', json_encode($report->warnings, JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR));
                file_put_contents('warnings_dump.txt', print_r($report->warnings, true));
                throw $e;
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $batch->update([
                'status' => 'failed',
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'warnings' => ['error' => $e->getMessage()],
            ]);
            throw $e;
        }

        return $batch;
    }

    private function processFile(UploadedFile $file, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $data = Excel::toArray(new GenericImport, $file);
        if (empty($data) || empty($data[0])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('File kosong atau tidak dapat dibaca');
        }

        $rows = $data[0];
        $expectedHeader = ['Employee ID', 'Employee Name', 'Join Date', 'Employment Type', 'Job Level Code', 'Job Title Code', 'Job Title Name', 'Organization Code', 'Organization Name', 'Location Code', 'Location Name', 'Company Code', 'Company Name', 'Birth Date', 'Birth Place', 'Gender', 'Marital Status', 'Religion', 'PTKP Code', 'PTKP Name', 'Group', 'Region'];

        // Auto-detect header row within first 25 rows
        $headerRowIndex = null;
        $colIndexMap = [];

        $searchLimit = min(25, count($rows));
        for ($i = 0; $i < $searchLimit; $i++) {
            $trimmedCells = array_map(fn ($v) => trim((string) $v), (array) $rows[$i]);
            $found = [];
            foreach ($expectedHeader as $colName) {
                $foundIdx = array_search(strtolower($colName), array_map('strtolower', $trimmedCells));
                if ($foundIdx !== false) {
                    $found[$colName] = $foundIdx;
                }
            }

            if (count($found) >= count($expectedHeader) * 0.75 || (isset($found['Employee ID']) && isset($found['Employee Name']) && isset($found['Company Code']))) {
                $headerRowIndex = $i;
                $colIndexMap = $found;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($headerRowIndex === null) {
            $firstRowCells = array_map('trim', array_filter((array) ($rows[0] ?? []), fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== ''));
            $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, $firstRowCells);
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: '.implode(', ', $missing ?: $expectedHeader));
        }

        $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, array_keys($colIndexMap));
        if ($missing) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: '.implode(', ', $missing));
        }

        $existingEmpIds = DB::table('employees')->pluck('employee_id')->all();
        $importedEmpIds = [];

        // Mulai dari baris setelah header
        for ($i = $headerRowIndex + 1; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
            $r = $rows[$i];

            // Skip baris kosong
            if (empty(array_filter($r, fn ($val) => $val !== null && trim((string) $val) !== ''))) {
                continue;
            }

            $row = [];
            foreach ($colIndexMap as $colName => $colIdx) {
                $row[$colName] = $r[$colIdx] ?? null;
            }

            // Skip baris tanpa Employee ID dan tanpa Name (misal catatan di baris bawah)
            if (empty(trim((string) ($row['Employee ID'] ?? ''))) && empty(trim((string) ($row['Employee Name'] ?? '')))) {
                continue;
            }

            $report->totalRows++;
            $employeeId = trim((string) $row['Employee ID']);
            if ($employeeId !== '') {
                $importedEmpIds[] = $employeeId;
            }
            $this->processRow($row, $report);
        }

        $missing = array_diff($existingEmpIds, $importedEmpIds);
        if ($missing) {
            $report->addWarning('missing_from_file', 'Karyawan ada di DB tapi tidak ada di file baru', count($missing).' karyawan, misal: '.implode(', ', array_slice($missing, 0, 5)));
        }
    }

    private function processRow(array $r, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $now = now();
        $employeeId = trim((string) $r['Employee ID']);

        if ($employeeId === '') {
            $report->skippedRows++;
            $report->addWarning('missing_employee_id', 'Baris tanpa Employee ID');

            return;
        }

        $companyCode = trim((string) $r['Company Code']);
        $companyName = trim((string) $r['Company Name']);
        if (str_starts_with($companyName, '=')) {
            $companyName = $companyCode;
        }

        // Jika company code belum memiliki suffix pemisah ('-'), tapi company name berakhiran angka ('... 1' atau '... 2'),
        // bedakan company code menjadi turunan unik (misal 'R11-1' dan 'R11-2') agar terdaftar sebagai entitas perusahaan tersendiri.
        if (! str_contains($companyCode, '-') && preg_match('/\s+(\d+)$/', $companyName, $numMatch)) {
            $companyCode = $companyCode.'-'.$numMatch[1];
        }

        [$group, $region] = $this->resolveGroupAndRegion($companyCode, $r['Group'] ?? null, $r['Region'] ?? null, $report, $employeeId);

        if (! isset($this->companiesCache[$companyCode])) {
            $id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
                'code' => $companyCode,
                'name' => $companyName,
                'group' => $group,
                'region' => $region,
                'created_at' => $now,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
            $this->companiesCache[$companyCode] = $id;
        } else {
            DB::table('companies')->where('id', $this->companiesCache[$companyCode])->update([
                'name' => $companyName,
                'group' => $group,
                'region' => $region,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
        }
        $companyId = $this->companiesCache[$companyCode];

        $locationCode = trim((string) $r['Location Code']);
        $locationName = trim((string) $r['Location Name']);
        if (str_starts_with($locationName, '=')) {
            $locationName = $locationCode;
        }

        if (! isset($this->locationsCache[$locationCode])) {
            $id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId([
                'code' => $locationCode,
                'name' => $locationName,
                'created_at' => $now,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
            $this->locationsCache[$locationCode] = $id;
        } else {
            DB::table('locations')->where('id', $this->locationsCache[$locationCode])->update([
                'name' => $locationName,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
        }
        $locationId = $this->locationsCache[$locationCode];

        $birth = Clean::birth($r['Birth Date']);
        $join = Clean::join($r['Join Date']);

        if (! $birth || ! $join || $join->lt($birth->copy()->addYears(15)) || $join->isFuture()) {
            $report->addWarning('suspicious_dates', 'Tanggal lahir/masuk mencurigakan', "Employee ID: $employeeId");
        }

        DB::table('employees')->updateOrInsert(
            ['employee_id' => $employeeId],
            [
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Employee Name']),
                'join_date' => $join?->toDateString(),
                'birth_date' => $birth?->toDateString(),
                'birth_place' => trim((string) $r['Birth Place']) ?: null,
                'employment_type' => trim((string) $r['Employment Type']),
                'job_level_code' => trim((string) $r['Job Level Code']),
                'job_title_code' => trim((string) $r['Job Title Code']),
                'job_title_name' => trim((string) $r['Job Title Name']),
                'organization_code' => trim((string) $r['Organization Code']),
                'organization_name' => trim((string) $r['Organization Name']),
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'gender' => trim((string) $r['Gender']),
                'marital_status' => trim((string) $r['Marital Status']),
                'religion' => trim((string) $r['Religion']),
                'ptkp_code' => trim((string) $r['PTKP Code']),
                'ptkp_name' => trim((string) $r['PTKP Name']),
                'group' => $group,
                'region' => $region,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]
        );

        $report->importedRows++;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    private function resolveGroupAndRegion(string $companyCode, ?string $rawGroup, ?string $rawRegion, ImportReport $report, string $employeeId): array
    {
        $group = trim((string) $rawGroup);
        $region = Clean::region($rawRegion) ?? trim((string) $rawRegion);

        $isGroupCorrupt = str_starts_with($group, '=') || str_starts_with($group, '#') || $group === '';
        $isRegionCorrupt = str_starts_with($region, '=') || str_starts_with($region, '#') || $region === '';

        if ($isGroupCorrupt || $isRegionCorrupt) {
            $baseCode = explode('-', $companyCode)[0];
            $default = self::COMPANY_DEFAULTS[$companyCode] ?? self::COMPANY_DEFAULTS[$baseCode] ?? null;

            if (! $default) {
                $prefix = strtoupper(substr($companyCode, 0, 1));
                $default = match ($prefix) {
                    'R' => ['group' => 'FR', 'region' => 'Riau'],
                    'B' => ($baseCode === 'B10') ? ['group' => 'PO2', 'region' => 'Corp'] : ['group' => 'FR', 'region' => 'Kalbar'],
                    'T' => ($baseCode === 'T16') ? ['group' => 'NON GROUP', 'region' => 'Non'] : ['group' => 'FR', 'region' => 'Kaltim'],
                    'U', 'L' => ['group' => 'PO2', 'region' => 'Corp'],
                    'J' => ['group' => 'NON GROUP', 'region' => 'Non'],
                    default => null,
                };
            }

            if ($default) {
                if ($isGroupCorrupt) {
                    $group = $default['group'];
                }
                if ($isRegionCorrupt) {
                    $region = $default['region'];
                }

                $report->addWarning(
                    'formula_or_empty_group_region',
                    'Kolom Group/Region berupa formula Excel atau kosong, otomatis dipulihkan ke nilai standar.',
                    "Employee ID: $employeeId ($companyCode -> Group: $group, Region: $region)"
                );
            }
        }

        return [$group, $region];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

class ImportReport
{
    public int $totalRows = 0;

    public int $importedRows = 0;

    public int $skippedRows = 0;

    public array $warnings = [];

    public function addWarning(string $category, string $message, ?string $sample = null): void
    {
        if (! isset($this->warnings[$category])) {
            $this->warnings[$category] = ['message' => $message, 'count' => 0, 'samples' => []];
        }
        $this->warnings[$category]['count']++;
        if ($sample) {
            if (! mb_check_encoding($sample, 'UTF-8')) {
                $sample = mb_convert_encoding($sample, 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1');
            }
            if (count($this->warnings[$category]['samples']) < 20) {
                $this->warnings[$category]['samples'][] = $sample;
            }
        }
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'total_rows' => $this->totalRows,
            'imported_rows' => $this->importedRows,
            'skipped_rows' => $this->skippedRows,
            'warnings' => $this->warnings,
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Services/Import/StaffResignImporter.php

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

use App\Imports\GenericImport;
use App\Models\StaffResign;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use DateTimeInterface;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date as ExcelDate;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class StaffResignImporter
{
    /**
     * Import resignation data from uploaded file (xlsx, xls, csv).
     *
     * @return array{success: bool, total: int, imported: int, updated: int, skipped: int, errors: array}
     */
    public function import(UploadedFile $file, string $mode = 'append'): array
    {
        $extension = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        $rows = [];

        if (in_array($extension, ['csv', 'txt'])) {
            $rows = $this->readCsv($file);
        } else {
            $data = Excel::toArray(new GenericImport, $file);
            if (empty($data) || empty($data[0])) {
                throw new RuntimeException('File Excel kosong atau tidak dapat dibaca.');
            }
            $rows = $data[0];
        }

        if (empty($rows)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Tidak ada data baris yang ditemukan dalam file.');
        }

        // Auto detect header row (within first 15 rows)
        $headerIndex = null;
        $headerMap = [];

        foreach (array_slice($rows, 0, 15, true) as $idx => $row) {
            $map = $this->resolveHeaderMap($row);
            if (isset($map['nama']) || (isset($map['employee_id']) && isset($map['resign_date']))) {
                $headerIndex = $idx;
                $headerMap = $map;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($headerIndex === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Header kolom tidak dikenali. Pastikan file memiliki minimal kolom "Nama Karyawan" atau "NIK" dan "Tgl Resign".');
        }

        $dataRows = array_slice($rows, $headerIndex + 1);
        if (empty($dataRows)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('File hanya berisi header tanpa ada baris data karyawan.');
        }

        $imported = 0;
        $updated = 0;
        $skipped = 0;
        $total = 0;
        $errors = [];

        DB::transaction(function () use ($dataRows, $headerMap, $mode, &$imported, &$updated, &$skipped, &$total, &$errors) {
            if ($mode === 'replace') {
                StaffResign::truncate();
            }

            foreach ($dataRows as $rowIdx => $row) {
                // Check if row is empty
                $rowValues = array_filter($row, fn ($v) => $v !== null && trim((string) $v) !== '');
                if (empty($rowValues)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $total++;
                $actualRowNumber = $rowIdx + 2;

                $rawName = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'nama');
                $rawNik = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'employee_id');

                if (empty($rawName) && empty($rawNik)) {
                    $skipped++;

                    continue;
                }

                $nama = ! empty($rawName) ? trim((string) $rawName) : 'Karyawan (NIK: '.$rawNik.')';
                $employeeId = ! empty($rawNik) ? trim((string) $rawNik) : null;

                $rawResignDate = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'resign_date');
                $resignDate = $this->parseDate($rawResignDate);

                if (! $resignDate) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris {$actualRowNumber}: Tanggal resign ({$rawResignDate}) tidak valid, baris dilewati.";
                    $skipped++;

                    continue;
                }

                $rawJoinDate = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'join_date');
                $joinDate = $this->parseDate($rawJoinDate);

                $jabatan = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'jabatan') ?: '-';
                $kebun = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'kebun') ?: '-';
                $rawRegion = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'region') ?: 'Riau';
                $rawJenis = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'jenis_resign') ?: 'VOLUNTARY';
                $rawCluster = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'cluster_resign') ?: 'Lainnya';
                $rawAlumni = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'alumni') ?: 'Non Alumni';
                $deskripsiResign = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'deskripsi_resign');
                $keterangan = $this->getValue($row, $headerMap, 'keterangan');

                // Normalizations
                $region = $this->normalizeRegion($rawRegion);
                $jenisResign = $this->normalizeJenisResign($rawJenis);
                $clusterResign = $this->normalizeClusterResign($rawCluster);
                $alumni = $this->normalizeAlumni($rawAlumni);

                $recordData = [
                    'employee_id' => $employeeId,
                    'nama' => $nama,
                    'join_date' => $joinDate,
                    'resign_date' => $resignDate,
                    'jabatan' => trim((string) $jabatan),
                    'kebun' => trim((string) $kebun),
                    'region' => $region,
                    'jenis_resign' => $jenisResign,
                    'cluster_resign' => $clusterResign,
                    'alumni' => $alumni,
                    'deskripsi_resign' => $deskripsiResign ? trim((string) $deskripsiResign) : null,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan ? trim((string) $keterangan) : null,
                ];

                if ($mode === 'replace') {
                    StaffResign::create($recordData);
                    $imported++;
                } else {
                    // Check duplicate for upsert/append
                    $query = StaffResign::query()->where('resign_date', $resignDate);
                    if (! empty($employeeId)) {
                        $query->where(function ($q) use ($employeeId, $nama) {
                            $q->where('employee_id', $employeeId)->orWhere('nama', $nama);
                        });
                    } else {
                        $query->where('nama', $nama);
                    }

                    $existing = $query->first();

                    if ($existing) {
                        $existing->update($recordData);
                        $updated++;
                    } else {
                        StaffResign::create($recordData);
                        $imported++;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'total' => $total,
            'imported' => $imported,
            'updated' => $updated,
            'skipped' => $skipped,
            'errors' => $errors,
        ];
    }

    private function readCsv(UploadedFile $file): array
    {
        $path = $file->getRealPath();
        $handle = fopen($path, 'r');
        if (! $handle) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Gagal membuka file CSV.');
        }

        // Read first line to detect delimiter (comma or semicolon)
        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
        rewind($handle);

        $delimiter = ';';
        if ($firstLine !== false && substr_count($firstLine, ',') > substr_count($firstLine, ';')) {
            $delimiter = ',';
        }

        $rows = [];
        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            $rows[] = $data;
        }

        fclose($handle);

        return $rows;
    }

    private function resolveHeaderMap(array $row): array
    {
        $map = [];

        foreach ($row as $colIdx => $headerVal) {
            if ($headerVal === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $clean = strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', (string) $headerVal)));

            if (in_array($clean, ['nik', 'employeeid', 'id', 'nip'])) {
                $map['employee_id'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['nama', 'namakaryawan', 'employeename', 'name'])) {
                $map['nama'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tgljoin', 'joindate', 'tanggaljoin', 'tglmasuk', 'tanggalmasuk'])) {
                $map['join_date'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tglresign', 'resigndate', 'tanggalresign', 'tglkeluar', 'tanggalkeluar', 'resign'])) {
                $map['resign_date'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['jabatan', 'jobtitle', 'posisi', 'jobtitlename'])) {
                $map['jabatan'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['kebun', 'unit', 'lokasi', 'lokasikerja', 'estate'])) {
                $map['kebun'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['region', 'wilayah'])) {
                $map['region'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['jenisresign', 'jenis', 'voluntaryinvoluntary', 'statusresign'])) {
                $map['jenis_resign'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['clusterresign', 'cluster', 'klaster', 'klasterresign', 'kategori'])) {
                $map['cluster_resign'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['alumni', 'statusalumni'])) {
                $map['alumni'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['alasanresign', 'deskripsiresign', 'alasan', 'keteranganresign', 'reason'])) {
                $map['deskripsi_resign'] = $colIdx;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['keterangan', 'catatan', 'notes', 'remark'])) {
                $map['keterangan'] = $colIdx;
            }
        }

        return $map;
    }

    private function getValue(array $row, array $map, string $key): mixed
    {
        if (! isset($map[$key])) {
            return null;
        }

        $colIdx = $map[$key];

        return $row[$colIdx] ?? null;
    }

    private function parseDate(mixed $val): ?string
    {
        if ($val === null || $val === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if ($val instanceof DateTimeInterface) {
            return Carbon::instance($val)->format('Y-m-d');
        }

        // Numeric Excel date serial
        if (is_numeric($val) && (float) $val > 25569 && (float) $val < 65000) {
            try {
                return Carbon::instance(ExcelDate::excelToDateTimeObject((float) $val))->format('Y-m-d');
            } catch (Throwable) {
                // Fallback
            }
        }

        $str = trim((string) $val);

        // Try standard formats
        $formats = ['Y-m-d', 'd/m/Y', 'd-m-Y', 'Y/m/d', 'm/d/Y', 'd M Y', 'd-M-Y', 'd F Y'];
        foreach ($formats as $fmt) {
            try {
                $d = Carbon::createFromFormat($fmt, $str);
                if ($d && $d->format($fmt) === $str) {
                    return $d->format('Y-m-d');
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($str)->format('Y-m-d');
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private function normalizeRegion(mixed $val): string
    {
        $str = strtolower(trim((string) $val));
        if (str_contains($str, 'kubar') || str_contains($str, 'kaltim')) {
            return 'Kaltim';
        }
        if (str_contains($str, 'kalbar')) {
            return 'Kalbar';
        }

        return 'Riau';
    }

    private function normalizeJenisResign(mixed $val): string
    {
        $str = strtoupper(trim((string) $val));
        if (str_contains($str, 'INVOLUNTARY')) {
            return 'INVOLUNTARY';
        }

        return 'VOLUNTARY';
    }

    private function normalizeClusterResign(mixed $val): string
    {
        $raw = trim((string) $val);
        if ($raw === '') {
            return 'Lainnya';
        }

        $clusterMap = [
            'pindah perusahaan' => 'Pindah Perusahaan',
            'working condition' => 'Working Condition',
            'under perform' => 'Under Perform',
            'keluarga' => 'Keluarga',
            'efisiensi' => 'Efisiensi',
            'kasus' => 'Kasus',
            'meninggalkan kebun tanpa keterangan' => 'Meninggalkan Kebun Tanpa Keterangan',
            'hbs kontrak' => 'Hbs Kontrak',
            'indisipliner' => 'Indisipliner',
        ];

        $lower = strtolower($raw);
        if (isset($clusterMap[$lower])) {
            return $clusterMap[$lower];
        }

        return ucwords($lower);
    }

    private function normalizeAlumni(mixed $val): string
    {
        $str = strtolower(trim((string) $val));
        if (str_contains($str, 'alumni') && ! str_contains($str, 'non')) {
            return 'Alumni';
        }

        return 'Non Alumni';
    }
}

File: app/Services/Import/TrainingImporter.php

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

use App\Imports\GenericImport;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Portal\PortalTrainingClient;
use App\Support\Clean;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class TrainingImporter
{
    private array $companyByKey = [];

    private array $aliasMap = [];

    private array $employeeIds = [];

    public function import(UploadedFile $file, ?int $userId = null): ImportBatch
    {
        $batch = ImportBatch::create([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'type' => 'training',
            'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            'status' => 'running',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $report = new ImportReport;

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($file, $report) {
                // Delete existing records
                DB::table('training_records')->delete();

                $this->loadLookups();

                $this->processFile($file, $report);
            });

            Cache::flush();

            $batch->update([
                'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'status' => 'completed',
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $batch->update([
                'status' => 'failed',
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'warnings' => ['error' => $e->getMessage()],
            ]);
            throw $e;
        }

        return $batch;
    }

    public function importFromPortal(
        ?int $userId = null,
        bool $dryRun = false,
        bool $scheduled = false,
        ?PortalTrainingClient $client = null
    ): ImportBatch {
        $lock = Cache::lock('portal-sync', 600);

        if (! $lock->get()) {
            if ($scheduled) {
                $batch = ImportBatch::create([
                    'user_id' => null,
                    'type' => 'training',
                    'filename' => 'Portal API (terjadwal)',
                    'status' => 'failed',
                    'started_at' => now(),
                    'finished_at' => now(),
                    'warnings' => ['error' => 'Sinkronisasi sedang berjalan.'],
                ]);
                AuditLogger::log(null, 'import.portal_sync_scheduled', null, null, ['status' => 'failed', 'reason' => 'lock_acquired']);

                return $batch;
            }

            throw new RuntimeException('Sinkronisasi sedang berjalan.');
        }

        try {
            $client = $client ?? app(PortalTrainingClient::class);

            $filename = $scheduled
                ? 'Portal API (terjadwal)'
                : ($dryRun ? 'Portal API (dry-run)' : 'Portal API (training-records/export)');
            $batchUserId = $scheduled ? null : $userId;

            $batch = null;
            if (! $dryRun) {
                $batch = ImportBatch::create([
                    'user_id' => $batchUserId,
                    'type' => 'training',
                    'filename' => $filename,
                    'status' => 'running',
                    'started_at' => now(),
                ]);
            }

            try {
                // Fetch all rows from API before touching database
                $apiRows = $client->fetchAll();
                $mappedRows = array_map(fn ($row) => $client->mapRow($row), $apiRows);

                // Guard penurunan drastis khusus mode terjadwal
                if ($scheduled) {
                    $currentLocalCount = DB::table('training_records')->count();
                    $minRatio = (float) config('services.portal.sync_min_ratio', 0.8);
                    $fetchedCount = count($mappedRows);

                    if ($currentLocalCount > 0 && $fetchedCount < ($currentLocalCount * $minRatio)) {
                        throw new RuntimeException("Jumlah data portal turun drastis ({$fetchedCount} dari {$currentLocalCount}).");
                    }
                }

                $report = new ImportReport;

                if ($dryRun) {
                    $this->loadLookups();
                    $this->processMappedRows($mappedRows, $report, true);

                    return new ImportBatch([
                        'user_id' => $userId,
                        'type' => 'training',
                        'filename' => 'Portal API (dry-run)',
                        'status' => 'completed',
                        'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                        'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                        'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                        'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                        'started_at' => now(),
                        'finished_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                DB::transaction(function () use ($mappedRows, $report) {
                    DB::table('training_records')->delete();

                    $this->loadLookups();
                    $this->processMappedRows($mappedRows, $report, false);
                });

                $batch->update([
                    'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                    'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                    'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                    'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                    'finished_at' => now(),
                    'status' => 'completed',
                ]);

                if ($scheduled) {
                    AuditLogger::log(null, 'import.portal_sync_scheduled', null, null, [
                        'status' => 'completed',
                        'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                        'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                    ]);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($batch) {
                    $batch->update([
                        'status' => 'failed',
                        'finished_at' => now(),
                        'warnings' => ['error' => $e->getMessage()],
                    ]);
                }

                if ($scheduled) {
                    AuditLogger::log(null, 'import.portal_sync_scheduled', null, null, [
                        'status' => 'failed',
                        'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                    ]);
                }

                throw $e;
            }

            return $batch;
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }
    }

    private function loadLookups(): void
    {
        $this->companyByKey = DB::table('companies')->get()->keyBy(fn ($c) => Clean::companyKey($c->name))->map->id->all();
        $this->aliasMap = DB::table('company_aliases')->pluck('company_id', 'alias')->all();
        $this->employeeIds = DB::table('employees')->pluck('id', 'employee_id')->all();
    }

    private function processFile(UploadedFile $file, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $data = Excel::toArray(new GenericImport, $file);
        if (empty($data) || empty($data[0])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('File kosong atau tidak dapat dibaca');
        }

        $rows = $data[0];
        $expectedHeader = ['NIK', 'Nama', 'Jenis Kelamin', 'Nama PT', 'Department', 'lokasi Kerja', 'Group', 'REGION', 'GOL', 'Jabatan', 'Tgl', 'Bln', 'Thn', 'Jml Hari', 'Jam Pelatihan', 'Nama Pelatihan', 'Instruktur', 'Tempat Pelatihan', 'Reg / Non Reg', 'Keterangan', 'Internal/Eksternal', 'Level', 'Periode'];

        // Auto-detect header row within first 25 rows
        $headerRowIndex = null;
        $colIndexMap = [];

        $searchLimit = min(25, count($rows));
        for ($i = 0; $i < $searchLimit; $i++) {
            $trimmedCells = array_map(fn ($v) => trim((string) $v), (array) $rows[$i]);
            $found = [];
            foreach ($expectedHeader as $colName) {
                $foundIdx = array_search(strtolower($colName), array_map('strtolower', $trimmedCells));
                if ($foundIdx !== false) {
                    $found[$colName] = $foundIdx;
                }
            }

            if (count($found) >= count($expectedHeader) * 0.75 || (isset($found['NIK']) && isset($found['Nama']) && isset($found['Nama Pelatihan']))) {
                $headerRowIndex = $i;
                $colIndexMap = $found;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($headerRowIndex === null) {
            $firstRowCells = array_map('trim', array_filter((array) ($rows[0] ?? []), fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== ''));
            $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, $firstRowCells);
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: '.implode(', ', $missing ?: $expectedHeader));
        }

        $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, array_keys($colIndexMap));
        if ($missing) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: '.implode(', ', $missing));
        }

        $mappedRows = [];

        for ($i = $headerRowIndex + 1; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
            $r = $rows[$i];

            if (empty(array_filter($r, fn ($val) => $val !== null && trim((string) $val) !== ''))) {
                continue;
            }

            $row = [];
            foreach ($colIndexMap as $colName => $colIdx) {
                $row[$colName] = $r[$colIdx] ?? null;
            }

            if (empty(trim((string) ($row['NIK'] ?? ''))) && empty(trim((string) ($row['Nama'] ?? '')))) {
                continue;
            }

            $mappedRows[] = $row;
        }

        $this->processMappedRows($mappedRows, $report, false);
    }

    private function processMappedRows(array $mappedRows, ImportReport $report, bool $dryRun = false): void
    {
        $insertBatch = [];

        foreach ($mappedRows as $row) {
            $report->totalRows++;

            $month = Clean::month($row['Bln']);
            $year = (int) trim((string) $row['Thn']);
            if (! $month || ! $year) {
                $report->skippedRows++;
                $report->addWarning('missing_date', 'Tanpa bulan/tahun', "Baris {$report->totalRows}");

                continue;
            }

            $nikRaw = substr(trim((string) $row['NIK']), 0, 40) ?: null;
            $nikStatus = Clean::nikStatus($row['NIK']);
            $nik = Clean::nik($row['NIK']);

            if ($nikStatus === 'empty') {
                $report->addWarning('nik_empty', 'NIK kosong atau "-"', $nikRaw);
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'corrupt') {
                $report->addWarning('nik_corrupt', 'NIK rusak (notasi ilmiah)', $nikRaw);
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'invalid') {
                $report->addWarning('nik_invalid', 'NIK tidak valid (huruf)', $nikRaw);
            }

            $empId = $nik ? ($this->employeeIds[$nik] ?? null) : null;
            if ($nik && ! $empId) {
                $report->addWarning('nik_unmatched', 'NIK rapi tetapi tidak ditemukan di data Karyawan', $nik);
            }

            $rawPt = trim((string) $row['Nama PT']);
            $key = Clean::companyKey($rawPt);
            $companyId = $this->aliasMap[$key] ?? $this->companyByKey[$key] ?? null;

            if ($key !== '' && ! array_key_exists($key, $this->aliasMap)) {
                if (! $dryRun) {
                    DB::table('company_aliases')->insertOrIgnore([
                        'alias' => $key,
                        'company_id' => $companyId,
                        'created_at' => now(),
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }
                $this->aliasMap[$key] = $companyId;
            }

            if (! $companyId && $key !== '') {
                $report->addWarning('company_unmapped', 'Alias PT belum terpetakan', $rawPt);
            }

            $hours = is_numeric($row['Jam Pelatihan']) ? (float) $row['Jam Pelatihan'] : 0.0;
            if ($hours == 0) {
                $report->addWarning('hours_zero', 'Jam pelatihan 0', "Baris {$report->totalRows}");
            }

            if (! $dryRun) {
                $insertBatch[] = [
                    'nik' => $nik,
                    'nik_raw' => $nikRaw,
                    'nik_status' => $nikStatus,
                    'employee_id' => $empId,
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'participant_name' => trim((string) $row['Nama']),
                    'gender' => trim((string) $row['Jenis Kelamin']) ?: null,
                    'company_name_raw' => $rawPt ?: null,
                    'department' => trim((string) $row['Department']) ?: null,
                    'work_location' => trim((string) $row['lokasi Kerja']) ?: null,
                    'group' => trim((string) $row['Group']) ?: null,
                    'region' => Clean::region($row['REGION']),
                    'grade' => trim((string) $row['GOL']) ?: null,
                    'position' => trim((string) $row['Jabatan']) ?: null,
                    'year' => $year,
                    'month' => $month,
                    'days' => is_numeric($row['Jml Hari']) ? (int) $row['Jml Hari'] : null,
                    'hours' => $hours,
                    'training_name' => trim((string) $row['Nama Pelatihan']),
                    'instructor' => trim((string) $row['Instruktur']) ?: null,
                    'venue' => trim((string) $row['Tempat Pelatihan']) ?: null,
                    'regularity' => Clean::regularity($row['Reg / Non Reg']),
                    'note' => trim((string) $row['Keterangan']) ?: null,
                    'source_type' => trim((string) $row['Internal/Eksternal']) ?: null,
                    'level' => Clean::level($row['Level']),
                    'period' => substr(trim((string) $row['Periode']), 0, 5) ?: null,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ];

                if (count($insertBatch) >= 500) {
                    DB::table('training_records')->insert($insertBatch);
                    $insertBatch = [];
                }
            }

            $report->importedRows++;
        }

        if (! $dryRun && $insertBatch) {
            DB::table('training_records')->insert($insertBatch);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

class InsightBuilder
{
    /**
     * Menghasilkan teks ringkasan (PRD 4.7)
     * "Mayoritas karyawan adalah generasi {gen_terbanyak} ({gen_pct}%) dan berada di usia produktif (rata-rata {avg_age} tahun). Risiko kehilangan pengetahuan cukup {tingkat_risiko} dengan {pensiun_count} karyawan ({pensiun_pct}%) yang akan pensiun dalam 5 tahun ke depan."
     */
    public static function build(array $rawTotals, float $avgAge, int $totalHc): ?string
    {
        if ($totalHc === 0 || empty($rawTotals['generations'])) {
            return null;
        }

        $generations = $rawTotals['generations'];
        arsort($generations);
        $topGen = array_key_first($generations);
        $topGenCount = $generations[$topGen];
        $genPct = round(($topGenCount / $totalHc) * 100, 1);

        $pensiunCount = $rawTotals['pensiun'];
        $pensiunPct = round(($pensiunCount / $totalHc) * 100, 1);

        $tingkatRisiko = $pensiunPct > 10 ? 'tinggi' : ($pensiunPct > 5 ? 'sedang' : 'rendah');

        return "Mayoritas karyawan adalah generasi {$topGen} ({$genPct}%) dan berada di usia produktif (rata-rata {$avgAge} tahun). Risiko kehilangan pengetahuan cukup {$tingkatRisiko} dengan {$pensiunCount} karyawan ({$pensiunPct}%) yang akan segera memasuki batas usia pensiun (55).";
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Portal;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class PortalTrainingClient
{
    /**
     * Ambil seluruh data training dari Portal API dengan paginasi.
     *
     * @return array Array dari baris data mentah API
     *
     * @throws RuntimeException
     */
    public function fetchAll(): array
    {
        $url = config('services.portal.url');
        $token = config('services.portal.token');
        $timeout = (int) config('services.portal.timeout', 30);
        $verifySsl = (bool) config('services.portal.verify_ssl', true);

        if (empty($url) || empty($token)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Koneksi portal belum dikonfigurasi.');
        }

        $endpoint = rtrim($url, '/').'/api/v1/training-records/export';

        $page = 1;
        $lastPage = 1;
        $allRows = [];
        $expectedTotal = null;

        do {
            try {
                $client = Http::withToken($token)
                    ->acceptJson()
                    ->timeout($timeout)
                    ->retry(3, 500);

                if (! $verifySsl) {
                    $client = $client->withoutVerifying();
                }

                $response = $client->get($endpoint, [
                    'per_page' => 1000,
                    'page' => $page,
                ]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Gagal terhubung ke Portal API: '.$e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
            }

            if (! $response->successful()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Gagal mengambil data dari Portal API (Status: {$response->status()}).");
            }

            $data = $response->json();
            if (! is_array($data) || ! isset($data['data']) || ! is_array($data['data'])) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Format respon dari Portal API tidak valid.');
            }

            if ($page === 1) {
                $meta = $data['meta'] ?? [];
                $expectedTotal = isset($meta['total']) ? (int) $meta['total'] : null;
                $lastPage = isset($meta['last_page']) ? (int) $meta['last_page'] : 1;
            }

            foreach ($data['data'] as $row) {
                $allRows[] = (array) $row;
            }

            $page++;
        } while ($page <= $lastPage);

        if ($expectedTotal !== null && count($allRows) !== $expectedTotal) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Jumlah baris portal ('.count($allRows).') tidak cocok dengan meta total ('.$expectedTotal.').');
        }

        if (count($allRows) === 0 && DB::table('training_records')->exists()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Portal mengembalikan 0 data training, sinkronisasi dibatalkan untuk melindungi data lokal.');
        }

        return $allRows;
    }

    /**
     * Memetakan field API ke kunci header Excel.
     *
     * @param  array  $api  Baris data dari API portal
     * @return array Baris data berkunci header Excel
     */
    public function mapRow(array $api): array
    {
        return [
            'NIK' => isset($api['nik']) ? (string) $api['nik'] : '',
            'Nama' => $api['nama'] ?? '',
            'Jenis Kelamin' => $api['jenis_kelamin'] ?? '',
            'Nama PT' => $api['nama_pt'] ?? '',
            'Department' => $api['department'] ?? '',
            'lokasi Kerja' => $api['lokasi_kerja'] ?? '',
            'Group' => $api['group'] ?? '',
            'REGION' => $api['region'] ?? '',
            'GOL' => $api['gol'] ?? '',
            'Jabatan' => $api['jabatan'] ?? '',
            'Tgl' => null,
            'Bln' => $api['bulan'] ?? '',
            'Thn' => isset($api['tahun']) ? (string) $api['tahun'] : '',
            'Jml Hari' => $api['jml_hari'] ?? null,
            'Jam Pelatihan' => $api['jam_pelatihan'] ?? 0,
            'Nama Pelatihan' => $api['nama_pelatihan'] ?? '',
            'Instruktur' => $api['instruktur'] ?? '',
            'Tempat Pelatihan' => $api['tempat_pelatihan'] ?? '',
            'Reg / Non Reg' => $api['reg_non_reg'] ?? '',
            'Keterangan' => null,
            'Internal/Eksternal' => $api['internal_eksternal'] ?? '',
            'Level' => $api['level'] ?? '',
            'Periode' => $api['periode'] ?? '',
        ];
    }
}
