<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\StaffResign;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ResignationMetrics
{
    /**
     * Compute comprehensive metrics for Resignation Dashboard.
     */
    public function getMetrics(Request $request): array
    {
        $selectedYear = $request->input('year', 'all');
        $rawRegion = $request->input('region', 'all');

        $selectedRegions = [];
        if ($rawRegion !== 'all' && ! empty($rawRegion)) {
            $selectedRegions = collect(Arr::flatten((array) $rawRegion))
                ->filter(fn ($r) => ! empty($r) && $r !== 'all')
                ->values()
                ->all();
        }

        // Dynamically discover available years from the database
        $availableYears = StaffResign::query()
            ->whereNotNull('resign_date')
            ->selectRaw('DISTINCT YEAR(resign_date) as yr')
            ->orderByDesc('yr')
            ->pluck('yr')
            ->map(fn ($y) => (int) $y)
            ->values()
            ->toArray();

        if (empty($availableYears)) {
            $availableYears = [(int) date('Y'), (int) date('Y') - 1];
        }

        // Target (Current) Year & Comparison (Previous) Year
        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && ! empty($selectedYear)) {
            $targetYear = (int) $selectedYear;
        } else {
            // Default to the latest year in DB
            $targetYear = $availableYears[0];
        }
        $compareYear = $targetYear - 1;

        // Base query for current filter (scoped by region)
        $baseQuery = StaffResign::query();
        if (! empty($selectedRegions)) {
            $baseQuery->whereIn('region', $selectedRegions);
        }

        // Clone base queries for comparison year and target year
        $qPrev = (clone $baseQuery)->whereYear('resign_date', $compareYear);
        $qCurr = (clone $baseQuery)->whereYear('resign_date', $targetYear);

        // 1. KPI Cards Calculations
        $totalPrev = (clone $qPrev)->count();
        $totalCurr = (clone $qCurr)->count();

        $vtPrev = (clone $qPrev)->where('jenis_resign', 'VOLUNTARY')->count();
        $vtCurr = (clone $qCurr)->where('jenis_resign', 'VOLUNTARY')->count();

        $itPrev = (clone $qPrev)->where('jenis_resign', 'INVOLUNTARY')->count();
        $itCurr = (clone $qCurr)->where('jenis_resign', 'INVOLUNTARY')->count();

        $alumniPrev = (clone $qPrev)->where('alumni', 'Alumni')->count();
        $alumniCurr = (clone $qCurr)->where('alumni', 'Alumni')->count();

        $nonAlumniPrev = (clone $qPrev)->where('alumni', 'Non Alumni')->count();
        $nonAlumniCurr = (clone $qCurr)->where('alumni', 'Non Alumni')->count();

        $kpis = [
            'total' => [
                'count_prev' => $totalPrev,
                'count_curr' => $totalCurr,
                'count_2025' => $totalPrev,
                'count_2026' => $totalCurr,
                'diff' => $totalCurr - $totalPrev,
                'diff_pct' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round((($totalCurr - $totalPrev) / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ],
            'vt' => [
                'count_prev' => $vtPrev,
                'pct_prev' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($vtPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_curr' => $vtCurr,
                'pct_curr' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($vtCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2025' => $vtPrev,
                'pct_2025' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($vtPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2026' => $vtCurr,
                'pct_2026' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($vtCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'diff' => $vtCurr - $vtPrev,
                'diff_pct' => $vtPrev > 0 ? round((($vtCurr - $vtPrev) / $vtPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ],
            'it' => [
                'count_prev' => $itPrev,
                'pct_prev' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($itPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_curr' => $itCurr,
                'pct_curr' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($itCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2025' => $itPrev,
                'pct_2025' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($itPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2026' => $itCurr,
                'pct_2026' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($itCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'diff' => $itCurr - $itPrev,
                'diff_pct' => $itPrev > 0 ? round((($itCurr - $itPrev) / $itPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ],
            'alumni' => [
                'count_prev' => $alumniPrev,
                'pct_prev' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($alumniPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_curr' => $alumniCurr,
                'pct_curr' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($alumniCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2025' => $alumniPrev,
                'pct_2025' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($alumniPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2026' => $alumniCurr,
                'pct_2026' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($alumniCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'diff' => $alumniCurr - $alumniPrev,
                'diff_pct' => $alumniPrev > 0 ? round((($alumniCurr - $alumniPrev) / $alumniPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ],
            'non_alumni' => [
                'count_prev' => $nonAlumniPrev,
                'pct_prev' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($nonAlumniPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_curr' => $nonAlumniCurr,
                'pct_curr' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($nonAlumniCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2025' => $nonAlumniPrev,
                'pct_2025' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($nonAlumniPrev / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'count_2026' => $nonAlumniCurr,
                'pct_2026' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($nonAlumniCurr / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'diff' => $nonAlumniCurr - $nonAlumniPrev,
                'diff_pct' => $nonAlumniPrev > 0 ? round((($nonAlumniCurr - $nonAlumniPrev) / $nonAlumniPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ],
        ];

        // 2. Cluster Penyebab Resign (Comparison prev vs curr)
        $clusters = (clone $baseQuery)
            ->select('cluster_resign')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('cluster_resign')
            ->filter()
            ->values();

        $clusterData = [];
        foreach ($clusters as $cl) {
            $cP = (clone $qPrev)->where('cluster_resign', $cl)->count();
            $cC = (clone $qCurr)->where('cluster_resign', $cl)->count();
            $vt = (clone $baseQuery)->where('cluster_resign', $cl)->where('jenis_resign', 'VOLUNTARY')->count();
            $it = (clone $baseQuery)->where('cluster_resign', $cl)->where('jenis_resign', 'INVOLUNTARY')->count();

            $clusterData[] = [
                'cluster' => $cl,
                'y_prev' => $cP,
                'y_curr' => $cC,
                'y2025' => $cP,
                'y2026' => $cC,
                'total' => $cP + $cC,
                'pct_prev' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($cP / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_curr' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($cC / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_2025' => $totalPrev > 0 ? round(($cP / $totalPrev) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_2026' => $totalCurr > 0 ? round(($cC / $totalCurr) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'vt' => $vt,
                'it' => $it,
                'diff' => $cC - $cP,
                'diff_pct' => $cP > 0 ? round((($cC - $cP) / $cP) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ];
        }

        // Sort clusters by total descending
        usort($clusterData, fn ($a, $b) => $b['total'] <=> $a['total']);

        // 3. Cluster Resign by Jabatan (Comparison prev vs curr)
        $jabatans = (clone $baseQuery)
            ->select('jabatan')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('jabatan')
            ->filter()
            ->values();

        $jabatanData = [];
        foreach ($jabatans as $jb) {
            $jP = (clone $qPrev)->where('jabatan', $jb)->count();
            $jC = (clone $qCurr)->where('jabatan', $jb)->count();

            $jabatanData[] = [
                'jabatan' => $jb,
                'y_prev' => $jP,
                'y_curr' => $jC,
                'y2025' => $jP,
                'y2026' => $jC,
                'total' => $jP + $jC,
            ];
        }

        usort($jabatanData, fn ($a, $b) => $b['total'] <=> $a['total']);

        // 4. Sebaran Top 10 Per Kebun
        $topKebunPrev = (clone $qPrev)
            ->select('kebun', DB::raw('count(*) as total'), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'VOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'INVOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"))
            ->groupBy('kebun')
            ->orderByDesc('total')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get()
            ->map(fn ($row) => [
                'kebun' => $row->kebun,
                'total' => (int) $row->total,
                'vt' => (int) $row->vt,
                'it' => (int) $row->it,
            ])
            ->toArray();

        $topKebunCurr = (clone $qCurr)
            ->select('kebun', DB::raw('count(*) as total'), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'VOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'INVOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"))
            ->groupBy('kebun')
            ->orderByDesc('total')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get()
            ->map(fn ($row) => [
                'kebun' => $row->kebun,
                'total' => (int) $row->total,
                'vt' => (int) $row->vt,
                'it' => (int) $row->it,
            ])
            ->toArray();

        // 5. Monthly Turnover Trend
        $months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
        $monthlyTrend = [];

        $monthlyP = (clone $qPrev)
            ->select(DB::raw('MONTH(resign_date) as m'), DB::raw('count(*) as total'), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'VOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'INVOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"))
            ->groupBy('m')
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('m');

        $monthlyC = (clone $qCurr)
            ->select(DB::raw('MONTH(resign_date) as m'), DB::raw('count(*) as total'), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'VOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"), DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN jenis_resign = 'INVOLUNTARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"))
            ->groupBy('m')
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('m');

        for ($m = 1; $m <= 12; $m++) {
            $mPrev = $monthlyP->get($m);
            $mCurr = $monthlyC->get($m);

            $monthlyTrend[] = [
                'month' => $months[$m - 1],
                'month_num' => $m,
                'total_prev' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->total : 0,
                'vt_prev' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->vt : 0,
                'it_prev' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->it : 0,
                'total_curr' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->total : 0,
                'vt_curr' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->vt : 0,
                'it_curr' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->it : 0,
                'total_2025' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->total : 0,
                'vt_2025' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->vt : 0,
                'it_2025' => $mPrev ? (int) $mPrev->it : 0,
                'total_2026' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->total : 0,
                'vt_2026' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->vt : 0,
                'it_2026' => $mCurr ? (int) $mCurr->it : 0,
            ];
        }

        // 6. Regional Breakdown for summary
        $regionalBreakdown = StaffResign::query()
            ->select('region',
                DB::raw('count(*) as total'),
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$compareYear} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c_prev"),
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$targetYear} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c_curr"),
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$compareYear} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c2025"),
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$targetYear} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c2026")
            )
            ->groupBy('region')
            ->orderByDesc('total')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn ($r) => [
                'region' => $r->region,
                'total' => (int) $r->total,
                'c_prev' => (int) $r->c_prev,
                'c_curr' => (int) $r->c_curr,
                'c2025' => (int) $r->c2025,
                'c2026' => (int) $r->c2026,
            ])
            ->toArray();

        // 7. Executive Insights Generator
        $insights = $this->generateExecutiveInsights(
            $kpis,
            $clusterData,
            $jabatanData,
            $topKebunCurr,
            $regionalBreakdown,
            $selectedRegions,
            $targetYear,
            $compareYear
        );

        return [
            'year_current' => $targetYear,
            'year_previous' => $compareYear,
            'year_target' => $targetYear,
            'year_compare' => $compareYear,
            'kpis' => $kpis,
            'cluster_data' => $clusterData,
            'jabatan_data' => $jabatanData,
            'top_kebun_prev' => $topKebunPrev,
            'top_kebun_curr' => $topKebunCurr,
            'top_kebun_2025' => $topKebunPrev,
            'top_kebun_2026' => $topKebunCurr,
            'monthly_trend' => $monthlyTrend,
            'regional_breakdown' => $regionalBreakdown,
            'insights' => $insights,
            'available_years' => $availableYears,
            'available_regions' => ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Compute concise resignation summary for Executive Dashboard.
     */
    public function getSummary(Request $request, int $totalHc = 0): array
    {
        $metrics = $this->getMetrics($request);
        $kpis = $metrics['kpis'] ?? [];
        $yearCurrent = $metrics['year_current'] ?? (int) date('Y');
        $yearPrevious = $metrics['year_previous'] ?? ($yearCurrent - 1);

        $totalCurr = $kpis['total']['count_curr'] ?? 0;
        $totalPrev = $kpis['total']['count_prev'] ?? 0;
        $diff = $kpis['total']['diff'] ?? ($totalCurr - $totalPrev);
        $diffPct = $kpis['total']['diff_pct'] ?? 0;

        $vtCurr = $kpis['vt']['count_curr'] ?? 0;
        $vtPct = $kpis['vt']['pct_curr'] ?? 0;
        $itCurr = $kpis['it']['count_curr'] ?? 0;
        $itPct = $kpis['it']['pct_curr'] ?? 0;

        $topCluster = ! empty($metrics['cluster_data']) ? $metrics['cluster_data'][0]['cluster'] : null;
        $topKebun = ! empty($metrics['top_kebun_curr']) ? $metrics['top_kebun_curr'][0]['kebun'] : null;

        $turnoverRate = $totalHc > 0 ? round(($totalCurr / $totalHc) * 100, 1) : null;

        return [
            'year_current' => $yearCurrent,
            'year_previous' => $yearPrevious,
            'total_curr' => $totalCurr,
            'total_prev' => $totalPrev,
            'diff' => $diff,
            'diff_pct' => $diffPct,
            'vt_curr' => $vtCurr,
            'vt_pct' => $vtPct,
            'it_curr' => $itCurr,
            'it_pct' => $itPct,
            'turnover_rate' => $turnoverRate,
            'top_cluster' => $topCluster,
            'top_kebun' => $topKebun,
            'insights' => array_slice($metrics['insights'] ?? [], 0, 2),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Generate dynamic AI/Management bullet points based on resignation metrics.
     */
    private function generateExecutiveInsights(
        array $kpis,
        array $clusterData,
        array $jabatanData,
        array $topKebunCurr,
        array $regionalBreakdown,
        array $selectedRegions,
        int $targetYear,
        int $compareYear
    ): array {
        $bullets = [];

        if (! empty($selectedRegions)) {
            $regionNames = implode(', ', $selectedRegions);
            $bullets[] = "Data pergerakan turnover & resign difilter untuk region: {$regionNames}.";
        }

        // Total YoY insight
        $diffTotal = $kpis['total']['diff'];
        $diffPct = abs($kpis['total']['diff_pct']);
        $trendWord = $diffTotal <= 0 ? 'mengalami penurunan' : 'mengalami peningkatan';
        $bullets[] = "Total staff resign pada tahun {$targetYear} {$trendWord} sebesar {$diffPct}% dibandingkan tahun {$compareYear} (dari {$kpis['total']['count_prev']} menjadi {$kpis['total']['count_curr']} karyawan).";

        // Voluntary dominance
        $vtPctCurr = $kpis['vt']['pct_curr'];
        $itPctCurr = $kpis['it']['pct_curr'];
        $bullets[] = "Pengunduran diri sukarela (Voluntary) mendominasi pada tahun {$targetYear} dengan proporsi {$vtPctCurr}% ({$kpis['vt']['count_curr']} orang), sementara Involuntary (PHK/Audit/Underperform) sebesar {$itPctCurr}% ({$kpis['it']['count_curr']} orang).";

        // Dominant Cluster
        if (! empty($clusterData)) {
            $topCluster = $clusterData[0];
            $secondCluster = $clusterData[1] ?? null;
            $msg = "Penyebab resign terbanyak adalah '{$topCluster['cluster']}' ({$topCluster['total']} total kasus)";
            if ($secondCluster) {
                $msg .= ", disusul oleh faktor '{$secondCluster['cluster']}' ({$secondCluster['total']} total kasus).";
            } else {
                $msg .= '.';
            }
            $bullets[] = $msg;
        }

        // Dominant Jabatan
        if (! empty($jabatanData)) {
            $topJabatan = $jabatanData[0];
            $bullets[] = "Posisi lini operasional paling rentan adalah '{$topJabatan['jabatan']}' dengan total akumulasi turnover {$topJabatan['total']} staf.";
        }

        // Top Kebun hotspot
        if (! empty($topKebunCurr)) {
            $topUnit = $topKebunCurr[0];
            $bullets[] = "Unit perkebunan dengan resign tertinggi di {$targetYear} adalah kebun {$topUnit['kebun']} ({$topUnit['total']} staf: {$topUnit['vt']} Voluntary, {$topUnit['it']} Involuntary).";
        }

        // Alumni vs Non Alumni observation
        $alumniPct = $kpis['alumni']['pct_curr'];
        $bullets[] = "Sebanyak {$alumniPct}% dari total resign {$targetYear} merupakan Alumni FRLC ({$kpis['alumni']['count_curr']} staf), menunjukkan urgensi evaluasi retention program serta jalur karir pasca program pelatihan.";

        return $bullets;
    }
}

File: app/Services/RetirementMetrics.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class RetirementMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get([
            'birth_date', 'region', 'job_level_code', 'organization_name', 'company_id', 'job_title_name',
        ]);

        if ($employees->isEmpty()) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::today();
        $retireAge = config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);

        $kpi = [
            'now' => 0,
            '1_year' => 0,
            '3_years' => 0,
            '5_years' => 0,
        ];

        $projection = [];
        $currentYear = $asOf->year;
        for ($i = 0; $i <= 5; $i++) {
            $projection[$currentYear + $i] = 0;
        }

        $byLevel = [];
        $titlesByLevel = [];
        $byDept = [];
        $byRegion = [];
        $byCompanyId = [];

        $concentratedPositions = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if (! $e->birth_date) {
                continue;
            }

            $birth = Carbon::parse($e->birth_date);
            $ageFloat = $birth->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;

            $retireDate = $birth->copy()->addYears($retireAge);
            $yearsToRetireFloat = $asOf->diffInMonths($retireDate, false) / 12;

            $isRetireNow = $ageFloat >= $retireAge;
            $in1Year = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 1;
            $in3Years = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 3;
            $in5Years = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 5;

            if ($isRetireNow) {
                $kpi['now']++;
            }
            if ($in1Year) {
                $kpi['1_year']++;
            }
            if ($in3Years) {
                $kpi['3_years']++;
            }
            if ($in5Years) {
                $kpi['5_years']++;
            }

            $rYear = $retireDate->year;
            if ($isRetireNow || $rYear <= $currentYear) {
                $projection[$currentYear]++;
            } elseif ($rYear <= $currentYear + 5) {
                $projection[$rYear]++;
            }

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $cid = $e->company_id ?? 0;
            $title = $e->job_title_name ?? 'Unknown';

            if (! isset($byLevel[$lvl])) {
                $byLevel[$lvl] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($byDept[$dept])) {
                $byDept[$dept] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($byRegion[$reg])) {
                $byRegion[$reg] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            }
            if (! isset($byCompanyId[$cid])) {
                $byCompanyId[$cid] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            }

            if (! isset($concentratedPositions[$title])) {
                $concentratedPositions[$title] = ['total' => 0, 'risk_3y' => 0];
            }

            $byLevel[$lvl]['total']++;
            $byDept[$dept]['total']++;
            $byRegion[$reg]['total']++;
            $byCompanyId[$cid]['total']++;
            $concentratedPositions[$title]['total']++;

            if ($lvl !== 'Unknown' && $title !== 'Unknown') {
                if (! isset($titlesByLevel[$lvl])) {
                    $titlesByLevel[$lvl] = [];
                }
                $titlesByLevel[$lvl][$title] = ($titlesByLevel[$lvl][$title] ?? 0) + 1;
            }

            if ($isRetireNow) {
                $byLevel[$lvl]['risk']++;
                $byDept[$dept]['risk']++;
                $byRegion[$reg]['risk']++;
                $byCompanyId[$cid]['risk']++;
            }

            if ($ageFloat >= ($retireAge - 3)) {
                $concentratedPositions[$title]['risk_3y']++;
            }
        }

        foreach ($titlesByLevel as $lvl => &$tList) {
            arsort($tList);
        }
        unset($tList);

        $companyIds = array_keys($byCompanyId);
        $companyNames = DB::table('companies')->whereIn('id', $companyIds)->pluck('name', 'id');

        $byCompany = [];
        foreach ($byCompanyId as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $byCompany[$name] = ($byCompany[$name] ?? 0) + $data['risk'];
        }

        $regionRisk = [];
        foreach ($byRegion as $reg => $data) {
            $regionRisk[$reg] = $data['risk'];
        }

        $levelTable = [];
        foreach ($byLevel as $lvl => $data) {
            $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
            $levelTable[] = [
                'name' => $lvl,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'value' => $data['risk'],
                'pct' => round($pct, 1),
                'top_titles' => array_slice($titlesByLevel[$lvl] ?? [], 0, 6, true),
                'total_titles' => count($titlesByLevel[$lvl] ?? []),
            ];
        }
        usort($levelTable, fn ($a, $b) => $b['value'] <=> $a['value']);

        $deptTable = [];
        foreach ($byDept as $dept => $data) {
            $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
            $deptTable[] = [
                'name' => $dept,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'value' => $data['risk'],
                'pct' => round($pct, 1),
            ];
        }
        usort($deptTable, fn ($a, $b) => $b['value'] <=> $a['value']);

        $concentratedTable = [];
        foreach ($concentratedPositions as $title => $data) {
            if ($data['risk_3y'] >= 1) {
                $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk_3y'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
                $concentratedTable[] = [
                    'title' => $title,
                    'total' => $data['total'],
                    'risk' => $data['risk_3y'],
                    'pct' => round($pct, 1),
                ];
            }
        }
        usort($concentratedTable, fn ($a, $b) => $b['risk'] <=> $a['risk']);

        return [
            'kpi' => $kpi,
            'projection' => $projection,
            'tables' => [
                'level' => $levelTable,
                'dept' => $deptTable,
                'concentrated' => $concentratedTable,
            ],
            'bars' => [
                'region' => $regionRisk,
                'company' => $byCompany,
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'kpi' => ['now' => 0, '1_year' => 0, '3_years' => 0, '5_years' => 0],
            'projection' => [],
            'tables' => ['level' => [], 'dept' => [], 'concentrated' => []],
            'bars' => ['region' => [], 'company' => []],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TenureMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get([
            'birth_date', 'join_date', 'region', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type', 'gender',
        ]);

        if ($employees->isEmpty()) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::today();

        $histogram = [
            '<1 tahun' => 0,
            '1-<3 tahun' => 0,
            '3-<5 tahun' => 0,
            '5-<10 tahun' => 0,
            '10+ tahun' => 0,
        ];

        $joinYearly = [];
        $joinMonthly = []; // Only for last 3 years
        $yearLimit = $asOf->year - 3;

        $tenureByLevelSum = [];
        $tenureByRegionSum = [];

        $scatter = [];
        $heatmap = [];

        $waves = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if (! $e->join_date || ! $e->birth_date) {
                continue;
            }

            $join = Carbon::parse($e->join_date);
            $birth = Carbon::parse($e->birth_date);

            $ageFloat = $birth->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;
            $tenureFloat = $join->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;

            if ($tenureFloat < 1) {
                $histogram['<1 tahun']++;
            } elseif ($tenureFloat < 3) {
                $histogram['1-<3 tahun']++;
            } elseif ($tenureFloat < 5) {
                $histogram['3-<5 tahun']++;
            } elseif ($tenureFloat < 10) {
                $histogram['5-<10 tahun']++;
            } else {
                $histogram['10+ tahun']++;
            }

            $jYear = $join->year;
            $joinYearly[$jYear] = ($joinYearly[$jYear] ?? 0) + 1;

            if ($jYear >= $yearLimit && $jYear <= $asOf->year) {
                $my = $join->format('Y-m');
                $joinMonthly[$my] = ($joinMonthly[$my] ?? 0) + 1;
            }

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            if (! isset($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl])) {
                $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl] = ['sum' => 0, 'count' => 0];
            }
            $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['sum'] += $tenureFloat;
            $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['count']++;

            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            if (! isset($tenureByRegionSum[$reg])) {
                $tenureByRegionSum[$reg] = ['sum' => 0, 'count' => 0];
            }
            $tenureByRegionSum[$reg]['sum'] += $tenureFloat;
            $tenureByRegionSum[$reg]['count']++;

            $joinAge = $birth->diffInMonths($join) / 12;
            $isAnomaly = ($joinAge < 18 || $joinAge > 55) ? 'yes' : 'no';

            $scatter[] = [
                'umur' => round($ageFloat, 1),
                'masa_kerja' => round($tenureFloat, 1),
                'anomali' => $isAnomaly,
                'join_age' => round($joinAge, 1),
            ];

            if (! isset($heatmap[$jYear])) {
                $heatmap[$jYear] = [];
            }
            $heatmap[$jYear][$reg] = ($heatmap[$jYear][$reg] ?? 0) + 1;

            if (! isset($waves[$jYear])) {
                $waves[$jYear] = [
                    'total' => 0,
                    'types' => [],
                    'levels' => [],
                    'regions' => [],
                    'genders' => [],
                    'join_ages_sum' => 0,
                    'tenures_sum' => 0,
                ];
            }
            $waves[$jYear]['total']++;
            $etype = $e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown';
            $waves[$jYear]['types'][$etype] = ($waves[$jYear]['types'][$etype] ?? 0) + 1;

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? '-';
            $waves[$jYear]['levels'][$lvl] = ($waves[$jYear]['levels'][$lvl] ?? 0) + 1;

            $regVal = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $waves[$jYear]['regions'][$regVal] = ($waves[$jYear]['regions'][$regVal] ?? 0) + 1;

            $genVal = $e->gender ?? 'Unknown';
            $waves[$jYear]['genders'][$genVal] = ($waves[$jYear]['genders'][$genVal] ?? 0) + 1;

            $waves[$jYear]['join_ages_sum'] += $joinAge;
            $waves[$jYear]['tenures_sum'] += $tenureFloat;
        }

        ksort($joinYearly);
        ksort($joinMonthly);

        $levelOrder = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5'];
        $avgByLevel = [];
        foreach ($levelOrder as $lvl) {
            if (isset($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl])) {
                $avgByLevel[$lvl] = round($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['sum'] / $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['count'], 1);
            }
        }
        foreach ($tenureByLevelSum as $lvl => $data) {
            if (! in_array($lvl, $levelOrder)) {
                $avgByLevel[$lvl] = round($data['sum'] / $data['count'], 1);
            }
        }

        $avgByRegion = [];
        foreach ($tenureByRegionSum as $reg => $data) {
            $avgByRegion[$reg] = round($data['sum'] / $data['count'], 1);
        }
        arsort($avgByRegion);

        krsort($waves);
        $recruitmentWaves = [];
        foreach ($waves as $year => $data) {
            arsort($data['types']);
            ksort($data['levels']);
            arsort($data['regions']);
            arsort($data['genders']);
            $dominant = array_key_first($data['types']) ?? 'PERMANENT';
            $count = max($data['total'], 1);

            $recruitmentWaves[] = [
                'year' => (string) $year,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'dominant_type' => $dominant,
                'types' => $data['types'],
                'levels' => $data['levels'],
                'regions' => $data['regions'],
                'genders' => $data['genders'],
                'avg_join_age' => round($data['join_ages_sum'] / $count, 1),
                'avg_tenure' => round($data['tenures_sum'] / $count, 1),
            ];
        }

        ksort($heatmap);

        return [
            'histogram' => $histogram,
            'trend' => [
                'yearly' => $joinYearly,
                'monthly' => $joinMonthly,
            ],
            'average' => [
                'level' => $avgByLevel,
                'region' => $avgByRegion,
            ],
            'scatter' => $scatter,
            'heatmap' => $heatmap,
            'waves' => $recruitmentWaves,
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'histogram' => [],
            'trend' => ['yearly' => [], 'monthly' => []],
            'average' => ['level' => [], 'region' => []],
            'scatter' => [],
            'heatmap' => [],
            'waves' => [],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\TrainingFilter;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TrainingMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter, User $user)
    {
        $latestBatch = ImportBatch::latest('id')->first();
        $batchId = $latestBatch ? $latestBatch->id : 0;

        $filterHash = md5(json_encode($request->all()).'_'.$user->id);
        $cacheKey = "training_metrics_{$batchId}_{$filterHash}";

        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 3600, function () use ($request, $filter) {
            return $this->calculate($request, $filter);
        });
    }

    protected function calculate(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = DB::table('training_records');
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $trainings = $query->get();

        $totalRows = $trainings->count();
        if ($totalRows === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $uniqueParticipants = [];
        $totalHours = 0;
        $totalDays = 0;
        $uniqueTrainings = [];

        $trend = [];
        $participantsTrend = [];

        $regularity = ['Reguler' => 0, 'Non Reguler' => 0];
        $sourceType = ['Internal' => 0, 'Eksternal' => 0];

        $trainingNames = [];
        $instructors = [];
        $locations = [];

        $hoursByRegion = [];
        $hoursByGroup = [];
        $hoursByDept = [];
        $hoursByGol = []; // Staf / Non Staf
        $hoursByLevel = []; // Workers, Middle, Senior

        $genderByLevel = []; // Stacked bar gender x Level

        $unlinkedRows = 0;

        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            $totalHours += $t->hours;
            $totalDays += $t->days;
            $uniqueTrainings[$t->training_name] = true;

            $participantKey = $t->employee_id ?: ($t->nik ?: ($t->nik_raw ?: $t->participant_name));
            if ($participantKey) {
                $uniqueParticipants[$participantKey] = true;
            }

            if (! $t->employee_id) {
                $unlinkedRows++;
            }

            // Trend
            if ($t->year && $t->month) {
                $my = $t->year.'-'.str_pad($t->month, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $trend[$my] = ($trend[$my] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

                if (! isset($participantsTrend[$my])) {
                    $participantsTrend[$my] = [];
                }
                if ($participantKey) {
                    $participantsTrend[$my][$participantKey] = true;
                }
            }

            // Donut
            $reg = $t->regularity ?: 'Unknown';
            $regularity[$reg] = ($regularity[$reg] ?? 0) + 1;

            $src = $t->source_type ?: 'Unknown';
            $sourceType[$src] = ($sourceType[$src] ?? 0) + 1;

            // Top 10
            $tn = $t->training_name ?: 'Unknown';
            $trainingNames[$tn] = ($trainingNames[$tn] ?? 0) + 1;

            if ($t->instructor) {
                $instructors[$t->instructor] = ($instructors[$t->instructor] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
            if ($t->venue) {
                $locations[$t->venue] = ($locations[$t->venue] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        $participantsCountTrend = [];
        foreach ($participantsTrend as $my => $pArr) {
            $participantsCountTrend[$my] = count($pArr);
        }
        ksort($trend);
        ksort($participantsCountTrend);

        $participantDemographics = [];

        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            $reg = $t->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByRegion[$reg] = ($hoursByRegion[$reg] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

            $grp = $t->group ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByGroup[$grp] = ($hoursByGroup[$grp] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

            $dept = $t->department ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByDept[$dept] = ($hoursByDept[$dept] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

            $gol = $t->grade ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByGol[$gol] = ($hoursByGol[$gol] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

            $lvlCategory = $t->level ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByLevel[$lvlCategory] = ($hoursByLevel[$lvlCategory] ?? 0) + $t->hours;

            $uniqueKey = $t->employee_id ?: ($t->nik_raw ?: $t->participant_name);
            if ($uniqueKey && ! isset($participantDemographics[$uniqueKey])) {
                $participantDemographics[$uniqueKey] = [
                    'gender' => $t->gender ?? 'Male',
                    'level' => $lvlCategory,
                ];
            }
        }

        $genderByLevel = [];
        foreach ($participantDemographics as $demo) {
            $lvl = $demo['level'];
            if (! isset($genderByLevel[$lvl])) {
                $genderByLevel[$lvl] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
            }
            $g = $demo['gender'] === 'Female' ? 'Female' : 'Male';
            $genderByLevel[$lvl][$g] += 1;
        }

        return [
            'kpi' => [
                'total_rows' => $totalRows,
                'unique_participants' => count($uniqueParticipants),
                'total_hours' => round($totalHours, 1),
                'avg_hours_per_participant' => count($uniqueParticipants) > 0 ? round($totalHours / count($uniqueParticipants), 1) : 0,
                'total_days' => round($totalDays, 1),
                'unique_trainings' => count($uniqueTrainings),
                'unlinked_rows' => $unlinkedRows,
            ],
            'trend' => [
                'hours' => $trend,
                'participants' => $participantsCountTrend,
            ],
            'donuts' => [
                'regularity' => $regularity,
                'source_type' => $sourceType,
            ],
            'top' => [
                'training_names' => $trainingNames,
                'instructors' => $instructors,
                'locations' => $locations,
            ],
            'hours_by' => [
                'region' => $hoursByRegion,
                'group' => $hoursByGroup,
                'dept' => $hoursByDept,
                'gol' => $hoursByGol,
                'level' => $hoursByLevel,
            ],
            'gender_by_level' => $genderByLevel,
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'kpi' => [
                'total_rows' => 0, 'unique_participants' => 0, 'total_hours' => 0,
                'avg_hours_per_participant' => 0, 'total_days' => 0, 'unique_trainings' => 0, 'unlinked_rows' => 0,
            ],
            'trend' => ['hours' => [], 'participants' => []],
            'donuts' => ['regularity' => [], 'source_type' => []],
            'top' => ['training_names' => [], 'instructors' => [], 'locations' => []],
            'hours_by' => ['region' => [], 'group' => [], 'dept' => [], 'gol' => [], 'level' => []],
            'gender_by_level' => [],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use App\Support\MetricsHelper;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class WorkforceMetrics
{
    protected ?Carbon $asOf;

    public function __construct(?Carbon $asOf = null)
    {
        $this->asOf = $asOf ?? Carbon::now();
    }

    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter, User $user)
    {
        // Cache key based on filter hash and latest import batch
        $latestBatch = ImportBatch::latest('id')->first();
        $batchId = $latestBatch ? $latestBatch->id : 0;

        $asOfStr = $this->asOf->format('Y-m-d');
        $filterHash = md5(json_encode($request->all()).'_'.$user->id.'_'.$asOfStr);
        $cacheKey = "metrics_{$batchId}_{$filterHash}";

        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 3600, function () use ($request, $filter, $user) {
            return $this->calculate($request, $filter, $user);
        });
    }

    protected function calculate(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter, User $user)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Single narrow query
        $employees = $query->get([
            'id', 'employee_id', 'company_id', 'location_id', 'region', 'gender',
            'birth_date', 'join_date', 'employment_type', 'job_level_code',
            'group', 'organization_name', 'marital_status', 'ptkp_code', 'job_title_name', 'birth_place',
        ]);

        $totalHc = $employees->count();
        if ($totalHc === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $females = 0;
        $perm = 0;
        $pensiun = 0;
        $ages = [];
        $loses = [];

        $generations = [];
        $generationsByLevel = [];
        $hcByRegion = [];
        $hcByCompany = [];
        $hcByRegionFacility = [];
        $retireRiskByLevel = [];

        $hcByGroup = [];
        $hcByDept = [];
        $agesByDept = [];
        $ageDistribution = ['<25' => 0, '25-29' => 0, '30-34' => 0, '35-39' => 0, '40-44' => 0, '45-49' => 0, '50-54' => 0, '55+' => 0];
        $populationPyramid = [];
        $genByRegion = [];
        $genderByLevel = [];
        $maritalStatus = [];
        $ptkp = [];
        $jobTitles = [];
        $employmentByRegion = [];
        $birthPlaces = [];

        $hcByLevel = [];
        $titlesByLevel = [];

        $locations = Location::pluck('name', 'id');

        $employeeIds = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $employeeIds[] = $e->id;
            if ($e->gender === 'Female') {
                $females++;
            }
            if ($e->employment_type === 'PERM' || $e->employment_type === 'PERMANENT') {
                $perm++;
            }

            $birthDate = $e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null;
            $joinDate = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;

            if ($birthDate) {
                $ageDec = Demographics::age($birthDate, $this->asOf);
                $ages[] = $ageDec;

                $ageFull = Demographics::ageFullYears($birthDate, $this->asOf);
                if ($ageFull >= config('sdm.retirement_age', 55)) {
                    $pensiun++;
                    $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
                    $retireRiskByLevel[$lvl] = ($retireRiskByLevel[$lvl] ?? 0) + 1;
                }

                $gen = Demographics::generation($birthDate->year);
                $generations[$gen] = ($generations[$gen] ?? 0) + 1;

                $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
                if (! isset($generationsByLevel[$lvl])) {
                    $generationsByLevel[$lvl] = [];
                }
                $generationsByLevel[$lvl][$gen] = ($generationsByLevel[$lvl][$gen] ?? 0) + 1;

                // Demographics additions
                $ageBin = match (true) {
                    $ageFull < 25 => '<25',
                    $ageFull < 30 => '25-29',
                    $ageFull < 35 => '30-34',
                    $ageFull < 40 => '35-39',
                    $ageFull < 45 => '40-44',
                    $ageFull < 50 => '45-49',
                    $ageFull < 55 => '50-54',
                    default => '55+'
                };
                $ageDistribution[$ageBin]++;

                if (! isset($populationPyramid[$ageBin])) {
                    $populationPyramid[$ageBin] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
                }
                $populationPyramid[$ageBin][$e->gender ?? 'Male']++;

                $region = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
                if (! isset($genByRegion[$region])) {
                    $genByRegion[$region] = [];
                }
                $genByRegion[$region][$gen] = ($genByRegion[$region][$gen] ?? 0) + 1;

                $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
                if (! isset($agesByDept[$dept])) {
                    $agesByDept[$dept] = [];
                }
                $agesByDept[$dept][] = $ageDec;
            }

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByLevel[$lvl] = ($hcByLevel[$lvl] ?? 0) + 1;

            if ($joinDate) {
                $loses[] = Demographics::los($joinDate, $this->asOf);
            }

            $region = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByRegion[$region] = ($hcByRegion[$region] ?? 0) + 1;

            $locName = $locations[$e->location_id] ?? '';
            // KLASIFIKASI FACILITY (TURUNAN)
            // Karena DB tidak memiliki kolom facility_type, kita menderivasikannya dari Location Name:
            // - HO (Head Office): Jika lokasi mengandung 'office' atau 'jakarta'
            // - Mill: Jika lokasi mengandung 'pabrik', 'mill', 'kcp', 'biodiesel', atau 'bulking'
            // - Estate: Default fallback untuk semua lokasi lainnya (kebun, dsb)
            $facilityType = match (true) {
                stripos($locName, 'office') !== false || stripos($locName, 'jakarta') !== false => 'HO',
                stripos($locName, 'pabrik') !== false || stripos($locName, 'mill') !== false || stripos($locName, 'kcp') !== false || stripos($locName, 'biodiesel') !== false || stripos($locName, 'bulking') !== false => 'Mill',
                default => 'Estate'
            };
            if (! isset($hcByRegionFacility[$region])) {
                $hcByRegionFacility[$region] = ['Estate' => 0, 'Mill' => 0, 'HO' => 0];
            }
            $hcByRegionFacility[$region][$facilityType]++;

            $hcByCompany[$e->company_id] = ($hcByCompany[$e->company_id] ?? 0) + 1;

            // Demographics additions
            $group = $e->group ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByGroup[$group] = ($hcByGroup[$group] ?? 0) + 1;

            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByDept[$dept] = ($hcByDept[$dept] ?? 0) + 1;

            if (! isset($genderByLevel[$lvl])) {
                $genderByLevel[$lvl] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
            }
            $genderByLevel[$lvl][$e->gender ?? 'Male']++;

            $ms = $e->marital_status ?? 'Unknown';
            $maritalStatus[$ms] = ($maritalStatus[$ms] ?? 0) + 1;

            $pt = $e->ptkp_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $ptkp[$pt] = ($ptkp[$pt] ?? 0) + 1;

            $jt = $e->job_title_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $jobTitles[$jt] = ($jobTitles[$jt] ?? 0) + 1;

            if ($lvl !== 'Unknown' && $jt !== 'Unknown') {
                if (! isset($titlesByLevel[$lvl])) {
                    $titlesByLevel[$lvl] = [];
                }
                $titlesByLevel[$lvl][$jt] = ($titlesByLevel[$lvl][$jt] ?? 0) + 1;
            }

            if (! isset($employmentByRegion[$region])) {
                $employmentByRegion[$region] = [];
            }
            $employmentByRegion[$region][$e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown'] = ($employmentByRegion[$region][$e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown'] ?? 0) + 1;

            if ($e->birth_place) {
                $bp = strtoupper(trim($e->birth_place));
                if ($bp === '(NONE)' || $bp === 'NONE' || $bp === '') {
                    $bp = 'TIDAK DIKETAHUI';
                }
                $birthPlaces[$bp] = ($birthPlaces[$bp] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        $avgAge = count($ages) > 0 ? array_sum($ages) / count($ages) : 0;
        $avgLos = count($loses) > 0 ? array_sum($loses) / count($loses) : 0;

        // --- Training Metrics ---
        // Get training records for the filtered employees ONLY for coverage
        // Coverage uses employees in the current filter who have at least 1 training
        $employeesWithTraining = DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereIn('employee_id', $employeeIds)
            ->distinct('employee_id')
            ->count('employee_id');

        $trainingCoverage = $totalHc > 0 ? round(($employeesWithTraining / $totalHc) * 100, 1) : 0;

        // For total hours and trend, PRD 4.5 says use ALL training records (not filtered by employees)
        $allTrainings = DB::table('training_records')
            ->get(['hours', 'month', 'year']);

        $totalTrainingHours = $allTrainings->sum('hours');

        // Tren jam pelatihan per bulan (year-month) using all trainings
        $trainingTrend = [];
        foreach ($allTrainings as $t) {
            if ($t->year && $t->month) {
                $my = $t->year.'-'.str_pad($t->month, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $trainingTrend[$my] = ($trainingTrend[$my] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            }
        }
        ksort($trainingTrend);

        // Unlinked training records (nik status tracking for coverage quality)
        // Since we are filtering by employees, unlinked ones won't be here.
        // We need all training records to report unlinked ones for the whole system, but maybe dashboard just shows total?
        // PRD 4.6 says: Selalu tampilkan dua angka berdampingan: coverage dan "Baris training yang tidak dapat dihubungkan ke karyawan"
        $unlinkedTrainingRows = DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereNull('employee_id')
            ->count();
        $totalTrainingRows = DB::table('training_records')->count();
        $unlinkedPct = $totalTrainingRows > 0 ? round(($unlinkedTrainingRows / $totalTrainingRows) * 100, 1) : 0;

        // Get company names for hcByCompany
        $companyNames = Company::whereIn('id', array_keys($hcByCompany))->pluck('name', 'id');
        $hcByCompanyNamed = [];
        foreach ($hcByCompany as $cid => $hc) {
            $hcByCompanyNamed[$companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown'] = $hc;
        }

        $avgAgeByDept = [];
        foreach ($agesByDept as $dept => $agArr) {
            if (count($agArr) >= 5) {
                $avgAgeByDept[$dept] = round(array_sum($agArr) / count($agArr), 1);
            }
        }
        arsort($avgAgeByDept);

        foreach ($titlesByLevel as $lvl => &$tList) {
            arsort($tList);
        }
        unset($tList);

        $configuredOrder = config('sdm.level_order', []);
        $existingLevels = array_unique(array_filter(array_merge(
            array_keys($hcByLevel),
            array_keys($generationsByLevel)
        ), fn ($lvl) => $lvl !== 'Unknown' && $lvl !== '-' && ! empty($lvl)));
        $existingInConfig = array_values(array_intersect($configuredOrder, $existingLevels));
        $otherExisting = array_values(array_diff($existingLevels, $configuredOrder));
        sort($otherExisting);
        $dynamicLevelOrder = array_merge($existingInConfig, $otherExisting);

        return [
            'total_hc' => $totalHc,
            'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
            'avg_los' => round($avgLos, 1),
            'female_pct' => round(($females / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
            'perm_pct' => round(($perm / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
            'pensiun' => $pensiun,
            'generations' => $generations,
            'generations_by_level' => $generationsByLevel,
            'hc_by_region' => $hcByRegion,
            'hc_by_region_facility' => $hcByRegionFacility,
            'hc_by_company' => $hcByCompanyNamed,
            'hc_by_level' => $hcByLevel,
            'titles_by_level' => $titlesByLevel,
            'retire_risk_by_level' => $retireRiskByLevel,
            'hc_by_group' => $hcByGroup,
            'hc_by_dept' => $hcByDept,
            'age_distribution' => $ageDistribution,
            'population_pyramid' => $populationPyramid,
            'gen_by_region' => $genByRegion,
            'avg_age_by_dept' => $avgAgeByDept,
            'gender_by_level' => $genderByLevel,
            'marital_status' => $maritalStatus,
            'ptkp' => $ptkp,
            'job_titles' => $jobTitles,
            'employment_by_region' => $employmentByRegion,
            'birth_places' => $birthPlaces,
            'level_order' => ! empty($dynamicLevelOrder) ? $dynamicLevelOrder : $configuredOrder,
            'training' => [
                'total_hours' => $totalTrainingHours,
                'coverage_pct' => $trainingCoverage,
                'unlinked_rows' => $unlinkedTrainingRows,
                'unlinked_pct' => $unlinkedPct,
                'trend' => $trainingTrend,
            ],
            'new_hire_no_training' => MetricsHelper::countNewHireNoTraining($employees, $this->asOf),
            'new_hire_this_year' => MetricsHelper::countNewHireThisYear($employees, $this->asOf),
            'raw_totals' => [
                'total_hc' => $totalHc,
                'generations' => $generations,
                'pensiun' => $pensiun,
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'total_hc' => 0, 'avg_age' => 0, 'avg_los' => 0, 'female_pct' => 0, 'perm_pct' => 0, 'pensiun' => 0,
            'generations' => [], 'generations_by_level' => [], 'hc_by_region' => [], 'hc_by_region_facility' => [], 'hc_by_company' => [], 'hc_by_level' => [], 'titles_by_level' => [], 'retire_risk_by_level' => [],
            'hc_by_group' => [], 'hc_by_dept' => [], 'age_distribution' => [], 'population_pyramid' => [], 'gen_by_region' => [],
            'avg_age_by_dept' => [], 'gender_by_level' => [], 'marital_status' => [], 'ptkp' => [], 'job_titles' => [],
            'employment_by_region' => [], 'birth_places' => [],
            'level_order' => config('sdm.level_order', []),
            'training' => ['total_hours' => 0, 'coverage_pct' => 0, 'unlinked_rows' => 0, 'unlinked_pct' => 0, 'trend' => []],
            'new_hire_no_training' => 0,
            'new_hire_this_year' => 0,
            'raw_totals' => ['total_hc' => 0, 'generations' => [], 'pensiun' => 0],
        ];
    }
}

================
File: app/Support/Clean.php

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\Carbon;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date;

/**
 * Aturan pembersihan data berdasarkan hasil profiling CSV asli.
 */
class Clean
{
    /** "04-Dec-06" -> Carbon. Tahun 2 digit: yy <= $pivot => 20yy, selain itu 19yy. */
    public static function date2(?string $value, int $pivot): ?Carbon
    {
        $value = trim((string) $value);
        if ($value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            try {
                return Carbon::instance(Date::excelToDateTimeObject($value))->startOfDay();
            } catch (\Throwable) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        if (preg_match('/^(\d{1,2})-([A-Za-z]{3})-(\d{2}|\d{4})$/', $value, $m)) {
            $year = (int) $m[3];
            if (strlen($m[3]) === 2) {
                $year += $year <= $pivot ? 2000 : 1900;
            }

            try {
                return Carbon::createFromFormat('d-M-Y', "{$m[1]}-{$m[2]}-{$year}")->startOfDay();
            } catch (\Throwable) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($value)->startOfDay();
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Karyawan termuda di data lahir 2006, jadi pivot 15 aman untuk tanggal lahir. */
    public static function birth(?string $v): ?Carbon
    {
        return self::date2($v, 15);
    }

    /** Join date: pivot = tahun berjalan (2 digit) supaya tidak jatuh ke masa depan. */
    public static function join(?string $v): ?Carbon
    {
        return self::date2($v, (int) now()->format('y'));
    }

    public static function month(?string $v): ?int
    {
        static $map = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4, 'MAY' => 5, 'MEI' => 5,
            'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7, 'AUG' => 8, 'AGT' => 8, 'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'SEP' => 9,
            'OCT' => 10, 'OKT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DEC' => 12, 'DES' => 12,
        ];

        return $map[strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $v), 0, 3))] ?? null;
    }

    public static function region(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));
        if ($k === '') {
            return null;
        }
        if ($k === 'kaltim' || $k === 'kubar' || $k === 'kutai barat') {
            return 'Kaltim';
        }
        if ($k === 'kalbar' || $k === 'kalimantan barat') {
            return 'Kalbar';
        }
        if ($k === 'riau') {
            return 'Riau';
        }

        return ucfirst($k);
    }

    public static function regularity(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));
        if ($k === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return str_contains($k, 'non') ? 'Non Reguler' : 'Reguler';
    }

    public static function level(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));

        return $k === '' ? null : ucfirst($k);
    }

    /**
     * Status NIK dari sumber training:
     *  - empty   : kosong atau "-"
     *  - corrupt : rusak notasi ilmiah Excel, mis. "2,01407E+13"
     *  - invalid : bukan angka murni, mis. "Promosi"
     *  - ok      : angka murni
     */
    public static function nikStatus(?string $v): string
    {
        $v = trim((string) $v);

        return match (true) {
            $v === '' || $v === '-' => 'empty',
            (bool) preg_match('/^\d+[,.]?\d*E\+\d+$/i', $v) => 'corrupt',
            ! ctype_digit($v) => 'invalid',
            default => 'ok',
        };
    }

    /** NIK yang bisa dipakai (status ok), selain itu null. */
    public static function nik(?string $v): ?string
    {
        return self::nikStatus($v) === 'ok' ? trim((string) $v) : null;
    }

    /** "PT. Panca Surya Garden" dan "PANCA SURYA GARDEN" => "PANCA SURYA GARDEN" */
    public static function companyKey(?string $v): string
    {
        $v = strtoupper(trim((string) $v));
        $v = preg_replace('/^(PT\.?|CV\.?)\s+/', '', $v);
        $v = preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9 ]/', ' ', $v);

        return trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $v));
    }

    /**
     * Ekstrak inisial/akronim operasional dan daftar alias pencarian untuk perusahaan.
     *
     * @param  string  $name  Nama lengkap perusahaan (mis. "PT. Subur Arum Makmur 1")
     * @param  array<int, string>  $locationNames  Daftar nama unit operasional perusahaan
     * @return array{initials: string, aliases: array<int, string>}
     */
    public static function companyMeta(string $name, array $locationNames = []): array
    {
        // Kamus akronim operasional standar FR Group & unit perkebunan
        $dictionary = [
            'CILIANDRA PERKASA' => 'CLP',
            'ARINDO TRISEJAHTERA' => 'ATS',
            'PRIATAMA RIAU' => 'PTR',
            'ADHITYA SERAYAKORITA' => 'ASK',
            'SETIA AGRINDO MANDIRI' => 'SAGM',
            'PANCA SURYA GARDEN' => 'PSG',
            'PANCA SURYA AGRINDO' => 'PSA',
            'SUBUR ARUM MAKMUR' => 'SAM',
            'PERDANA INTI SAWIT PERKASA' => 'PISP',
            'SAHABAT MEWAH & MAKMUR' => 'SMM',
            'SAHABAT MEWAH DAN MAKMUR' => 'SMM',
            'MERIDAN SEJATI SURYA PLANTATION' => 'MSSP',
            'KARYA TAMA BAKTI MULIA' => 'KTBM',
            'KAYUNG AGRO LESTARI' => 'KALE',
            'KETAPANG AGRO LESTARI' => 'KAL',
            'FALCON AGRI PERSADA' => 'FAP',
            'AUSTINDO NUSANTARA JAYA AGRI SIAIS' => 'ANJAS',
            'AUSTINDO NUSANTARA JAYA AGRI' => 'ANJA',
            'AUSTINDO AUFWIND NEW ENERGY' => 'AANE',
        ];

        $clean = preg_replace('/^(PT\.?|CV\.?|YAYASAN)\s+/i', '', trim($name));

        // Deteksi penomoran entitas jika ada (mis. "Subur Arum Makmur 1" -> 1)
        $number = '';
        if (preg_match('/\b(\d+)\s*$/', $clean, $m)) {
            $number = $m[1];
            $baseName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\b\d+\s*$/', '', $clean));
        } else {
            $baseName = $clean;
        }

        $upperBase = strtoupper((string) preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9& ]/', '', $baseName));
        $upperBase = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $upperBase));

        $primaryInitial = $dictionary[$upperBase] ?? null;

        // Jika tidak tercatat di kamus khusus, turunkan dari huruf depan setiap kata
        if (! $primaryInitial) {
            $splitCamel = (string) preg_replace('/([a-z])([A-Z])/', '$1 $2', $baseName);
            $cleanWords = (string) preg_replace('/\b(dan|and)\b/i', '', $splitCamel);
            $cleanWords = str_replace(['&', '.', ',', '(', ')', '-'], ' ', $cleanWords);
            $words = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $cleanWords)));

            $initials = '';
            foreach ($words as $w) {
                $w = trim($w);
                if ($w !== '') {
                    $initials .= strtoupper($w[0]);
                }
            }
            $primaryInitial = $initials;
        }

        // Susun variasi alias pencarian
        $aliases = [];
        if ($primaryInitial) {
            $aliases[] = $primaryInitial;
            if ($number !== '') {
                $aliases[] = $primaryInitial.$number;
                $aliases[] = $primaryInitial.' '.$number;
            }
        }

        // Pindai nama unit operasional untuk mendeteksi inisial lokal (mis. "Kebun SAM1", "Pabrik KALE", "Pabrik MKS2")
        $ignoredTokens = [
            'KEBUN', 'PABRIK', 'MILL', 'ESTATE', 'RO', 'OFFICE', 'DIVISI',
            'AFDELING', 'BIODIESEL', 'DOWNSTREAM', 'STATION', 'REFINERY',
            'CIKARANG', 'BULKING', 'CENTER', 'TRAINING', 'PEKANBARU', 'JAKARTA',
        ];
        foreach ($locationNames as $loc) {
            $parts = preg_split('/[\s,\-\/]+/', strtoupper((string) $loc));
            if (! is_array($parts)) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ($parts as $p) {
                $p = trim($p);
                if (strlen($p) >= 2 && strlen($p) <= 6 && ! in_array($p, $ignoredTokens, true)) {
                    $aliases[] = $p;
                    if (preg_match('/^([A-Z]+)\d+$/', $p, $pm)) {
                        $aliases[] = $pm[1];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $aliases = array_values(array_unique(array_filter($aliases)));
        $badge = $primaryInitial.($number !== '' ? " {$number}" : '');

        return [
            'initials' => $badge,
            'aliases' => $aliases,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Deteksi daftar tipe fasilitas operasional (Kebun, Pabrik, Downstream, Office)
     * berdasarkan nama unit kerja yang dimiliki perusahaan.
     *
     * @param  array<int, string>  $locationNames
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public static function facilities(array $locationNames): array
    {
        if (empty($locationNames)) {
            return [];
        }

        $hasKebun = false;
        $hasPabrik = false;
        $hasDownstream = false;
        $hasOffice = false;

        foreach ($locationNames as $loc) {
            $l = strtolower(trim((string) $loc));

            $isDownstream = (
                str_contains($l, 'biodiesel') ||
                str_contains($l, 'bulking') ||
                str_contains($l, 'downstream') ||
                str_contains($l, 'refinery') ||
                str_contains($l, 'kcp') ||
                str_contains($l, 'cikarang') ||
                str_contains($l, 'jetty')
            );

            $isPabrik = (
                str_contains($l, 'pabrik') ||
                str_contains($l, 'mill') ||
                str_contains($l, 'pks')
            );

            $isOffice = (
                str_contains($l, 'office') ||
                str_contains($l, 'jakarta') ||
                str_contains($l, 'pekanbaru') ||
                str_contains($l, 'pontianak') ||
                str_contains($l, 'balikpapan') ||
                str_contains($l, 'ro ') ||
                str_contains($l, 'head office')
            );

            if ($isDownstream) {
                $hasDownstream = true;
            }
            if ($isPabrik) {
                $hasPabrik = true;
            }
            if ($isOffice) {
                $hasOffice = true;
            }

            if (! $isDownstream && ! $isPabrik && ! $isOffice) {
                $hasKebun = true;
            }
        }

        $facilities = [];
        if ($hasKebun) {
            $facilities[] = 'Estate';
        }
        if ($hasPabrik) {
            $facilities[] = 'Mill';
        }
        if ($hasDownstream) {
            $facilities[] = 'Downstream';
        }
        if (empty($facilities) && $hasOffice) {
            $facilities[] = 'Office';
        }

        return $facilities;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\Carbon;

class Demographics
{
    public static function age(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?float
    {
        if (! $birthDate) {
            return null;
        }
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();

        return $birthDate->diffInDays($asOf) / 365.25;
    }

    public static function los(?Carbon $joinDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?float
    {
        if (! $joinDate) {
            return null;
        }
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();

        return $joinDate->diffInDays($asOf) / 365.25;
    }

    public static function ageFullYears(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?int
    {
        if (! $birthDate) {
            return null;
        }
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();

        return (int) $birthDate->diffInYears($asOf);
    }

    public static function losFullYears(?Carbon $joinDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?int
    {
        if (! $joinDate) {
            return null;
        }
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();

        return (int) $joinDate->diffInYears($asOf);
    }

    public static function ageGroup(?int $age): string
    {
        if ($age === null) {
            return 'Unknown';
        }
        if ($age < 25) {
            return '<25';
        }
        if ($age < 35) {
            return '25-34';
        }
        if ($age < 45) {
            return '35-44';
        }
        if ($age < 55) {
            return '45-54';
        }

        return '55+';
    }

    public static function losGroup(?int $los): string
    {
        if ($los === null) {
            return 'Unknown';
        }
        if ($los < 1) {
            return '<1';
        }
        if ($los < 3) {
            return '1-<3';
        }
        if ($los < 5) {
            return '3-<5';
        }
        if ($los < 10) {
            return '5-<10';
        }

        return '10+';
    }

    public static function generation(?int $birthYear): string
    {
        if ($birthYear === null) {
            return 'Unknown';
        }
        $config = config('sdm.generations', [
            'Boomers' => 1964,
            'Gen X' => 1980,
            'Gen Y' => 1996,
        ]);
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Boomers']) {
            return 'Boomers';
        }
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Gen X']) {
            return 'Gen X';
        }
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Gen Y']) {
            return 'Gen Y';
        }

        return 'Gen Z';
    }

    public static function isRetirementRisk(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): bool
    {
        if (! $birthDate) {
            return false;
        }
        $age = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $asOf);

        return $age >= config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);
    }

    public static function retiresInYears(?Carbon $birthDate, int $years, ?Carbon $asOf = null): bool
    {
        if (! $birthDate) {
            return false;
        }
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        $targetDate = $asOf->copy()->addYears($years);

        $currentAge = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $asOf);
        $futureAge = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $targetDate);
        $retirementAge = config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);

        return $currentAge < $retirementAge && $futureAge >= $retirementAge;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class EmployeeFilter
{
    public static function apply(Builder $query, Request $request): Builder
    {
        $getArrayInput = fn (string $key): array => collect(Arr::flatten((array) $request->input($key, [])))
            ->filter(fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '' && $v !== 'all')
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $regions = $getArrayInput('region');
        if (! empty($regions)) {
            $query->whereIn('region', $regions);
        }

        $groups = $getArrayInput('group');
        if (! empty($groups)) {
            $query->whereIn('group', $groups);
        }

        $companies = $getArrayInput('company_id');
        if (! empty($companies)) {
            $query->whereIn('company_id', $companies);
        }

        $locations = $getArrayInput('location_id');
        if (! empty($locations)) {
            $query->whereIn('location_id', $locations);
        }

        $orgs = $getArrayInput('organization_name');
        if (! empty($orgs)) {
            $query->whereIn('organization_name', $orgs);
        }

        $jobLevels = $getArrayInput('job_level_code');
        if (! empty($jobLevels)) {
            $query->whereIn('job_level_code', $jobLevels);
        }

        $empTypes = $getArrayInput('employment_type');
        if (! empty($empTypes)) {
            $query->whereIn('employment_type', $empTypes);
        }

        $genders = $getArrayInput('gender');
        if (! empty($genders)) {
            $query->whereIn('gender', $genders);
        }

        $generations = $getArrayInput('generation');
        if (! empty($generations)) {
            $config = config('sdm.generations', [
                'Boomers' => 1964,
                'Gen X' => 1980,
                'Gen Y' => 1996,
            ]);

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($generations, $config) {
                foreach ($generations as $gen) {
                    if ($gen === 'Boomers') {
                        $q->orWhereYear('birth_date', '<=', $config['Boomers']);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen X') {
                        $q->orWhereBetween(DB::raw('YEAR(birth_date)'), [$config['Boomers'] + 1, $config['Gen X']]);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen Y') {
                        $q->orWhereBetween(DB::raw('YEAR(birth_date)'), [$config['Gen X'] + 1, $config['Gen Y']]);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen Z') {
                        $q->orWhereYear('birth_date', '>', $config['Gen Y']);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        return $query;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class MetricsHelper
{
    /**
     * Menghitung jumlah karyawan dengan masa kerja < 1 tahun yang TIDAK punya training.
     * Menggunakan logika yang persis sama dengan CombinedMetrics.
     *
     * @param  Collection  $employees  Koleksi object karyawan (minimal punya id, join_date)
     * @param  array|null  $empHours  Array assoc [employee_id => total_hours] (opsional untuk optimalisasi)
     */
    public static function countNewHireNoTraining(Collection $employees, Carbon $asOf, ?array $empHours = null): int
    {
        if ($empHours === null) {
            $empIds = $employees->pluck('id')->toArray();
            $trainings = DB::table('training_records')
                ->whereNotNull('employee_id')
                ->whereIn('employee_id', $empIds)
                ->get(['employee_id', 'hours']);

            $empHours = [];
            foreach ($trainings as $t) {
                if (! isset($empHours[$t->employee_id])) {
                    $empHours[$t->employee_id] = 0;
                }
                $empHours[$t->employee_id] += $t->hours;
            }
        }

        $count = 0;
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $hasTraining = isset($empHours[$e->id]);
            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            $tenureFloat = Demographics::los($join, $asOf);

            if ($tenureFloat !== null && $tenureFloat < 1 && ! $hasTraining) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        return $count;
    }

    /**
     * Menghitung karyawan yang masuk di tahun yang sama dengan $asOf.
     */
    public static function countNewHireThisYear(Collection $employees, Carbon $asOf): int
    {
        $count = 0;
        $targetYear = $asOf->year;

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            if ($join !== null && $join->year === $targetYear) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        return $count;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Query\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TrainingFilter
{
    public static function apply(Builder $query, Request $request): Builder
    {

        if ($request->filled('year')) {
            $query->whereIn('year', (array) $request->input('year'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('month')) {
            $query->whereIn('month', (array) $request->input('month'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('training_name')) {
            $query->where('training_name', 'like', '%'.$request->input('training_name').'%');
        }
        if ($request->filled('regularity')) {
            $query->whereIn('regularity', (array) $request->input('regularity'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('source_type')) {
            $query->whereIn('source_type', (array) $request->input('source_type'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('company_id')) {
            $query->whereIn('company_id', (array) $request->input('company_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('region')) {
            $query->whereIn('region', (array) $request->input('region'));
        }

        return $query;
    }
}

use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureRole;
use App\Http\Middleware\HandleInertiaRequests;
use App\Http\Middleware\SecurityHeadersMiddleware;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->trustProxies(at: '*');
        $middleware->append(SecurityHeadersMiddleware::class);
        $middleware->web(append: [
            HandleInertiaRequests::class,
        ]);
        $middleware->alias([
            'role' => EnsureRole::class,
        ]);
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        $exceptions->shouldRenderJsonWhen(
            fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson(),
        );
    })->create();

<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option defines the default authentication "guard" and password
    | reset "broker" for your application. You may change these values
    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.
    |
    */

    'defaults' => [
        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),
        'passwords' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_BROKER', 'users'),
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Guards
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |
    */

    'guards' => [
        'web' => [
            'driver' => 'session',
            'provider' => 'users',
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | User Providers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

    'providers' => [
        'users' => [
            'driver' => 'eloquent',
            'model' => env('AUTH_MODEL', User::class),
        ],

        // 'users' => [
        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

    'passwords' => [
        'users' => [
            'provider' => 'users',
            'table' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE', 'password_reset_tokens'),
            'expire' => 60,
            'throttle' => 60,
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Password Confirmation Timeout
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define the number of seconds before a password confirmation
    | window expires and users are asked to re-enter their password via the
    | confirmation screen. By default, the timeout lasts for three hours.
    |
    */

    'password_timeout' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_TIMEOUT', 10800),

];
