## 15. Risiko dan ketergantungan
| Risiko | Dampak | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| 47% baris training punya NIK rusak (notasi ilmiah Excel) dan 14,5% tanpa NIK | Coverage rendah/menyesatkan; analisis gabungan hanya mencakup ±38% baris | Definisi 4.6, banner, panel kualitas data, **minta HR mengekspor ulang Training Record dengan kolom NIK berformat Teks** |
| 76% baris training tidak otomatis terpetakan ke perusahaan | Filter perusahaan di halaman Pelatihan tidak lengkap | UI pemetaan alias + saran otomatis; label "Belum terpetakan" |
| Koordinat lokasi belum ada (92 lokasi) | Peta kosong | Modul koordinat + impor CSV; peta tetap berfungsi parsial; daftar panel tidak bergantung koordinat |
| Tahun 2 digit | Umur/generasi salah | Aturan pivot 3.4 dan unit test |
| Kebocoran data pribadi | Risiko hukum dan reputasi | Bagian 10, `.gitignore`, audit log, role |
| Batas generasi dan usia pensiun berbeda dengan kebijakan | Angka dipertanyakan | Semua di `config/sdm.php` dan tercantum di UI sebagai catatan kaki definisi |

## 16. Pertanyaan terbuka (catat di `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`, ambil default yang tertulis)
1. Apakah usia pensiun kebijakan perusahaan = 55? *(default 55, konfigurabel)*
2. ~~Apakah `Kaltim` (training) = `Kubar` (employee)?~~ **Diputuskan pemilik: dibiarkan terpisah** (`Kaltim` tetap `Kaltim`). Bila kelak ingin digabung, ubah `Clean::region()` dan import ulang.
3. Arti pasti kode level A–F dan 1–5. *(default: tabel 3.5)*
4. Bisakah HR mengekspor ulang Training Record dengan NIK berformat Teks (14 digit non-staf tidak rusak)? Apakah export employee akan dilengkapi non-staf yang NIK-nya 14 digit? *(default: tampilkan apa adanya dengan banner kualitas data)*
5. Karyawan yang hilang dari file employee terbaru: dianggap resign atau dibiarkan? *(default: dibiarkan, dengan peringatan)*
6. Apakah `hr_company` boleh melihat lebih dari satu perusahaan? *(default: ya, lewat pivot)*
7. Apakah manajemen boleh melihat nama staf pada level tertentu (mis. Manager ke atas)? *(default: tidak)*
8. Apakah ada kebijakan retensi audit log? *(default: simpan 24 bulan)*
9. Apakah aplikasi di-host di server internal atau cloud? *(default: tidak mempengaruhi kode; siapkan README deploy generik)*
10. Sumber logo dan panduan merek resmi. *(default: placeholder teks)*

## 17. Definisi selesai (keseluruhan)
Seluruh fase memenuhi DoD-nya; nilai acuan 3.6 cocok; matriks akses 10.2 terverifikasi lewat test; tidak ada data nyata atau kredensial di repo; `npm run build` dan seluruh test hijau; README dan dokumen asumsi/pertanyaan terbuka lengkap.

## Lampiran C — Pemetaan kolom training ke database

| Kolom sumber | Kolom DB | Normalisasi |
|---|---|---|
| NIK | `nik`, `nik_raw`, `nik_status`, `employee_id` | `Clean::nikStatus` (ok/empty/corrupt/invalid); `employee_id` diisi bila NIK ok dan ada di employee |
| Nama | `participant_name` | trim |
| Jenis Kelamin | `gender` | trim |
| Nama PT | `company_name_raw`, `company_id` | kunci via `Clean::companyKey`, lalu `company_aliases` |
| Department | `department` | trim (25 nilai unik) |
| lokasi Kerja | `work_location` | trim |
| Group | `group` | trim |
| REGION | `region` | `Clean::region` (hanya menyamakan huruf besar/kecil; Kaltim tetap Kaltim) |
| GOL | `grade` | Staf / Non Staf |
| Jabatan | `position` | trim |
| Tgl | *(diabaikan)* | campuran format |
| Bln, Thn | `month`, `year` | `Clean::month`; baris tanpa bulan/tahun dilewati |
| Jml Hari | `days` | numerik |
| Jam Pelatihan | `hours` | numerik |
| Nama Pelatihan | `training_name` | trim (41 nilai unik) |
| Instruktur | `instructor` | trim |
| Tempat Pelatihan | `venue` | trim |
| Reg / Non Reg | `regularity` | `Clean::regularity` |
| Keterangan | `note` | trim |
| Internal/Eksternal | `source_type` | trim |
| Level | `level` | `Clean::level` |
| Periode | `period` | Q1–Q4 |

## Lampiran D — Glosarium
**HC** headcount. **LOS** length of service (masa kerja). **NIK** nomor induk karyawan (di training) = **Employee ID** (di employee). **PTKP** penghasilan tidak kena pajak (kode status tanggungan). **GOL** golongan (Staf / Non Staf pada data training). **Coverage** proporsi karyawan yang tercatat mengikuti pelatihan (definisi 4.6). **Alias** nama PT versi data training yang dipetakan ke perusahaan resmi.

# Progress Peta SDM Operasional

## Fase yang Selesai
- **Fase 0**: Setup dan Starter Code (Database Migration, Model, Seeder awal) selesai.
- **Fase 1**: Lapisan Data (Import SDM, Cleaning, Filter) selesai dan teruji.
- **Fase 2**: Visualisasi Geospasial → **Diganti ke Galeri Perusahaan** (lihat Fase 2b di bawah).
- **Fase 3**: Dashboard & Demografi selesai (berbagai komponen grafik).
- **Fase 4**: Modul Pelatihan (halaman Pelatihan) selesai.
- **Fase 5**: Modul Analisis Gabungan selesai.
- **Fase 6**: Direktori Karyawan (Tabel server-side, modal detail, export Excel) selesai.
- **Fase 7**: Data Training Mentah (Tabel server-side, modal detail karyawan, filter NIK, export Excel) selesai.
- **Fase 8**: Foto Profil Karyawan (upload, simpan, tampil di avatar) selesai.
- **Fase 9**: Sync Portal Otomatis (jadwal malam 02:00 WIB, PORTAL_SYNC_ENABLED) selesai.
- **Fase 10 (2b)**: Galeri Perusahaan — Peta dihapus, diganti galeri kard + detail halaman penuh.

## Fase yang Sedang Dikerjakan / Belum
- (Semua Fase Selesai)

## Keputusan Penting

### Fase 10 — Galeri Perusahaan (2026-10-13)
- **Peta dihapus**: Leaflet, react-leaflet, react-leaflet-cluster, leaflet.markercluster diuninstall dari npm.
- **URL lama**: `/peta` tetap ada sebagai redirect 301 ke `/perusahaan`.
- **Master Lokasi dihapus**: Route `/admin/lokasi`, `LocationController`, `Pages/Admin/Location.jsx`, `ResetCoordinatesCommand` dihapus. Data lokasi tetap ada di database.
- **Kolom koordinat dihapus**: Migrasi `2026_10_13_100000_drop_coordinate_columns_from_locations.php` menghapus `latitude`, `longitude`, `coordinate_source` dari tabel `locations`. Migrasi memiliki `down()` yang lengkap.
- **StaffDetailModal dipindahkan**: Dari `Components/Map/` ke `Components/staff/` agar tidak bergantung konteks peta.
- **Widget Dashboard tetap utuh**: `RegionalMapWidget` menggunakan SVG statis + div overlay, tidak pernah bergantung Leaflet.
- **Halaman detail**: `/perusahaan/{code}` adalah full page dengan banner gradient, KPI cards, tab Profil (grafik generasi, level, departemen, lokasi) dan tab Staf (tabel paginated + StaffDetailModal).
- **Backup database**: `storage/backups/backup_before_company_gallery_2026_10_13.sql`

### Keputusan Lama
- **Akun & Role**: Aplikasi menggunakan SATU AKUN TANPA ROLE. Kolom `role` dan `is_active` dihapus via migrasi `2026_09_28_155134_drop_company_user_and_role_columns.php`.
- **Admin Setup**: Command `php artisan sdm:create-user` untuk pembuatan akun admin.
- **Coordinate Source**: Kolom ini sudah dihapus bersama fase 10.

## Cara Menjalankan Test & Build
- Menjalankan Test: `php artisan test`
- Build Frontend: `npm run build`
- Menjalankan Frontend Dev: `npm run dev`
- Rollback koordinat (jika perlu): `php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1`

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Tooltip, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import L from 'leaflet';
import { renderToString } from 'react-dom/server';
import { MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { companies } from '../data/mockData';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';

// Custom MapPin icon menggunakan Lucide React dengan warna corporate (Dark Teal)
const CorporateIcon = L.divIcon({
  html: renderToString(<MapPin color="#004D40" size={36} strokeWidth={2.5} />),
  className: 'custom-leaflet-icon',
  iconSize: [36, 36],
  iconAnchor: [18, 36],
  popupAnchor: [0, -36],
});

// Komponen helper untuk mengontrol kamera Peta (Animasi FlyTo)
function MapController({ selectedCompany, defaultCenter, defaultZoom }) {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCompany) {
      // Zoom ke titik perusahaan
      map.flyTo(selectedCompany.coordinates, 12, { duration: 1.5 });
    } else {
      // Kembali ke tampilan seluruh Indonesia
      map.flyTo(defaultCenter, defaultZoom, { duration: 1.5 });
    }
  }, [selectedCompany, map, defaultCenter, defaultZoom]);
  return null;
}

export default function MapViewer({ onMarkerClick, selectedCompany }) {
  const indonesiaCenter = [-0.5, 110.0]; // Posisi tengah mencakup Sumatera & Kalimantan
  const zoomLevel = 5;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full relative z-0 bg-[#f3f4f5]">
      <MapContainer
        center={indonesiaCenter}
        zoom={zoomLevel}
        className="w-full h-full"
        zoomControl={false}
      >
        <MapController 
          selectedCompany={selectedCompany} 
          defaultCenter={indonesiaCenter} 
          defaultZoom={zoomLevel} 
        />
        
        {/* Google Maps Base Tile Layer */}
        <TileLayer
          attribution='&copy; Google Maps'
          url="https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}"
        />

        {/* Marker untuk setiap perusahaan */}
        {companies.map((company) => (
          <Marker
            key={company.id}
            position={company.coordinates}
            icon={CorporateIcon}
            eventHandlers={{
              click: () => onMarkerClick(company),
            }}
          >
            <Tooltip
              direction="top"
              offset={[0, -28]}
              opacity={1}
              className="bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm border-none shadow-lg text-gray-800 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm"
            >
              {company.name}
            </Tooltip>
          </Marker>
        ))}
      </MapContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Search, Users, MapPin, Briefcase, ChevronLeft, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { companies, employees } from '../data/mockData';
import StaffDetailModal from './StaffDetailModal';

export default function SidebarDetail({ company, onClose, onSelectCompany }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedStaff, setSelectedStaff] = useState(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('Staff'); // 'Profil' atau 'Staff'
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState(''); // State untuk filter cepat

  // KONDISI 1: JIKA BELUM ADA PERUSAHAAN YANG DIPILIH
  if (!company) {
    const groupedCompanies = companies.reduce((acc, curr) => {
      acc[curr.region] = acc[curr.region] || [];
      acc[curr.region].push(curr);
      return acc;
    }, {});

    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col bg-white">
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-100 shrink-0">
          <div className="relative group">
            <Search size={18} className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 group-focus-within:text-corporate-light transition-colors" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Cari perusahaan atau kabupaten..."
              className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light/20 focus:border-corporate-light text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 pt-2 custom-scrollbar">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Semua Provinsi</p>
          {Object.entries(groupedCompanies).map(([region, comps]) => (
            <div key={region} className="mb-6">
              {comps.map((c) => (
                <div 
                  key={c.id} 
                  onClick={() => onSelectCompany(c)}
                  className="mb-4 group cursor-pointer p-3 -mx-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-green-50 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-corporate-light mb-1 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-400 mr-2"></span> {region}
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="font-extrabold text-gray-800 text-base group-hover:text-corporate-dark transition-colors">{c.name}</h4>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">{c.kabupaten || 'Area Operasi'}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // KONDISI 2: PERUSAHAAN TERPILIH
  const companyStaff = employees.filter((emp) => emp.companyId === company.id);
  const filteredStaff = companyStaff.filter((emp) => {
    const matchesSearch = emp.nama.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
                          emp.jabatan.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesFilter = activeFilter ? emp.jabatan.toLowerCase().includes(activeFilter.toLowerCase()) : true;
    return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
  });

  return (
    <>
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col bg-white">
        
        {/* Header Panel dengan Background Image */}
        <div 
          className="relative text-white p-6 overflow-hidden shrink-0"
          style={{
            backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0,77,64,0.95), rgba(0,77,64,0.85)), url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518531933037-91b2f5f229cc?q=80&w=800&auto=format&fit=crop')`,
            backgroundSize: 'cover',
            backgroundPosition: 'center'
          }}
        >
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-white opacity-10 rounded-full blur-2xl transform translate-x-10 -translate-y-10"></div>
          
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="flex items-center text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm font-medium mb-4 transition-colors z-10 relative"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} className="mr-1" /> Kembali ke daftar
          </button>
          
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-extrabold mb-1 pr-4 leading-tight relative z-10">{company.name}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-white/90 font-medium mb-4 relative z-10 shadow-sm">
            {company.kabupaten || 'Area Operasi'} &bull; {company.region}
          </p>
          
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 relative z-10">
            {(company.fasilitas || []).map((fas, i) => (
              <span key={i} className="px-3 py-1 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm border border-white/20">
                {fas}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-100 shrink-0 px-2">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('Profil')}
            className={`px-6 py-4 text-sm font-bold border-b-2 transition-colors ${activeTab === 'Profil' ? 'border-corporate-light text-corporate-dark' : 'border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'}`}
          >
            Profil
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('Staff')}
            className={`px-6 py-4 text-sm font-bold border-b-2 transition-colors ${activeTab === 'Staff' ? 'border-corporate-light text-corporate-dark' : 'border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'}`}
          >
            Staff (SDM)
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content: Profil */}
        {activeTab === 'Profil' && (
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6 text-sm">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Deskripsi</p>
              <p className="text-gray-700 font-medium leading-relaxed">{company.description}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Provinsi</p>
              <p className="text-gray-800 font-bold">{company.region}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Kabupaten / Area Operasi</p>
              <p className="text-gray-800 font-bold">{company.kabupaten}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Fasilitas</p>
              <p className="text-gray-800 font-bold">{(company.fasilitas || []).join(', ')}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Koordinat Acuan</p>
              <p className="text-gray-800 font-bold font-mono">{company.coordinates[0].toFixed(4)}&deg;, {company.coordinates[1].toFixed(4)}&deg;</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tab Content: Staff */}
        {activeTab === 'Staff' && (
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 pb-2 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
                <div className="relative group flex-1">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Cari nama staff..."
                    className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light/20 focus:border-corporate-light text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300"
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <button className="bg-corporate-light hover:bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm flex items-center shadow-sm transition-colors">
                  <Plus size={16} className="mr-1" /> Tambah
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Quick Filters */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2">
                {['Manager', 'Askep', 'Asisten', 'Mandor'].map((f) => (
                  <button 
                    key={f} 
                    onClick={() => setActiveFilter(activeFilter === f ? '' : f)}
                    className={`text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                      activeFilter === f 
                        ? 'bg-corporate-dark text-white shadow-md' 
                        : 'text-corporate-dark bg-corporate-light/10 hover:bg-corporate-light/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {f}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 pb-6 pt-2 space-y-3 custom-scrollbar">
              {filteredStaff.length > 0 ? (
                filteredStaff.map((staff) => (
                  <div 
                    key={staff.id} 
                    onClick={() => setSelectedStaff(staff)}
                    className="group bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-corporate-light/30 transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-4"
                  >
                    {staff.foto ? (
                      <img src={staff.foto} alt={staff.nama} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0 border border-gray-100" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-corporate-dark text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0">
                        {staff.nama.substring(0,2).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-corporate-dark transition-colors">{staff.nama}</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium mt-0.5">{staff.jabatan}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                      staff.status === 'Aktif' 
                        ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' 
                        : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                    }`}>
                      {staff.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-400">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">Tidak ada staf ditemukan.</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <StaffDetailModal staff={selectedStaff} onClose={() => setSelectedStaff(null)} />
    </>
  );
}

import { X, Target, MapPin, Briefcase, Award, Clock, Plus } from 'lucide-react';

export default function StaffDetailModal({ staff, onClose }) {
  // Local state untuk demonstrasi UI yang bisa diedit sementara
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(null);

  // Sync state ketika staff berubah
  useEffect(() => {
    if (staff) {
      setFormData({
        ...staff,
        // Inisialisasi properti opsional jika belum ada
        nik: staff.nik || '',
        targetPosisi: staff.targetPosisi || '',
        lokasiPenugasan: staff.lokasiPenugasan || '',
        statusPenugasan: staff.statusPenugasan || '',
        region: staff.region || 'Riau',
        historiPekerjaan: staff.historiPekerjaan || [],
        prestasi: staff.prestasi || [],
        kompetensi: staff.kompetensi || [],
        progressIDP: staff.progressIDP || 0
      });
    }
  }, [staff]);

  if (!staff || !formData) return null;

  const handleInputChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    // Di aplikasi nyata, ini akan call API. Di sini cukup alert/feedback visual
    alert(`Perubahan untuk ${formData.nama} berhasil disimpan sementara di memori browser!`);
  };

  const handleAddHistori = () => {
    const newEntry = prompt("Masukkan histori pekerjaan baru (format: Waktu: Deskripsi):", "Okt 2026 - Sekarang: Promosi Askep");
    if (newEntry) {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, historiPekerjaan: [newEntry, ...prev.historiPekerjaan] }));
    }
  };

  const handleAddPrestasi = () => {
    const newEntry = prompt("Masukkan prestasi baru:", "Pencapaian target tahunan 120%");
    if (newEntry) {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, prestasi: [newEntry, ...prev.prestasi] }));
    }
  };

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6" 
      style={{ zIndex: 9999 }}
    >
      <div 
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity" 
        onClick={onClose}
      ></div>
      
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-5xl h-[90vh] bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row transform transition-all overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* Left Side: Editable Profile Info */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-[400px] bg-gray-50 p-8 border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col items-center shrink-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          
          {/* Breadcrumb Header */}
          <div className="w-full mb-6">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-left">
              PT Ciliandra Perkasa / {formData.nama.split(' ')[0]}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Foto Profil */}
          <div className="relative mb-6">
            <div className="w-28 h-28 rounded-[2rem] overflow-hidden bg-corporate-dark text-white flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-bold shadow-lg">
              {formData.foto ? (
                <img src={formData.foto} alt={formData.nama} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                formData.nama.substring(0,2).toUpperCase()
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 mb-1 text-center">{formData.nama}</h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 font-medium mb-6 text-sm text-center">ID: {formData.nik || 'Belum diisi'}</p>

          {/* Form Inputs */}
          <div className="w-full space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Nama Lengkap</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.nama} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('nama', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">ID Karyawan</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.nik} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('nik', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Contoh: 2026010001"
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Jabatan Saat Ini</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.jabatan} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('jabatan', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Target Jabatan</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.targetPosisi} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('targetPosisi', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Lokasi OJT / Penempatan</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.lokasiPenugasan} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('lokasiPenugasan', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Status OJT</label>
              <select 
                value={formData.statusPenugasan}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('statusPenugasan', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              >
                <option value="Belum Penugasan">Belum Penugasan</option>
                <option value="Sedang OJT">Sedang OJT</option>
                <option value="Sudah Penugasan">Sudah Penugasan</option>
                <option value="Definitif">Definitif</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1.5 ml-1">Region</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={formData.region} 
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('region', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm transition-all"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-8 w-full pb-8">
            <button 
              onClick={handleSave}
              className="w-full py-3.5 bg-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition-colors"
            >
              Simpan Perubahan
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Side: Dashboard Details */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-8 relative overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar bg-white">
          <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 z-10 flex items-center gap-4">
            <button 
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 font-bold transition-colors"
            >
              <X size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} className="mr-1" /> Tutup
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {/* Section: Progress IDP */}
          <div className="mb-10 mt-6 bg-corporate-dark p-6 rounded-3xl border border-corporate-dark/80 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-white opacity-5 rounded-full blur-3xl transform translate-x-20 -translate-y-20 pointer-events-none"></div>
            
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white/60 uppercase tracking-widest mb-6 relative z-10">
              PROGRESS IDP (INDIVIDUAL DEVELOPMENT PLAN)
            </h3>
            
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8 relative z-10">
              {/* Overall Progress (Besar) */}
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="relative w-32 h-32 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <svg className="w-full h-full transform -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" strokeWidth="8" />
                    <circle 
                      cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#4ade80" strokeWidth="8" 
                      strokeDasharray={`${formData.progressIDP * 2.83} 283`}
                      className="transition-all duration-1000 ease-out"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div className="absolute text-white font-extrabold text-3xl">
                    {formData.progressIDP}%
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-white/80 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mt-3">Overall Progress</span>
              </div>

              {/* Sub-progress (Kecil) */}
              {['Refreshment', 'Soft Skill', 'OJT Task'].map((item, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center">
                  <div className="relative w-16 h-16 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg className="w-full h-full transform -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" strokeWidth="8" />
                      {formData.progressIDP > 0 && (
                        <circle 
                          cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="8" 
                          strokeDasharray={`${(formData.progressIDP / 1.5) * 2.51} 251`}
                        />
                      )}
                    </svg>
                    <div className="absolute text-white font-bold text-sm">
                      {formData.progressIDP > 0 ? Math.round(formData.progressIDP / 1.5) : '0'}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-white/70 font-bold mt-2 text-center w-16 leading-tight">{item}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section: Histori Pekerjaan */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-100 pb-2">
              <h4 className="font-extrabold text-gray-800 text-lg">Histori Pekerjaan</h4>
              <button onClick={handleAddHistori} className="text-xs font-bold text-corporate-light hover:text-green-700 flex items-center bg-green-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors">
                <Plus size={14} className="mr-1" /> Tambah
              </button>
            </div>
            {formData.historiPekerjaan.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-4 border-l-2 border-gray-100 ml-2 pl-6 py-2">
                {formData.historiPekerjaan.map((histori, index) => {
                  const parts = histori.split(':');
                  const waktu = parts[0];
                  const deskripsi = parts.slice(1).join(':').trim() || histori;
                  return (
                    <div key={index} className="relative">
                      <span className="absolute -left-[31px] top-1.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-corporate-light ring-4 ring-white shadow-sm"></span>
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-0.5">{waktu}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-800 font-medium">{deskripsi}</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Belum ada histori pekerjaan.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Section: Achievement & Prestasi */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-100 pb-2">
              <h4 className="font-extrabold text-gray-800 text-lg">Achievement & Prestasi</h4>
              <button onClick={handleAddPrestasi} className="text-xs font-bold text-corporate-light hover:text-green-700 flex items-center bg-green-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors">
                <Plus size={14} className="mr-1" /> Tambah
              </button>
            </div>
            {formData.prestasi.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {formData.prestasi.map((prestasi, index) => (
                  <div key={index} className="flex items-start bg-yellow-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-100/50">
                    <div className="bg-white p-1.5 rounded-full shadow-sm mr-3 shrink-0">
                      <Award size={16} className="text-yellow-500" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800 pt-0.5">{prestasi}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Belum ada achievement/prestasi.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Section: Kompetensi Talent */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-100 pb-2">
              <h4 className="font-extrabold text-gray-800 text-lg">Kompetensi Talent</h4>
              <button className="text-xs font-bold text-corporate-light hover:text-green-700 flex items-center bg-green-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors">
                <Plus size={14} className="mr-1" /> Tambah
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Belum ada data kompetensi.</p>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(modalContent, document.body);
}

# Script Otomatis Packaging / Zipping Monitoring Operations (Peta SDM) untuk Tim IT Jakarta
# Jalankan di PowerShell: .\package-for-deploy.ps1
param(
    [switch]$IncludeVendor = $false
)

Write-Host "==========================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  MENYIAPKAN PAKET DEPLOY MONITORING OPERATIONS           " -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Domain Target : https://monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
Write-Host "  API Portal    : https://academy.first-resources.com     " -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
Write-Host "==========================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$sourceDir = $PSScriptRoot
$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmm'
$zipFileName = if ($IncludeVendor) {
    "monitoringops-peta-sdm-release-with-vendor-$timestamp.zip"
} else {
    "monitoringops-peta-sdm-release-$timestamp.zip"
}
$zipPath = Join-Path $sourceDir $zipFileName
$stagingDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP "monitoringops-staging-$(Get-Random)"

Write-Host "`n[1/6] Membersihkan cache lokal Laravel..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
php artisan optimize:clear

Write-Host "`n[2/6] Memastikan build frontend production terbaru (Vite/React)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
npm run build
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "Build frontend gagal! Pembungkusan dibatalkan." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "`n[3/6] Memperbarui dump database (database_peta_sdm_initial.sql)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$sqlFile = Join-Path $sourceDir "database_peta_sdm_initial.sql"
mysqldump -u root --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --single-transaction --quick db_peta --result-file=$sqlFile
if (Test-Path $sqlFile) {
    $sqlSize = [math]::Round((Get-Item $sqlFile).Length / 1MB, 2)
    Write-Host "  > Database dump berhasil diexport ($sqlSize MB)" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "  > Peringatan: mysqldump gagal atau tidak ditemukan. Menggunakan dump database sebelumnya jika ada." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "`n[4/6] Menyiapkan struktur berkas ke direktori staging..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $stagingDir }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir | Out-Null

# Folder yang disertakan
$includeDirs = @("app", "bootstrap", "config", "database", "public", "resources", "routes", "storage")
if ($IncludeVendor -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $sourceDir "vendor"))) {
    $includeDirs += "vendor"
    Write-Host "  > Menyertakan folder vendor..." -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

foreach ($dir in $includeDirs) {
    $src = Join-Path $sourceDir $dir
    if (Test-Path $src) {
        $dest = Join-Path $stagingDir $dir
        Copy-Item -Path $src -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force
    }
}

# Berkas root yang disertakan
$includeFiles = @(
    "artisan",
    "composer.json",
    "composer.lock",
    "package.json",
    ".env.example",
    "PANDUAN_DEPLOY_IT_JAKARTA.md",
    "database_peta_sdm_initial.sql"
)
foreach ($file in $includeFiles) {
    $src = Join-Path $sourceDir $file
    if (Test-Path $src) {
        Copy-Item -Path $src -Destination (Join-Path $stagingDir $file) -Force
    }
}

# Hapus public/storage di staging agar tidak merusak symlink pada server Linux
$stagingPublicStorage = Join-Path $stagingDir "public\storage"
if (Test-Path $stagingPublicStorage) {
    Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $stagingPublicStorage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

# Bersihkan file log & cache temporary di staging storage
$stagingStorage = Join-Path $stagingDir "storage"
if (Test-Path $stagingStorage) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path "$stagingStorage\logs" -File -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Get-ChildItem -Path "$stagingStorage\framework\cache\data" -File -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Get-ChildItem -Path "$stagingStorage\framework\sessions" -File -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Get-ChildItem -Path "$stagingStorage\framework\views" -File -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Get-ChildItem -Path "$stagingStorage\backups" -File -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (Test-Path "$stagingStorage\app\public\employees.zip") {
        Remove-Item -Force "$stagingStorage\app\public\employees.zip" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    # Pastikan file .gitignore tetap ada agar direktori tidak hilang saat di-unzip
    $storageGitIgnores = @(
        "$stagingStorage\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\app\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\app\public\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\framework\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\framework\cache\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\framework\sessions\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\framework\views\.gitignore",
        "$stagingStorage\logs\.gitignore"
    )
    foreach ($gi in $storageGitIgnores) {
        $parent = Split-Path $gi -Parent
        if (Test-Path $parent) {
            if (-not (Test-Path $gi)) {
                "*`n!.gitignore`n" | Set-Content -Path $gi -Force
            }
        }
    }
}

# Bersihkan file temporary di staging bootstrap/cache (kecuali .gitignore)
$stagingBootstrapCache = Join-Path $stagingDir "bootstrap\cache"
if (Test-Path $stagingBootstrapCache) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $stagingBootstrapCache -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne ".gitignore" } | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $bcGi = Join-Path $stagingBootstrapCache ".gitignore"
    if (-not (Test-Path $bcGi)) {
        "*`n!.gitignore`n" | Set-Content -Path $bcGi -Force
    }
}

Write-Host "`n[5/6] Mengompres seluruh berkas menjadi ZIP: $zipFileName..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
if (Test-Path $zipPath) { Remove-Item -Force $zipPath }

# Gunakan tar bawaan Windows untuk kompresi zip super cepat
$prevLoc = Get-Location
Set-Location $stagingDir
tar -a -cf $zipPath *
Set-Location $prevLoc

Write-Host "`n[6/6] Membersihkan direktori temporary staging..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $stagingDir

$fileSizeMb = [math]::Round((Get-Item $zipPath).Length / 1MB, 2)
Write-Host "`n==========================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  SUKSES! PAKET DEPLOYMENT SIAP DISERAHKAN KE IT JAKARTA  " -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==========================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  File ZIP : $zipPath" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Ukuran   : $fileSizeMb MB" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Panduan  : PANDUAN_DEPLOY_IT_JAKARTA.md (tersedia di dalam ZIP)" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "==========================================================" -ForegroundColor Green

# Panduan Lengkap Deployment Monitoring Operations (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS)
**Untuk: Tim IT Jakarta & Tim Operasional FR Academy**  
*Update Terakhir: 30 Oktober 2026 (Berdasarkan Evaluasi & Pengujian Server `fr-academy-dev` / `10.121.1.17`)*

---

## 1. Arsitektur & Informasi Server

| Komponen | Nilai / Konfigurasi | Keterangan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sistem Operasi** | Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS (Focal Fossa) | Kernel Linux x86_64 |
| **IP Server Internal** | `10.121.1.17` | Host server internal IT Jakarta |
| **Domain Monitoring Ops** | `https://monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com` | Dashboard Analitik & Peta SDM (Laravel 12 + Inertia React) |
| **Domain Portal FR Academy** | `https://academy.first-resources.com` | Sumber Data Training & Pelatihan |
| **Endpoint API Portal** | `https://academy.first-resources.com/api/v1/training-records/export` | Endpoint penarikan snapshot seluruh data pelatihan |
| **Web Server** | Nginx 1.18.0 (Ubuntu) | Reverse Proxy, Gzip & SSL Termination |
| **PHP Runtime** | PHP 8.4 (Custom Prefix `/usr/local/php84`) | PHP-FPM FastCGI listening on `127.0.0.1:9000` |
| **Web Root Directory** | `/var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com/public` | Wajib mengarah ke subfolder `/public` |

---

## 2. Kebutuhan PHP di Ubuntu 20.04 LTS

> [!WARNING]
> **Catatan Penting Tim IT:**  
> Repository bawaan Ubuntu 20.04 secara *default* hanya memiliki PHP 7.4. Sedangkan aplikasi Monitoring Operations membutuhkan **PHP 8.2+**.  
> Pada server `fr-academy-dev` (`10.121.1.17`), **PHP 8.4 sudah terpasang di direktori `/usr/local/php84/`**.

### 1. Standarisasi Binary CLI
Pastikan perintah `php` di terminal Ubuntu mengeksekusi PHP 8.4:
```bash
sudo ln -sf /usr/local/php84/bin/php /usr/bin/php
php -v  # Harus mencetak PHP 8.4.x
```

### 2. Matikan PHP 7.4 FPM Bawaan (Cegah Konflik RAM & Port)
```bash
sudo systemctl stop php7.4-fpm 2>/dev/null
sudo systemctl disable php7.4-fpm 2>/dev/null
```

### 3. Node.js Tidak Diperlukan di Server Produksi
Seluruh aset frontend (React, Tailwind, Vite) **sudah dikompilasi ke dalam paket rilis ZIP** pada folder `public/build`. Tim IT **tidak perlu** menginstall Node.js atau menjalankan `npm install`/`npm run build` di server.

---

## 3. Langkah-Langkah Deployment (End-to-End)

### Langkah 1: Penyiapan Direktori & Ekstraksi File
Ekstrak paket ZIP rilis ke direktori `/var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com`:
```bash
# 1. Buat folder jika belum ada
sudo mkdir -p /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com

# 2. Ekstrak berkas rilis ZIP (sesuaikan lokasi file zip hasil upload)
sudo unzip -o monitoringops-peta-sdm-release-*.zip -d /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com/

# 3. Masuk ke direktori aplikasi
cd /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com
```

## 4. Konfigurasi Nginx (Teruji untuk Server Jakarta `10.121.1.17`)

Buka file konfigurasi Nginx untuk domain ini:
```bash
sudo nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com
```

Gunakan konfigurasi berikut (menggunakan port FastCGI `127.0.0.1:9000` dan SSL yang sudah terpasang di server):

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com;

    # 1. Root WAJIB mengarah ke subfolder /public
    root /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com/public;
    index index.php index.html;
    charset utf-8;

    # 2. Sertifikat SSL yang sudah ada di server internal Jakarta
    ssl_certificate /var/www/html/first-resources/first-resources_cert.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /var/www/html/first-resources/first-resources_key.txt;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;

    # 3. Batas upload diperbesar untuk batch import Excel & ZIP foto karyawan
    client_max_body_size 100M;

    # Gzip Compression
    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml application/xml image/svg+xml;

    # Security Headers
    add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN";
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff";
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block";

    # Forwarding headers untuk proxy/load balancer
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string;
    }

    location = /favicon.ico { access_log off; log_not_found off; }
    location = /robots.txt  { access_log off; log_not_found off; }

    # 4. Static assets caching (Vite / React)
    location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|css|js|webp|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, no-transform";
        access_log off;
    }

    # 5. FastCGI PHP-FPM 8.4 (WAJIB menggunakan TCP Port 127.0.0.1:9000)
    location ~ \.php$ {
        fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000;
        fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $realpath_root$fastcgi_script_name;
        include fastcgi_params;
        fastcgi_param HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO https;
        fastcgi_hide_header X-Powered-By;

        # Timeout 300s agar sinkronisasi Portal API ribuan data / Excel besar tidak 504 Gateway Timeout
        fastcgi_read_timeout 300;
        fastcgi_send_timeout 300;
        fastcgi_connect_timeout 60;
    }

    location ~ /\.(?!well-known).* {
        deny all;
    }
}
```

Aktifkan virtual host dan reload Nginx:
```bash
sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
sudo nginx -t
sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

## 5. Manajemen Service PHP-FPM 8.4

Karena PHP 8.4 terpasang di `/usr/local/php84/`, berikut perintah operasionalnya:

* **Mengecek apakah PHP-FPM running di port 9000:**
  ```bash
  ps aux | grep php-fpm | grep -v grep
  ss -tulpn | grep 9000
  ```
* **Me-restart PHP-FPM secara bersih jika diperlukan:**
  ```bash
  sudo pkill -9 -f php-fpm
  sudo /usr/local/php84/sbin/php-fpm
  ```

## 6. Cron Job Auto-Sync Jam 02:00 Pagi

Agar penarikan data rekam pelatihan dari Portal FR Academy berjalan otomatis setiap dini hari pukul **02:00 WIB**:

> [!CAUTION]
> Crontab WAJIB didaftarkan di user **`www-data`** (bukan `root`) agar file log tidak terkunci permission-nya.

Buka crontab user `www-data`:
```bash
sudo crontab -u www-data -e
```

Tambahkan baris berikut di bagian paling bawah:
```cron
* * * * * cd /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com && /usr/local/php84/bin/php artisan schedule:run >> /dev/null 2>&1
```

## 7. Panduan Akses Klien / Laptop Tester (DNS Mapping)

Jika domain `monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com` belum didaftarkan di DNS publik kantor dan tester mengakses via IP server `10.121.1.17`, browser laptop akan memunculkan error `DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN`.

**Solusi di laptop tester Windows:**
Buka Notepad **Run as Administrator**, buka file `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts`, dan tambahkan baris:
```text
10.121.1.17 academy.first-resources.com
10.121.1.17 monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com
```
Simpan file tersebut. Halaman aplikasi langsung dapat diakses di browser melalui:  
👉 **`https://monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com/login`**

## 9. Tabel Diagnostik Error (Troubleshooting Cheatsheet)

| Gejala / Error | Penyebab Utama | Solusi Cepat |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`502 Bad Gateway`** | Nginx diarahkan ke `.sock` yang tidak ada, atau PHP-FPM di port 9000 mati | Di Nginx set `fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000;`. Pastikan service hidup dengan `sudo /usr/local/php84/sbin/php-fpm`. |
| **`403 Forbidden` (directory index ... forbidden)** | `root` Nginx kurang subfolder `/public` | Pastikan `root /var/www/monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com/public;` terpasang. |
| **`413 Request Entity Too Large`** | `client_max_body_size` Nginx masih default 1M | Tambahkan `client_max_body_size 100M;` di konfigurasi Nginx. |
| **`504 Gateway Timeout` saat sync** | FastCGI timeout Nginx terlalu singkat (< 60s) | Tambahkan `fastcgi_read_timeout 300;` di Nginx dan pastikan `PORTAL_API_TIMEOUT=60` di `.env`. |
| **Foto Karyawan 404 Not Found** | Symlink `public/storage` belum dibuat | Jalankan `php artisan storage:link` dan pastikan hak folder `sudo chown -R www-data:www-data storage/app/public`. |
| **cURL SSL error 60 / 77** | Server Linux internal belum memuat CA bundle internal | Ubah sementara `PORTAL_API_VERIFY_SSL=false` pada `.env`, lalu `php artisan config:cache`. |
| **Gagal Verifikasi Turnstile saat Login** | Koneksi server terhalang proxy atau domain belum match | Untuk pengujian/bypass darurat, set `TURNSTILE_ENABLED=false` di `.env`, lalu `php artisan config:cache`. |
| **Permission Denied pada `laravel.log`** | Crontab atau artisan dijalankan sebagai user `root` | Jalankan `sudo chown -R www-data:www-data storage` dan pastikan crontab berada di user `www-data`. |
| **`DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN` di laptop** | Domain internal belum terdaftar di DNS kantor | Tambahkan `10.121.1.17 monitoringops-academy.first-resources.com` ke file `hosts` Windows laptop. |

File: public/.htaccess

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    <IfModule mod_negotiation.c>
        Options -MultiViews -Indexes
    </IfModule>

    RewriteEngine On

    # Handle Authorization Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

    # Handle X-XSRF-Token Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:x-xsrf-token} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_X_XSRF_TOKEN:%{HTTP:X-XSRF-Token}]

    # Redirect Trailing Slashes If Not A Folder...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} (.+)/$
    RewriteRule ^ %1 [L,R=301]

    # Send Requests To Front Controller...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
    RewriteRule ^ index.php [L]
</IfModule>

# Peta SDM Operasional

Aplikasi manajemen dan visualisasi data geospasial Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) perusahaan.

## Fitur Utama

- **Peta Interaktif SDM**: Visualisasi persebaran karyawan berdasarkan lokasi kantor dengan klaster dinamis (didukung oleh Leaflet).
- **Dashboard & Analisis Demografi**: Analisis usia, generasi, masa kerja, dan status pensiun karyawan.
- **Pelatihan**: Analisis catatan pelatihan (*training records*) dan efektivitas kompetensi.
- **Analisis Gabungan**: Melakukan perbandingan korelasi tingkat kinerja dengan *coverage* pelatihan.
- **Direktori Karyawan**: Tabel pencarian karyawan skala besar secara *server-side* dengan kapabilitas Ekspor ke Excel tanpa mengubah data tipe string menjadi ilmiah.

## Persyaratan Sistem

- PHP >= 8.3
- Composer >= 2.0
- Node.js >= 20.x
- Database: SQLite (default) / MySQL / PostgreSQL
- Web Server: Laragon / Nginx / Apache / `php artisan serve`

## Instalasi (Dari Nol)

1. **Clone repository & masuk ke direktori proyek**:
   ```bash
   git clone <repo-url> peta-sdm
   cd peta-sdm
   ```

2. **Instal dependensi Backend (PHP) & Frontend (Node)**:
   ```bash
   composer install
   npm install
   ```

3. **Setup Environment**:
   Salin file konfigurasi `.env`:
   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   php artisan key:generate
   ```

4. **Migrasi Database**:
   Aplikasi menggunakan database SQLite secara default (`database/database.sqlite`).
   ```bash
   php artisan migrate:fresh
   ```

5. **Pembuatan Akun Admin**:
   Aplikasi ini menggunakan sistem **Single Account** tanpa role tambahan. Jalankan command ini untuk membuat akun admin dengan cepat:
   ```bash
   php artisan sdm:create-user admin@peta-sdm.com password
   ```

6. **Import Data Master SDM**:
   Masuk ke aplikasi melalui browser (`http://localhost:8000/login`) lalu akses modul **/admin/import** untuk mengunggah file CSV SDM resmi:
   - `employees-data.csv`
   - `locations-filled.csv`
   - `training_records.csv`
   - `performance_reviews.csv`

7. **Build & Run Aplikasi**:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   php artisan serve
   ```

## Catatan Penting Keamanan (Security Notes)

- **Akses Data Bersifat Rahasia**: Data karyawan mengandung 1.746 baris data pribadi termasuk (namun tak terbatas pada) Tanggal Lahir, Status Pernikahan, Agama, dan Kode PTKP. Seluruh rute aplikasi (kecuali `/login`) dilindungi dengan *middleware* `auth`.
- **Tidak Ada File Publik**: Jangan pernah membuat file viewer, debug scratch, atau menyimpan file hasil *export* di folder `public/` atau menggunakan symlink publik (`php artisan storage:link`) jika tujuannya menampung data sensitif. Semua *export* harus disalurkan langsung via browser (Response Stream Download) tanpa disimpan secara permanen di root aplikasi.
- **Single Admin Architecture**: Karena keputusan pengembangan, aplikasi didesain khusus bagi pengelola utama SDM sehingga tidak ada halaman manajemen multi-user (`/admin/users`) atau registrasi terbuka untuk mencegah eskalasi *privilege*.

## Testing

Untuk menjalankan *unit testing* dan *feature testing*, jalankan perintah:
```bash
php artisan test
```

Aplikasi ini menggunakan SQLite in-memory untuk testing secara terisolasi.

import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip as RechartsTooltip, Legend } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { generationColors, facilityColors, defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

export function DonutChart({ 
    data, 
    nameKey = 'name', 
    dataKey = 'value', 
    colors, 
    unit = '', 
    hideLegend = false, 
    onClick 
}) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

    const getColor = (entry, index) => {
        if (entry?.fill) return entry.fill;
        const name = entry?.[nameKey] || entry?.name;
        if (colors && colors[name]) return colors[name];
        if (facilityColors && facilityColors[name]) return facilityColors[name];
        if (generationColors && generationColors[name]) return generationColors[name];
        return defaultPalette[index % defaultPalette.length];
    };

    const renderCustomizedLabel = ({ cx, cy, midAngle, innerRadius, outerRadius, percent, index }) => {
        if (percent < 0.05) return null;
        const radius = innerRadius + (outerRadius - innerRadius) * 0.5;
        const x = cx + radius * Math.cos(-midAngle * Math.PI / 180);
        const y = cy + radius * Math.sin(-midAngle * Math.PI / 180);

        return (
            <text x={x} y={y} fill="white" textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="central" fontSize="12" fontWeight="bold" className="pointer-events-none">
                {`${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
            </text>
        );
    };

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <PieChart>
                <Pie
                    data={data}
                    cx="50%"
                    cy="50%"
                    innerRadius="50%"
                    outerRadius="80%"
                    paddingAngle={2}
                    dataKey={dataKey}
                    nameKey={nameKey}
                    labelLine={false}
                    label={renderCustomizedLabel}
                >
                    {data.map((entry, index) => (
                        <Cell 
                            key={`cell-${index}`} 
                            fill={getColor(entry, index)} 
                            onClick={() => onClick && onClick(entry)}
                            className={onClick ? "cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity outline-none" : ""}
                        />
                    ))}
                </Pie>
                <RechartsTooltip 
                    formatter={(value, name) => [`${formatNumber(value)}${unit ? ' ' + unit : ''}`, 'Jumlah']} 
                    contentStyle={{ borderRadius: '12px', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)', padding: '8px 12px' }}
                />
                {!hideLegend && <Legend iconType="circle" wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '12px' }} />}
            </PieChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { Maximize2, X } from 'lucide-react';

export function Heatmap({ 
    data, 
    xLabels = [], 
    yLabels = [], 
    valueKey = 'value', 
    tooltipKey = 'label',
    title = 'Heatmap',
    yTitle = 'Region',
    expandable = 'auto' 
}) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0 || !xLabels.length || !yLabels.length) return null;

    const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const shouldShowExpand = expandable === true || (expandable === 'auto' && xLabels.length > 6);

    // Escape key listener to close modal
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!modalOpen) return;
        const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') setModalOpen(false);
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
        
        // Lock body scroll
        const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
            document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
        };
    }, [modalOpen]);

    // Menemukan nilai maksimal untuk menentukan intensitas warna
    const maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(d => Number(d[valueKey]) || 0), 1);

    // Palet warna dari abu-abu (0) ke hijau muda hingga hijau tua korporat (#004D40)
    const getColor = (value) => {
        if (!value || value <= 0) return '#F3F4F6'; // gray-100 for empty
        const intensity = value / maxValue;
        if (intensity > 0.8) return '#004D40'; // corporate-dark
        if (intensity > 0.6) return '#00695C';
        if (intensity > 0.4) return '#2E7D32'; // corporate-light
        if (intensity > 0.2) return '#4CAF50';
        return '#A5D6A7'; // lightest green
    };

    const getTextColor = (value) => {
        if (!value || value <= 0) return '#9CA3AF';
        const intensity = value / maxValue;
        return intensity > 0.4 ? '#FFFFFF' : '#1F2937';
    };

    // Render Matrix Content (used both in card and modal)
    const renderMatrix = (isModal = false) => {
        const cellWidthClass = isModal ? 'w-16 sm:w-20' : 'w-14 sm:w-16';
        const cellHeightClass = isModal ? 'h-11' : 'h-9';
        const labelWidthClass = isModal ? 'w-28 sm:w-36' : 'w-24 sm:w-28';
        const fontSizeClass = isModal ? 'text-xs sm:text-sm' : 'text-xs';

        return (
            <div className={`w-full overflow-auto ${isModal ? 'max-h-[66vh]' : 'max-h-[340px]'}`} style={{ scrollbarWidth: 'thin' }}>
                <div className="min-w-max pb-2">
                    {/* Header Row (Years) */}
                    <div className="flex sticky top-0 bg-white z-20 pb-1.5 pt-1 border-b border-gray-200">
                        {/* Pinned Top-Left Corner (Row Header) */}
                        <div className={`${labelWidthClass} shrink-0 sticky left-0 bg-white z-30 font-bold text-gray-500 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-end pr-3 border-r border-gray-200`}>
                            <span>{yTitle}</span>
                        </div>
                        {xLabels.map(x => (
                            <div key={x} className={`${cellWidthClass} shrink-0 text-center py-1.5 font-bold text-gray-700 ${fontSizeClass} truncate px-0.5`} title={String(x)}>
                                {x}
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    {/* Data Rows (Regions) */}
                    <div className="pt-1.5 space-y-1">
                        {yLabels.map(y => (
                            <div key={y} className="flex items-center group">
                                {/* Pinned Left Column (Region Name) */}
                                <div 
                                    className={`${labelWidthClass} shrink-0 text-right pr-3 py-2 font-bold text-gray-800 truncate sticky left-0 bg-white z-10 border-r border-gray-200 shadow-[2px_0_6px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] ${fontSizeClass}`} 
                                    title={y}
                                >
                                    {y}
                                </div>
                                {xLabels.map(x => {
                                    const cell = data.find(d => d.x === x && d.y === y);
                                    const val = cell ? cell[valueKey] : 0;
                                    const label = cell ? cell[tooltipKey] : '';

                                    return (
                                        <div 
                                            key={`${x}-${y}`} 
                                            className={`${cellWidthClass} ${cellHeightClass} shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center p-1 mx-[1px] rounded-lg transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:z-20 cursor-default select-none font-semibold ${fontSizeClass} shadow-2xs hover:shadow-md`}
                                            style={{ backgroundColor: getColor(val), color: getTextColor(val) }}
                                            title={`${y} — Tahun ${x}\n${label || 'Jumlah Rekrutmen'}: ${formatNumber(val)} orang`}
                                        >
                                            {val > 0 ? formatNumber(val) : '-'}
                                        </div>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    };

    return (
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col">
            {/* Inline Card View */}
            {renderMatrix(false)}

            {/* Expand / Enlarge Button Below Chart */}
            {shouldShowExpand && (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setModalOpen(true)}
                    className="mt-3.5 w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-emerald-50/80 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-2xs hover:shadow-xs group cursor-pointer"
                >
                    <Maximize2 size={14} className="text-emerald-700 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                    <span>Perbesar Tampilan Heatmap (Layar Penuh)</span>
                </button>
            )}

            {/* Fullscreen Modal View */}
            {modalOpen && typeof document !== 'undefined' && createPortal(
                <div 
                    className="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-900/60 backdrop-blur-2xs z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setModalOpen(false);
                    }}
                >
                    <div 
                        className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 w-full max-w-6xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
                        role="dialog"
                        aria-modal="true"
                    >
                        {/* Modal Header */}
                        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-slate-50/70">
                            <div>
                                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600"></span>
                                    <span>{title}</span>
                                </h3>
                                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                                    Geser secara horizontal untuk melihat seluruh rentang data. Nama {yTitle.toLowerCase()} tetap terkunci di sebelah kiri.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Tutup (Esc)"
                            >
                                <X size={20} />
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        {/* Color Scale Legend */}
                        <div className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-50/50 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shrink-0">
                            <span className="text-gray-500 font-medium">Intensitas Rekrutmen:</span>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 inline-block"></span>
                                    <span className="text-gray-600">0 (Nol)</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded bg-[#A5D6A7] inline-block"></span>
                                    <span className="text-gray-600">Rendah</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded bg-[#4CAF50] inline-block"></span>
                                    <span className="text-gray-600">Sedang</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded bg-[#004D40] inline-block"></span>
                                    <span className="text-gray-600">Tinggi (Puncak)</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Modal Matrix Body */}
                        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                            {renderMatrix(true)}
                        </div>

                        {/* Modal Footer */}
                        <div className="px-6 py-3.5 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/50 shrink-0 text-xs">
                            <div className="text-gray-500 font-medium flex items-center gap-4">
                                <span>Total Tahun: <strong className="text-gray-800">{xLabels.length}</strong></span>
                                <span>Total Region: <strong className="text-gray-800">{yLabels.length}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                                className="px-4 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                                Tutup
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>,
                document.body
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Cell } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

function CustomHorizontalBarTooltip({ active, payload, label }) {
    if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
    const entry = payload[0];
    const row = entry?.payload;
    const topTitles = row?.top_titles ? Object.entries(row.top_titles) : [];

    return (
        <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] border border-gray-200 text-xs min-w-[220px] max-w-[290px] z-50">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 pb-2 mb-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm tracking-tight">{row?.name || label}</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200/50">
                    Total: {formatNumber(entry.value)}
                </span>
            </div>

            {topTitles.length > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 mb-1.5">
                        <span>Jabatan di Level Ini</span>
                        <span>({topTitles.length})</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                        {topTitles.slice(0, 5).map(([title, count]) => (
                            <div key={title} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-gray-600 gap-2">
                                <span className="truncate" title={title}>{title}</span>
                                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 shrink-0">{formatNumber(count)}</span>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                        {topTitles.length > 5 && (
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-medium italic pt-0.5">
                                + {topTitles.length - 5} jabatan lainnya...
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export function HorizontalBar({ data, nameKey = 'name', dataKey = 'value', color = defaultPalette[0], labelInside = true, onClick }) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={data} layout="vertical" margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" horizontal={false} stroke="#E5E7EB" />
                <XAxis type="number" tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} tickFormatter={formatNumber} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
                <YAxis 
                    type="category" 
                    dataKey={nameKey} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} 
                    tickFormatter={(val) => {
                        const str = String(val ?? '');
                        return str.length > 22 ? str.substring(0, 20) + '...' : str;
                    }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                    width={140} 
                />
                <Tooltip 
                    content={<CustomHorizontalBarTooltip />}
                    cursor={!onClick ? { fill: '#F3F4F6' } : false}
                />
                <Bar dataKey={dataKey} fill={color} radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}>
                    {data.map((entry, index) => (
                        <Cell 
                            key={`cell-${index}`} 
                            fill={entry.color || color} 
                            onClick={() => onClick && onClick(entry)}
                            className={onClick ? "cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity outline-none" : ""}
                        />
                    ))}
                </Bar>
            </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

File: resources/js/Components/charts/LineTrend.jsx

import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

export function LineTrend({ 
    data, 
    keys = ['value'], 
    lines, 
    xAxisKey = 'name', 
    colors, 
    labels = {}, 
    dualAxis = false 
}) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

    const effectiveKeys = lines ? lines.map((l) => l.dataKey) : keys;

    const getColor = (key, index) => {
        if (lines) {
            const lineObj = lines.find((l) => l.dataKey === key);
            if (lineObj?.stroke) return lineObj.stroke;
        }
        if (colors && colors[key]) return colors[key];
        return defaultPalette[index % defaultPalette.length];
    };

    const getLabel = (key) => {
        if (lines) {
            const lineObj = lines.find((l) => l.dataKey === key);
            if (lineObj?.name) return lineObj.name;
        }
        if (labels && labels[key]) return labels[key];
        if (key === 'hours') return 'Total Jam';
        if (key === 'participants') return 'Jumlah Peserta';
        return key;
    };

    const getUnit = (key) => {
        if (key === 'hours' || key === 'Jam') return ' jam';
        if (key === 'participants' || key === 'Peserta') return ' peserta';
        return '';
    };

    const isDual = dualAxis && effectiveKeys.length === 2;

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart 
                data={data} 
                margin={{ 
                    top: 10, 
                    right: isDual ? 25 : 10, 
                    left: isDual ? 10 : -20, 
                    bottom: 0 
                }}
            >
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="#E5E7EB" />
                <XAxis 
                    dataKey={xAxisKey} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 12, fill: '#6B7280' }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                />
                
                {isDual ? (
                    <>
                        <YAxis 
                            yAxisId="left"
                            orientation="left"
                            tick={{ fontSize: 12, fill: getColor(effectiveKeys[0], 0) }} 
                            tickFormatter={formatNumber} 
                            axisLine={false} 
                            tickLine={false} 
                            width={50}
                        />
                        <YAxis 
                            yAxisId="right"
                            orientation="right"
                            tick={{ fontSize: 12, fill: getColor(effectiveKeys[1], 1) }} 
                            tickFormatter={formatNumber} 
                            axisLine={false} 
                            tickLine={false} 
                            width={40}
                        />
                    </>
                ) : (
                    <YAxis 
                        tick={{ fontSize: 12, fill: '#6B7280' }} 
                        tickFormatter={formatNumber} 
                        axisLine={false} 
                        tickLine={false} 
                    />
                )}

                <Tooltip 
                    formatter={(value, name) => [
                        `${formatNumber(value)}${getUnit(name)}`, 
                        getLabel(name)
                    ]}
                    contentStyle={{ 
                        borderRadius: '12px', 
                        border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', 
                        boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)',
                        padding: '10px 14px',
                        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF'
                    }}
                    labelStyle={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#111827', marginBottom: 4 }}
                />

                {effectiveKeys.length > 1 && (
                    <Legend 
                        iconType="circle" 
                        wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '12px', paddingTop: '10px' }} 
                        formatter={(value) => getLabel(value)}
                    />
                )}

                {effectiveKeys.map((key, index) => (
                    <Line 
                        key={key} 
                        yAxisId={isDual ? (index === 0 ? 'left' : 'right') : undefined}
                        type="monotone" 
                        dataKey={key} 
                        name={key}
                        stroke={getColor(key, index)} 
                        strokeWidth={2.5} 
                        dot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 2, fill: '#FFFFFF', stroke: getColor(key, index) }} 
                        activeDot={{ r: 6, stroke: getColor(key, index), strokeWidth: 2 }} 
                    />
                ))}
            </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

File: resources/js/Components/charts/PopulationPyramid.jsx
