import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend, ReferenceLine } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';

export function PopulationPyramid({ data, yAxisKey = 'ageGroup', leftKey = 'Male', rightKey = 'Female', leftColor = '#0EA5E9', rightColor = '#EC4899' }) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

    // Transform data for pyramid: left side negative, right side positive
    const pyramidData = data.map(d => ({
        ...d,
        _left: -Math.abs(d[leftKey] || 0),
        _right: Math.abs(d[rightKey] || 0),
        _rawLeft: d[leftKey] || 0,
        _rawRight: d[rightKey] || 0,
    }));

    const CustomTooltip = ({ active, payload, label }) => {
        if (active && payload && payload.length) {
            return (
                <div className="bg-white p-3 border border-gray-100 rounded-lg shadow-md text-sm">
                    <p className="font-bold mb-2">{label}</p>
                    {payload.map(p => (
                        <p key={p.dataKey} style={{ color: p.color }}>
                            {p.name}: {formatNumber(Math.abs(p.value))}
                        </p>
                    ))}
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    };

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={pyramidData} layout="vertical" margin={{ top: 20, right: 20, left: 20, bottom: 0 }} stackOffset="sign">
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" horizontal={true} vertical={false} stroke="#E5E7EB" />
                <XAxis 
                    type="number" 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} 
                    tickFormatter={(val) => formatNumber(Math.abs(val))} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                />
                <YAxis 
                    type="category" 
                    dataKey={yAxisKey} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold' }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                    width={80} 
                    orientation="left"
                />
                <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltip />} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '12px' }} />
                <ReferenceLine x={0} stroke="#9CA3AF" />
                <Bar dataKey="_left" name={leftKey} fill={leftColor} stackId="a" radius={[4, 0, 0, 4]} />
                <Bar dataKey="_right" name={rightKey} fill={rightColor} stackId="a" radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]} />
            </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';

export function RegionalMapWidget({ data, total }) {
    // data is already grouped by geo-region from the backend:
    // { 'Sumatera': { Estate: x, Mill: y, HO: z }, 'Kalimantan': ..., 'Jawa / HO': ..., 'Lainnya': ... }

    // Hardcode positions for the regions for the SVG overlay
    const regionPositions = {
        'Riau': { top: '28%', left: '16%' },
        'Kalbar': { top: '18%', left: '40%' },
        'Kaltim': { top: '40%', left: '64%' },
        'Kubar': { top: '40%', left: '64%' },
        'Corp': { top: '78%', left: '28%' },
        'Non': { top: '76%', left: '80%' },
    };

    const displayRegions = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim', 'Corp', 'Non'];

    const getRegionData = (name) => {
        const d = data?.[name] || { Estate: 0, Mill: 0, HO: 0 };
        const regionTotal = (d.Estate || 0) + (d.Mill || 0) + (d.HO || 0);
        const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((regionTotal / total) * 100) : 0;
        return { Estate: d.Estate || 0, Mill: d.Mill || 0, HO: d.HO || 0, total: regionTotal, pct };
    };

    return (
        <div className="relative w-full h-[420px] flex items-center justify-center bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            {/* SVG representation of Indonesia map for background */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none p-4">
                <img src="/indonesia-map.svg" alt="Peta Indonesia" className="w-[92%] h-auto opacity-15 grayscale object-contain" />
            </div>

            {displayRegions.map(region => {
                const stat = getRegionData(region);
                if (stat.total === 0) return null; // Don't show empty cards

                const pos = regionPositions[region] || { top: '50%', left: '50%' };
                
                return (
                    <div 
                        key={region} 
                        className="absolute bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xs shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-100 rounded-xl p-2.5 sm:p-3 flex gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 items-center z-10 hover:z-20 transition-all select-none"
                        style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)', minWidth: '150px' }}
                    >
                        <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-corporate-dark text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                            {stat.pct}%
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">

import { ScatterChart as RechartsScatter, Scatter, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Cell } from 'recharts';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

export function ScatterChart({ data, xKey = 'umur', yKey = 'masa_kerja', zKey = 'anomali', xLabel = 'X', yLabel = 'Y' }) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

    const CustomTooltip = ({ active, payload }) => {
        if (active && payload && payload.length) {
            const pointData = payload[0].payload;
            return (
                <div className="bg-white p-3 border border-gray-100 shadow-lg rounded-lg text-sm">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-1">
                        {xLabel}: {pointData[xKey]}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-gray-600">
                        {yLabel}: {pointData[yKey]}
                    </p>
                    {pointData.join_age && (
                        <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                            Umur Masuk: {pointData.join_age} tahun
                        </p>
                    )}
                    {pointData[zKey] === 'yes' && (
                        <p className="text-red-600 mt-1 font-bold text-xs">
                            ⚠️ Anomali (Usia masuk &lt; 18 atau &gt; 55)
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    };

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <RechartsScatter margin={{ top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 20, left: -20 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#E5E7EB" />
                <XAxis 
                    type="number" 
                    dataKey={xKey} 
                    name={xLabel} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false}
                    domain={['auto', 'auto']}
                />
                <YAxis 
                    type="number" 
                    dataKey={yKey} 
                    name={yLabel} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                />
                <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltip />} cursor={{ strokeDasharray: '3 3' }} />
                <Scatter name="Karyawan" data={data}>
                    {data.map((entry, index) => (
                        <Cell 
                            key={`cell-${index}`} 
                            fill={entry[zKey] === 'yes' ? '#EF4444' : '#60A5FA'} 
                            fillOpacity={entry[zKey] === 'yes' ? 1 : 0.6}
                        />
                    ))}
                </Scatter>
            </RechartsScatter>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { generationColors, defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

function CustomStackedBarTooltip({ active, payload, label }) {
    if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
    const row = payload[0]?.payload;
    const total = payload.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (Number(entry.value) || 0), 0);
    const topTitles = row?.top_titles ? Object.entries(row.top_titles) : [];

    return (
        <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] border border-gray-200 text-xs min-w-[230px] max-w-[300px] z-50">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 pb-2 mb-2.5">
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm tracking-tight">{label}</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200/50">
                    Total: {formatNumber(total)}
                </span>
            </div>

            {/* Breakdown per Generasi / Kategori */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 mb-2.5">
                {payload.filter(p => Number(p.value) > 0).map((entry) => (
                    <div key={entry.name} className="flex items-center justify-between text-gray-700 text-[11.5px]">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color || entry.fill }} />
                            <span className="font-medium">{entry.name}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formatNumber(entry.value)}</span>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* Komposisi Jabatan Jika Ada */}
            {topTitles.length > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 mb-1.5">
                        <span>Jabatan di Level Ini</span>
                        <span>({topTitles.length})</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                        {topTitles.slice(0, 5).map(([title, count]) => (
                            <div key={title} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-gray-600 gap-2">
                                <span className="truncate" title={title}>{title}</span>
                                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 shrink-0">{formatNumber(count)}</span>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                        {topTitles.length > 5 && (
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-medium italic pt-0.5">
                                + {topTitles.length - 5} jabatan lainnya...
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export function StackedBar({ data, keys = [], xAxisKey = 'name', colors, onClick }) {
    if (!data || data.length === 0 || keys.length === 0) return null;

    const getColor = (key, index) => {
        if (colors && colors[key]) return colors[key];
        if (generationColors[key]) return generationColors[key];
        return defaultPalette[index % defaultPalette.length];
    };

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="#E5E7EB" />
                <XAxis 
                    dataKey={xAxisKey} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 500 }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                    interval={0} 
                    angle={-35} 
                    textAnchor="end" 
                    height={60} 
                />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} tickFormatter={formatNumber} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
                <Tooltip 
                    content={<CustomStackedBarTooltip />}
                    cursor={!onClick ? { fill: '#F3F4F6' } : false}
                />
                <Legend iconType="circle" wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '12px' }} />
                {keys.map((key, index) => (
                    <Bar 
                        key={key} 
                        dataKey={key} 
                        stackId="a" 
                        fill={getColor(key, index)} 
                        onClick={(data) => onClick && onClick(key, data?.payload?.[xAxisKey] || data?.[xAxisKey] || data?.name)}
                        className={onClick ? "cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity outline-none" : ""}
                    />
                ))}
            </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

import { Treemap as RechartsTreemap, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

const CustomizedContent = (props) => {
    const { root, depth, x, y, width, height, index, payload, colors, rank, name } = props;
    
    // Only render for leaf nodes or if they are large enough
    if (depth < 1) return null;

    return (
        <g>
            <rect
                x={x}
                y={y}
                width={width}
                height={height}
                style={{
                    fill: defaultPalette[index % defaultPalette.length],
                    stroke: '#fff',
                    strokeWidth: 2 / (depth + 1e-10),
                    strokeOpacity: 1 / (depth + 1e-10),
                }}
            />
            {width > 50 && height > 30 ? (
                <text x={x + 8} y={y + 18} fill="#fff" fontSize={12} fontWeight="bold" className="truncate">
                    {name}
                </text>
            ) : null}
            {width > 50 && height > 45 ? (
                <text x={x + 8} y={y + 34} fill="#fff" fontSize={11} opacity={0.9}>
                    {formatNumber(props.value)}
                </text>
            ) : null}
        </g>
    );
};

        );

    return null;
};

File: resources/js/Components/EmployeeAvatar.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';

const SIZE_CLASSES = {
    xs: 'w-6 h-6 text-[10px]',
    sm: 'w-8 h-8 text-xs',
    md: 'w-10 h-10 text-sm',
    lg: 'w-14 h-14 text-base font-semibold',
    xl: 'w-20 h-20 text-2xl font-bold',
};

const COLOR_PALETTES = [
    'bg-amber-600 text-white',
    'bg-emerald-700 text-white',
    'bg-blue-700 text-white',
    'bg-indigo-700 text-white',
    'bg-teal-700 text-white',
    'bg-purple-700 text-white',
    'bg-rose-700 text-white',
    'bg-slate-700 text-white',
];

export function getInitials(name) {
    if (!name) return '?';
    const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (parts.length === 1) {
        return parts[0].substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    }
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
}

function getColorForName(name) {
    if (!name) return COLOR_PALETTES[0];
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
        hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
    }
    const index = Math.abs(hash) % COLOR_PALETTES.length;
    return COLOR_PALETTES[index];
}

export default function EmployeeAvatar({
    name = '',
    photoUrl = null,
    size = 'md',
    className = '',
    alt = '',
}) {
    const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);

    const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASSES[size] || SIZE_CLASSES.md;
    const colorClass = getColorForName(name);
    const initials = getInitials(name);

    const hasPhoto = Boolean(photoUrl) && !imgError;

    return (
        <div
            className={`relative shrink-0 rounded-full overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center font-sans tracking-wide ring-2 ring-white/80 shadow-sm transition-transform ${sizeClass} ${
                hasPhoto ? 'bg-gray-100' : colorClass
            } ${className}`}
        >
            {hasPhoto ? (
                <img
                    src={photoUrl}
                    alt={alt || name}
                    onError={() => setImgError(true)}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-full"
                />
            ) : (
                <span className="select-none leading-none">{initials}</span>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';

export function FilterBar({ availableFilters }) {
    const { filters } = usePage().props;
    const [localFilters, setLocalFilters] = useState(filters || {});

    const apply = () => {
        router.get(route(route().current()), localFilters, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
    };

    const reset = () => {
        setLocalFilters({});
        router.get(route(route().current()), {}, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded shadow mb-4 flex gap-4 flex-wrap items-end">
            <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">Region</label>
                <select 
                    className="border p-2 rounded text-sm w-40"
                    value={localFilters.region || ''}
                    onChange={e => setLocalFilters({...localFilters, region: e.target.value})}
                >
                    <option value="">Semua</option>
                    <option value="Sumatera">Sumatera</option>
                    <option value="Kalimantan">Kalimantan</option>
                    <option value="Riau">Riau</option>
                    <option value="Kalbar">Kalbar</option>
                    <option value="Kaltim">Kaltim</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            {/* Add more filters similarly: Group, Company, Location, Dept, Level, Emp Type, Gen, Gender */}
            <div>
                <button onClick={apply} className="bg-corporate-light text-white px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm font-bold mr-2">Terapkan</button>
                <button onClick={reset} className="bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm font-bold">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';

export function CompanyList({ companies, locations, totalLocations, selectedLocation, onSelectCompany }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

    const filtered = companies.filter(c => 
        c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || 
        c.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        c.region.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    );

    // Group by region
    const grouped = filtered.reduce((acc, c) => {
        const r = c.region || 'Lainnya';
        if (!acc[r]) acc[r] = [];
        acc[r].push(c);
        return acc;
    }, {});

    const totalHc = filtered.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.employee_count === '<5' ? 0 : parseInt(c.employee_count) || 0), 0);

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-white">
            <div className="p-4 border-b">
                <div className="relative mb-4">
                    <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400 w-5 h-5" />
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        placeholder="Cari perusahaan, lokasi, atau region..." 
                        className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none"
                        value={search}
                        onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    />
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{totalHc.toLocaleString()}</span> HC</div>
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{filtered.length}</span> Perusahaan</div>
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{totalLocations}</span> Lokasi</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-6">
                {Object.keys(grouped).sort().map(region => (
                    <div key={region}>
                        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500"></span>
                            {region}
                        </h3>
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                            {grouped[region].map(c => (
                                <button 
                                    key={c.id}
                                    onClick={() => onSelectCompany(c.id)}
                                    className="w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 hover:border-corporate-light hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
                                >
                                    <div className="font-bold text-corporate-dark">{c.code} - {c.name}</div>
                                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1 flex justify-between">
                                        <span>HC: {c.employee_count}</span>
                                        <span>{c.location_count} Lokasi</span>
                                    </div>
                                </button>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

        const locParam = location ? `&location_id=${location.id}` : '';
        axios.get(`/data/companies/${company.id}/employees?page=${page}&search=${search}${locParam}`)
            .then(res => {
                setEmployees(res.data);
                setLoading(false);
            });
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        loadData();
    }, [company.id, page, location]);

    useEffect(() => {
        setPage(1);
        const timer = setTimeout(loadData, 500);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [search]);

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full space-y-4">
            <div className="relative">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400 w-5 h-5" />
                <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="Cari nama, NIK, jabatan..." 
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                />
            </div>

            {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Memuat staf...</div>
            ) : employees?.data.length > 0 ? (
                <>
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
                        {employees.data.map(emp => (
                            <button 
                                key={emp.employee_id}
                                onClick={() => setSelectedEmp(emp.employee_id)}
                                className="w-full text-left p-3 border rounded-lg hover:border-corporate-light hover:bg-gray-50 flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors"
                            >
                                <EmployeeAvatar name={emp.name} photoUrl={emp.photo_url} size="md" />
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <div className="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">{emp.name}</div>
                                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 truncate">{emp.job_title_name}</div>
                                </div>
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-t">
                        <button 
                            disabled={page === 1}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded disabled:opacity-50"
                        >Prev</button>
                        <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Hal {employees.current_page} dari {employees.last_page}</span>
                        <button 
                            disabled={page === employees.last_page}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded disabled:opacity-50"
                        >Next</button>
                    </div>
                </>
            ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Tidak ada staf ditemukan.</div>
            )}

            {selectedEmp && (
                <StaffDetailModal 
                    employeeId={selectedEmp} 
                    onClose={() => setSelectedEmp(null)} 
                />
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { X, User } from 'lucide-react';
import StaffDetailPane from '@/Components/staff/StaffDetailPane';

export default function StaffDetailDrawer({ employeeId, onClose }) {
    // Handle Escape key
    useEffect(() => {
        const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                onClose();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }, [onClose]);

    // Prevent body scroll when drawer is open
    useEffect(() => {
        const originalStyle = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        return () => {
            document.body.style.overflow = originalStyle;
        };
    }, []);

    if (!employeeId || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

    return createPortal(
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[99998] flex justify-end">
            {/* Backdrop Overlay */}
            <div 
                className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/35 backdrop-blur-[2px] transition-opacity animate-in fade-in duration-200 cursor-pointer"
                onClick={onClose}
                aria-label="Tutup panel"
            />

            {/* Slide-over Drawer Panel */}
            <aside 
                className="relative z-[99999] w-full max-w-2xl lg:max-w-3xl h-full bg-[#F8FAF9] shadow-2xl flex flex-col border-l border-gray-200/90 transform transition-all animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300 ease-out"
                role="dialog"
                aria-modal="true"
                aria-label="Detail Profil Karyawan"
            >
                {/* Drawer Sticky Header */}
                <header className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-5 sm:px-6 py-3.5 border-b border-gray-200/80 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-20 shrink-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-emerald-100">
                            <User size={16} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 leading-tight truncate">
                                Profil Lengkap Karyawan
                            </h3>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                                Penempatan, demografi, dan riwayat pelatihan
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Close Button */}
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                        title="Tutup Panel (Esc)"
                    >
                        <X size={14} />
                        <span>Tutup</span>
                        <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-500 bg-white rounded border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                            Esc
                        </kbd>
                    </button>
                </header>

                {/* Drawer Scrollable Content */}
                <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-4">
                    <StaffDetailPane employeeId={employeeId} />
                </div>
            </aside>
        </div>,
        document.body
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import EmployeeAvatar from '@/Components/EmployeeAvatar';
import { 
    X, 
    Upload, 
    Trash2, 
    Camera, 
    Briefcase, 
    Calendar, 
    Clock, 
    User, 
    GraduationCap, 
    AlertCircle,
    Building2,
    MapPin
} from 'lucide-react';

export function StaffDetailModal({ employeeId, onClose }) {
    const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
    const [uploadMsg, setUploadMsg] = useState(null);
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        axios.get(`/data/employees/${employeeId}`)
            .then(res => {
                setDetail(res.data);
                setLoading(false);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal memuat data');
                setLoading(false);
            });
    }, [employeeId]);

    // Handle escape key
    useEffect(() => {
        const handleEsc = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    }, [onClose]);

    const handlePhotoSelect = (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('photo', file);

        setUploading(true);
        setUploadMsg(null);

        axios.post(`/karyawan/${employeeId}/photo`, formData, {
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }
        })
        .then(res => {
            setDetail(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                identitas: {
                    ...prev.identitas,
                    photo_url: res.data.photo_url
                }
            }));
            setUploadMsg({ type: 'success', text: 'Foto profil berhasil diperbarui!' });
        })
        .catch(err => {
            setUploadMsg({ type: 'error', text: err.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal mengunggah foto.' });
        })
        .finally(() => {
            setUploading(false);
            if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
        });
    };

    const handleDeletePhoto = () => {
        if (!window.confirm('Hapus foto profil karyawan ini?')) return;

        setUploading(true);
        axios.delete(`/karyawan/${employeeId}/photo`)
            .then(res => {
                setDetail(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    identitas: {
                        ...prev.identitas,
                        photo_url: null
                    }
                }));
                setUploadMsg({ type: 'success', text: 'Foto profil berhasil dihapus.' });
            })
            .catch(err => {
                setUploadMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Gagal menghapus foto.' });
            })
            .finally(() => {
                setUploading(false);
            });
    };

    return createPortal(
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm z-[99999] flex justify-center items-center p-3 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div 
                className="bg-[#FAFCFA] rounded-3xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-emerald-100/70 relative"
                onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
                {/* Header Modal Minimalis */}
                <div className="px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 sm:py-4 bg-white border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 min-w-0">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] shrink-0">
                            <User size={18} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight truncate">Detail Profil Karyawan</h2>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 hidden sm:block">Informasi komprehensif kepegawaian dan riwayat pelatihan</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                        onClick={onClose} 
                        className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded-full transition-colors shrink-0"
                        title="Tutup (Esc)"
                    >
                        <X size={18} />
                    </button>
                </div>
                
                {/* Modal Body */}
                <div className="p-4 sm:p-7 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-gray-400">
                            <div className="w-9 h-9 border-3 border-emerald-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-3"></div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Memuat profil karyawan...</p>
                        </div>
                    ) : error ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-rose-500">
                            <AlertCircle size={36} className="mb-2 opacity-80" />
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{error}</p>
                            <button 
                                onClick={onClose} 
                                className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 rounded-xl transition-colors"
                            >
                                Tutup
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    ) : detail && (
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
                            {/* ==================== KOLOM KIRI ==================== */}
                            <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-5">
                                {/* Card 1: Avatar, Identitas Utama & Upload */}
                                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-emerald-50/80 shadow-[0_2px_14px_rgba(6,78,59,0.04)] flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                                    {/* Avatar Foto Profil */}
                                    <div className="relative group shrink-0 mb-3.5">
                                        <EmployeeAvatar 
                                            name={detail.identitas.name} 
                                            photoUrl={detail.identitas.photo_url} 
                                            size="xl" 
                                            className="!w-24 !h-24 sm:!w-28 sm:!h-28 !text-2xl ring-4 ring-emerald-500/10 shadow-md transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105"
                                        />
                                        <button 
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                                            disabled={uploading}
                                            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all text-white text-[11px] font-medium backdrop-blur-[2px]"
                                            title="Ubah Foto Profil"
                                        >
                                            <Camera size={20} className="mb-0.5" />
                                            <span>Ubah</span>
                                        </button>
                                        <input 
                                            type="file" 
                                            ref={fileInputRef} 
                                            accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" 
                                            className="hidden" 
                                            onChange={handlePhotoSelect} 
                                        />
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Nama & NIK */}
                                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 leading-snug">{detail.identitas.name}</h3>
                                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 mt-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-xs font-mono font-semibold">
                                        <span className="text-gray-400">NIK:</span>
                                        <span>{detail.identitas.employee_id}</span>
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Jabatan */}
                                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-2 font-medium px-2">{detail.identitas.job}</p>

                                    {/* Badges Level, Tipe, Generasi */}
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-1.5 mt-3">
                                        {detail.identitas.level && (
                                            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-100">
                                                Level {detail.identitas.level}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {detail.kepegawaian.employment_type && (

                                                {detail.kepegawaian.employment_type}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {detail.kepegawaian.generation && (
                                            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-100">

                                            </span>

                                        >

                                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                            <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40]">
                                                <Briefcase size={16} />
                                            </div>
                                            <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">Status Kepegawaian & Masa Kerja</h4>
                                        </div>
                                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold self-start sm:self-auto ${
                                            detail.kepegawaian.retire_risk
                                                ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200'
                                                : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200'
                                        }`}>
                                            <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${detail.kepegawaian.retire_risk ? 'bg-rose-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'}`}></span>
                                            {detail.kepegawaian.retire_risk ? 'Mendekati / Batas Pensiun (55+ Th)' : 'Masa Aktif Produktif'}

                                        {detail.pelatihan?.length > 0 && (
                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
                                                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
                                                    {detail.pelatihan.length} Pelatihan
                                                </span>
                                                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200">
                                                    {detail.pelatihan_total_jam} Jam Total
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                        )}
                                    </div>

                                    {detail.pelatihan?.length > 0 ? (
                                        <div className="overflow-hidden border border-gray-100 rounded-xl">
                                            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                                <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                                                    <thead className="bg-gray-50/80 text-gray-500 font-semibold border-b border-gray-100">
                                                        <tr>
                                                            <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Periode</th>
                                                            <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Nama Pelatihan</th>
                                                            <th className="py-2.5 px-3 hidden sm:table-cell">Instruktur / Provider</th>
                                                            <th className="py-2.5 px-3 hidden md:table-cell">Jenis</th>
                                                            <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Jam</th>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    </thead>
                                                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-50">
                                                        {detail.pelatihan.map((p, i) => (
                                                            <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-emerald-50/20 transition-colors">
                                                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-500 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">{p.month_year}</td>
                                                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-gray-800">{p.name}</td>
                                                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-600 hidden sm:table-cell">{p.provider || '—'}</td>
                                                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-500 hidden md:table-cell">
                                                                    {p.regularity ? (
                                                                        <span className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium ${
                                                                            p.regularity === 'Reguler' ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
                                                                        }`}>
                                                                            {p.regularity}
                                                                        </span>
                                                                    ) : '—'}
                                                                </td>
                                                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[#004D40]">{p.hours}</td>
                                                            </tr>
                                                        ))}
                                                    </tbody>
                                                    <tfoot className="bg-gray-50/60 border-t border-gray-100 font-semibold text-gray-800">
                                                        <tr>
                                                            <td colSpan={4} className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right text-gray-500">Total Akumulasi:</td>
                                                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[#004D40]">{detail.pelatihan_total_jam} jam</td>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    </tfoot>
                                                </table>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    ) : (
                                        <div className="py-12 px-4 rounded-xl bg-gray-50/60 border border-dashed border-gray-200 text-center">
                                            <GraduationCap size={32} className="mx-auto text-gray-300 mb-2" />
                                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600">Belum Ada Riwayat Pelatihan</p>
                                            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Tidak ditemukan data pelatihan yang tertaut dengan NIK {detail.identitas.employee_id}.</p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
    );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import EmployeeAvatar from '@/Components/EmployeeAvatar';
import { 
    Briefcase, Calendar, Clock, User, GraduationCap, Award, 
    Building2, MapPin, Printer, Camera, Trash2, AlertCircle, 
    CheckCircle2, Sparkles, Shield, ChevronRight, FileSpreadsheet,
    Activity, BookOpen, Layers
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function StaffDetailPane({ employeeId }) {
    const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
    const [uploadMsg, setUploadMsg] = useState(null);
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!employeeId) return;

        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        setUploadMsg(null);

        axios.get(`/data/employees/${employeeId}`)
            .then(res => {
                setDetail(res.data);
                setLoading(false);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal memuat detail karyawan.');
                setLoading(false);
            });
    }, [employeeId]);

    const handlePhotoSelect = (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('photo', file);

        setUploading(true);
        setUploadMsg(null);

        axios.post(`/karyawan/${employeeId}/photo`, formData, {
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }
        })
        .then(res => {
            setDetail(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                identitas: {
                    ...prev.identitas,
                    photo_url: res.data.photo_url
                }
            }));
            setUploadMsg({ type: 'success', text: 'Foto profil berhasil diperbarui!' });
        })
        .catch(err => {
            setUploadMsg({ type: 'error', text: err.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal mengunggah foto.' });
        })
        .finally(() => {
            setUploading(false);
            if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
        });
    };

    const handleDeletePhoto = () => {
        if (!window.confirm('Hapus foto profil karyawan ini?')) return;

        setUploading(true);
        axios.delete(`/karyawan/${employeeId}/photo`)
            .then(() => {
                setDetail(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    identitas: {
                        ...prev.identitas,
                        photo_url: null
                    }
                }));
                setUploadMsg({ type: 'success', text: 'Foto profil berhasil dihapus.' });
            })
            .catch(() => {
                setUploadMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Gagal menghapus foto profil.' });
            })
            .finally(() => {
                setUploading(false);
            });
    };

    const handlePrint = () => {
        window.print();
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="space-y-4 animate-pulse">
                {/* Skeleton Card 1: Identity */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-full bg-slate-200 shrink-0" />
                        <div className="space-y-2.5 flex-1">
                            <div className="h-6 w-52 bg-slate-200 rounded-md" />
                            <div className="h-4 w-36 bg-slate-200 rounded-md" />
                            <div className="h-4 w-60 bg-slate-100 rounded-md" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => (
                            <div key={i} className="h-14 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg" />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Skeleton Card 2 & 3: Org & Personal */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 space-y-3">
                        <div className="h-5 w-40 bg-slate-200 rounded-md mb-2" />
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map(i => (
                            <div key={i} className="h-4 bg-slate-100 rounded-md" />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 space-y-3">
                        <div className="h-5 w-40 bg-slate-200 rounded-md mb-2" />
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map(i => (
                            <div key={i} className="h-4 bg-slate-100 rounded-md" />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Skeleton Card 4: Pelatihan */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 space-y-4">
                    <div className="h-5 w-48 bg-slate-200 rounded-md" />
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                        {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
                            <div key={i} className="h-16 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg" />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-28 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg border border-slate-100" />
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (error || !detail) {
        return (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-10 text-center space-y-3">
                <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                    <AlertCircle size={22} />
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900">Gagal Memuat Data</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">{error || 'Data karyawan tidak ditemukan.'}</p>
            </div>
        );
    }

    const { identitas, pribadi, kepegawaian, pelatihan = [], pelatihan_total_jam = 0 } = detail;

    return (
        <div className="space-y-4 print:p-0">
            {/* ALERT NOTIFICATION TOAST */}
            {uploadMsg && (
                <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200 ${
                    uploadMsg.type === 'success' 
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 border border-emerald-200' 
                        : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-900 border border-rose-200'
                }`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {uploadMsg.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 size={15} className="text-emerald-600" /> : <AlertCircle size={15} className="text-rose-600" />}
                        <span>{uploadMsg.text}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => setUploadMsg(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700">✕</button>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* CARD 1: IDENTITY & QUICK STATS */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 sm:p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
                <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-start lg:items-center justify-between gap-5">
                    {/* Left: Avatar + Identity */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center sm:items-start gap-4 text-center sm:text-left">
                        {/* Avatar with Camera Button */}
                        <div className="relative group shrink-0">
                            {identitas.photo_url ? (
                                <img 
                                    src={identitas.photo_url} 
                                    alt={identitas.name} 
                                    className="w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 ring-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 shadow-2xs transition-transform group-hover:scale-102"
                                />
                            ) : (
                                <div className="w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#004D40] to-emerald-800 text-white font-black text-2xl sm:text-3xl flex items-center justify-center ring-2 ring-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 shadow-2xs">
                                    {identitas.name?.charAt(0) || 'K'}
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Camera overlay for upload */}
                            <label 
                                htmlFor="staff-photo-input"
                                className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 p-1.5 bg-[#004D40] hover:bg-[#00382e] text-white rounded-full shadow-xs border-2 border-white cursor-pointer transition-transform hover:scale-110"
                                title="Unggah / Ganti Foto"
                            >
                                <Camera size={13} />
                            </label>
                            <input 
                                type="file" 
                                id="staff-photo-input" 
                                ref={fileInputRef}
                                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/jpg,image/webp" 
                                onChange={handlePhotoSelect} 
                                className="hidden" 
                                disabled={uploading}
                            />
                        </div>

                        {/* Name & Role */}
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight leading-tight">
                                    {identitas.name}
                                </h2>
                                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-200/70">
                                    {identitas.employee_id}
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mt-1 flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-1.5">
                                <Briefcase size={14} className="text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                                <span>{identitas.job}</span>
                            </p>

                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-1.5">
                                <MapPin size={12} className="text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                                <span>{identitas.location} · {identitas.company}</span>
                            </p>

                            {/* Delete photo text if photo exists */}
                            {identitas.photo_url && (
                                <button
                                    onClick={handleDeletePhoto}
                                    disabled={uploading}
                                    className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 font-semibold mt-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                                >

                                    <span>Hapus foto</span>
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Action Buttons */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center sm:justify-end print:hidden">
                        <button
                            onClick={handlePrint}

                            <Printer size={13} />
                            <span>Cetak Profil (A4)</span>
                        </button>

                </div>

                {/* 4 Quick Info Badges */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
                    <div className="bg-slate-50/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/70">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Level / Golongan</span>
                        <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5 truncate">{identitas.level || '-'}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-slate-50/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/70">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Lokasi & Kebun</span>

                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-right">
                                {pribadi.age || '-'} Tahun · <span className="text-emerald-700">{kepegawaian.generation || '-'}</span>

                                {pribadi.birth_place ? `${pribadi.birth_place}, ` : ''}{pribadi.birth_date || '-'}

                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-right">{pribadi.ptkp || '-'}</span>

            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] border border-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <GraduationCap size={15} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <h3 className="font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                                Riwayat &amp; Akumulasi Pelatihan
                            </h3>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                Rekapitulasi jam belajar dan program pelatihan yang pernah diikuti staf
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
                        <Sparkles size={12} />
                        <span>{pelatihan.length > 0 ? `${pelatihan_total_jam} Jam Belajar Tercatat` : 'Belum Ada Jam Pelatihan'}</span>
                    </span>
                </div>

                {/* Metric Summary Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 bg-slate-50/80 p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80">
                    {/* Total Jam Pelatihan */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <Clock size={18} />

                        <div>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Total Jam Pelatihan</span>
                            <p className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                                {Number(pelatihan_total_jam).toFixed(1)} <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Jam</span>
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Program Diikuti */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <BookOpen size={18} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Program Diikuti</span>
                            <p className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                                {pelatihan.length} <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Pelatihan</span>
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Rata-rata Durasi */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <Activity size={18} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Rata-rata Durasi</span>
                            <p className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                                {pelatihan.length > 0 ? (pelatihan_total_jam / pelatihan.length).toFixed(1) : '0.0'} <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Jam/Pelatihan</span>
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Table of Completed Trainings */}
                <div>
                    <h4 className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                        Riwayat Program Pelatihan yang Pernah Diikuti
                    </h4>
                    
                    {pelatihan.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-2xs">
                            <table className="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse">
                                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 font-bold uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-gray-200">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th className="px-3.5 py-2">Nama Program Pelatihan</th>
                                        <th className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center">Periode</th>
                                        <th className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center">Durasi</th>
                                        <th className="px-3.5 py-2">Penyelenggara / Instruktur</th>
                                        <th className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center">Kategori</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                                    {pelatihan.map((p, idx) => (
                                        <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                                            <td className="px-3.5 py-2 font-bold text-slate-900">{p.name}</td>
                                            <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center font-mono text-slate-600">{p.month_year || '-'}</td>
                                            <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center font-bold text-emerald-800">{p.hours} Jam</td>
                                            <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-slate-600">{p.provider || '-'}</td>
                                            <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-center">
                                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded font-semibold text-[10px]">
                                                    {p.regularity || 'Reguler'}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    ))}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="bg-slate-50/70 rounded-lg p-5 text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200 text-slate-500">
                            <GraduationCap size={24} className="mx-auto text-slate-400 mb-1.5 opacity-60" />
                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Belum Ada Riwayat Pelatihan</p>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Karyawan ini belum memiliki catatan jam pelatihan di database pelatihan.</p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
