import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { 
    X, 
    Calendar, 
    Users, 
    Clock, 
    TrendingUp, 
    MapPin, 
    Search, 
    ChevronLeft, 
    ChevronRight, 
    Eye, 
    ExternalLink, 
    Briefcase,
    Building2,
    Shield,
    Sparkles,
    UserCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import EmployeeAvatar from '@/Components/EmployeeAvatar';

export function CohortDetailModal({ cohort, isPeak, onClose, onSelectEmployee }) {
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('distribution'); // 'distribution' | 'employees'
    const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    const [selectedLevel, setSelectedLevel] = useState('ALL');
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
    const [totalResults, setTotalResults] = useState(0);

    const searchTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

    // Close on Escape key and lock body scroll
    useEffect(() => {
        const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
        const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
            document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
        };
    }, [onClose]);

    // Fetch employee list when tab is active or search/filters change
    useEffect(() => {
        if (activeTab !== 'employees') return;

        setLoading(true);
        if (searchTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimeoutRef.current);

        searchTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams();
            if (searchTerm.trim()) params.append('search', searchTerm.trim());
            if (selectedLevel !== 'ALL') params.append('level', selectedLevel);
            params.append('page', String(page));

            fetch(`/data/cohort/${cohort.year}/employees?${params.toString()}`)
                .then((res) => {
                    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Gagal mengambil data personil');
                    return res.json();
                })
                .then((data) => {
                    setEmployees(data.data || []);
                    setTotalPages(data.last_page || 1);
                    setTotalResults(data.total || 0);
                    setLoading(false);
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                    console.error('Error fetching cohort employees:', err);
                    setEmployees([]);
                    setLoading(false);
                });
        }, 250);

        return () => {
            if (searchTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimeoutRef.current);
        };
    }, [activeTab, cohort.year, searchTerm, selectedLevel, page]);

    if (!cohort) return null;

    const totalHC = cohort.total || 1;

    // Helper for visual bars
    const renderProgressBar = (label, count, total, colorClass = 'bg-[#004D40]') => {
        const pct = Math.round((count / total) * 100);
        return (
            <div key={label} className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{label}</span>
                    <span className="text-gray-500 font-medium">
                        <strong className="text-gray-900">{formatNumber(count)}</strong> org ({pct}%)
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                    <div 
                        className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${colorClass}`} 
                        style={{ width: `${Math.max(pct, 2)}%` }} 
                    />
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    };

    return createPortal(
        <div 
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-[9990] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
            onClick={onClose}
        >
            <div 
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 relative"
                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
                {/* Header Modal */}
                <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 bg-white border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] border border-emerald-100/60 shrink-0">
                            <Calendar className="w-6 h-6" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
                                    Detail Angkatan Rekrutmen {cohort.year}
                                </h2>
                                {isPeak && (
                                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/70 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                        <TrendingUp size={11} /> Angkatan Terbanyak
                                    </span>
                                )}
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/70">
                                    Dominan: {cohort.dominant_type}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                                Analisis komprehensif personil bergabung pada tahun {cohort.year} ({formatNumber(cohort.total)} total personil aktif).
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                        title="Tutup (Esc)"
                    >
                        <X size={20} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* KPI Summary Cards */}
                <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 pt-4 pb-2 bg-slate-50/60 border-b border-gray-100 shrink-0">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">Total Personil</span>
                            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                                <span className="text-xl font-black text-gray-900">{formatNumber(cohort.total)}</span>
                                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">orang</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">Rata-rata Masa Kerja</span>
                            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                                <span className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-700">{cohort.avg_tenure || '-'}</span>
                                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">tahun</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">Rata-rata Usia Masuk</span>
                            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                                <span className="text-xl font-black text-teal-700">{cohort.avg_join_age || '-'}</span>
                                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">tahun</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">Status Kepegawaian</span>
                            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 truncate" title={cohort.dominant_type}>
                                {cohort.dominant_type || 'PERMANENT'}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Navigation Tabs */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-4">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setActiveTab('distribution')}
                            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                activeTab === 'distribution'
                                    ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-xs'
                                    : 'bg-white text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200/70'
                            }`}
                        >
                            Komposisi &amp; Distribusi
                        </button>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setActiveTab('employees')}
                            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                                activeTab === 'employees'
                                    ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-xs'
                                    : 'bg-white text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200/70'
                            }`}
                        >
                            <Users size={13} />
                            <span>Daftar Personil ({formatNumber(cohort.total)})</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Modal Body */}
                <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1" style={{ scrollbarWidth: 'thin' }}>
                    {activeTab === 'distribution' ? (
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
                            {/* Card 1: Job Level Composition */}
                            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/70 shadow-2xs space-y-3.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
                                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <Briefcase size={14} className="text-emerald-600" />
                                        Distribusi Job Level
                                    </h4>
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">
                                        {Object.keys(cohort.levels || {}).length} Jenjang
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    {Object.entries(cohort.levels || {}).map(([lvl, count]) => (
                                        renderProgressBar(`Level ${lvl}`, count, totalHC, 'bg-emerald-600')
                                    ))}
                                    {(!cohort.levels || Object.keys(cohort.levels).length === 0) && (
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic">Data job level tidak tersedia.</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Card 2: Region Distribution */}
                            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/70 shadow-2xs space-y-3.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
                                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <MapPin size={14} className="text-teal-600" />
                                        Sebaran Penempatan Wilayah
                                    </h4>
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">
                                        {Object.keys(cohort.regions || {}).length} Region
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    {Object.entries(cohort.regions || {}).map(([reg, count]) => (
                                        renderProgressBar(reg, count, totalHC, 'bg-[#004D40]')
                                    ))}
                                    {(!cohort.regions || Object.keys(cohort.regions).length === 0) && (
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic">Data region tidak tersedia.</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Card 3: Employment Types */}
                            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/70 shadow-2xs space-y-3.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
                                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <Shield size={14} className="text-blue-600" />
                                        Status Kepegawaian
                                    </h4>
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">
                                        {Object.keys(cohort.types || {}).length} Status
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    {Object.entries(cohort.types || {}).map(([type, count]) => (
                                        renderProgressBar(type, count, totalHC, 'bg-blue-600')
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Card 4: Gender Breakdown */}
                            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/70 shadow-2xs space-y-3.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
                                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <Users size={14} className="text-purple-600" />
                                        Komposisi Gender
                                    </h4>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    {Object.entries(cohort.genders || {}).map(([gen, count]) => {
                                        const isFemale = gen === 'Female' || gen === 'Perempuan' || gen === 'Wanita' || gen === 'P';
                                        const isMale = gen === 'Male' || gen === 'Laki-laki' || gen === 'Pria' || gen === 'L';
                                        const label = isFemale ? 'Perempuan' : (isMale ? 'Laki-laki' : gen);
                                        const color = isFemale ? 'bg-pink-500' : (isMale ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-purple-600');
                                        return renderProgressBar(label, count, totalHC, color);
                                    })}
                                    {(!cohort.genders || Object.keys(cohort.genders).length === 0) && (
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic">Data gender tidak tersedia.</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        /* Tab 2: Employee List Table */
                        <div className="space-y-4">
                            {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
                            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                <div className="relative flex-1">
                                    <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                                    <input
                                        type="text"
                                        placeholder="Cari berdasarkan nama, NIK, atau jabatan..."
                                        value={searchTerm}
                                        onChange={(e) => {
                                            setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
                                            setPage(1);
                                        }}
                                        className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500 bg-white"
                                    />
                                </div>

                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <select
                                        value={selectedLevel}
                                        onChange={(e) => {
                                            setSelectedLevel(e.target.value);
                                            setPage(1);
                                        }}
                                        className="text-xs border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 bg-white text-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500"
                                    >
                                        <option value="ALL">Semua Level</option>
                                        {Object.keys(cohort.levels || {}).map((lvl) => (
                                            <option key={lvl} value={lvl}>Level {lvl}</option>
                                        ))}
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Table Container */}
                            <div className="border border-gray-200/80 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-2xs">
                                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                    <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                                        <thead className="bg-slate-50/80 text-gray-600 font-semibold border-b border-gray-200/70">
                                            <tr>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3">Personil</th>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3">Jabatan &amp; Level</th>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3">Perusahaan &amp; Region</th>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3">Tgl Masuk</th>
                                                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Aksi</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-gray-700">
                                            {loading ? (
                                                <tr>
                                                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-gray-400">
                                                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                                                            <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-emerald-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                                                            <span>Memuat daftar personil angkatan {cohort.year}...</span>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </td>
                                                </tr>
                                            ) : employees.length === 0 ? (
                                                <tr>
                                                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-gray-500">
                                                        Tidak ada personil yang sesuai dengan kriteria pencarian.
                                                    </td>
                                                </tr>
                                            ) : (
                                                employees.map((emp) => (
                                                    <tr 
                                                        key={emp.id}
                                                        onClick={() => onSelectEmployee(emp.employee_id)}
                                                        className="hover:bg-emerald-50/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                                                    >
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                                                <EmployeeAvatar
                                                                    name={emp.name}
                                                                    photoUrl={emp.photo_url}
                                                                    size="sm"
                                                                />
                                                                <div className="min-w-0">
                                                                    <div className="font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-emerald-800 transition-colors truncate">
                                                                        {emp.name}
                                                                    </div>
                                                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                                                                        NIK: {emp.employee_id}
                                                                    </div>
                                                                </div>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                            <div className="font-medium text-gray-800 truncate max-w-[200px]" title={emp.job_title_name}>
                                                                {emp.job_title_name || '-'}
                                                            </div>
                                                            <span className="inline-block mt-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700">
                                                                Level {emp.job_level_code || '-'}
                                                            </span>
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                            <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">
                                                                {emp.company_code} - {emp.region}
                                                            </div>
                                                            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate max-w-[150px]">
                                                                {emp.department || '-'}
                                                            </div>
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                            <span className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                                                                emp.employment_type === 'PERMANENT'
                                                                    ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200/60'
                                                                    : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/60'
                                                            }`}>
                                                                {emp.employment_type || '-'}
                                                            </span>
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600 font-medium">
                                                            {emp.join_date}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                                            <button
                                                                type="button"
                                                                onClick={(e) => {
                                                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                                                    onSelectEmployee(emp.employee_id);
                                                                }}
                                                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 transition-colors"
                                                            >
                                                                <Eye size={12} />
                                                                <span>Profil</span>
                                                            </button>
                                                        </td>
                                                    </tr>
                                                ))
                                            )}
                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>

                                {/* Pagination Controls */}
                                {totalPages > 1 && (
                                    <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50/70 border-t border-gray-200/70 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-600">
                                        <span>
                                            Menampilkan <strong>{employees.length}</strong> dari <strong>{totalResults}</strong> personil
                                        </span>
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                            <button
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(p - 1, 1))}
                                                disabled={page <= 1}
                                                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white border border-transparent hover:border-gray-200 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent cursor-pointer"
                                            >
                                                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                                            </button>
                                            <span className="px-2 font-semibold text-gray-800">
                                                {page} / {totalPages}
                                            </span>
                                            <button
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(p + 1, totalPages))}
                                                disabled={page >= totalPages}
                                                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white border border-transparent hover:border-gray-200 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent cursor-pointer"
                                            >
                                                <ChevronRight size={16} />
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {/* Footer Modal */}
                <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 py-3.5 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
                    <a
                        href={`/karyawan?search=${encodeURIComponent(cohort.year)}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 hover:underline"
                    >
                        <span>Buka Direktori Karyawan</span>
                        <ExternalLink size={12} />
                    </a>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        className="px-4 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 font-semibold text-xs rounded-xl border border-gray-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                        Tutup
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
    );
}

function extractTextFromReactNode(node) {
    if (!node) return '';
    if (typeof node === 'string') return node;
    if (typeof node === 'number') return String(node);
    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(extractTextFromReactNode).join(' ').trim();
    if (node?.props?.children) return extractTextFromReactNode(node.props.children);
    return '';
}

function resolveChartDescription(title, explicitDesc) {
    if (explicitDesc) return explicitDesc;
    if (!title) return null;

    const titleStr = typeof title === 'string' ? title : extractTextFromReactNode(title);
    if (!titleStr) return null;

    if (DEFAULT_CHART_DESCRIPTIONS[titleStr]) {
        return DEFAULT_CHART_DESCRIPTIONS[titleStr];
    }

    const lower = titleStr.toLowerCase();
    for (const [key, desc] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_CHART_DESCRIPTIONS)) {
        if (lower === key.toLowerCase() || lower.includes(key.toLowerCase()) || key.toLowerCase().includes(lower)) {
            return desc;
        }
    }

    if (lower.includes('generasi')) {
        return 'Visualisasi sebaran komposisi generasi karyawan (Gen Z, Milenial, Gen X, Baby Boomer).';
    }
    if (lower.includes('pensiun')) {
        return 'Visualisasi data proyeksi dan risiko masa pensiun karyawan (usia >= 55 tahun).';
    }
    if (lower.includes('pelatihan') || lower.includes('training')) {
        return 'Visualisasi data keikutsertaan dan jam pelatihan karyawan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('masa kerja') || lower.includes('los')) {
        return 'Visualisasi distribusi masa kerja karyawan (Length of Service).';
    }
    if (lower.includes('rekrutmen') || lower.includes('hire')) {
        return 'Visualisasi tren penerimaan dan gelombang rekrutmen karyawan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('umur') || lower.includes('usia')) {
        return 'Visualisasi demografi kelompok umur karyawan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('gender') || lower.includes('jenis kelamin')) {
        return 'Visualisasi perbandingan keterwakilan gender karyawan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('level jabatan') || lower.includes('jenjang')) {
        return 'Visualisasi sebaran tingkatan struktur jenjang jabatan karyawan.';
    }

    return null;
}

export function ChartCard({ title, action, description, loading, isEmpty, children, className = '', height = "h-72" }) {
    const titleStr = typeof title === 'string' ? title : (extractTextFromReactNode(title) || 'chart');
    const { ref: cardRef, isCopying, status, handleCopy } = useCopyAsImage({ title: titleStr });
    const resolvedDesc = resolveChartDescription(title, description);

    return (
        <div ref={cardRef} className={`bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col relative hover:z-40 focus-within:z-40 ${className}`}>
            <CopyButton handleCopy={handleCopy} status={status} isCopying={isCopying} loading={loading} />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 mb-4 pr-12 border-b border-gray-100/60 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-sm sm:text-base leading-snug">{title}</h3>
                    {resolvedDesc && <InfoTooltip title={titleStr} text={resolvedDesc} />}
                </div>
                {action && <div className="shrink-0">{action}</div>}
            </div>

            <div className={`relative w-full min-h-[18rem] ${height}`}>
                {loading ? (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 p-4">
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-1/3" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-2/3" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-1/2" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-full" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-3/4" />
                    </div>
                ) : isEmpty ? (
                    <EmptyState />
                ) : (
                    children
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import { Check, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export function CopyButton({ handleCopy, status, isCopying, loading }) {
    return (
        <div className="hide-from-export absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
            {status === 'copied' && <span className="text-xs font-medium text-green-700 bg-green-50 border border-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded shadow-sm">Disalin ke clipboard!</span>}
            {status === 'downloaded' && <span className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded shadow-sm max-w-48 text-right leading-tight">Browser tidak mendukung salin gambar, file diunduh sebagai gantinya.</span>}
            
            <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                disabled={loading || isCopying}
                title={loading ? 'Memuat...' : 'Salin sebagai Gambar'}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors ${loading ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed text-gray-300' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
            >
                {status === 'copied' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" /> : <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useFilters } from '@/hooks/useFilters';
import { MultiSelect } from './MultiSelect';
import { Skeleton } from './Skeleton';
import { RotateCcw, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Filter } from 'lucide-react';

export default function FilterBar({ isTrainingPage = false }) {
    const { filters, options, loading, updateFilter, resetFilters, getActiveCount } = useFilters(isTrainingPage);
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 mb-6">
                <div className="flex gap-4">
                    {[1,2,3,4].map(i => <Skeleton key={i} className="w-32 h-10" />)}
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (!options) return null;

    const activeCount = getActiveCount();

    // Determine location options based on selected companies
    let locationOptions = options.locations;
    if (filters.company_id.length > 0) {
        locationOptions = options.locations.filter(loc => 
            loc.companies.some(cid => filters.company_id.includes(String(cid)))
        );
    }

    // Determine region options based on page
    const regionOptions = isTrainingPage ? options.trainingRegions : options.regions;

    // Map job levels to labels
    const jobLevelOptions = options.jobLevels.map(code => ({
        id: code,
        name: `Level ${code}`
    }));

    return (
        <div className={`bg-white rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 mb-6 relative ${isOpen ? 'z-50' : 'z-20'}`}>
            {/* Chips area and Toggle Button */}
            <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-100/60 bg-gray-50/30 rounded-t-xl">
                <div className="flex-1 flex gap-2 flex-wrap items-center">
                    {activeCount > 0 ? (
                        <>
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium mr-1 flex items-center gap-1.5"><Filter size={12}/> Filter aktif:</span>
                            {filters.region.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`region-${v}`} label={`Region: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('region', filters.region.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.company_id.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`comp-${v}`} label={`PT: ${options.companies.find(c => String(c.id) === v)?.code || v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('company_id', filters.company_id.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.location_id.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`loc-${v}`} label={`Lokasi: ${options.locations.find(l => String(l.id) === v)?.name || v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('location_id', filters.location_id.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.organization_name.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`dept-${v}`} label={`Dept: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('organization_name', filters.organization_name.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.job_level_code.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`lvl-${v}`} label={`Level: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('job_level_code', filters.job_level_code.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.group.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`grp-${v}`} label={`Group: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('group', filters.group.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.employment_type.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`emp-${v}`} label={`Status: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('employment_type', filters.employment_type.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.generation?.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`gen-${v}`} label={`Gen: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('generation', filters.generation.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.gender?.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`gndr-${v}`} label={`Gender: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('gender', filters.gender.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.year && <Chip label={`Tahun: ${filters.year}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('year', '')} />}
                            {filters.month && <Chip label={`Bulan: ${filters.month}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('month', '')} />}
                            {filters.nik_status && <Chip label={`NIK: ${filters.nik_status}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('nik_status', '')} />}
                            {filters.job_category?.map(v => (
                                <Chip key={`cat-${v}`} label={`Gol: ${v}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('job_category', filters.job_category.filter(x => x !== v))} />
                            ))}
                            {filters.is_regular !== '' && <Chip label={`Tipe: ${filters.is_regular === '1' ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler'}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('is_regular', '')} />}
                            {filters.is_internal !== '' && <Chip label={`Asal: ${filters.is_internal === '1' ? 'Internal' : 'Eksternal'}`} onRemove={() => updateFilter('is_internal', '')} />}
                            
                            <button 
                                onClick={resetFilters}
                                className="text-xs text-corporate-light font-medium flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-corporate-dark transition-colors ml-1"
                            >
                                <RotateCcw size={12} />
                                Reset Semua
                            </button>
                        </>
                    ) : (
                        <span className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Tidak ada filter aktif</span>
                    )}
                </div>
                
                <button 
                    onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors shrink-0 w-full sm:w-auto"
                >
                    <Filter size={14} />
                    {isOpen ? 'Tutup Filter' : 'Filter Lanjutan'}
                    {isOpen ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
                </button>
            </div>
            
            {isOpen && (
                <div className="p-3.5 sm:p-5 bg-white">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <label className="text-xs text-gray-500">Region</label>
                    <MultiSelect 
                        placeholder="Semua Region"
                        options={regionOptions}
                        value={filters.region}
                        onChange={(v) => updateFilter('region', v)}
                    />
                    {isTrainingPage && <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-1">Menggunakan region training (Kaltim)</span>}

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <label className="text-xs text-gray-500">Perusahaan</label>
                    <MultiSelect 
                        placeholder="Semua Perusahaan"
                        options={options.companies}
                        valueKey="id"
                        labelKey="name"
                        value={filters.company_id}
                        onChange={(v) => updateFilter('company_id', v)}
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <label className="text-xs text-gray-500">Lokasi</label>
                    <MultiSelect 
                        placeholder="Semua Lokasi"
                        options={locationOptions}
                        valueKey="id"
                        labelKey="name"
                        value={filters.location_id}
                        onChange={(v) => updateFilter('location_id', v)}
                    />

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Info } from 'lucide-react';

export function InfoTooltip({ title, text, position = 'bottom', className = '' }) {
    const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
    const [coords, setCoords] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0, width: 280, arrowLeft: 0, placement: 'bottom' });
    const buttonRef = useRef(null);
    const tooltipRef = useRef(null);

    const updatePosition = () => {
        if (!buttonRef.current) return;
        const rect = buttonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltipWidth = Math.min(288, window.innerWidth - 32); // w-72 or screen fit
        const iconCenterX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;

        // Horizontally center tooltip under/above icon, clamped within screen margins
        let left = iconCenterX - tooltipWidth / 2;
        const margin = 12;
        if (left < margin) {
            left = margin;
        } else if (left + tooltipWidth > window.innerWidth - margin) {
            left = window.innerWidth - margin - tooltipWidth;
        }

        // Relative arrow position (clamped inside tooltip rounded corners)
        let arrowLeft = iconCenterX - left;
        arrowLeft = Math.max(16, Math.min(arrowLeft, tooltipWidth - 16));

        // Determine vertical placement: open bottom by default, or top if not enough room below
        const spaceBelow = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
        const spaceAbove = rect.top;
        const estimatedHeight = tooltipRef.current?.offsetHeight || 250;

        let placement = position;
        let top = 0;

        if (position === 'top' || (spaceBelow < estimatedHeight + 16 && spaceAbove > 80)) {
            placement = 'top';
            top = rect.top - 8;
        } else {
            placement = 'bottom';
            top = rect.bottom + 8;
        }

        setCoords({ top, left, width: tooltipWidth, arrowLeft, placement });
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!visible) return;

        updatePosition();
        const raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updatePosition();
        });

        const handleScrollOrResize = () => {
            updatePosition();
        };

        const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
            if (
                buttonRef.current && !buttonRef.current.contains(e.target) &&
                tooltipRef.current && !tooltipRef.current.contains(e.target)
            ) {
                setVisible(false);
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScrollOrResize, true);
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleScrollOrResize);
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
        document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);

        return () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
            window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScrollOrResize, true);
            window.removeEventListener('resize', handleScrollOrResize);
            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
            document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
        };
    }, [visible]);

    if (!text && !title) return null;

    return (
        <>
            <button
                ref={buttonRef}
                type="button"
                className={`hide-from-export transition-colors p-0.5 rounded-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500/30 cursor-help inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                    visible 
                        ? 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50' 
                        : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50'
                } ${className}`}
                aria-label={title || 'Informasi detail data'}
                tabIndex={0}
                onMouseEnter={() => setVisible(true)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setVisible(false)}
                onFocus={() => setVisible(true)}
                onBlur={() => setVisible(false)}
                onClick={(e) => { 
                    e.stopPropagation(); 
                    setVisible(prev => !prev); 
                }}
            >
                <Info size={13.5} strokeWidth={2.2} />
            </button>

            {visible && typeof document !== 'undefined' && createPortal(
                <div
                    ref={tooltipRef}
                    style={{
                        position: 'fixed',
                        top: coords.placement === 'top' ? 'auto' : `${coords.top}px`,
                        bottom: coords.placement === 'top' ? `${window.innerHeight - coords.top}px` : 'auto',
                        left: `${coords.left}px`,
                        width: `${coords.width}px`,
                        maxHeight: 'calc(100vh - 24px)',
                        zIndex: 9999,
                    }}
                    className="p-3.5 bg-white text-gray-800 text-xs rounded-xl shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] border border-gray-200 transition-all animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-100 normal-case font-normal text-left pointer-events-auto overflow-y-auto"
                    role="tooltip"
                    onMouseEnter={() => setVisible(true)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setVisible(false)}
                >
                    {/* Caret / Arrow */}
                    <span 
                        style={{ left: `${coords.arrowLeft}px` }}
                        className={`absolute w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-white border-gray-200 rotate-45 transform pointer-events-none -translate-x-1/2 ${
                            coords.placement === 'top' 
                                ? '-bottom-1.5 border-b border-r' 
                                : '-top-1.5 border-t border-l'
                        }`} 
                    />

                    {title && (
                        <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-[#004D40] text-xs mb-1.5 leading-snug tracking-tight">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shrink-0"></span>
                            <span>{title}</span>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="relative z-10 block text-gray-600 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed font-normal">
                        {text}
                    </div>
                </div>,
                document.body
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import { formatNumber, formatDecimal } from '@/lib/format';
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Users, Activity, BarChart2, Calendar, Target, GraduationCap, Briefcase, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { InfoTooltip } from '@/Components/ui/InfoTooltip';

const DEFAULT_KPI_DESCRIPTIONS = {
    'Total Karyawan': 'Total seluruh tenaga kerja aktif (Headcount) yang tercatat dalam sistem dan sesuai filter aktif saat ini.',
    'Rata-rata Umur': 'Rata-rata usia seluruh karyawan aktif dihitung dari tanggal lahir hingga saat ini (dalam satuan tahun).',
    'Rata-rata Masa Kerja': 'Rata-rata lama masa pengabdian kerja karyawan (Length of Service) dihitung sejak tanggal bergabung (join date).',
    'Risiko Pensiun': 'Jumlah karyawan yang berusia 55 tahun ke atas atau akan memasuki masa pensiun dalam waktu dekat (<= 5 tahun).',
    'Karyawan Belum Pernah Training (<1 Tahun)': 'Karyawan dengan masa kerja di bawah 1 tahun yang belum tercatat memiliki riwayat training. Perlu diprioritaskan onboarding.',
    'Karyawan Baru Belum Pernah Training (<1 Tahun)': 'Karyawan dengan masa kerja di bawah 1 tahun yang belum tercatat memiliki riwayat training. Perlu diprioritaskan onboarding.',
    'Karyawan Baru Belum Dilatih (<1 Tahun)': 'Karyawan dengan masa kerja di bawah 1 tahun yang belum tercatat memiliki riwayat training. Perlu diprioritaskan onboarding.',
    'Karyawan Baru Masuk Tahun Ini': 'Jumlah karyawan baru yang direkrut dan mulai aktif bekerja terhitung sejak awal tahun kalender berjalan.',
    'Total Jam Pelatihan': 'Akumulasi total jam pelatihan dari seluruh sesi yang berhasil terhubung dengan data master karyawan.',
    'Training Coverage': 'Persentase perbandingan antara karyawan yang telah mengikuti minimal satu pelatihan terhadap total seluruh karyawan aktif.',
};

function resolveKpiDescription(title, explicitDesc) {
    if (explicitDesc) return explicitDesc;
    if (!title) return null;

    if (DEFAULT_KPI_DESCRIPTIONS[title]) {
        return DEFAULT_KPI_DESCRIPTIONS[title];
    }

    const lower = title.toLowerCase();
    for (const [key, desc] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_KPI_DESCRIPTIONS)) {
        if (lower === key.toLowerCase() || lower.includes(key.toLowerCase())) {
            return desc;
        }
    }

    if (lower.includes('total karyawan') || lower.includes('headcount') || lower.includes('total hc')) {
        return 'Total tenaga kerja aktif terdaftar dalam sistem.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('umur') || lower.includes('usia')) {
        return 'Rata-rata usia karyawan dalam satuan tahun.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('masa kerja') || lower.includes('los')) {
        return 'Rata-rata lama pengabdian kerja karyawan sejak tanggal awal masuk.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('pensiun')) {
        return 'Jumlah karyawan berisiko pensiun (usia 55 tahun ke atas).';
    }
    if (lower.includes('belum pernah training') || lower.includes('belum training') || lower.includes('belum dilatih')) {
        return 'Karyawan masa kerja < 1 tahun yang belum tercatat pernah mengikuti training.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('karyawan baru') || lower.includes('new hire')) {
        return 'Karyawan yang baru bergabung pada periode tahun kalender berjalan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('jam pelatihan') || lower.includes('training hours')) {
        return 'Total akumulasi durasi pelatihan karyawan dalam satuan jam.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('coverage') || lower.includes('cakupan')) {
        return 'Persentase karyawan yang telah tersentuh minimal satu program pelatihan.';
    }
    if (lower.includes('resign') || lower.includes('turnover')) {
        return 'Total akumulasi karyawan operasional yang keluar/mengundurkan diri pada periode tahun berjalan serta perbandingan YoY.';
    }

    return null;
}

export function KpiCard({ 
    title, 
    value, 
    unit = '', 
    note = '', 
    highlight = false, 
    isDecimal = false, 
    secondaryText = '', 
    icon: CustomIcon, 
    description,
    href,
    hrefLabel,
    noteClass
}) {
    const displayValue = isDecimal ? formatDecimal(value) : formatNumber(value);
    const resolvedDesc = resolveKpiDescription(title, description);
    
    // Choose icon based on title
    let Icon = CustomIcon || BarChart2;
    if (!CustomIcon) {
        const tl = title.toLowerCase();
        if (tl.includes('karyawan') || tl.includes('perempuan') || tl.includes('gen')) {
            Icon = Users;
        } else if (tl.includes('resign') || tl.includes('turnover')) {
            Icon = TrendingDown;
        } else if (tl.includes('umur') || tl.includes('masa kerja')) {
            Icon = Activity;
        } else if (tl.includes('pensiun')) {
            Icon = TrendingUp;
        } else if (tl.includes('pelatihan') || tl.includes('training')) {
            Icon = GraduationCap;
        }
    }

    const tlLower = title.toLowerCase();
    const isResign = tlLower.includes('resign') || tlLower.includes('turnover');
    const needsAttention = tlLower.includes('risiko') || tlLower.includes('belum pernah training') || tlLower.includes('belum training') || tlLower.includes('belum dilatih') || tlLower.includes('anomali') || highlight;
    const borderClass = needsAttention ? 'border border-amber-500' : 'border border-[#40826D]/40';
    const iconBgClass = isResign ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40]' : (needsAttention ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600' : 'bg-green-50 text-[#40826D]');

    return (
        <div className={`bg-white p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] ${borderClass} transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between h-full relative hover:z-40 focus-within:z-40 group`}>
            {/* Subtle background decoration for highlight (contained so tooltips aren't clipped) */}
            {highlight && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl pointer-events-none">
                    <div className="absolute -right-6 -top-6 w-24 h-24 bg-amber-500 rounded-full blur-3xl opacity-10 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></div>
                </div>
            )}
            
            <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3 sm:mb-4 relative z-10">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-1.5 sm:pr-2 min-w-0">
                        <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-[12.5px] font-extrabold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider leading-snug">{title}</h3>
                        {resolvedDesc && <InfoTooltip title={title} text={resolvedDesc} />}
                    </div>
                    <div className={`p-2 sm:p-2.5 rounded-xl flex-shrink-0 ${iconBgClass}`}>
                        <Icon size={20} className="sm:w-[22px] sm:h-[22px]" strokeWidth={2.5} />
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="relative">
                    <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                        <span className="text-3xl sm:text-[34px] font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900 tabular-nums leading-none">
                            {displayValue}
                        </span>
                        {unit && <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 ml-1">{unit}</span>}
                    </div>
                    
                    {(note || secondaryText) && (
                        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 items-center">
                            {note && (
                                <span className={`inline-flex items-center text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-semibold px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-0.5 sm:py-1 rounded-md border ${noteClass || 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200/60'}`}>
                                    {note}
                                </span>
                            )}
                            {secondaryText && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-0.5 sm:py-1 rounded-md border border-amber-200/70">
                                    {secondaryText}
                                </span>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            {href && (
                <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Link 
                        href={href}
                        className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#004D40] hover:text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1 group/link transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                        <span>{hrefLabel || 'Lihat Analisis Detail'}</span>
                        <ArrowRight size={13} className="transition-transform group-hover/link:translate-x-0.5" />

            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Check, X, Search } from 'lucide-react';

export function MultiSelect({ options = [], value = [], onChange, placeholder, disabled = false, labelKey = 'name', valueKey = 'id' }) {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const containerRef = useRef(null);
    const searchInputRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
            if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
                setIsOpen(false);
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isOpen) {
            setSearch('');
        } else if (options.length > 7 && searchInputRef.current) {
            setTimeout(() => searchInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
        }
    }, [isOpen, options.length]);

    const toggleOption = (optValue) => {
        if (value.includes(optValue)) {
            onChange(value.filter(v => v !== optValue));
        } else {
            onChange([...value, optValue]);
        }
    };

    const clearAll = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onChange([]);
    };

    const selectedCount = value.length;

    const filteredOptions = useMemo(() => {
        if (!search.trim()) return options;
        const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
        return options.filter(opt => {
            if (typeof opt !== 'object' || opt === null) {
                return String(opt || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
            }
            const label = String(opt[labelKey] || '').toLowerCase();
            const code = String(opt.code || '').toLowerCase();
            const initials = String(opt.initials || '').toLowerCase();
            const aliases = Array.isArray(opt.aliases)
                ? opt.aliases.some(a => String(a).toLowerCase().includes(q))
                : false;
            return label.includes(q) || code.includes(q) || initials.includes(q) || aliases;
        });
    }, [options, search, labelKey]);

    return (
        <div className={`relative ${isOpen ? 'z-50' : 'z-10'} ${disabled ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}`} ref={containerRef}>
            <div 
                className={`flex items-center justify-between min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                    isOpen 
                        ? 'border-[#004D40] ring-2 ring-[#004D40]/15' 
                        : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-corporate-light'
                }`}
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
            >
                <div className="flex-1 truncate text-sm">
                    {selectedCount > 0 ? (
                        <span className="font-semibold text-corporate-dark">{selectedCount} terpilih</span>
                    ) : (
                        <span className="text-gray-400">{placeholder}</span>
                    )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-400">
                    {selectedCount > 0 && (
                        <button onClick={clearAll} className="p-0.5 hover:text-red-500 rounded-full hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors" title="Hapus pilihan">
                            <X size={14} />
                        </button>
                    )}
                    <ChevronDown size={16} className={`transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-[#004D40]' : ''}`} />
                </div>
            </div>

            {isOpen && (
                <div className="absolute z-[100] left-0 w-full min-w-[200px] mt-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                    {options.length > 7 && (
                        <div className="p-2 border-b border-gray-100 sticky top-0 bg-white z-10">
                            <div className="relative">
                                <input
                                    ref={searchInputRef}
                                    type="text"
                                    value={search}
                                    onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                                    placeholder="Cari pilihan..."
                                    className="w-full pl-7 pr-6 py-1 text-xs border border-gray-200 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#004D40] focus:border-[#004D40]"
                                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                />
                                <Search size={12} className="absolute left-2 top-2 text-gray-400" />
                                {search && (
                                    <button 
                                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setSearch(''); }}
                                        className="absolute right-2 top-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-0.5"
                                    >
                                        <X size={12} />
                                    </button>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {filteredOptions.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-3 text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
                            {options.length === 0 ? 'Tidak ada opsi' : 'Tidak ada hasil'}
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="p-1">
                            {filteredOptions.map((opt) => {
                                const optVal = typeof opt === 'object' ? opt[valueKey] : opt;
                                const optLabel = typeof opt === 'object' ? opt[labelKey] : opt;
                                const isSelected = value.includes(String(optVal));
                                return (
                                    <div 
                                        key={optVal} 
                                        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer"
                                        onClick={() => toggleOption(String(optVal))}
                                    >
                                        <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-corporate-light border-corporate-light text-white' : 'border-gray-300'}`}>
                                            {isSelected && <Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                                        </div>
                                        <span className="truncate">{optLabel}</span>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export const PalmFrond = ({ size = 24, className = '', strokeWidth = 1.5, ...props }) => (
    <svg

        height={size} 
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"

import { useEffect, useRef, useImperativeHandle, forwardRef } from 'react';

const TurnstileWidget = forwardRef(function TurnstileWidget(
    { siteKey, onVerify, onExpire, onError, theme = 'light', className = '' },
    ref
) {
    const containerRef = useRef(null);
    const widgetIdRef = useRef(null);

    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
        reset: () => {
            if (widgetIdRef.current !== null && window.turnstile) {
                try {
                    window.turnstile.reset(widgetIdRef.current);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Failed to reset Turnstile widget:', e);
                }
            }
        },
    }));

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!siteKey) return;

        let isMounted = true;
        let pollTimer = null;

        const renderWidget = () => {
            if (!isMounted || !containerRef.current || !window.turnstile) return;
            if (widgetIdRef.current !== null) return;

            try {
                // Bersihkan konten kontainer jika ada sisa render sebelumnya
                containerRef.current.innerHTML = '';

                widgetIdRef.current = window.turnstile.render(containerRef.current, {
                    sitekey: siteKey,
                    theme: theme,
                    callback: (token) => {
                        if (isMounted && onVerify) {
                            onVerify(token);
                        }
                    },
                    'expired-callback': () => {
                        if (isMounted && onExpire) {
                            onExpire();
                        }
                    },
                    'error-callback': (err) => {
                        console.warn('Turnstile error-callback:', err);
                        if (isMounted && onError) {
                            onError(err);
                        }
                    },
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error rendering Cloudflare Turnstile:', err);
            }
        };

        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.turnstile) {
            renderWidget();
        } else {
            // Pastikan tag script terpasang
            const scriptId = 'cf-turnstile-script';
            if (!document.getElementById(scriptId)) {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.id = scriptId;
                script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?render=explicit';
                script.async = true;
                script.defer = true;
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            }

            // Polling setiap 50ms hingga window.turnstile siap
            let attempts = 0;
            pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
                attempts++;
                if (window.turnstile) {
                    clearInterval(pollTimer);
                    pollTimer = null;
                    renderWidget();
                } else if (attempts > 100) { // Timeout setelah 5 detik
                    clearInterval(pollTimer);
                    pollTimer = null;
                    console.warn('Cloudflare Turnstile script failed to initialize within 5 seconds.');
                }
            }, 50);
        }

        return () => {
            isMounted = false;
            if (pollTimer) {
                clearInterval(pollTimer);
                pollTimer = null;
            }
            if (widgetIdRef.current !== null && window.turnstile) {
                try {
                    window.turnstile.remove(widgetIdRef.current);
                } catch (e) {
                    // ignore
                }
                widgetIdRef.current = null;
            }
        };
    }, [siteKey, theme]);

    return (
        <div className={`turnstile-wrapper ${className}`}>
            <div ref={containerRef} className="flex justify-center sm:justify-start min-h-[65px]" />
        </div>
    );
});

export default TurnstileWidget;

File: resources/js/hooks/useCopyAsImage.js

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { toBlob, toPng } from 'html-to-image';

export function useCopyAsImage({ title = 'export', onBeforeCapture = null, onAfterCapture = null } = {}) {
    const ref = useRef(null);
    const [isCopying, setIsCopying] = useState(false);
    const [status, setStatus] = useState(''); // 'copied', 'downloaded', ''

    const handleCopy = async () => {
        if (!ref.current) return;
        
        setIsCopying(true);
        setStatus('');
        
        // Optional pre-capture operations (like expanding scrollable elements)
        if (onBeforeCapture) {
            await onBeforeCapture(ref.current);
            // wait a tiny bit for DOM changes to render
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); 
        }

        // Filter out the button container
        const filter = (node) => {
            return !(node.classList && node.classList.contains('hide-from-export'));
        };
        
        try {
            const blob = await toBlob(ref.current, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', filter });
            
            if (navigator.clipboard && window.ClipboardItem) {
                try {
                    await navigator.clipboard.write([
                        new window.ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })
                    ]);
                    setStatus('copied');
                } catch (err) {
                    throw err; // Fallback to download
                }
            } else {
                throw new Error('Clipboard API not supported'); // Fallback to download
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Failed to copy to clipboard, falling back to download', error);
            try {
                const dataUrl = await toPng(ref.current, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', filter });
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                const titleStr = typeof title === 'string' ? title : 'grafik';
                link.download = `${titleStr.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase()}.png`;
                link.href = dataUrl;
                link.click();
                setStatus('downloaded');
            } catch (dlError) {
                console.error('Failed to download image', dlError);
            }
        } finally {
            if (onAfterCapture) {
                await onAfterCapture(ref.current);
            }
            setIsCopying(false);
            setTimeout(() => setStatus(''), 2500);
        }
    };

    return { ref, isCopying, status, handleCopy };
}

import { useFilters } from './useFilters';

export function useCrossFilter(isTrainingPage = false) {
    const { filters, updateFilter } = useFilters(isTrainingPage);

    // Adds a value to an array filter if it doesn't exist, removes if it does
    const toggleFilter = (key, value) => {
        const currentVals = filters[key] || [];
        if (Array.isArray(currentVals)) {
            if (currentVals.includes(String(value)) || currentVals.includes(value)) {
                // Remove
                updateFilter(key, currentVals.filter(v => String(v) !== String(value)));
            } else {
                // Add
                updateFilter(key, [...currentVals, String(value)]);
            }
        }
    };

    const hasFilter = (key, value) => {
        const currentVals = filters[key] || [];
        return Array.isArray(currentVals) && (currentVals.includes(String(value)) || currentVals.includes(value));
    };

    return { toggleFilter, hasFilter };
}

File: resources/js/hooks/useFilters.js
