import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useForm, Head } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Eye, EyeOff, LogIn } from 'lucide-react';
import TurnstileWidget from '@/Components/ui/TurnstileWidget';

export default function Login({ turnstileSiteKey, turnstileEnabled = true }) {
    const turnstileRef = useRef(null);
    const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

    const { data, setData, post, processing, errors } = useForm({
        nik: '',
        password: '',
        remember: false,
        turnstile_token: '',
    });

    const submit = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        post('/login', {
            onError: () => {
                turnstileRef.current?.reset();
                setData('turnstile_token', '');
            },
        });
    };

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex bg-app-bg font-sans">
            <Head title="Masuk - Monitoring Operation" />

            {/* Kolom Kiri - Visual Panel (Image Background) */}
            <div className="hidden lg:flex lg:w-1/2 relative overflow-hidden items-end p-12">
                {/* Background Image */}
                <div
                    className="absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center"
                    style={{ backgroundImage: "url('/welcomefr.jpg')" }}
                ></div>

                {/* Dark Green Overlay */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-corporate-dark/80 mix-blend-multiply"></div>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-corporate-dark/95 via-corporate-dark/40 to-transparent"></div>

                {/* Content at Bottom Left */}
                <div className="relative z-10 w-full mb-8">
                    <h2 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-white mb-4 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Monitoring Operation
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-lg text-white/90 font-medium mb-1">
                        Sistem Monitoring Operasional Perkebunan
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-white/70">
                        First Resources
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Kolom Kanan - Form */}
            <div className="w-full lg:w-1/2 flex items-center justify-center p-8 lg:p-24 bg-white relative z-10">
                <div className="w-full max-w-md">
                    <div className="text-center lg:text-left mb-10">
                        <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-white rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6 mx-auto lg:mx-0 shadow-md hidden">
                            <img src="/logofr.png" alt="Logo" className="w-12 h-12 object-contain" />
                        </div>
                        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-corporate-dark mb-3">Selamat Datang</h1>
                        <p className="text-gray-500">Silakan masuk menggunakan Nomor Induk Karyawan (NIK) Anda untuk melanjutkan.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
                        <div>
                            <label htmlFor="nik" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                                Nomor Induk Karyawan (NIK)
                            </label>
                            <input
                                id="nik"
                                name="nik"
                                type="text"
                                autoComplete="username"
                                value={data.nik}
                                onChange={e => setData('nik', e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400"
                                placeholder="Masukkan Nomor Induk Karyawan (NIK)"
                                required
                                autoFocus
                            />
                            {errors.nik && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2 font-medium">{errors.nik}</p>}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                                Kata Sandi
                            </label>
                            <div className="relative">
                                <input
                                    id="password"
                                    name="password"
                                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                                    autoComplete="current-password"
                                    value={data.password}
                                    onChange={e => setData('password', e.target.value)}
                                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 pr-11 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400"
                                    placeholder="Masukkan kata sandi"
                                    required
                                />
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                                    className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3.5 flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                                    aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan kata sandi' : 'Lihat kata sandi'}
                                >
                                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            {errors.password && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2 font-medium">{errors.password}</p>}
                        </div>

                        {/* Ingat Saya (Remember Me) */}
                        <div className="flex items-center">
                            <input
                                id="remember_me"
                                name="remember"
                                type="checkbox"
                                checked={data.remember}
                                onChange={e => setData('remember', e.target.checked)}
                                className="h-4 w-4 text-corporate-dark focus:ring-corporate-light border-gray-300 rounded cursor-pointer accent-[#004D40]"
                            />
                            <label htmlFor="remember_me" className="ml-2 block text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium cursor-pointer select-none">
                                Ingat Saya
                            </label>
                        </div>

                        {/* Cloudflare Turnstile Widget (Jika Diaktifkan) */}
                        {turnstileEnabled && turnstileSiteKey && (
                            <div className="pt-1">
                                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                                    Verifikasi Keamanan
                                </label>
                                <TurnstileWidget
                                    ref={turnstileRef}
                                    siteKey={turnstileSiteKey}
                                    onVerify={(token) => setData('turnstile_token', token)}
                                    onExpire={() => setData('turnstile_token', '')}
                                    onError={() => setData('turnstile_token', '')}
                                />
                                {errors.turnstile_token && (
                                    <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1.5 font-medium">
                                        {errors.turnstile_token}
                                    </p>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={processing || (turnstileEnabled && turnstileSiteKey && !data.turnstile_token)}
                            className="w-full bg-corporate-dark hover:bg-corporate-light text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-lg transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed mt-6 flex justify-center items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-sm hover:shadow"
                        >
                            Masuk ke Sistem
                            <LogIn size={18} />
                        </button>
                    </form>

                    <div className="mt-16 text-center">
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">&copy; {new Date().getFullYear()} Monitoring Operation - First Resources</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function CompanyRankingTable({ data = [], onSelectCompany, isSelectedCompany }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState('coverage');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState('desc');
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    const [perPage, setPerPage] = useState(10);

    // Filter and sort data
    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = data;

        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(item => 
                item.name && String(item.name).toLowerCase().includes(q)
            );
        }

        return [...result].sort((a, b) => {
            let valA = a[sortKey];
            let valB = b[sortKey];

            if (valA === undefined || valA === null) valA = '';
            if (valB === undefined || valB === null) valB = '';

            if (typeof valA === 'number' && typeof valB === 'number') {
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }

            const strA = String(valA).toLowerCase();
            const strB = String(valB).toLowerCase();

            const cmp = strA.localeCompare(strB, undefined, { numeric: true });
            return sortOrder === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        });
    }, [data, search, sortKey, sortOrder]);

    // Reset pagination when search or perPage changes
    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentPage(1);
    }, [search, perPage]);

    const totalRows = filtered.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalRows / perPage) || 1;
    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * perPage;
    const paginated = filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + perPage);

    const handleSort = (key) => {
        if (sortKey === key) {
            setSortOrder(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortKey(key);
            setSortOrder(key === 'name' ? 'asc' : 'desc');
        }
    };

    const getPageNumbers = (current, total) => {
        if (total <= 7) return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
        if (current <= 4) return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, '...', total];
        if (current >= total - 3) return [1, '...', total - 4, total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
        return [1, '...', current - 1, current, current + 1, '...', total];
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        if (sortKey !== column) return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1 text-xs">↕</span>;
        return sortOrder === 'asc' ? (
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        ) : (
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        );
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col">
            {/* Header Toolbar */}
            <div className="pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] rounded-xl">
                            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-lg">Peringkat Kinerja Perusahaan</h3>
                                <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60">
                                    {totalRows.toLocaleString('id-ID')} Perusahaan
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                                Perbandingan komprehensif demografi, partisipasi pelatihan, dan risiko pensiun antar entitas perusahaan.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                    {/* Search */}
                    <div className="relative flex-1 sm:flex-initial sm:w-64">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Cari nama perusahaan..."
                            value={search}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all"
                        />
                        <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                        {search && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setSearch('')}
                                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                                title="Hapus pencarian"
                            >
                                <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Per-Page Selector */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select
                            value={perPage}
                            onChange={(e) => setPerPage(Number(e.target.value))}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-700"
                        >
                            <option value={10}>10 baris</option>
                            <option value={25}>25 baris</option>
                            <option value={50}>50 baris</option>
                            <option value={100}>100 baris</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Table Area */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto relative">
                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse">
                    <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur-xs border-b border-gray-200/80 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-2xs">
                        <tr>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Perusahaan</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="name" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('hc')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Total HC</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="hc" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('avg_age')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Rata Umur</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="avg_age" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('trained_hc')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Karyawan Dilatih</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="trained_hc" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('coverage')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Coverage (%)</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="coverage" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('total_hours')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Total Jam</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="total_hours" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('avg_hours')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Jam/Org</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="avg_hours" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('risk_pct')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Risiko Pensiun (%)</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="risk_pct" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                        {paginated.length > 0 ? (
                            paginated.map((row) => {
                                const selected = isSelectedCompany ? isSelectedCompany(row) : false;
                                return (
                                    <tr 
                                        key={row.id || row.name} 
                                        className={`transition-colors group ${
                                            selected ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 font-semibold' : 'hover:bg-emerald-50/30'
                                        }`}
                                    >
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                            <button
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => onSelectCompany && onSelectCompany(row)}
                                                className="text-left hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors font-medium cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
                                                title="Klik untuk memfilter dashboard berdasarkan perusahaan ini"
                                            >
                                                <span>{row.name}</span>
                                                {selected && (
                                                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                                                        Terpilih
                                                    </span>
                                                )}
                                            </button>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-semibold text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {formatNumber(row.hc)} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">orang</span>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {formatDecimal(row.avg_age)} thn
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-medium text-emerald-800 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {formatNumber(row.trained_hc ?? 0)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold ${
                                                row.coverage >= 70 ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60' :
                                                row.coverage >= 30 ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200/60' :
                                                row.coverage > 0 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/60' :
                                                'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'
                                            }`}>
                                                {formatDecimal(row.coverage)}%
                                            </span>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {formatNumber(row.total_hours ?? 0)} jam
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {formatDecimal(row.avg_hours)} jam/org
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold ${
                                                row.risk_pct >= 20 ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200/60' :
                                                row.risk_pct >= 10 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60' :
                                                'bg-gray-50 text-gray-600'
                                            }`}>
                                                {formatDecimal(row.risk_pct)}%
                                            </span>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                );
                            })
                        ) : (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
                                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                                        <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-gray-50 text-gray-400">
                                            <Building2 size={24} />
                                        </div>
                                        <p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-700">Tidak ada perusahaan yang cocok</p>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Silakan sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian yang dimasukkan.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        )}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination Footer */}
            {totalRows > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-4 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 bg-white">
                    <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Menampilkan <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{startIndex + 1}</span> - <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{Math.min(startIndex + perPage, totalRows)}</span> dari <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{totalRows.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span> perusahaan
                    </div>

                    {totalPages > 1 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end gap-1">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                                className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                                aria-label="Sebelumnya"
                            >
                                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                            </button>

                            {getPageNumbers(currentPage, totalPages).map((item, idx) => (
                                item === '...' ? (
                                    <span key={`ellipsis-${idx}`} className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-300">
                                        ...
                                    </span>
                                ) : (
                                    <button
                                        key={item}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => setCurrentPage(item)}
                                        className={`min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                                            currentPage === item
                                                ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-2xs'
                                                : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900'
                                        }`}
                                    >
                                        {item}
                                    </button>
                                )
                            ))}

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={currentPage === totalPages || totalPages === 0}
                                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.min(totalPages, prev + 1))}
                                className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                                aria-label="Selanjutnya"
                            >
                                <ChevronRight size={16} />
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function JobTitlesTable({ data = [], onSelectJobTitle, onSelectLevel }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [levelFilter, setLevelFilter] = useState('all');
    const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState('hc');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState('desc');
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    const [perPage, setPerPage] = useState(10);

    // Extract unique levels for filter dropdown
    const availableLevels = useMemo(() => {
        const set = new Set();
        data.forEach(item => {
            if (item.level && item.level !== '-') set.add(String(item.level));
        });
        return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true }));
    }, [data]);

    // Filter and sort data
    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let result = data;

        if (search.trim()) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter(item => 
                (item.title && String(item.title).toLowerCase().includes(q)) || 
                (item.level && String(item.level).toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
        }

        if (levelFilter !== 'all') {
            result = result.filter(item => String(item.level) === String(levelFilter));
        }

        return [...result].sort((a, b) => {
            let valA = a[sortKey];
            let valB = b[sortKey];

            if (valA === undefined || valA === null) valA = '';
            if (valB === undefined || valB === null) valB = '';

            if (typeof valA === 'number' && typeof valB === 'number') {
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }

            const strA = String(valA).toLowerCase();
            const strB = String(valB).toLowerCase();

            const cmp = strA.localeCompare(strB, undefined, { numeric: true });
            return sortOrder === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        });
    }, [data, search, levelFilter, sortKey, sortOrder]);

    // Reset pagination when filter changes
    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentPage(1);
    }, [search, levelFilter, perPage]);

    const totalRows = filtered.length;
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalRows / perPage) || 1;
    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * perPage;
    const paginated = filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + perPage);

    const handleSort = (key) => {
        if (sortKey === key) {
            setSortOrder(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortKey(key);
            setSortOrder(key === 'title' || key === 'level' ? 'asc' : 'desc');
        }
    };

    const getPageNumbers = (current, total) => {
        if (total <= 7) return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
        if (current <= 4) return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, '...', total];
        if (current >= total - 3) return [1, '...', total - 4, total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
        return [1, '...', current - 1, current, current + 1, '...', total];
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        if (sortKey !== column) return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1 text-xs">↕</span>;
        return sortOrder === 'asc' ? (
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        ) : (
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        );
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col">
            {/* Header Toolbar */}
            <div className="pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 text-[#004D40] rounded-xl">
                            <Briefcase className="w-5 h-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-lg">Daftar Seluruh Jabatan &amp; Headcount</h3>
                                <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60">
                                    {totalRows.toLocaleString('id-ID')} Jabatan
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                                Rekapitulasi lengkap jumlah karyawan dan keterlibatan pelatihan pada masing-masing jabatan.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                    {/* Search */}
                    <div className="relative flex-1 sm:flex-initial sm:w-64">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Cari nama jabatan..."
                            value={search}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all"
                        />
                        <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                        {search && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setSearch('')}
                                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                                title="Hapus pencarian"
                            >
                                <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Filter Level */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Level:</span>
                        <select
                            value={levelFilter}
                            onChange={(e) => setLevelFilter(e.target.value)}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-700"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Level ({availableLevels.length})</option>
                            {availableLevels.map(lvl => (
                                <option key={lvl} value={lvl}>Level {lvl}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Per-Page Selector */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select
                            value={perPage}
                            onChange={(e) => setPerPage(Number(e.target.value))}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-700"
                        >
                            <option value={10}>10 baris</option>
                            <option value={25}>25 baris</option>
                            <option value={50}>50 baris</option>
                            <option value={100}>100 baris</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Table Area */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto relative">
                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse">
                    <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur-xs border-b border-gray-200/80 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-2xs">
                        <tr>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('title')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Nama Jabatan</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="title" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-center"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('level')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Level</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="level" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('hc')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Jumlah Karyawan (HC)</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="hc" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('pct_of_total')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Porsi (%)</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="pct_of_total" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('trained_hc')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Karyawan Dilatih</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="trained_hc" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('coverage')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Coverage (%)</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="coverage" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('total_hours')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Total Jam</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="total_hours" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right"
                                onClick={() => handleSort('avg_hours')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Rata Jam</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="avg_hours" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                        {paginated.length > 0 ? (
                            paginated.map((row) => (
                                <tr key={`${row.title}-${row.level}`} className="hover:bg-emerald-50/30 transition-colors group">
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                        <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => onSelectJobTitle && onSelectJobTitle(row.title)}
                                            className="text-left hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors font-medium cursor-pointer"
                                            title="Klik untuk memfilter berdasarkan jabatan ini"
                                        >
                                            {row.title}
                                        </button>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => onSelectLevel && onSelectLevel(row.level)}
                                            className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-emerald-100 hover:text-emerald-900 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                            title={`Level ${row.level} (Klik untuk filter)`}
                                        >
                                            Level {row.level}
                                        </button>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-semibold text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        {formatNumber(row.hc)} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">orang</span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        {formatDecimal(row.pct_of_total)}%
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-medium text-emerald-800 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        {formatNumber(row.trained_hc)}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold ${
                                            row.coverage >= 70 ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60' :
                                            row.coverage >= 30 ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200/60' :
                                            row.coverage > 0 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/60' :
                                            'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'
                                        }`}>
                                            {formatDecimal(row.coverage)}%
                                        </span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        {formatNumber(row.total_hours)} jam
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-mono text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        {formatDecimal(row.avg_hours)} jam/org
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ))
                        ) : (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
                                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                                        <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-gray-50 text-gray-400">
                                            <Briefcase size={24} />
                                        </div>
                                        <p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-700">Tidak ada jabatan yang cocok</p>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Silakan sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter level yang dipilih.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        )}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination Footer */}
            {totalRows > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-4 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 bg-white">
                    <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Menampilkan <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{startIndex + 1}</span> - <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{Math.min(startIndex + perPage, totalRows)}</span> dari <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{totalRows.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span> jabatan
                    </div>

                    {totalPages > 1 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end gap-1">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                                className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                                aria-label="Sebelumnya"
                            >
                                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                            </button>

                            {getPageNumbers(currentPage, totalPages).map((item, idx) => (
                                item === '...' ? (
                                    <span key={`ellipsis-${idx}`} className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-300">
                                        ...
                                    </span>
                                ) : (
                                    <button
                                        key={item}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => setCurrentPage(item)}
                                        className={`min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                                            currentPage === item
                                                ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-2xs'
                                                : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900'
                                        }`}
                                    >
                                        {item}
                                    </button>
                                )
                            ))}

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={currentPage === totalPages || totalPages === 0}
                                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.min(totalPages, prev + 1))}
                                className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                                aria-label="Selanjutnya"
                            >
                                <ChevronRight size={16} />
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

const FACILITY_STYLES = {
    Estate: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200/70',
    Mill: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200/70',
    Downstream: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200/70',
    Office: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200/70',
};

function getCompanyBadge(company = {}) {
    if (company.initials) return company.initials;
    const name = company.name || '';
    const clean = name.replace(/^PT\.?\s+/i, '').trim();
    const parts = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length >= 2) return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    return (company.code || name).slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function CompanyCardSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-5 shadow-2xs animate-pulse flex flex-col justify-between h-[210px]">
            <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gray-200" />
                    <div className="h-5 bg-gray-200 rounded-md w-16" />
                </div>
                <div className="h-5 bg-gray-200 rounded w-4/5 mb-2" />
                <div className="h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/2" />
            </div>
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
                <div className="h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full w-full" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function GenerationBar({ generations = {} }) {
    const total = Object.values(generations).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
    if (total === 0) return null;
    const gens = Object.entries(generations).filter(([, v]) => v > 0);

    return (
        <div className="mt-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-gray-500 mb-1.5 font-medium">
                <span>Generasi</span>
                <span className="text-gray-400">
                    {gens.map(([name, val]) => `${name} (${Math.round((val / total) * 100)}%)`).slice(0, 2).join(' · ')}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-100 gap-0.5">
                {gens.map(([name, val]) => {
                    const pct = Math.round((val / total) * 100);
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={name}
                            style={{ 
                                width: `${(val / total) * 100}%`, 
                                backgroundColor: generationColors[name] || '#94A3B8' 
                            }}
                            title={`${name}: ${val.toLocaleString('id-ID')} staf (${pct}%)`}
                            className="transition-opacity hover:opacity-80"
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

const REGIONS = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim', 'Corp', 'Non'];

export default function CompanyIndex() {
    const [companies, setCompanies] = useState([]);
    const [totalLocations, setTotalLocations] = useState(0);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [activeRegion, setActiveRegion] = useState('Semua');
    const [activeFacility, setActiveFacility] = useState('Semua'); // 'Semua' | 'Estate' | 'Mill' | 'Downstream'
    const [sort, setSort] = useState('hc'); // hc | az
    const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('grid'); // grid | list

    useEffect(() => {
        axios.get('/data/companies').then(res => {
            setCompanies(res.data.data || []);
            setTotalLocations(res.data.total_locations || 0);
            setLoading(false);
        }).catch(() => setLoading(false));
    }, []);

    // Ekstrak seluruh region unik yang ada di data perusahaan dengan urutan prioritas
    const availableRegions = useMemo(() => {
        const unique = Array.from(new Set(companies.map(c => c.region).filter(Boolean)));
        const priority = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim', 'Corp', 'Non'];
        return unique.sort((a, b) => {
            const idxA = priority.indexOf(a);
            const idxB = priority.indexOf(b);
            if (idxA !== -1 && idxB !== -1) return idxA - idxB;
            if (idxA !== -1) return -1;
            if (idxB !== -1) return 1;
            return a.localeCompare(b);
        });
    }, [companies]);

    // Hitung jumlah per region untuk chip
    const regionCounts = useMemo(() => {
        return availableRegions.reduce((acc, r) => {
            acc[r] = companies.filter(c => c.region === r).length;
            return acc;
        }, {});
    }, [companies, availableRegions]);

    // Hitung jumlah per fasilitas untuk chip
    const facilityCounts = useMemo(() => {
        const counts = { 'Semua': companies.length };
        ['Estate', 'Mill', 'Downstream'].forEach(f => {
            counts[f] = companies.filter(c => c.facilities?.includes(f)).length;
        });
        return counts;
    }, [companies]);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let list = companies;
        if (search) {
            const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
            const qNoSpace = q.replace(/\s+/g, '');

            list = list.filter(c => {
                // 1. Inisial langsung dari badge hijau (mis. ASK, CLP, SMM, SAM 1, SAM 2, SAGM, PSG, KTBM)
                const badge = (c.initials || '').toLowerCase();
                const badgeNoSpace = badge.replace(/\s+/g, '');
                const initialMatch = badge === q || 
                                     badge.split(/\s+/).includes(q) || 
                                     badge.startsWith(q) || 
                                     badgeNoSpace.startsWith(qNoSpace);

                // 2. Variasi alias resmi (mis. SAM, SAM1, SAM 2)
                const aliasMatch = (c.aliases || []).some(a => {
                    const al = a.toLowerCase();
                    return al === q || al.startsWith(q) || al.replace(/\s+/g, '').startsWith(qNoSpace);
                });

                // 3. Kode perusahaan (mis. R18, R03, R11-1, R14, L02)
                const codeMatch = c.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);

                // 4. Nama perusahaan (jika <= 3 huruf, periksa awalan kata agar tidak salah mencocokkan suku kata di tengah)
                const nameLower = c.name.toLowerCase();
                const nameMatch = q.length <= 3
                    ? nameLower.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean).some(w => w.startsWith(q))
                    : nameLower.includes(q);

                // 5. Grup (exact match)
                const groupMatch = (c.group || '').toLowerCase() === q;

                // 6. Unit operasional (kode lokasi seperti KR13 & nama lokasi seperti Jetty)
                const locCodeMatch = (c.location_codes || []).some(lc => lc.toLowerCase().includes(q));
                const locNameMatch = (c.location_names || []).some(l => {
                    const locLower = l.toLowerCase();
                    return q.length <= 3
                        ? locLower.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean).some(w => w.startsWith(q))
                        : locLower.includes(q);
                });

                return initialMatch || aliasMatch || codeMatch || nameMatch || groupMatch || locCodeMatch || locNameMatch;
            });
        }
        if (activeRegion !== 'Semua') {
            list = list.filter(c => c.region === activeRegion);
        }
        if (activeFacility !== 'Semua') {
            list = list.filter(c => c.facilities?.includes(activeFacility));
        }
        if (sort === 'az') {
            list = [...list].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        } else {
            list = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.employee_count - a.employee_count);
        }
        return list;
    }, [companies, search, activeRegion, activeFacility, sort]);

    const totalHc = filtered.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.employee_count || 0), 0);

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Galeri Perusahaan">
            <Head title="Galeri Perusahaan" />

            {/* Header Title & Subtitle */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">Galeri Perusahaan</h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                        Eksplorasi entitas operasional FR Group, sebaran tenaga kerja, dan klasifikasi unit operasional.
                    </p>
                </div>

                {/* 3 Executive Metric Cards */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 shadow-2xs border border-gray-100 relative hover:z-40 focus-within:z-40">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                            <Users size={16} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Total HC</p>
                                <InfoTooltip title="Total Headcount" text="Akumulasi seluruh karyawan aktif pada unit-unit perusahaan terfilter." />
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-gray-900">{totalHc.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 shadow-2xs border border-gray-100 relative hover:z-40 focus-within:z-40">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                            <Building2 size={16} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Perusahaan</p>
                                <InfoTooltip title="Jumlah Perusahaan" text="Jumlah entitas unit bisnis / PT yang terdaftar dan sesuai filter aktif." />
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-gray-900">{filtered.length}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 shadow-2xs border border-gray-100 relative hover:z-40 focus-within:z-40">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                            <MapPin size={16} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Lokasi</p>
                                <InfoTooltip title="Total Lokasi Kerja" text="Total persebaran unit kantor atau site operasional terdata." />
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-gray-900">{totalLocations}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Filter & Toolbar Container */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs p-4 mb-6 space-y-3.5">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    {/* Search Input */}
                    <div className="relative flex-1">
                        <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" size={16} />
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            value={search}
                            onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Cari nama, inisial (SAM, PSG, SMM), kode (R11), atau unit (Jetty, KR13)..."
                            className="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2 text-sm bg-gray-50/70 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200/80 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 outline-none transition-all"
                        />
                        {search && (
                            <button
                                onClick={() => setSearch('')}
                                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                            >
                                <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Sort & View Mode Toggle */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        <button
                            onClick={() => setSort(s => s === 'hc' ? 'az' : 'hc')}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 transition-colors"
                            title="Ubah Urutan"
                        >
                            <ArrowUpDown size={13} className="text-gray-500" />
                            <span>{sort === 'hc' ? 'HC Terbanyak' : 'Nama (A–Z)'}</span>
                        </button>

                        <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100/80 p-0.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200/50">
                            <button
                                onClick={() => setViewMode('grid')}
                                className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'bg-white shadow-2xs text-[#004D40]' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'}`}
                                title="Tampilan Grid"
                            >
                                <LayoutGrid size={15} />
                            </button>
                            <button
                                onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}
                                className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors ${viewMode === 'list' ? 'bg-white shadow-2xs text-[#004D40]' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'}`}
                                title="Tampilan Daftar"
                            >
                                <List size={15} />
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Region Filter Chips */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 mr-1">Region:</span>
                    {['Semua', ...availableRegions].map(r => {
                        const count = r === 'Semua' ? companies.length : (regionCounts[r] || 0);
                        if (r !== 'Semua' && count === 0) return null;
                        const active = activeRegion === r;
                        return (
                            <button
                                key={r}
                                onClick={() => setActiveRegion(r)}
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                    active
                                        ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white border-[#004D40] shadow-2xs font-semibold'
                                        : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-gray-200 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:text-emerald-800'
                                }`}
                            >
                                {r}
                                <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono ${active ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'}`}>
                                    {count}
                                </span>
                            </button>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>

                {/* Category / Facility Filter Chips */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100/60">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 mr-1">Kategori:</span>
                    {['Semua', 'Estate', 'Mill', 'Downstream'].map(f => {
                        const count = facilityCounts[f] || 0;
                        if (f !== 'Semua' && count === 0) return null;
                        const active = activeFacility === f;
                        return (
                            <button
                                key={f}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setActiveFacility(f)}
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                    active
                                        ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white border-[#004D40] shadow-2xs font-semibold'
                                        : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-gray-200 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:text-emerald-800'
                                }`}
                            >
                                {f}
                                <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono ${active ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'}`}>
                                    {count}
                                </span>
                            </button>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Gallery Grid or List */}
            {loading ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                    {[...Array(8)].map((_, i) => <CompanyCardSkeleton key={i} />)}
                </div>
            ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-16 text-center shadow-2xs">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-gray-100">
                        <Building2 size={32} className="opacity-50" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">Tidak ada perusahaan ditemukan</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                        Tidak ada perusahaan yang sesuai dengan kata kunci pencarian atau filter yang dipilih.
                    </p>
                    {(search || activeRegion !== 'Semua' || activeFacility !== 'Semua') && (
                        <button
                            onClick={() => { setSearch(''); setActiveRegion('Semua'); setActiveFacility('Semua'); }}
                            className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 rounded-xl transition-colors"
                        >
                            Reset Pencarian &amp; Filter
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>
            ) : viewMode === 'grid' ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                    {filtered.map(c => <CompanyCard key={c.id} company={c} />)}
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    {filtered.map(c => <CompanyRowItem key={c.id} company={c} />)}
                </div>
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

const LEVEL_ORDER = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5'];

const regionBadgeStyles = {
    Riau: 'bg-amber-100/90 text-amber-800 border-amber-200/60',

function renderEmploymentBadge(type) {
    const normalized = (type || '').toUpperCase();
    if (normalized === 'PERMANENT' || normalized === 'PERM') {
        return (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200/60">
                Permanent
            </span>
        );
    }
    if (normalized === 'CONTRACT' || normalized === 'PKWT') {
        return (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60">
                Contract
            </span>
        );
    }
    if (normalized === 'PROBATION') {
        return (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border border-sky-200/60">
                Probation
            </span>
        );
    }
    if (normalized === 'TRAINEE') {
        return (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200/60">
                Trainee
            </span>
        );
    }
    return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">
            {type || '—'}
        </span>
    );
}

function SubtlePalmPattern() {
    return (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.035] pointer-events-none overflow-hidden" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg className="w-full h-full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                <defs>
                    <pattern id="palm-leaf-pattern" width="90" height="90" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(25)">
                        <path d="M45 5 C30 25, 15 45, 5 70 C25 65, 45 55, 60 40 M45 5 C60 25, 75 45, 85 70 C65 65, 45 55, 30 40 M45 5 L45 85" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2" />
                    </pattern>
                </defs>
                <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#palm-leaf-pattern)" />
            </svg>
        </div>
    );
}

function OverviewTab({ profile, onTabSwitch, onSelectStaff, selectedLocation }) {
    if (!profile) return null;
    const { generations, levels, departments, training, demografi, masa_kerja, kpi } = profile;

    // Generasi donut data
    const totalGen = Object.values(generations || {}).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
    const genData = Object.entries(generations || {})
        .filter(([, v]) => v > 0)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ 
            name, 
            value, 
            pct: totalGen > 0 ? Math.round((value / totalGen) * 100) : 0,
            fill: generationColors[name] || '#94A3B8' 
        }));

    // Level bar data (urutan A-F lalu 1-5)
    const levelData = LEVEL_ORDER
        .filter(l => levels?.[l])
        .map(l => ({ name: l, label: `${l} - ${levelLabels[l] || l}`, value: levels[l] }));

    // Department top 8
    const deptData = Object.entries(departments || {})
        .slice(0, 8)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ 
            name: name.length > 22 ? name.slice(0, 22) + '…' : name, 
            fullName: name,
            value 
        }));

    // Spotlight trainings (top 3)
    const spotlightTrainings = (training?.top_trainings || []).slice(0, 3);

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* 4 Multi-dimensi Highlights Strip */}

                    >
                        Detail Pelatihan <ArrowRight size={12} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white p-4.5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex flex-col justify-between">

                {(() => {

                    const totalGender = maleCount + femaleCount;

                            <RechartsTooltip 
                                formatter={(v) => [formatNumber(v), 'Karyawan']}

                            <XAxis type="number" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: '#64748B' }} />

                            <RechartsTooltip 
                                formatter={(v) => [formatNumber(v), 'Karyawan']}

            {/* Row Bawah: Status Hubungan Kerja & Top Program Training */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {/* Status Hubungan Kerja Card */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs">

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Briefcase className="text-emerald-700" size={18} />
                            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">
                                Status Hubungan Kerja {selectedLocation ? `(${selectedLocation.name})` : ''}
                            </h3>
                        </div>
                        <button
                            onClick={() => onTabSwitch('demografi')}
                            className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                            Detail Demografi <ArrowRight size={13} />
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-3">
                        {Object.entries(demografi?.employment_types || {}).map(([name, value]) => {
                            const pct = kpi?.hc > 0 ? Math.round((value / kpi.hc) * 100) : 0;
                            return (
                                <div key={name} className="space-y-1">

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <GraduationCap className="text-emerald-700" size={18} />
                            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">
                                Spotlight: Program Training Terbanyak {selectedLocation ? `(${selectedLocation.name})` : ''}
                            </h3>
                        </div>
                        <button
                            onClick={() => onTabSwitch('pelatihan')}
                            className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                            Lihat Semua ({training?.top_trainings?.length || 0}) <ArrowRight size={13} />
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-2.5">
                        {spotlightTrainings.length > 0 ? (
                            spotlightTrainings.map((tr, idx) => (
                                <div
                                    key={tr.name}
                                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50/70 border border-gray-100"
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
