                        onClick={() => handleLocationToggle(null)}
                        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all font-semibold cursor-pointer border ${
                            !selectedLocation
                                ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white border-[#004D40] shadow-sm ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20'
                                : 'bg-gray-50/80 text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:text-emerald-900'
                        }`}
                    >
                        <Building2 size={13} className={!selectedLocation ? 'text-emerald-200' : 'text-emerald-700'} />
                        <span>Semua Unit</span>
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono text-[11px] font-bold border ${
                            !selectedLocation 
                                ? 'bg-white/20 text-white border-white/20' 
                                : 'bg-white text-emerald-800 border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs'
                        }`}>
                            {formatNumber(profile?.total_company_hc || profile?.kpi?.hc || 0)}
                        </span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Unit Buttons */}
                    {(profile?.locations || []).map(l => {
                        const isSelected = selectedLocation && String(selectedLocation.id) === String(l.id);
                        return (
                            <button
                                key={l.id}
                                onClick={() => handleLocationToggle(l)}
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                                    isSelected
                                        ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white border-[#004D40] shadow-sm ring-2 ring-emerald-500/30 font-bold'
                                        : 'bg-gray-50/80 text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:text-emerald-900 font-medium'
                                }`}
                                title={`Klik untuk memfilter seluruh analitik & grafik untuk unit ${l.name}`}
                            >
                                <MapPin size={13} className={isSelected ? 'text-emerald-300' : 'text-emerald-700'} />
                                <span>{l.name}</span>
                                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono text-[11px] font-bold border ${
                                    isSelected
                                        ? 'bg-white/20 text-white border-white/20'
                                        : 'bg-white text-emerald-800 border-gray-200/60 shadow-2xs'
                                }`}>
                                    {formatNumber(l.count)}
                                </span>
                            </button>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Active Unit Indicator Banner (Jika Ada Filter Unit yang Aktif) */}
            {selectedLocation && (
                <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50/90 border border-emerald-200 shadow-2xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-emerald-950">
                        <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-700 text-white shrink-0">
                            <MapPin size={15} />
                        </span>
                        <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-emerald-950 text-sm">
                                Sedang Memfilter Data Unit: {selectedLocation.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-emerald-800 text-[11px] mt-0.5">
                                Seluruh grafik (Demografi, Masa Kerja, Pelatihan SDM), KPI, dan daftar staf menampilkan data khusus untuk <strong className="font-mono font-bold">{profile?.kpi?.hc || 0}</strong> staf di unit ini.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0">
                        {tab !== 'staf' && (
                            <button
                                onClick={() => handleTabChange('staf')}
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border border-emerald-300 font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                            >
                                <Users size={13} /> Buka Daftar Staf Unit ({profile?.kpi?.hc || 0})
                            </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                            onClick={() => handleLocationToggle(null)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#004D40] hover:bg-[#00382E] text-white font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                        >
                            <RotateCcw size={12} /> Tampilkan Seluruh Unit ({profile?.total_company_hc || 0})
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Segmented Cockpit Navigation Tabs (5 Dimensi Operasional) */}
            <div className="flex items-center overflow-x-auto p-1 bg-gray-100/90 rounded-2xl w-full sm:w-fit mb-6 border border-gray-200/50 scrollbar-none gap-1">
                <button
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange('overview')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        tab === 'overview'
                            ? 'bg-white text-[#004D40] shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                    }`}
                >
                    <Layers size={15} />
                    <span>Overview 360°</span>
                </button>

                <button
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange('demografi')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        tab === 'demografi'
                            ? 'bg-white text-[#004D40] shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                    }`}
                >
                    <Users size={15} />
                    <span>Demografi</span>
                </button>

                <button
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange('tenure')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        tab === 'tenure'
                            ? 'bg-white text-[#004D40] shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                    }`}
                >
                    <Briefcase size={15} />
                    <span>Masa Kerja</span>
                </button>

                <button
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange('pelatihan')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        tab === 'pelatihan'
                            ? 'bg-white text-[#004D40] shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                    }`}
                >
                    <GraduationCap size={15} />
                    <span>Pelatihan SDM</span>
                    {profile?.training?.coverage_pct > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
                            {profile.training.coverage_pct}%
                        </span>
                    )}
                </button>

                <button
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange('staf')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        tab === 'staf'
                            ? 'bg-white text-[#004D40] shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                    }`}
                >
                    <Search size={15} />
                    <span>Daftar Staf</span>
                    {profile?.kpi?.hc > 0 && (
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${tab === 'staf' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-600'}`}>
                            {formatNumber(profile.kpi.hc)}
                        </span>
                    )}
                </button>
            </div>

            {/* Views Content */}
            {tab === 'overview' && (
                <OverviewTab
                    profile={profile}
                    onTabSwitch={handleTabChange}
                    onSelectStaff={(empId) => {
                        setSelectedEmpId(empId);
                        if (empId) setTab('staf');
                    }}
                    selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                />
            )}

            {tab === 'demografi' && (
                <DemografiTab
                    profile={profile}
                    selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                />
            )}

            {tab === 'tenure' && (
                <MasaKerjaTab
                    profile={profile}
                    selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                />
            )}

            {tab === 'pelatihan' && (
                <PelatihanTab
                    profile={profile}
                    selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                />
            )}

            {tab === 'staf' && (
                <StafTab
                    companyId={companyId}
                    selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                    filterOptions={profile?.filter_options}
                    selectedEmpId={selectedEmpId}
                    onSelectStaff={setSelectedEmpId}
                    onLocationClear={() => handleLocationToggle(null)}
                />
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

import AppLayout from '../Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Deferred, Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { KpiCard } from '@/Components/ui/KpiCard';
import { ChartCard } from '@/Components/ui/ChartCard';
import { DonutChart } from '@/Components/charts/DonutChart';
import { StackedBar } from '@/Components/charts/StackedBar';
import { HorizontalBar } from '@/Components/charts/HorizontalBar';
import { LineTrend } from '@/Components/charts/LineTrend';
import { generationColors } from '@/lib/colors';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { InfoTooltip } from '@/Components/ui/InfoTooltip';
import { 
    UserPlus, 
    UserCheck, 
    Users, 
    GraduationCap, 
    TrendingDown, 
    TrendingUp, 
    ArrowRight, 
    Sparkles, 
    Activity 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCrossFilter } from '@/hooks/useCrossFilter';
import { useFilters } from '@/hooks/useFilters';

export default function Dashboard({ metrics, insight, resign_summary }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const { options } = useFilters();
    
    // Transform metrics for charts
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.total_hc > 0;
    
    const genData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.generations).map(([name, value]) => ({
        name, value, fill: generationColors[name] || '#ccc'
    })) : [];

    const stackedKeys = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];
    const levelOrder = hasData && metrics.level_order ? metrics.level_order : [];

    const stackedData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(level => {
        const gens = metrics.generations_by_level?.[level] || {};
        const total = Object.values(gens).reduce((sum, val) => sum + (Number(val) || 0), 0);
        return {
            name: `Level ${level}`,
            level,
            total,
            top_titles: metrics.titles_by_level?.[level] || {},
            ...gens
        };
    }).filter(row => row.total > 0) : [];

    const regionData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_region)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    const companyData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_company)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];
        
    const trainingTrendData = hasData && metrics.training?.trend ? Object.entries(metrics.training.trend).map(([my, val]) => ({
        name: my, value: val
    })) : [];

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Dashboard">
            <Head title="Executive Workforce Dashboard" />
            
            <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* TOP EXECUTIVE HEADER (Flat Canvas Header) */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
                            Executive Workforce Dashboard
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                            Monitoring komprehensif demografi tenaga kerja, pergerakan rekrutmen, retensi karyawan & pelatihan.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Filter Bar */}
                <FilterBar />

                <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<DashboardSkeleton />}>
                    {hasData ? (
                        <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
                            {/* KPI Grid (8 Kartu Bersatu Rapi) */}
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 sm:gap-4">
                                <KpiCard title="Total Karyawan" value={metrics.total_hc} highlight={true} note="Headcount Aktif" />
                                <KpiCard title="Rata-rata Umur" value={metrics.avg_age} isDecimal={true} unit="Tahun" note="Usia Produktif" />
                                <KpiCard title="Rata-rata Masa Kerja" value={metrics.avg_los} isDecimal={true} unit="Tahun" note="Length of Service" />
                                <KpiCard 
                                    title="Turnover & Resign" 
                                    value={resign_summary?.total_curr ?? 0} 
                                    unit="Orang"
                                    note={resign_summary?.diff_pct !== undefined ? `${(resign_summary.diff_pct ?? 0) > 0 ? '+' : ''}${resign_summary.diff_pct}% YoY` : ''} 
                                    noteClass={(resign_summary?.diff ?? 0) <= 0 ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-200'}
                                    secondaryText={resign_summary?.vt_pct !== undefined ? `VT: ${resign_summary.vt_pct}% · IT: ${resign_summary.it_pct}%` : ''}
                                    icon={TrendingDown}
                                />
                                <KpiCard title="Karyawan Baru Masuk Tahun Ini" value={metrics.new_hire_this_year || 0} note={`Sejak Januari ${new Date().getFullYear()}`} icon={UserCheck} />
                                <KpiCard title="Karyawan Belum Pernah Training (<1 Tahun)" value={metrics.new_hire_no_training || 0} note="Perlu onboarding training" icon={UserPlus} />
                                <KpiCard title="Total Jam Pelatihan" value={metrics.training?.total_hours || 0} isDecimal={true} unit="Jam" secondaryText={`Unlinked: ${metrics.training?.unlinked_rows || 0}`} />
                                <KpiCard title="Training Coverage" value={metrics.training?.coverage_pct || 0} isDecimal={true} unit="%" />
                            </div>

                            {/* Executive Key Insight Card */}
                            <Deferred data="insight" fallback={<div className="h-20 bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl animate-pulse" />}>
                                <InsightCard insight={insight} resignInsight={resign_summary?.insights?.[0]} />
                            </Deferred>

                            {/* Section 5: Charts Grid */}
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                                <ChartCard title="Komposisi Generasi" loading={!metrics}>
                                    <DonutChart data={genData} dataKey="value" onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('generation', entry.name)} />
                                </ChartCard>

                                <ChartCard title="Generasi per Level Jabatan" loading={!metrics} className="lg:col-span-2">
                                    <StackedBar data={stackedData} keys={stackedKeys} xAxisKey="name" onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('generation', key)} />
                                </ChartCard>

                                <ChartCard title="Top 10 Perusahaan (HC)" loading={!metrics} className="lg:col-span-2">
                                    <HorizontalBar 
                                        data={companyData} 
                                        dataKey="value" 
                                        yAxisKey="name" 
                                        onClick={(entry) => {
                                            const comp = options?.companies?.find(c => c.name === entry.name || c.code === entry.name);
                                            if (comp) toggleFilter('company_id', String(comp.id));
                                            else toggleFilter('company_id', entry.name);
                                        }} 
                                    />
                                </ChartCard>

                                <ChartCard title="Tren Jam Pelatihan" loading={!metrics}>
                                    <LineTrend data={trainingTrendData} lines={[{ dataKey: 'value', name: 'Jam', stroke: '#10B981' }]} xAxisKey="name" />
                                </ChartCard>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                            <div className="text-gray-400 mb-2">
                                <svg className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4" />
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </Deferred>
            </div>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function InsightCard({ insight, resignInsight }) {
    if (!insight && !resignInsight) return null;
    return (
        <div className="relative overflow-hidden text-white p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950 via-[#004D40] to-emerald-900 border border-emerald-800/50">
            {/* Subtle light accent */}
            <div className="absolute -right-16 -top-16 w-56 h-56 bg-emerald-400/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
            
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-3 relative z-10">
                <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-400/20 rounded-xl text-emerald-300 shadow-2xs">
                    <Sparkles size={18} />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-200">
                    Executive Summary & Key Insights SDM
                </h3>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-2.5 relative z-10 text-xs sm:text-sm text-emerald-50/95 leading-relaxed font-medium">
                {insight && (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 mt-2 shrink-0 shadow-xs" />
                        <p>{insight}</p>
                    </div>
                )}
                {resignInsight && (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-teal-300 mt-2 shrink-0 shadow-xs" />
                        <p>{resignInsight}</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function DashboardSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 sm:gap-4">
                {[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-32 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-xl" />)}
            </div>
            <div className="h-28 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl lg:col-span-2" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl lg:col-span-2" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import AppLayout from '../Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Deferred } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { ChartCard } from '@/Components/ui/ChartCard';
import { HorizontalBar } from '@/Components/charts/HorizontalBar';
import { Histogram } from '@/Components/charts/Histogram';
import { PopulationPyramid } from '@/Components/charts/PopulationPyramid';
import { Heatmap } from '@/Components/charts/Heatmap';
import { StackedBar } from '@/Components/charts/StackedBar';
import { DonutChart } from '@/Components/charts/DonutChart';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';
import { useCopyAsImage } from '@/hooks/useCopyAsImage';
import { CopyButton } from '@/Components/ui/CopyButton';
import { useCrossFilter } from '@/hooks/useCrossFilter';

export default function Demographics({ metrics }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.total_hc > 0;
    
    // Derived datasets
    const regionData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_region)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    // Histogram data (Age)
    const ageBins = ['<25', '25-29', '30-34', '35-39', '40-44', '45-49', '50-54', '55+'];
    const ageDistData = hasData ? ageBins.map(bin => ({
        name: bin,
        value: metrics.age_distribution[bin] || 0
    })) : [];

    // Population Pyramid (Age x Gender)
    const popPyramidData = hasData ? ageBins.map(bin => ({
        name: bin,
        Male: (metrics.population_pyramid[bin]?.Male || 0) * -1, // Negative for left side
        Female: metrics.population_pyramid[bin]?.Female || 0
    })) : [];

    // Heatmap (Gen x Region)
    const regionNames = hasData ? Object.keys(metrics.hc_by_region).sort() : [];
    const genNames = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];
    const heatmapData = hasData ? regionNames.flatMap(region => 
        genNames.map(gen => ({
            y: region,
            x: gen,
            value: metrics.gen_by_region[region]?.[gen] || 0
        }))
    ) : [];

    // Avg Age by Dept
    const avgAgeDeptData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.avg_age_by_dept)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .slice(0, 15) : [];

    // HC per level
    const levelOrder = hasData && metrics.level_order ? metrics.level_order : [];
    const levelData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(lvl => ({
        name: `Level ${lvl}`,
        level: lvl,
        value: metrics.hc_by_level[lvl] || 0,
        top_titles: metrics.titles_by_level?.[lvl] || {}
    })).filter(d => d.value > 0) : [];

    // Gender by Level (Stacked)
    const genderLevelData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(lvl => ({
        name: `Level ${lvl}`,
        level: lvl,
        Male: metrics.gender_by_level[lvl]?.Male || 0,
        Female: metrics.gender_by_level[lvl]?.Female || 0,
        top_titles: metrics.titles_by_level?.[lvl] || {}
    })).filter(d => d.Male > 0 || d.Female > 0) : [];

    // Gender Donut
    const genderData = hasData ? [
        { name: 'Laki-laki', value: Object.values(metrics.gender_by_level).reduce((sum, g) => sum + (g.Male || 0), 0), fill: '#3B82F6' },
        { name: 'Perempuan', value: Object.values(metrics.gender_by_level).reduce((sum, g) => sum + (g.Female || 0), 0), fill: '#EC4899' }
    ] : [];

    // Marital Status
    const maritalData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.marital_status)
        .map(([name, value], i) => ({ name, value, fill: defaultPalette[i % defaultPalette.length] }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    // PTKP
    const ptkpData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.ptkp)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    // Job Titles (Top 10)
    const topJobTitles = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.job_titles)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];

    // Birth Places (Top 10)
    const topBirthPlaces = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.birth_places)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];

    // Employment by Region (Stacked)
    const empTypes = hasData ? [...new Set(Object.values(metrics.employment_by_region).flatMap(Object.keys))] : [];
    const empRegionData = hasData ? regionNames.map(region => {
        const row = { name: region };
        empTypes.forEach(type => {
            row[type] = metrics.employment_by_region[region]?.[type] || 0;
        });
        return row;
    }) : [];

    const { ref: top10Ref, isCopying: top10Copying, status: top10Status, handleCopy: handleTop10Copy } = useCopyAsImage({ 
        title: 'Top 10 Jabatan (HC)',
        onBeforeCapture: (el) => {
            el.style.height = 'max-content';
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-y-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = 'visible';
        },
        onAfterCapture: (el) => {
            el.style.height = '';
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-y-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = '';
        }
    });

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Demografi & Headcount">
            <Head title="Demografi & Headcount" />
            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<DemographicsSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
                        {/* Section 1: HC Overview */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="HC per Region">
                                <HorizontalBar data={regionData} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('region', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 2: Age & Gender */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Distribusi Umur (Histogram)" className="lg:col-span-1">
                                <Histogram data={ageDistData} xAxisKey="name" dataKey="value" />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Piramida Umur × Gender" className="lg:col-span-2">
                                <PopulationPyramid data={popPyramidData} yAxisKey="name" leftKey="Male" rightKey="Female" />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 3: Generations & Dept Age */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Generasi × Region (Heatmap)">
                                <Heatmap data={heatmapData} xLabels={genNames} yLabels={regionNames} expandable={false} title="Heatmap Generasi × Region" />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Rata-rata Umur per Departemen (Top 15, HC >= 5)">
                                <HorizontalBar data={avgAgeDeptData} color={defaultPalette[2]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 4: Job Levels & Gender Details */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="HC per Level Jabatan">
                                <HorizontalBar data={levelData} color={defaultPalette[3]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_level_code', entry.level || entry.name.replace('Level ', ''))} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Gender per Level Jabatan" className="lg:col-span-2">
                                <StackedBar data={genderLevelData} keys={['Male', 'Female']} xAxisKey="name" colors={{ Male: '#3B82F6', Female: '#EC4899' }} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 5: Demographics Details */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Gender">
                                <DonutChart data={genderData} colors={{ 'Laki-laki': '#3B82F6', 'Perempuan': '#EC4899' }} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('gender', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Status Pernikahan">
                                <DonutChart data={maritalData} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('marital_status', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="PTKP">
                                <HorizontalBar data={ptkpData} color={defaultPalette[4]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 6: Top Titles, Employment, Birth Place */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <div ref={top10Ref} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 flex flex-col h-80 relative transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1">
                                <CopyButton handleCopy={handleTop10Copy} status={top10Status} isCopying={top10Copying} />
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 pb-3 mb-4 pr-12 border-b border-gray-100/60">Top 10 Jabatan (HC)</h3>
                                <div className="space-y-3 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                                    {topJobTitles.map((jt, idx) => (
                                        <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-b pb-2 last:border-0">
                                            <span className="text-gray-700 truncate mr-2">{jt.name}</span>
                                            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 bg-gray-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">{formatNumber(jt.value)}</span>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <ChartCard title="Status Karyawan per Region">
                                <StackedBar data={empRegionData} keys={empTypes} xAxisKey="name" onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('employment_type', key)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            
                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Tempat Lahir">
                                <HorizontalBar data={topBirthPlaces} color={defaultPalette[5]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function DemographicsSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl lg:col-span-2" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

File: resources/js/Pages/Employees/Index.jsx

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { 
    Search, Download, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, 
    Columns, Table as TableIcon, Users, MapPin, Briefcase, Sparkles, Eye, X
} from 'lucide-react';
import StaffDetailPane from '@/Components/staff/StaffDetailPane';
import { formatDecimal } from '@/lib/format';
import EmployeeAvatar from '@/Components/EmployeeAvatar';

export default function EmployeeIndex({ employees, filters }) {
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(filters.search || '');
    const [selectedEmployeeId, setSelectedEmployeeId] = useState(filters.selected || null);

    const rightPaneRef = useRef(null);
    const [rightHeight, setRightHeight] = useState(null);

    // Sync left pane height with right pane height accurately
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!selectedEmployeeId) {
            setRightHeight(null);
            return;
        }

        const updateHeight = () => {
            if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth >= 1024 && rightPaneRef.current) {
                const h = Math.round(rightPaneRef.current.getBoundingClientRect().height);
                if (h > 100) {
                    setRightHeight(h);
                }
            } else {
                setRightHeight(null);
            }
        };

        updateHeight();

        let animId = null;
        const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
            animId = requestAnimationFrame(updateHeight);
        });

        if (rightPaneRef.current) {
            observer.observe(rightPaneRef.current);
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', updateHeight);

        return () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
            observer.disconnect();
            window.removeEventListener('resize', updateHeight);
        };
    }, [selectedEmployeeId]);

    const handleSearch = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, search: searchTerm, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handleSort = (column) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        let newOrder = 'asc';
        if (currentSort === column) {
            newOrder = currentOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        }

        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, sort: column, order: newOrder, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handlePerPageChange = (e) => {
        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, per_page: e.target.value, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const renderEmploymentBadge = (type) => {
        const normalized = (type || '').toUpperCase();
        if (normalized === 'PERMANENT' || normalized === 'PERM') {
            return (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/70">
                    Permanent
                </span>
            );
        }
        if (normalized === 'CONTRACT' || normalized === 'PKWT') {
            return (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/70">
                    Contract
                </span>
            );
        }
        if (normalized === 'PROBATION') {
            return (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border border-sky-200/70">
                    Probation
                </span>
            );
        }
        if (normalized === 'TRAINEE') {
            return (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold bg-purple-50 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200/70">
                    Trainee
                </span>
            );
        }
        return (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                {type || '-'}
            </span>
        );
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        if (currentSort !== column) {
            return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1">↕</span>;
        }
        
        return currentOrder === 'asc' ? 
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" /> : 
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />;
    };

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Direktori Karyawan">
            <Head title="Direktori Karyawan" />

            {/* TOP EXECUTIVE HEADER */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
                        Direktori Karyawan
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                        Daftar dan profil komprehensif tenaga kerja operasional ({employees.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')} total staf).
                    </p>
                </div>
                
                {/* Right Tools: View Toggle & Export */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
                    {/* View Mode Toggle / Reset */}
                    {selectedEmployeeId ? (
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(null)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs border border-gray-200 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Tutup Detail dan Kembali ke Tabel Penuh"
                        >
                            <TableIcon size={14} className="text-[#004D40]" />
                            <span>Tabel Penuh</span>
                            <X size={13} className="text-slate-400" />
                        </button>
                    ) : (
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(employees.data?.[0]?.employee_id || null)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs border border-gray-200 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Buka Mode Split Master-Detail"
                        >
                            <Columns size={14} className="text-[#004D40]" />
                            <span>Mode Split Detail</span>
                        </button>
                    )}

                    <a 
                        href={`/karyawan/export?${new URLSearchParams(filters).toString()}`}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#004D40] hover:bg-[#00382e] text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-xs border border-emerald-900/10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                        <Download size={14} />
                        <span>Export Excel</span>
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* GLOBAL FILTER BAR */}
            <FilterBar />

            {/* CONDITIONAL RENDER: SPLIT DETAIL vs FULL-WIDTH TABLE */}
            {selectedEmployeeId ? (
                /* MODE 1: MASTER-DETAIL SPLIT VIEW (EQUAL HEIGHT ALIGNED BOTTOM) */
                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-5 items-start animate-in fade-in duration-300">
                    {/* LEFT PANE: MASTER LIST OF EMPLOYEES (Height matches Right Pane exactly) */}
                    <div 
                        className="w-full lg:w-[380px] xl:w-[400px] shrink-0 bg-white border border-gray-200/90 rounded-xl shadow-2xs overflow-hidden flex flex-col transition-[height] duration-150"
                        style={rightHeight ? { height: `${rightHeight}px`, maxHeight: `${rightHeight}px` } : undefined}
                    >
                        {/* Search and Header Box */}
                        <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-gray-100 bg-slate-50/70 space-y-2.5 shrink-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <Users size={14} className="text-[#004D40]" />
                                    <span>Daftar Karyawan</span>
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-100/70 text-[#004D40] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-200/60">
                                    {employees.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')} Staf
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="relative">
                                <input
                                    type="text"
                                    placeholder="Cari nama, NIK, jabatan..."
                                    value={searchTerm}
                                    onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                                    className="w-full pl-8 pr-8 py-1.5 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all font-medium"
                                />
                                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5" />
                                {searchTerm && (
                                    <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            setSearchTerm('');
                                            router.get('/karyawan', { ...filters, search: '', page: 1 }, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
                                        }}
                                        className="absolute right-2.5 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                                    >
                                        ✕
                                    </button>
                                )}
                            </form>
                        </div>

                        {/* Scrollable List of Staff Cards (Fills Remaining Height to Match Right Pane) */}
                        <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1">
                            {employees.data.length > 0 ? (
                                employees.data.map((emp) => {
                                    const isSelected = selectedEmployeeId === emp.employee_id;
                                    return (
                                        <div
                                            key={emp.id}
                                            onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(emp.employee_id)}
                                            className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-3 relative group ${
                                                isSelected
                                                    ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 border-emerald-300 ring-1 ring-[#004D40]/20 shadow-2xs'
                                                    : 'bg-white border-slate-200/70 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300 shadow-2xs'
                                            }`}
                                        >
                                            {/* Active Left Indicator Bar */}
                                            {isSelected && (
                                                <div className="absolute left-0 top-2.5 bottom-2.5 w-1 bg-[#004D40] rounded-r" />
                                            )}

                                            {/* Avatar */}
                                            <div className="shrink-0 pl-1">
                                                <EmployeeAvatar name={emp.name} photoUrl={emp.photo_url} size="md" />
                                            </div>

                                            {/* Info Content */}
                                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                                                    <p className={`text-xs font-black truncate leading-tight ${
                                                        isSelected ? 'text-[#004D40]' : 'text-slate-900 group-hover:text-[#004D40]'
                                                    }`}>
                                                        {emp.name}
                                                    </p>
                                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                                                        {emp.employee_id}
                                                    </span>
                                                </div>

                                                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 truncate mt-0.5 font-semibold">
                                                    {emp.job_title}
                                                </p>

                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                                    <span className="truncate max-w-[130px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                                                        {emp.location_name || emp.company_name}
                                                    </span>
                                                    <span>·</span>
                                                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 px-1 py-0.2 bg-slate-100 rounded">
                                                        {emp.level}
                                                    </span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    );
                                })
                            ) : (
                                <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 p-4">
                                    <Users size={30} className="mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50 text-slate-300" />
                                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">Karyawan Tidak Ditemukan</p>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter aktif.</p>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Left Pane Pagination Controls (Pinned at bottom) */}
                        {employees.total > 0 && (
                            <div className="p-2.5 border-t border-gray-100 bg-slate-50/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 shrink-0 mt-auto">
                                <span className="text-[11px]">
                                    Hal <b className="text-slate-900">{employees.current_page}</b> dari <b className="text-slate-900">{employees.last_page}</b>
                                </span>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                    {employees.prev_page_url ? (
                                        <Link
                                            href={employees.prev_page_url}
                                            preserveScroll
                                            preserveState
                                            className="p-1 rounded-md bg-white border border-gray-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 shadow-2xs"
                                            title="Halaman Sebelumnya"
                                        >
                                            <ChevronLeft size={13} />
                                        </Link>
                                    ) : (
                                        <span className="p-1 rounded-md text-slate-300 border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 cursor-not-allowed">
                                            <ChevronLeft size={13} />
                                        </span>
                                    )}

                                    {employees.next_page_url ? (
                                        <Link
                                            href={employees.next_page_url}
                                            preserveScroll
                                            preserveState
                                            className="p-1 rounded-md bg-white border border-gray-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 shadow-2xs"
                                            title="Halaman Berikutnya"
                                        >
                                            <ChevronRight size={13} />
                                        </Link>
                                    ) : (
                                        <span className="p-1 rounded-md text-slate-300 border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 cursor-not-allowed">
                                            <ChevronRight size={13} />
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* RIGHT PANE: DETAIL PROFILE (ANIMATED SLIDE-IN) */}
                    <div ref={rightPaneRef} className="flex-1 min-w-0 w-full flex flex-col gap-3.5 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right duration-300">
                        {/* Top Action Ribbon for Detail */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white p-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200/90 shadow-2xs shrink-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                                <span>Menampilkan Profil: <b className="text-slate-900">{employees.data.find(e => e.employee_id === selectedEmployeeId)?.name || selectedEmployeeId}</b></span>
                            </div>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(null)}
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer"
                                title="Kembali ke Tampilan Tabel Penuh"
                            >
                                <TableIcon size={14} className="text-[#004D40]" />
                                <span>Kembali ke Tabel Penuh</span>
                                <X size={13} className="text-slate-400" />
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <StaffDetailPane employeeId={selectedEmployeeId} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            ) : (
                /* MODE 2: FULL-WIDTH TABLE VIEW (DEFAULT BEFORE CLICK) */
                <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200/90 rounded-xl shadow-2xs overflow-hidden flex flex-col animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-gray-50/60">
                        <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex relative w-full sm:w-80">
                            <input
                                type="text"
                                placeholder="Cari nama, NIK, atau jabatan..."
                                value={searchTerm}
                                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-1.5 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all"
                            />
                            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-2" />
                            <button type="submit" className="hidden">Search</button>
                        </form>
                        
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Tampilkan:</span>
                            <select 
                                value={filters.per_page || 25} 
                                onChange={handlePerPageChange}
                                className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer font-semibold"
                            >
                                <option value="10">10</option>
                                <option value="15">15</option>
                                <option value="25">25</option>
                                <option value="50">50</option>
                                <option value="100">100</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-270px)] relative">
                        <table className="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse">
                            <thead className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 uppercase bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur-xs border-b border-gray-200/80 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-2xs">
                                <tr>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('employee_id')}>
                                        NIK <SortIcon column="employee_id" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('name')}>
                                        Nama Karyawan <SortIcon column="name" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('company_name')}>
                                        Perusahaan <SortIcon column="company_name" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('location_name')}>
                                        Lokasi <SortIcon column="location_name" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('organization_name')}>
                                        Departemen <SortIcon column="organization_name" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('job_title_name')}>
                                        Jabatan <SortIcon column="job_title_name" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-center" onClick={() => handleSort('job_level_code')}>
                                        Level <SortIcon column="job_level_code" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-center" onClick={() => handleSort('generasi')}>
                                        Generasi <SortIcon column="generasi" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('umur')}>
                                        Umur <SortIcon column="umur" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('masa_kerja')}>
                                        Masa Kerja <SortIcon column="masa_kerja" />
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-center" onClick={() => handleSort('employment_type')}>
                                        Status <SortIcon column="employment_type" />
                                    </th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                                {employees.data.length > 0 ? (
                                    employees.data.map((emp) => (
                                        <tr 
                                            key={emp.id} 
                                            onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(emp.employee_id)}
                                            className="hover:bg-emerald-50/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                                            title="Klik untuk membuka detail profil"
                                        >
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <span className="bg-gray-100/70 text-gray-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-gray-200/50">
                                                    {emp.employee_id}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                                    <EmployeeAvatar name={emp.name} photoUrl={emp.photo_url} size="sm" />
                                                    <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-emerald-800 transition-colors">{emp.name}</span>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-700">{emp.company_name}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{emp.location_name}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{emp.department}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-700 font-medium">{emp.job_title}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                                                <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200/60">
                                                    {emp.level}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
                                                {emp.generasi}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-gray-700 font-medium">{formatDecimal(emp.umur)}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-gray-700 font-medium">{formatDecimal(emp.masa_kerja)}</td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                                                {renderEmploymentBadge(emp.employment_type)}
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    ))
                                ) : (
                                    <tr>
                                        <td colSpan="11" className="px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
                                            <p className="text-base font-medium text-gray-700">Tidak ada data karyawan yang ditemukan</p>
                                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter yang aktif.</p>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                )}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Pagination */}
                    {employees.total > 0 && (
                        <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 bg-white">
                            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                                Menampilkan <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{employees.from}</span> - <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{employees.to}</span> dari <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{employees.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span> karyawan
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end gap-1">
                                {employees.links.map((link, i) => {
                                    const rawLabel = String(link.label || '');
                                    const labelLower = rawLabel.toLowerCase();
                                    const isPrev = labelLower.includes('previous') || rawLabel.includes('«') || rawLabel.includes('&laquo;');
                                    const isNext = labelLower.includes('next') || rawLabel.includes('»') || rawLabel.includes('&raquo;');
                                    
                                    return link.url ? (
                                        <Link
                                            key={i}
                                            href={link.url}
                                            preserveScroll
                                            preserveState
                                            className={`min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                                                link.active 
                                                    ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-2xs font-bold' 
                                                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900'
                                            }`}
                                        >
                                            {isPrev ? <ChevronLeft size={14} /> : isNext ? <ChevronRight size={14} /> : <span>{link.label}</span>}
                                        </Link>
                                    ) : (
                                        <span key={i} className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-300">
                                            {isPrev ? <ChevronLeft size={14} /> : isNext ? <ChevronRight size={14} /> : <span>{link.label}</span>}
                                        </span>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { KeyRound } from 'lucide-react';

export default function UpdatePasswordForm({ className = '' }) {
    const passwordInput = useRef();
    const currentPasswordInput = useRef();

    const { data, setData, errors, put, reset, processing, recentlySuccessful } = useForm({
        current_password: '',
        password: '',
        password_confirmation: '',
    });

    const updatePassword = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();

        put('/pengaturan/password', {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => reset(),
            onError: (errors) => {
                if (errors.password) {
                    reset('password', 'password_confirmation');
                    passwordInput.current.focus();
                }

                if (errors.current_password) {
                    reset('current_password');
                    currentPasswordInput.current.focus();
                }
            },
        });
    };

    return (
        <section className={className}>
            <header>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Ubah Password</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    Pastikan akun Anda menggunakan password yang panjang (minimal 12 karakter) dan acak agar tetap aman.
                </p>
            </header>

            <form onSubmit={updatePassword} className="mt-6 space-y-6 max-w-xl">
                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="current_password" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Password Saat Ini</label>
                    <input
                        id="current_password"
                        ref={currentPasswordInput}
                        value={data.current_password}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('current_password', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="current-password"
                    />
                    {errors.current_password && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">{errors.current_password}</p>}
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Password Baru (Min. 12 karakter)</label>
                    <input
                        id="password"
                        ref={passwordInput}
                        value={data.password}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('password', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="new-password"
                    />
                    {errors.password && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">{errors.password}</p>}
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="password_confirmation" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Konfirmasi Password Baru</label>
                    <input
                        id="password_confirmation"
                        value={data.password_confirmation}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('password_confirmation', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="new-password"
                    />
                    {errors.password_confirmation && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">{errors.password_confirmation}</p>}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={processing}
                        className="bg-corporate-dark hover:bg-corporate-light text-white font-bold py-2.5 px-5 rounded-lg transition-colors disabled:opacity-70 flex items-center gap-2"
                    >
                        <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4" />
                        Ubah Password
                    </button>

                    {recentlySuccessful && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-green-600 font-medium bg-green-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-md border border-green-100 transition-opacity">
                            Password berhasil diubah.
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            </form>
        </section>
    );
}
