                                unit="jam" 
                                icon={Target} 
                                description="Rata-rata akumulasi durasi jam pelatihan yang diterima oleh setiap peserta." 
                            />
                            <KpiCard 
                                title="Total Hari" 
                                value={kpi.total_days} 
                                isDecimal 
                                unit="hari" 
                                icon={Calendar} 
                                description="Total durasi pelaksanaan seluruh program pelatihan dalam satuan hari." 
                            />
                            <KpiCard 
                                title="Jenis Pelatihan" 
                                value={kpi.unique_trainings} 
                                icon={GraduationCap} 
                                description="Ragam topik atau judul program pelatihan yang telah diselenggarakan." 
                            />
                        </div>

                        {/* Trend */}
                        <ChartCard title="Tren Jam & Peserta Pelatihan" className="h-96">
                            <LineTrend 
                                data={trendData} 
                                xAxisKey="name" 
                                keys={['hours', 'participants']} 
                                colors={{ hours: defaultPalette[0], participants: defaultPalette[1] }} 
                                labels={{ hours: 'Total Jam (Sumbu Kiri)', participants: 'Jumlah Peserta (Sumbu Kanan)' }}
                                dualAxis={true}
                            />
                        </ChartCard>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Reguler vs Non Reguler">
                                <DonutChart data={regularityData} unit="partisipasi" onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('is_regular', entry.name === 'Reguler' ? '1' : '0')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Internal vs Eksternal">
                                <DonutChart data={sourceData} unit="partisipasi" onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('is_internal', entry.name === 'Internal' ? '1' : '0')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Gender x Level (Peserta)">
                                <StackedBar data={genderLevelData} keys={['Male', 'Female']} xAxisKey="name" colors={{ Male: '#3B82F6', Female: '#EC4899' }} onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('gender', key === 'Male' ? 'Laki-laki' : 'Perempuan')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Hours Breakdowns */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam per Region">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursRegion} color={defaultPalette[3]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('region', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam - Golongan">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursGol} color={defaultPalette[0]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_category', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam - Level">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursLevel} color={defaultPalette[1]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_level_code', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        <ChartCard title="Total Jam per Departemen (Top 15)" height="h-[460px]">
                            <HorizontalBar data={hoursDept} color={defaultPalette[5]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('organization_name', entry.name)} />
                        </ChartCard>

                        {/* Datatable */}
                        <TrainingTable filters={filters} />
                        
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function TrainingTable({ filters }) {
    const [data, setData] = useState([]);
    const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ from: 0, to: 0, total: 0, page: 1, lastPage: 1 });
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [perPage, setPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [sort, setSort] = useState('year');
    const [dir, setDir] = useState('desc');
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        setLoading(true);
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (search) params.append('search', search);
        params.append('page', page);
        params.append('per_page', perPage);
        params.append('sort', sort);
        params.append('direction', dir);
        
        // Append active filters
        Object.entries(filters || {}).forEach(([k, v]) => {
            if (Array.isArray(v)) {
                v.forEach(val => params.append(`${k}[]`, val));
            } else if (v) {
                params.append(k, v);
            }
        });

        axios.get(`/data/trainings?${params.toString()}`).then(res => {
            setData(res.data.data || []);
            setMeta({
                from: res.data.from || 0,
                to: res.data.to || 0,
                total: res.data.total || 0,
                page: res.data.current_page || 1,
                lastPage: res.data.last_page || 1,
            });
            setLoading(false);
        }).catch(err => {
            console.error(err);
            setLoading(false);
        });
    }, [page, perPage, search, sort, dir, filters]);

    const handleSort = (field) => {
        if (sort === field) {
            setDir(dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSort(field);
            setDir('asc');
        }
        setPage(1);
    };

    const getPageNumbers = (current, total) => {
        if (total <= 7) {
            return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
        }
        if (current <= 4) {
            return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, '...', total];
        }
        if (current >= total - 3) {
            return [1, '...', total - 4, total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
        }
        return [1, '...', current - 1, current, current + 1, '...', total];
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        if (sort !== column) {
            return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1 text-xs">↕</span>;
        }
        return dir === 'asc' ? (
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        ) : (
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
        );
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
            {/* Header Box / Toolbar */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-gray-50/60">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-base">Daftar Pelatihan</h3>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-600">
                            {meta.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')} Agenda
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline text-gray-300">|</span>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                        Rekapitulasi program pelatihan dan intensitas keikutsertaan peserta.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
                    {/* Search */}
                    <div className="relative flex-1 sm:flex-initial sm:w-64">
                        <input 
                            type="text" 
                            placeholder="Cari nama pelatihan..." 
                            className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all"
                            value={search}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
                        />
                        <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                        {search && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => { setSearch(''); setPage(1); }}
                                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                                title="Hapus pencarian"
                            >
                                <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Per-Page Selector */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select 
                            value={perPage} 
                            onChange={(e) => { setPerPage(Number(e.target.value)); setPage(1); }}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-xs sm:text-sm bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer font-medium"
                        >
                            <option value="10">10</option>
                            <option value="25">25</option>
                            <option value="50">50</option>
                            <option value="100">100</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Link ke Tabel Mentah */}
                    <Link
                        href="/pelatihan/data"
                        className="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#004D40] bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200/80 rounded-xl hover:bg-emerald-100 transition-colors shadow-2xs shrink-0"
                        title="Buka tabel lengkap seluruh catatan peserta training"
                    >
                        <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5 text-emerald-700" />
                        <span>Data Mentah</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />
                    </Link>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Table Area */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto relative min-h-[300px]">
                {loading && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xs flex items-center justify-center z-20">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-3 border-emerald-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    </div>
                )}
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm border-collapse">
                    <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur-xs border-b border-gray-200/80 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-2xs">
                        <tr>
                            <th 
                                className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" 
                                onClick={() => handleSort('training_name')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Nama Pelatihan</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="training_name" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" 
                                onClick={() => handleSort('year')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Periode</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="year" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" 
                                onClick={() => handleSort('participants')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Peserta</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="participants" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" 
                                onClick={() => handleSort('total_hours')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                    <span>Total Jam</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="total_hours" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                            <th className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                                <span>Rata-rata Jam</span>
                            </th>
                            <th 
                                className="px-5 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-center" 
                                onClick={() => handleSort('source_type')}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                    <span>Tipe Sumber</span>
                                    <SortIcon column="source_type" />
                                </div>
                            </th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                        {data.length > 0 ? data.map((row, idx) => {
                            const avgHours = row.participants > 0 ? (row.total_hours / row.participants) : 0;
                            return (
                                <tr key={`${row.training_name}-${row.year}-${row.month}-${idx}`} className="hover:bg-emerald-50/30 transition-colors">
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                        <span className="line-clamp-2" title={row.training_name}>
                                            {row.training_name}
                                        </span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs">
                                        {String(row.month).padStart(2, '0')}/{row.year}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 whitespace-nowrap text-right font-medium text-gray-800">
                                        {formatNumber(row.participants)}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 whitespace-nowrap text-right font-semibold text-gray-900">
                                        {formatDecimal(row.total_hours)} jam
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-gray-600 text-xs">
                                        {formatDecimal(avgHours)} jam/org
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3.5 whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold ${
                                            row.source_type === 'Internal' 
                                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200/60' 
                                                : row.source_type === 'Eksternal'
                                                ? 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200/60'
                                                : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200'
                                        }`}>
                                            {row.source_type || 'Unknown'}
                                        </span>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            );
                        }) : (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan="6" className="px-6 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
                                    {!loading && (
                                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                                            <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-gray-50 text-gray-400">
                                                <GraduationCap size={24} />
                                            </div>
                                            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-700">Tidak ada data pelatihan ditemukan</p>
                                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter yang aktif.</p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        )}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
            
            {/* Pagination Footer */}
            {meta.total > 0 && (
                <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 bg-white">
                    <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Menampilkan <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{meta.from}</span> - <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{meta.to}</span> dari <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{meta.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span> pelatihan
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end gap-1">
                        <button 
                            type="button"
                            disabled={page === 1 || loading}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                            className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                            aria-label="Sebelumnya"
                        >
                            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                        </button>

                        {getPageNumbers(page, meta.lastPage).map((item, idx) => (
                            item === '...' ? (
                                <span key={`ellipsis-${idx}`} className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-300">
                                    ...
                                </span>
                            ) : (
                                <button
                                    key={item}
                                    type="button"
                                    disabled={loading}
                                    onClick={() => setPage(item)}
                                    className={`min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                                        page === item
                                            ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-2xs'
                                            : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900'
                                    }`}
                                >
                                    {item}
                                </button>
                            )
                        ))}

                        <button 
                            type="button"
                            disabled={page === meta.lastPage || meta.lastPage === 0 || loading}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.min(meta.lastPage, p + 1))}
                            className="min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900 cursor-pointer"
                            aria-label="Selanjutnya"
                        >
                            <ChevronRight size={16} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function TrainingSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
                {[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />)}
            </div>
            <div className="h-96 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { Search, Download, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, AlertCircle, X, BarChart2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { StaffDetailModal } from '@/Components/staff/StaffDetailModal';

export default function TrainingData({ records, filters }) {
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(filters.search || '');
    const [selectedEmployee, setSelectedEmployee] = useState(null);

    const handleSearch = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, search: searchTerm, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handleSort = (column) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'participant_name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        let newOrder = 'asc';
        if (currentSort === column) {
            newOrder = currentOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        }

        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, sort: column, order: newOrder, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handlePerPageChange = (e) => {
        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, per_page: e.target.value, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'participant_name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        if (currentSort !== column) {
            return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1">↕</span>;
        }
        
        return currentOrder === 'asc' ? 
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-emerald-700" /> : 
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-emerald-700" />;
    };

    const renderNikBadge = (status) => {
        if (status === 'ok') return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200/60 ml-2">OK</span>;
        if (status === 'empty') return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 ml-2">KOSONG</span>;
        if (status === 'corrupt') return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-rose-200/60 ml-2">RUSAK</span>;
        return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-200/60 ml-2">TIDAK VALID</span>;
    };

    const renderConnectionBadge = (isLinked) => {
        if (isLinked) {
            return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200/60 whitespace-nowrap">TERHUBUNG KE KARYAWAN</span>;
        }
        return <span className="inline-flex items-center bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap">TIDAK TERHUBUNG</span>;
    };

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Data Training Mentah">
            <Head title="Data Training Mentah" />

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">Data Training Mentah</h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                        Daftar lengkap riwayat keikutsertaan pelatihan ({records.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data).
                    </p>
                </div>
                
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0 self-start sm:self-auto">
                    <Link
                        href="/pelatihan"
                        className="inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
                    >
                        <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        Dashboard Analitik
                    </Link>
                    <a 
                        href={`/pelatihan/data/export?${new URLSearchParams(filters).toString()}`}
                        className="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 bg-[#004D40] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#00382e] transition-colors font-medium text-sm shadow-xs border border-emerald-900/10 shrink-0"
                    >
                        <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                        Export Excel
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>

            <FilterBar />

            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-gray-50/60">
                    <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex relative w-full sm:w-80">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Cari peserta, NIK, pelatihan, PT..."
                            value={searchTerm}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full pl-10 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-sm bg-white shadow-2xs transition-all"
                        />
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
                        {searchTerm && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSearchTerm('');
                                    router.get('/pelatihan/data', { ...filters, search: '', page: 1 }, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
                                }}
                                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                                title="Hapus pencarian"
                            >
                                <X size={14} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                        <button type="submit" className="hidden">Search</button>
                    </form>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select 
                            value={filters.per_page || 25} 
                            onChange={handlePerPageChange}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-600 text-sm bg-white shadow-2xs cursor-pointer"
                        >
                            <option value="25">25</option>
                            <option value="50">50</option>
                            <option value="100">100</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-270px)] relative">
                    <table className="w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse">
                        <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur-xs border-b border-gray-200/80 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-2xs">
                            <tr>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('nik')}>
                                    NIK / NIK Mentah <SortIcon column="nik" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('participant_name')}>
                                    Nama Peserta <SortIcon column="participant_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-center">Status Terhubung</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('training_name')}>
                                    Nama Pelatihan <SortIcon column="training_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('pt_name')}>
                                    Nama PT <SortIcon column="pt_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('department')}>
                                    Departemen <SortIcon column="department" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('work_location')}>
                                    Lokasi Kerja <SortIcon column="work_location" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('region')}>
                                    Region <SortIcon column="region" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('job_category')}>
                                    Golongan <SortIcon column="job_category" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('period_year')}>
                                    Periode <SortIcon column="period_year" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('hours')}>
                                    Jam <SortIcon column="hours" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-50/40 hover:text-emerald-900 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('is_internal')}>
                                    Tipe <SortIcon column="is_internal" />
                                </th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
                            {records.data.length > 0 ? (
                                records.data.map((rec) => (
                                    <tr key={rec.id} className="hover:bg-emerald-50/30 transition-colors group">
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 bg-gray-100/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-gray-200/50">
                                                {rec.nik || '-'}
                                            </span>
                                            {renderNikBadge(rec.nik_status)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {rec.employee ? (
                                                <button 
                                                    onClick={() => setSelectedEmployee(rec.employee)}
                                                    className="text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 hover:underline text-left transition-colors font-semibold"
                                                    title="Klik untuk melihat detail profil karyawan"
                                                >
                                                    {rec.participant_name}
                                                </button>
                                            ) : (
                                                <span title="Tidak dapat dihubungkan ke data karyawan" className="text-gray-900">
                                                    {rec.participant_name}
                                                </span>
                                            )}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                                            {renderConnectionBadge(!!rec.employee_id)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-800 font-medium max-w-[220px] truncate" title={rec.training_name}>
                                            {rec.training_name}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <div className="text-gray-900 font-medium">{rec.pt_name}</div>
                                            {rec.company_alias !== '-' && <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Alias: {rec.company_alias}</div>}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{rec.department || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{rec.work_location || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{rec.region || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{rec.job_category || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-600">{rec.period_month}/{rec.period_year}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right font-semibold text-gray-900">{rec.hours}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-xs">
                                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                                                <span className="text-gray-600 font-medium">{rec.is_internal ? 'Internal' : 'Eksternal'}</span>
                                                <span className="text-gray-400">{rec.is_regular ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler'}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ))
                            ) : (
                                <tr>
                                    <td colSpan="12" className="px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
                                        <p className="text-base font-medium text-gray-700">Tidak ada data training yang ditemukan</p>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter yang aktif.</p>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            )}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>

                {/* Pagination Controls */}
                <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 bg-white">
                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Menampilkan <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{records.from || 0}</span> - <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{records.to || 0}</span> dari <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{records.total?.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span> data
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap justify-center sm:justify-end gap-1">
                        {records.links.map((link, i) => {
                            const isPrev = String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('previous');
                            const isNext = String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('next');
                            let label = isPrev ? <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> : isNext ? <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: link.label }}></span>;
                            
                            return link.url ? (
                                <Link
                                    key={i}
                                    href={link.url}
                                    className={`
                                        flex items-center justify-center min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 text-sm rounded-lg transition-colors
                                        ${link.active 
                                            ? 'bg-[#004D40] text-white shadow-2xs font-semibold' 
                                            : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 hover:text-emerald-900'}
                                    `}
                                    preserveState
                                    preserveScroll
                                >
                                    {label}
                                </Link>
                            ) : (
                                <span key={i} className="flex items-center justify-center min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-2.5 text-sm text-gray-300">
                                    {label}
                                </span>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {selectedEmployee && (
                <StaffDetailModal 
                    employeeId={selectedEmployee.employee_id} 
                    onClose={() => setSelectedEmployee(null)} 
                />
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

Artisan::command('inspire', function () {

    ->dailyAt(config('services.portal.sync_time', '02:00'))
    ->timezone(config('app.timezone'))
    ->withoutOverlapping(30)

    ->when(fn () => (bool) config('services.portal.sync_enabled'))
    ->onFailure(function () {

    return redirect('/dashboard');

// Authentication routes
Route::middleware('guest')->group(function () {
    Route::get('/login', function () {
        return Inertia::render('Auth/Login', [
            'turnstileSiteKey' => config('services.turnstile.key'),
            'turnstileEnabled' => (bool) config('services.turnstile.enabled', true),
        ]);
    })->name('login');

    Route::post('/login', function (Request $request) {
        $rules = [
            'nik' => ['required', 'string'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ];

        $turnstileEnabled = (bool) config('services.turnstile.enabled', true) && ! app()->environment('testing');
        if ($turnstileEnabled) {
            $rules['turnstile_token'] = ['required', 'string'];
        }

        $credentials = $request->validate($rules, [
            'nik.required' => 'Nomor Induk Karyawan (NIK) wajib diisi.',
            'password.required' => 'Kata sandi wajib diisi.',
            'turnstile_token.required' => 'Harap selesaikan verifikasi keamanan (Cloudflare).',
        ]);

        if ($turnstileEnabled) {
            $http = Http::asForm()->timeout(10);
            if (app()->environment('local') || ! (bool) config('services.turnstile.verify_ssl', true)) {
                $http = $http->withoutVerifying();
            }

            try {
                $response = $http->post('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify', [
                    'secret' => config('services.turnstile.secret'),
                    'response' => $credentials['turnstile_token'],
                    'remoteip' => $request->ip(),
                ]);

                if (! $response->json('success')) {
                    return back()->withErrors([
                        'turnstile_token' => 'Verifikasi keamanan tidak valid atau kedaluwarsa. Silakan centang ulang.',
                    ]);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                Log::warning('Turnstile verification failed to reach Cloudflare: '.$e->getMessage());

                return back()->withErrors([
                    'turnstile_token' => 'Gagal memverifikasi keamanan ke server Cloudflare. Silakan periksa koneksi internet atau coba beberapa saat lagi.',
                ]);
            }
        }

        $user = User::where('nik', $credentials['nik'])->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($credentials['password'], $user->password)) {
            return back()->withErrors([
                'nik' => 'Nomor Induk Karyawan (NIK) atau kata sandi yang Anda masukkan tidak sesuai.',
            ]);
        }

        if (! $user->is_active) {
            return back()->withErrors([
                'nik' => 'Akun Anda telah dinonaktifkan. Silakan hubungi Administrator.',
            ]);
        }

        Auth::login($user, $request->boolean('remember'));
        $user->update(['last_login_at' => now()]);
        $request->session()->regenerate();

        return redirect()->intended('dashboard');
    });
});

        $metricsService = new WorkforceMetrics($asOf);
        $resignService = new ResignationMetrics;

        return Inertia::render('Dashboard', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user())),
            'resign_summary' => Inertia::defer(function () use ($resignService, $request, $metricsService, $filter) {
                $metrics = $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user());
                $totalHc = $metrics['raw_totals']['total_hc'] ?? 0;

                return $resignService->getSummary($request, $totalHc);
            }),
            'insight' => Inertia::defer(function () use ($metricsService, $request, $filter) {
                $metrics = $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user());

                return InsightBuilder::build($metrics['raw_totals'], $metrics['avg_age'], $metrics['raw_totals']['total_hc']);
            }),
            'filters' => $request->all(),
        ]);

<?php

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;

$locations = Location::pluck('name', 'id')->toArray();

$facilities = ['Estate' => [], 'Mill' => [], 'HO' => []];
$regions = ['Sumatera' => [], 'Kalimantan' => [], 'Jawa / HO' => [], 'Lainnya' => []];

foreach (Employee::all() as $e) {
    $locName = $locations[$e->location_id] ?? '';
    $regionStr = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
    $orgName = $e->organization_name ?? '';

    // Facility Logic
    $facilityType = match (true) {
        stripos($locName, 'office') !== false || stripos($locName, 'jakarta') !== false => 'HO',
        stripos($locName, 'pabrik') !== false || stripos($locName, 'mill') !== false || stripos($locName, 'kcp') !== false || stripos($locName, 'biodiesel') !== false || stripos($locName, 'bulking') !== false => 'Mill',
        default => 'Estate'
    };

    // Region Logic
    $targetRegion = 'Lainnya';
    if (stripos($regionStr, 'riau') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'sumatera') !== false) {
        $targetRegion = 'Sumatera';
    } elseif (stripos($regionStr, 'kalbar') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'kubar') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'kalimantan') !== false) {
        $targetRegion = 'Kalimantan';
    } elseif (stripos($regionStr, 'corp') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'jakarta') !== false) {
        $targetRegion = 'Jawa / HO';
    }

    $key = "$locName ($orgName)";

    if (! isset($facilities[$facilityType][$key])) {
        $facilities[$facilityType][$key] = 0;
    }
    $facilities[$facilityType][$key]++;

    if (! isset($regions[$targetRegion][$key])) {
        $regions[$targetRegion][$key] = 0;
    }
    $regions[$targetRegion][$key]++;
}

echo "=== LAINNYA REGIONS ===\n";
arsort($regions['Lainnya']);
foreach ($regions['Lainnya'] as $k => $v) {
    echo "$k: $v\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 ESTATE ===\n";
$estateKeys = array_keys($facilities['Estate']);
shuffle($estateKeys);
foreach (array_slice($estateKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 MILL ===\n";
$millKeys = array_keys($facilities['Mill']);
shuffle($millKeys);
foreach (array_slice($millKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 HO ===\n";
$hoKeys = array_keys($facilities['HO']);
shuffle($hoKeys);
foreach (array_slice($hoKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\nTOTAL HC: ".Employee::count()."\n";

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_guest_redirected_to_login()
    {
        $this->get('/dashboard')->assertRedirect('/login');
        // /peta masih ada (redirect 301 ke /perusahaan, tapi guest diredirect ke login lebih dulu)
        $this->get('/peta')->assertRedirect('/login');
        // /admin/lokasi sudah dihapus -> 404
        $this->get('/admin/lokasi')->assertStatus(404);
        $this->getJson('/data/companies')->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_authenticated_user_can_access_all()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/dashboard')->assertStatus(200);
        // /peta redirect ke /perusahaan
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/peta')->assertRedirect('/perusahaan');
        // /perusahaan harus 200
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/perusahaan')->assertStatus(200);
        // /admin/lokasi sudah tidak ada
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/admin/lokasi')->assertStatus(404);
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/karyawan')->assertStatus(200);
        $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/data/companies')->assertStatus(200);
    }

    public function test_register_not_available()
    {
        $this->get('/register')->assertStatus(404);
        $this->post('/register')->assertStatus(404);
    }
}

File: tests/Feature/CombinedAnalysisTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Services\CombinedMetrics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class CombinedAnalysisTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_linked_only_filter_is_stable_when_unlinked_rows_added()
    {
        // 0. Create company
        $companyId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
            'name' => 'PT Test',
            'code' => 'TEST',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        // 1. Create one employee
        Employee::create([
            'employee_id' => 'E001',
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'company_id' => $companyId,
            'region' => 'Riau',
            'organization_name' => 'IT',
            'job_level_code' => 'A',
            'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            'gender' => 'Male',
        ]);
        $emp = Employee::first();

        // 2. Add 1 linked training record
        DB::table('training_records')->insert([
            'employee_id' => $emp->id,
            'hours' => 10,
            'participant_name' => 'John Doe',
            'nik' => 'E001',
            'year' => 2026,
            'month' => 1,
            'days' => 1,
            'training_name' => 'Test Training',
        ]);

        // Calculate metrics
        $service = new CombinedMetrics;
        $request = new Request;
        $filter = new EmployeeFilter;

        $metricsBefore = $service->getMetrics($request, $filter);

        // Verify some initial metrics
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['coverage']['region'][0]['trained']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['coverage']['region'][0]['total']);
        $this->assertEquals(10, $metricsBefore['hours']['gender'][0]['total_hours']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['banner']['total_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(0, $metricsBefore['banner']['unlinked_count']);

        // 3. Add 5 UNLINKED training records (employee_id IS NULL)
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            DB::table('training_records')->insert([
                'employee_id' => null,
                'hours' => 20,
                'participant_name' => 'Unknown',
                'nik' => null,
                'year' => 2026,
                'month' => 1,
                'days' => 1,
                'training_name' => 'Unlinked Training',
            ]);
        }

        // Calculate metrics again
        $metricsAfter = $service->getMetrics($request, $filter);

        // Banner should change
        $this->assertEquals(6, $metricsAfter['banner']['total_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(5, $metricsAfter['banner']['unlinked_count']);

        // But ACTUAL metrics should NOT change!
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['coverage'], $metricsAfter['coverage']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['hours'], $metricsAfter['hours']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['scatter'], $metricsAfter['scatter']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['company_ranking'], $metricsAfter['company_ranking']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\TenureMetrics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DataEndpointTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->user = User::factory()->create();

        $this->company1Id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'CA', 'name' => 'Company A']);
        $this->company2Id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'CB', 'name' => 'Company B']);

        // Kolom latitude/longitude sudah dihapus; location tanpa koordinat
        $this->location1Id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Location 1']);
        $this->location2Id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L2', 'name' => 'Location 2']);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            ['employee_id' => 'E1', 'name' => 'E1', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E2', 'name' => 'E2', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E3', 'name' => 'E3', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],

            ['employee_id' => 'E4', 'name' => 'E4', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location2Id, 'region' => 'Kalbar', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E5', 'name' => 'E5', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location2Id, 'region' => 'Kalbar', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],

            // Shared location: Location 1 is used by Company B as well
            ['employee_id' => 'E6', 'name' => 'E6', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
        ]);
    }

    public function test_companies_endpoint_returns_correct_shape_and_counts()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonStructure([
            'data' => [
                '*' => ['id', 'code', 'name', 'employee_count', 'location_count', 'region', 'generations'],
            ],
            'total_locations',
        ]);

        // Total unique locations should be 2
        $this->assertEquals(2, $response->json('total_locations'));

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));

        // Company 1 has 3 employees, 1 location
        $c1 = $data->firstWhere('id', $this->company1Id);
        $this->assertEquals(3, $c1['employee_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $c1['location_count']);

        // Company 2 has 3 employees, 2 locations (location 2 and location 1)
        $c2 = $data->firstWhere('id', $this->company2Id);
        $this->assertEquals(3, $c2['employee_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(2, $c2['location_count']);
    }

    public function test_map_locations_endpoint_returns_empty_array()
    {
        // /data/map/locations masih ada tapi mengembalikan array kosong (peta sudah dihapus)
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/map/locations');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertExactJson([]);
    }

    public function test_employee_detail_endpoint_creates_audit_log()
    {
        $employee = Employee::first();
        $this->assertNotNull($employee, 'No employee found');

        // Clear existing audit logs just in case
        DB::table('audit_logs')->truncate();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson("/data/employees/{$employee->employee_id}");

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonStructure(['identitas', 'pribadi', 'kepegawaian', 'pelatihan']);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $this->user->id,
            'action' => 'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL',
            'subject_type' => Employee::class,
            'subject_id' => $employee->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_cohort_employees_endpoint_returns_filtered_by_year()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/cohort/2015/employees');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonStructure([
            'data' => [
                '*' => ['id', 'employee_id', 'name', 'job_title_name', 'job_level_code', 'department', 'company_code', 'region', 'gender', 'employment_type', 'join_date'],
            ],
            'total',
            'current_page',
        ]);

        $this->assertEquals(6, $response->json('total'));

        // Test year without employees
        $emptyResponse = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/cohort/1999/employees');
        $emptyResponse->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertEquals(0, $emptyResponse->json('total'));
    }

    public function test_tenure_metrics_waves_includes_gender_distribution()
    {
        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            'employee_id' => 'E7',
            'name' => 'E7 Female',
            'company_id' => $this->company1Id,
            'location_id' => $this->location1Id,
            'region' => 'Riau',
            'gender' => 'Female',
            'birth_date' => '1992-05-10',
            'join_date' => '2015-03-01',
        ]);

        $service = new TenureMetrics;
        $metrics = $service->getMetrics(new Request, new EmployeeFilter);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($metrics['waves']);
        $wave2015 = collect($metrics['waves'])->firstWhere('year', 2015);
        $this->assertNotNull($wave2015);
        $this->assertEquals(6, $wave2015['genders']['Male'] ?? 0);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $wave2015['genders']['Female'] ?? 0);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Unknown', $wave2015['genders']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FilterOptionsTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_it_returns_all_filter_options_for_authenticated_user(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/data/filter-options');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonStructure([
                'regions',

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Employee;

class FilterTest extends TestCase

        $companyId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
            'code' => 'TESTCOMP',

        $locationId = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId([
            'code' => 'TESTLOC',
            'name' => 'Test Location',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            [
                'employee_id' => 'EMP01',
                'name' => 'Employee 1',
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'region' => 'Riau',
                'job_level_code' => 'MGR',
                'employment_type' => 'PERM',
                'gender' => 'Male',
                'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
                'join_date' => '2015-01-01',
            ],
            [
                'employee_id' => 'EMP02',
                'name' => 'Employee 2',
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'region' => 'Kalbar',
                'job_level_code' => 'STF',
                'employment_type' => 'CONT',
                'gender' => 'Female',
                'birth_date' => '1995-01-01',
                'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_region()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Riau');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_job_level()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?job_level_code=MGR');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_employment_type()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?employment_type=CONT');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_combination_filters()
    {
        // Should return 0 employees if combination does not exist
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Kalbar&job_level_code=MGR');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(0, collect($data)->sum('employee_count'));

        // Should return 1 employee if combination matches
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Kalbar&job_level_code=STF');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, collect($data)->sum('employee_count'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Import\EmployeeImporter;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ImportTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_import_is_idempotent()
    {
        // Setup dummy CSV for employee
        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n".
                  'E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau';

        $trainCsv = "NIK;Nama;Jenis Kelamin;Nama PT;Department;lokasi Kerja;Group;REGION;GOL;Jabatan;Tgl;Bln;Thn;Jml Hari;Jam Pelatihan;Nama Pelatihan;Instruktur;Tempat Pelatihan;Reg / Non Reg;Keterangan;Internal/Eksternal;Level;Periode\n".
                    'E001;John Doe;Male;Comp 1;Dept 1;Loc 1;G1;Riau;Gol 1;Manager;;JAN;2023;1;8;Training 1;Inst 1;Venue 1;Reguler;;Internal;Level 1;Q1';

        $empFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        $trainFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'trn_');
        file_put_contents($empFile, $empCsv);
        file_put_contents($trainFile, $trainCsv);

        $empImporter = new EmployeeImporter;
        $trainImporter = new TrainingImporter;

        $empFileUploaded = new UploadedFile($empFile, 'emp.csv', 'text/csv', null, true);
        $trainFileUploaded = new UploadedFile($trainFile, 'train.csv', 'text/csv', null, true);

        $empBatch1 = $empImporter->import($empFileUploaded);
        $trainBatch1 = $trainImporter->import($trainFileUploaded);

        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('employees')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, $empBatch1->rows_imported);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $trainBatch1->rows_imported);

        // Run again, should be idempotent
        $empBatch2 = $empImporter->import($empFileUploaded);
        $trainBatch2 = $trainImporter->import($trainFileUploaded);

        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('employees')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, $empBatch2->rows_imported);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $trainBatch2->rows_imported);

        unlink($empFile);
        unlink($trainFile);
    }

    public function test_import_rejects_invalid_headers()

    }

                  "E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau\n".
                  'E002;Jane Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Female;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau';

    public function test_upsert_employee_and_warnings()
    {
        $compId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'C99', 'name' => 'Old']);
        $locId = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L99', 'name' => 'Old Loc']);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            'employee_id' => 'E999', 'name' => 'Old', 'company_id' => $compId, 'location_id' => $locId,
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'employment_type' => 'PERMANENT',
            'gender' => 'Male', 'marital_status' => 'Single', 'religion' => 'Islam', 'region' => 'Riau',
        ]);

        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n".
                  'E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau';
        $file = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        file_put_contents($file, $empCsv);

        $importer = new EmployeeImporter;
        $batch = $importer->import(new UploadedFile($file, 'test.csv', 'text/csv', null, true));

        $warnings = is_string($batch->warnings) ? json_decode($batch->warnings, true) : $batch->warnings;
        $hasMissingWarning = false;
        if ($warnings) {
            foreach ($warnings as $type => $w) {
                if ($type === 'missing_from_file' || (isset($w['type']) && $w['type'] === 'missing_from_file')) {
                    $hasMissingWarning = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertTrue($hasMissingWarning);
        unlink($file);
    }

    public function test_import_employee_with_replace_all_cleans_old_records()
    {
        $compId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'C99', 'name' => 'Old']);
        $locId = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L99', 'name' => 'Old Loc']);

        // Insert old employee (Level A)
        $oldEmpId = DB::table('employees')->insertGetId([
            'employee_id' => 'E999', 'name' => 'Old Employee', 'company_id' => $compId, 'location_id' => $locId,
            'job_level_code' => 'A', 'join_date' => '2020-01-01', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
            'employment_type' => 'PERMANENT', 'gender' => 'Male', 'marital_status' => 'Single', 'religion' => 'Islam', 'region' => 'Riau',
        ]);

        // Insert a training record linked to this employee
        DB::table('training_records')->insert([
            'nik' => 'E001',
            'employee_id' => $oldEmpId,
            'participant_name' => 'John Doe',
            'training_name' => 'Safety 101',
            'year' => 2024,
            'month' => 5,
            'hours' => 8,
        ]);

        // New CSV contains only E001 (Level C)
        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n".
                  'E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;C;T1;Supervisor;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau';
        $file = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        file_put_contents($file, $empCsv);

        $importer = new EmployeeImporter;
        // Import with replaceAll = true
        $batch = $importer->import(new UploadedFile($file, 'test.csv', 'text/csv', null, true), null, true);

        // Old employee E999 must no longer exist in DB
        $this->assertEquals(0, DB::table('employees')->where('employee_id', 'E999')->count());
        // Only 1 employee exists (E001)
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('employees')->count());
        $newEmployee = DB::table('employees')->where('employee_id', 'E001')->first();
        $this->assertNotNull($newEmployee);
        $this->assertEquals('C', $newEmployee->job_level_code);

        // Training record should now be relinked to new employee E001
        $trainingRecord = DB::table('training_records')->first();
        $this->assertEquals($newEmployee->id, $trainingRecord->employee_id);

        unlink($file);
    }

    public function test_reset_data_endpoint_cleans_employees_safely()

            'month' => 6,

    public function test_field_mapping_clean_rules()

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProfileTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_profile_page_is_displayed(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/pengaturan');

        $response->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_profile_information_can_be_updated(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->patch('/pengaturan/profil', [
            'name' => 'Test User Updated',
            'email' => 'testupdated@example.com',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $response->assertRedirect();

        $user->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('Test User Updated', $user->name);
        $this->assertSame('testupdated@example.com', $user->email);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'action' => 'account.updated',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_profile_information_rejects_invalid_email(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->patch('/pengaturan/profil', [
            'name' => 'Test User',
            'email' => 'not-an-email',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('email');
    }

    public function test_password_can_be_updated(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_lama',
            'password' => 'password_baru_panjang',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password_baru_panjang',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $response->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertTrue(Hash::check('password_baru_panjang', $user->refresh()->password));

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'action' => 'account.password_changed',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_correct_password_must_be_provided_to_update_password(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_salah',
            'password' => 'password_baru_panjang',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password_baru_panjang',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('current_password');
    }

    public function test_new_password_must_be_at_least_12_characters(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_lama',
            'password' => 'pendek',
            'password_confirmation' => 'pendek',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('password');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\StaffResign;

    public function test_authenticated_user_can_view_resignation_page()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        StaffResign::create([
            'employee_id' => '1001',
            'nama' => 'Ahmad Test',
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            'resign_date' => '2026-03-15',
            'jabatan' => 'Asisten Kebun',
            'kebun' => 'CPK',
            'deskripsi_resign' => 'Pindah kerja',
            'jenis_resign' => 'VOLUNTARY',
            'cluster_resign' => 'Pindah Perusahaan',
            'alumni' => 'Alumni',
            'keterangan' => 'Asisten Kebun - I/2020',
            'region' => 'Riau',
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/resign');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $props = $response->original->getData()['page']['props'];

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('metrics', $props);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('records', $props);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $props['records']['total']);
        $this->assertEquals('Ahmad Test', $props['records']['data'][0]['nama']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $props['metrics']['kpis']['total']['count_2026']);
    }

            'employee_id' => '1002',
            'nama' => 'Budi Kalbar',
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            'resign_date' => '2026-04-10',
            'jabatan' => 'Asisten Kebun',
            'kebun' => 'SAGM',
            'deskripsi_resign' => 'Alasan pribadi',
            'jenis_resign' => 'VOLUNTARY',
            'cluster_resign' => 'Keluarga',
            'alumni' => 'Non Alumni',
            'keterangan' => 'Batch 2',
            'region' => 'Kalbar',
        ]);

        // 1. Array format: region[] = Riau
        $response1 = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/resign?region[]=Riau');
        $response1->assertStatus(200);
        $props1 = $response1->original->getData()['page']['props'];
        $this->assertEquals(1, $props1['records']['total']);
        $this->assertEquals('Ahmad Riau', $props1['records']['data'][0]['nama']);

        // 2. Nested array format (as sent by qs/querySerializer): region[0][0] = Riau
        $response2 = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/resign?region[0][0]=Riau');
        $response2->assertStatus(200);
        $props2 = $response2->original->getData()['page']['props'];
        $this->assertEquals(1, $props2['records']['total']);
        $this->assertEquals('Ahmad Riau', $props2['records']['data'][0]['nama']);

        // 3. Dashboard deferred summary endpoint with nested region
        $metricsService = new ResignationMetrics;
        $req = Request::create('/dashboard?region[0][0]=Riau');
        $summary = $metricsService->getSummary($req, 100);
        $this->assertIsArray($summary);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $summary['total_curr']);
    }
}
