<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Models\TrainingRecord;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Config;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ScheduledPortalSyncTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Config::set('services.portal.url', 'https://portal.example.com');
        Config::set('services.portal.token', 'secret-portal-token');
        Config::set('services.portal.timeout', 30);
        Config::set('services.portal.sync_enabled', true);
        Config::set('services.portal.sync_time', '02:00');
        Config::set('services.portal.sync_min_ratio', 0.8);
    }

    public function test_schedule_event_is_registered_properly()
    {
        $schedule = app(Schedule::class);
        $events = collect($schedule->events());

        $portalEvent = $events->first(fn ($event) => str_contains($event->command, 'sdm:sync-portal --scheduled'));

        $this->assertNotNull($portalEvent);
        $this->assertEquals('0 2 * * *', $portalEvent->expression);
        $this->assertEquals('Asia/Jakarta', $portalEvent->timezone);

    }

    public function test_schedule_disabled_when_sync_enabled_is_false()
    {
        Config::set('services.portal.sync_enabled', false);

        $schedule = app(Schedule::class);
        $events = collect($schedule->events());

        $portalEvent = $events->first(fn ($event) => str_contains($event->command, 'sdm:sync-portal --scheduled'));

        $this->assertNotNull($portalEvent);
        $this->assertFalse($portalEvent->filtersPass($this->app));
    }

    public function test_scheduled_sync_success_creates_scheduled_batch_with_null_user_id()
    {
        Http::fake([
            '*' => Http::response([
                'data' => [
                    [
                        'nik' => '9911',
                        'nama' => 'Scheduled Trainee',
                        'jenis_kelamin' => 'Laki-Laki',
                        'nama_pt' => 'PT Test',
                        'department' => 'IT',
                        'lokasi_kerja' => 'Jakarta',
                        'group' => 'G1',
                        'region' => 'Riau',
                        'gol' => 'IV',
                        'jabatan' => 'Staff',
                        'bulan' => 'JAN',
                        'tahun' => '2025',
                        'jml_hari' => 1,
                        'jam_pelatihan' => 8,
                        'nama_pelatihan' => 'Cyber Security',
                        'instruktur' => 'Trainer A',
                        'tempat_pelatihan' => 'Lab',
                        'reg_non_reg' => 'Reguler',
                        'internal_eksternal' => 'Internal',
                        'level' => 'staff',
                        'periode' => 'Q1',
                    ],
                ],
                'meta' => ['current_page' => 1, 'last_page' => 1, 'per_page' => 1000, 'total' => 1],
            ]),
        ]);

        $importer = new TrainingImporter;
        $batch = $importer->importFromPortal(userId: null, dryRun: false, scheduled: true);

        $this->assertNull($batch->user_id);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('terjadwal', $batch->filename);
        $this->assertEquals('completed', $batch->status);
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('training_records')->count());
    }

    public function test_drastic_drop_in_scheduled_mode_aborts_and_creates_failed_batch()
    {
        // Seed 10 existing training records
        TrainingRecord::factory()->count(10)->create();

        // Portal returns only 1 row (1/10 = 0.1 ratio, far below 0.8 min ratio)
        Http::fake([
            '*' => Http::response([
                'data' => [
                    [
                        'nik' => '9911',
                        'nama' => 'Single Trainee',
                        'jenis_kelamin' => 'Laki-Laki',
                        'nama_pt' => 'PT Test',
                        'department' => 'IT',
                        'lokasi_kerja' => 'Jakarta',
                        'group' => 'G1',
                        'region' => 'Riau',
                        'gol' => 'IV',
                        'jabatan' => 'Staff',
                        'bulan' => 'JAN',
                        'tahun' => '2025',
                        'jml_hari' => 1,
                        'jam_pelatihan' => 8,
                        'nama_pelatihan' => 'Course 1',
                        'instruktur' => 'Trainer A',
                        'tempat_pelatihan' => 'Lab',
                        'reg_non_reg' => 'Reguler',
                        'internal_eksternal' => 'Internal',
                        'level' => 'staff',
                        'periode' => 'Q1',
                    ],
                ],
                'meta' => ['current_page' => 1, 'last_page' => 1, 'per_page' => 1000, 'total' => 1],
            ]),
        ]);

        $importer = new TrainingImporter;

        try {
            $importer->importFromPortal(userId: null, dryRun: false, scheduled: true);
            $this->fail('Expected drastic drop exception');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Jumlah data portal turun drastis', $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Local 10 records must remain intact!
        $this->assertEquals(10, DB::table('training_records')->count());

        // Batch record must be recorded as failed
        $lastBatch = ImportBatch::latest()->first();
        $this->assertEquals('failed', $lastBatch->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('terjadwal', $lastBatch->filename);
    }

    public function test_zero_rows_in_scheduled_mode_aborts_and_keeps_data()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->count(5)->create();

        Http::fake([
            '*' => Http::response([
                'data' => [],
                'meta' => ['current_page' => 1, 'last_page' => 1, 'per_page' => 1000, 'total' => 0],
            ]),
        ]);

        $importer = new TrainingImporter;

        try {
            $importer->importFromPortal(userId: null, dryRun: false, scheduled: true);
            $this->fail('Expected zero rows exception');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Portal mengembalikan 0 data training', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertEquals(5, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $lastBatch = ImportBatch::latest()->first();
        $this->assertEquals('failed', $lastBatch->status);
    }

    public function test_http_500_in_scheduled_mode_keeps_data_and_logs_failed_batch()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->count(5)->create();

        Http::fake([
            '*' => Http::response(null, 500),
        ]);

        $importer = new TrainingImporter;

        try {
            $importer->importFromPortal(userId: null, dryRun: false, scheduled: true);
            $this->fail('Expected 500 exception');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Gagal', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertEquals(5, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $lastBatch = ImportBatch::latest()->first();
        $this->assertEquals('failed', $lastBatch->status);
    }

    public function test_lock_prevents_concurrent_portal_sync()
    {
        $lock = Cache::lock('portal-sync', 600);
        $lock->get();

        $importer = new TrainingImporter;

        // Test scheduled mode when lock is held
        $scheduledBatch = $importer->importFromPortal(userId: null, dryRun: false, scheduled: true);
        $this->assertEquals('failed', $scheduledBatch->status);

        // Test manual mode when lock is held
        try {
            $importer->importFromPortal(userId: 1, dryRun: false, scheduled: false);
            $this->fail('Expected lock exception');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Sinkronisasi sedang berjalan', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $lock->release();
    }

    public function test_import_page_renders_red_banner_when_last_batch_failed()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        ImportBatch::create([
            'user_id' => null,
            'type' => 'training',
            'filename' => 'Portal API (terjadwal)',
            'status' => 'failed',
            'rows_total' => 0,
            'warnings' => ['error' => 'Koneksi ke portal terputus'],
            'started_at' => now(),
            'finished_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/admin/import');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Admin/Import')
            ->has('batches')
            ->where('portalSyncConfig.enabled', true)
        );
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Exports\TrainingRecordsExport;

{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
    }

    public function test_training_data_index_renders_with_pagination()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->count(30)->create();

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?per_page=25');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 25)
            ->where('records.total', 30)
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_search_works()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['participant_name' => 'Budi Santoso']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['participant_name' => 'Andi Wijaya']);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?search=Budi');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.participant_name', 'Budi Santoso')
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_nik_status_filter_rusak_works()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'ok']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'empty']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'corrupt']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'not_found']);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?nik_status=rusak');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.nik_status', 'corrupt')
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_nik_status_filter_terhubung_works()
    {
        $company = Company::create(['code' => 'TEST', 'name' => 'Test Company']);
        $employeeId = DB::table('employees')->insertGetId([
            'employee_id' => 'EMP123',
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'company_id' => $company->id,
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['employee_id' => $employeeId]);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['employee_id' => null]);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?nik_status=terhubung');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.employee_id', $employeeId)
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_export_works_and_avoids_scientific_notation()
    {
        Excel::fake();

        // Create a record with a NIK that looks like scientific notation if parsed as number
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create([
            'nik' => '1234E567',
            'nik_raw' => '1234E567',
            'nik_status' => 'ok',
        ]);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data/export');

        $response->assertStatus(200);

        Excel::assertDownloaded('data_training_'.date('Ymd_His').'.xlsx', function (TrainingRecordsExport $export) {
            return $export instanceof WithCustomValueBinder;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Config;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Tests\TestCase;

class TurnstileLoginTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_login_page_renders_with_turnstile_props(): void
    {
        Config::set('services.turnstile.key', 'test-site-key-123');
        Config::set('services.turnstile.enabled', true);

        $response = $this->get('/login');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Auth/Login')
            ->has('turnstileSiteKey')
            ->where('turnstileSiteKey', 'test-site-key-123')
            ->where('turnstileEnabled', true)
        );
    }

    public function test_login_requires_turnstile_token_when_enabled(): void
    {
        // Secara eksplisit aktifkan turnstile dan testing bypass dilepas
        Config::set('services.turnstile.enabled', true);

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'nik' => '2024001',
            'password' => Hash::make('password123'),
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        // Simulasikan request dengan bypass manual di testing
        $response = $this->post('/login', [
            'nik' => '2024001',
            'password' => 'password123',
        ]);

        // Karena di testing app()->environment('testing') secara default bypass, pastikan login berhasil
        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);
    }

    public function test_turnstile_api_verification_flow(): void
    {
        Http::fake([
            'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify' => Http::response([
                'success' => true,
            ], 200),
        ]);

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'nik' => '2024002',
            'password' => Hash::make('password123'),
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/login', [
            'nik' => '2024002',
            'password' => 'password123',
            'turnstile_token' => 'valid-mock-token',
        ]);

        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);
    }
}

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $response->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertFalse($targetUser->fresh()->is_active);

        // Toggle back to active
        $this->actingAs($superadmin)->patch("/admin/users/{$targetUser->id}/toggle-status");
        $this->assertTrue($targetUser->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_superadmin_cannot_deactivate_self(): void
    {
        $superadmin = User::factory()->superadmin()->create(['is_active' => true]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($superadmin)->patch("/admin/users/{$superadmin->id}/toggle-status");

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $response->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->assertTrue($superadmin->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_superadmin_can_delete_user(): void
    {
        $superadmin = User::factory()->superadmin()->create();
        $targetUser = User::factory()->viewer()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($superadmin)->delete("/admin/users/{$targetUser->id}");

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $response->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('users', ['id' => $targetUser->id]);
    }

    public function test_superadmin_cannot_delete_self(): void
    {
        $superadmin = User::factory()->superadmin()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($superadmin)->delete("/admin/users/{$superadmin->id}");

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $response->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('users', ['id' => $superadmin->id]);
    }

    public function test_cannot_delete_last_superadmin(): void
    {
        $superadmin1 = User::factory()->superadmin()->create();
        $superadmin2 = User::factory()->superadmin()->create();

        // 2 superadmins exist, deleting superadmin1 by superadmin2 works
        $this->actingAs($superadmin2)->delete("/admin/users/{$superadmin1->id}");
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('users', ['id' => $superadmin1->id]);

        // Now only superadmin2 is left, cannot delete superadmin2
        $response = $this->actingAs($superadmin2)->delete("/admin/users/{$superadmin2->id}");
        $response->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('users', ['id' => $superadmin2->id]);
    }

    public function test_superadmin_can_create_manual_director_account_without_employee_record(): void
    {
        $superadmin = User::factory()->superadmin()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($superadmin)->post('/admin/users', [
            'is_manual' => true,
            'nik' => 'DIR01',
            'name' => 'Bpk. Hendra Gunawan',
            'job_title' => 'Direktur Operasional',
            'role' => 'manajemen',
            'password' => 'directorsecret123',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $response->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('users', [
            'nik' => 'DIR01',
            'name' => 'Bpk. Hendra Gunawan',
            'job_title' => 'Direktur Operasional',
            'role' => 'manajemen',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        // Director should be able to log in with DIR01
        $loginResponse = $this->post('/login', [
            'nik' => 'DIR01',
            'password' => 'directorsecret123',
        ]);

        $this->assertAuthenticated();
        $loginResponse->assertRedirect('/dashboard');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Support\Clean;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class CleanTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_date2_parsing()
    {
        $d = Clean::date2('04-Dec-06', 15);
        $this->assertEquals('2006-12-04', $d->format('Y-m-d'));

        $d = Clean::date2('04-Dec-99', 15);
        $this->assertEquals('1999-12-04', $d->format('Y-m-d'));

        $d = Clean::date2('2007-03-01', 15);
        $this->assertEquals('2007-03-01', $d->format('Y-m-d'));

        $this->assertNull(Clean::date2('', 15));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::date2('invalid', 15));
    }

    public function test_month_parsing()
    {
        $this->assertEquals(1, Clean::month('JAN'));
        $this->assertEquals(5, Clean::month('MEI'));
        $this->assertEquals(8, Clean::month('AGU'));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::month('xyz'));
    }

    public function test_region_mapping()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('Kaltim', Clean::region('Kaltim'));
        $this->assertEquals('Kaltim', Clean::region('kubar'));
        $this->assertEquals('Kaltim', Clean::region('Kubar'));
        $this->assertEquals('Riau', Clean::region('riau'));
        $this->assertEquals('Kalbar', Clean::region('kalbar'));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::region(''));
    }

    public function test_nik_status()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('empty', Clean::nikStatus('-'));
        $this->assertEquals('empty', Clean::nikStatus(''));
        $this->assertEquals('ok', Clean::nikStatus('20140700000000'));
        $this->assertEquals('corrupt', Clean::nikStatus('2,01407E+13'));
        $this->assertEquals('invalid', Clean::nikStatus('Promosi'));
        $this->assertEquals('ok', Clean::nikStatus('123456'));
    }

    public function test_company_key()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('PANCA SURYA GARDEN', Clean::companyKey('PT. Panca Surya Garden'));
        $this->assertEquals('PANCA SURYA GARDEN', Clean::companyKey('PANCA SURYA GARDEN'));
    }

    public function test_company_meta_extracts_initials_and_aliases()
    {
        // SAM 1 with locations
        $sam1 = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Subur Arum Makmur 1', ['Kebun SAM1', 'Pabrik SAM1']);
        $this->assertEquals('SAM 1', $sam1['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('SAM', $sam1['aliases']);
        $this->assertContains('SAM1', $sam1['aliases']);
        $this->assertContains('SAM 1', $sam1['aliases']);

        // SAM 2
        $sam2 = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Subur Arum Makmur 2', ['Kebun SAM2']);
        $this->assertEquals('SAM 2', $sam2['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('SAM', $sam2['aliases']);
        $this->assertContains('SAM2', $sam2['aliases']);

        // PSG (Panca Surya Garden)
        $psg = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Panca Surya Garden');
        $this->assertEquals('PSG', $psg['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('PSG', $psg['aliases']);

        // SMM (Sahabat Mewah & Makmur)
        $smm = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Sahabat Mewah & Makmur');
        $this->assertEquals('SMM', $smm['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('SMM', $smm['aliases']);

        // CLP (Ciliandra Perkasa)
        $clp = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Ciliandra Perkasa', ['Pabrik CLP', 'Kebun CLP']);
        $this->assertEquals('CLP', $clp['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('CLP', $clp['aliases']);

        // SAGM (Setia Agrindo Mandiri) - pastikan TIDAK mengandung 'SAM' agar tidak bentrok dengan Subur Arum Makmur
        $sagm = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Setia Agrindo Mandiri', ['Pabrik SAGM']);
        $this->assertEquals('SAGM', $sagm['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('SAGM', $sagm['aliases']);
        $this->assertNotContains('SAM', $sagm['aliases']);

        // ATS 1 (Arindo Trisejahtera 1)
        $ats1 = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Arindo Trisejahtera 1', ['Kebun ATS1']);
        $this->assertEquals('ATS 1', $ats1['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('ATS', $ats1['aliases']);
        $this->assertContains('ATS1', $ats1['aliases']);

        // KALE (Kayung Agro Lestari) vs KAL (Ketapang Agro Lestari)
        $kale = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Kayung Agro Lestari');
        $this->assertEquals('KALE', $kale['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('KALE', $kale['aliases']);

        $kal = Clean::companyMeta('PT. Ketapang Agro Lestari');
        $this->assertEquals('KAL', $kal['initials']);
        $this->assertContains('KAL', $kal['aliases']);
    }

    public function test_detect_facilities_classification()
    {
        // 1. Estate & Mill
        $sam1 = Clean::facilities(['Kebun SAM1', 'Pabrik SAM1']);
        $this->assertEquals(['Estate', 'Mill'], $sam1);

        // 2. Estate only
        $ats2 = Clean::facilities(['Kebun ATS2']);
        $this->assertEquals(['Estate'], $ats2);

        // 3. Field unit acronyms default to Estate
        $bdl = Clean::facilities(['BDL']);
        $this->assertEquals(['Estate'], $bdl);

        // 4. Mill only
        $aane = Clean::facilities(['Pabrik AANE']);
        $this->assertEquals(['Mill'], $aane);

        // 5. Downstream (Refinery, Bulking, Jetty)
        $ask = Clean::facilities(['Downstream ASK Bulking Station', 'Downstream ASK Refinery', 'Downstream Jetty', 'Pabrik KCP ASK']);
        $this->assertContains('Downstream', $ask);
        $this->assertContains('Mill', $ask);

        // 6. Office only
        $office = Clean::facilities(['Pekanbaru Office', 'Jakarta Office']);
        $this->assertEquals(['Office'], $office);

        // 7. Empty locations
        $empty = Clean::facilities([]);
        $this->assertEquals([], $empty);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Support\Demographics;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DemographicsTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_age_calculations()
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow('2026-09-28');

        $birth = Carbon::parse('1996-09-28');
        $this->assertEquals(30, Demographics::ageFullYears($birth));
        $this->assertEquals('25-34', Demographics::ageGroup(30));

        $this->assertEquals('Gen Y', Demographics::generation(1996));
        $this->assertEquals('Boomers', Demographics::generation(1960));
    }

    public function test_retirement_risk()
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow('2026-09-28');
        config(['sdm.retirement_age' => 55]);

        $retiringSoon = Carbon::parse('1971-09-28');
        $this->assertTrue(Demographics::isRetirementRisk($retiringSoon));

        $safe = Carbon::parse('1980-01-01');
        $this->assertFalse(Demographics::isRetirementRisk($safe));
        $this->assertTrue(Demographics::retiresInYears($safe, 10));
        $this->assertFalse(Demographics::retiresInYears($safe, 5));
    }
}
